abstract.text: This study is the first to examine the effects of medical marijuana laws (MMLs) on body weight, physical wellness, and exercise. Using data from the 1990 to 2012 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and a difference-in-difference approach, we find that the enforcement of MMLs is associated with a 2% to 6% decline in the probability of obesity. We find some evidence of age-specific heterogeneity in mechanisms. For older individuals, MML-induced increases in physical mobility may be a relatively important channel, while for younger individuals, a reduction in consumption of alcohol, a substitute for marijuana, appears more important. These findings are consistent with the hypothesis that MMLs may be more likely to induce marijuana use for health-related reasons among older individuals, and cause substitution toward lower-calorie recreational 'highs' among younger individuals. Our estimates suggest that MMLs induce a $58 to $115 per-person annual reduction in obesity-related medical costs.

10.1002/hec.3267.abstractZh: 本研究首次探讨了医用大麻法律对体重、身体健康和锻炼的影响。通过1990至2012年行为风险因素监测系统的数据以及差异分解方法，我们发现医用大麻法律的实施与肥胖概率下降2%至6%之间存在关联。我们发现年龄因素可能对机制产生影响。对于年长人群而言，医用大麻导致的身体活动增加可能是一个重要的影响因素；而对于年轻人群而言，减少酒精消费（大麻的替代品）似乎更为重要。这些发现与以下假设一致：医用大麻法律可能更有可能促使年长人群出于健康原因使用大麻，而年轻人群则可能会转向低热量娱乐性“兴奋感”替代方式。我们的估计表明，医用大麻法律每年可使每人减少58至115美元的肥胖相关医疗费用。

abstract.text: This study uses data from the 2004-2006 Australian National Survey of Adult Oral Health and a simultaneous equation framework to investigate the interrelationships between dental health, private dental insurance and the use of dental services. The results show that insurance participation is influenced by social and demographic factors, health and health behaviours. In turn, these factors affect the use of dental services, both directly and through insurance participation. Our findings confirm that affordability is a major barrier to visiting the dentist for oral health maintenance and treatment. Our results suggest that having supplementary insurance is associated with some 56 percentage points higher probability of seeing the dentist in the general population. For those who did not have private insurance cover, we predict that conditional on them facing the same insurance conditions, on average, having insurance would increase their visits to the dentist by 43 percentage points. The uninsured in the survey have lower income, worse oral health and lower rates of preventive and treatment visits.

10.1002/hec.3272.abstractZh: 本研究利用2004-2006年澳大利亚全国成人口腔健康调查的数据，并采用联立方程框架来探讨口腔健康、私人牙科保险与牙科服务使用之间的相互关系。研究结果表明，保险参与率受到社会与人口统计因素、健康状况及健康行为的影响。这些因素又通过直接方式或经由保险参与率对牙科服务的使用产生影响。我们的研究发现证实，经济负担是患者寻求口腔健康维护和治疗的主要障碍。研究还表明，在普通人群中，拥有补充保险的人看牙医的概率高出约56个百分点。对于没有私人保险覆盖的人群来说，假设他们面临相同的保险条件，拥有保险平均会使他们看牙医的频率增加43个百分点。调查中的无保险人群收入较低，口腔健康状况较差，且预防性和治疗性就诊率也较低。

abstract.text: This paper considers determinants of physical functional limitations in daily-life activities at high ages. Specifically, we quantify the extent to which the impact of adverse life events on this outcome is larger in case of exposure to adverse economic conditions early in life. Adverse life events include bereavement, severe illness in the family, and the onset of chronic diseases. We use a longitudinal data set of individuals born in the first decades of the 20th century. The business cycle around birth is used as an indicator of economic conditions early in life. We find that the extent to which functional limitations suffer from the onset of chronic diseases is larger if the individual was born in a recession. The long-run effect of economic conditions early in life on functional limitations at high ages runs primarily via this life event.

10.1002/hec.3275.abstractZh: 本文探讨了高龄人群在日常生活活动中身体功能受限的决定因素。具体而言，我们量化了不良生活事件对这一结果的影响程度，其中在早年面临不良经济条件的情况下，这种影响更为显著。不良生活事件包括丧亲、家庭成员严重疾病以及慢性病的出现。我们使用了20世纪初期出生的个体的纵向数据集，并将出生时的经济状况作为早期经济条件的指标。研究发现，如果个体出生在经济衰退时期，因慢性病导致的功能受限程度会更大。早年经济条件对高龄人群功能受限的长期影响主要通过这一生活事件来体现。

abstract.text: Decisions about prescribed contraception are typically the result of a consultation between a woman and her doctor. In order to better understand contraceptive choice within this environment, stated preference methods are utilized to ask doctors about what contraceptive options they would discuss with different types of women. The role of doctors is to confine their discussion to a subset of products that best match their patient. This subset of options forms the consideration set from which the ultimate recommendation is made. Given the existence of consideration sets we address the issue of how to model appropriately the ultimate recommendations. The estimated models enable us to characterize doctor recommendations and how they vary with patient attributes and to highlight where recommendations are clear and when they are uncertain. The results also indicate systematic variation in recommendations across different types of doctors, and in particular we observe that some doctors are reluctant to embrace new products and instead recommend those that are more familiar. Such effects are one possible explanation for the relatively low uptake of more cost effective longer acting reversible contraceptives and indicate that further education and training of doctors may be warranted.

10.1002/hec.3276.abstractZh: 关于避孕措施的决策通常是女性与医生之间的协商结果。为了更好地理解在这种环境下的避孕选择，采用陈述偏好方法来询问医生会与不同类型的女性讨论哪些避孕选项。医生的作用是将讨论范围限定在最能匹配患者需求的几种产品上。这些选项构成了最终推荐的基础。鉴于存在多种考虑因素，我们需要研究如何恰当地对最终推荐进行建模。通过估算模型，我们可以描述医生的推荐方式及其如何随患者属性而变化，并明确哪些推荐是明确的，哪些是不确定的。研究结果还表明，不同类型的医生在推荐上存在系统性差异，特别是有些医生不愿采用新的产品，而更倾向于推荐那些更为熟悉的产品。这种效应可能是解释为什么更经济、长效且可逆的避孕措施被较少采用的原因之一，这表明可能需要对医生进行更多的教育和培训。

abstract.text: Risk equalization formulas have been refined since their introduction about two decades ago. Because of the complexity and the abundance of possible interactions between the variables used, hardly any interactions are considered. A regression tree is used to systematically search for interactions, a methodologically new approach in risk equalization. Analyses are based on a data set of nearly 2.9 million individuals from a major German social health insurer. A two-step approach is applied: In the first step a regression tree is built on the basis of the learning data set. Terminal nodes characterized by more than one morbidity-group-split represent interaction effects of different morbidity groups. In the second step the 'traditional' weighted least squares regression equation is expanded by adding interaction terms for all interactions detected by the tree, and regression coefficients are recalculated. The resulting risk adjustment formula shows an improvement in the adjusted R 2 from 25.43% to 25.81% on the evaluation data set. Predictive ratios are calculated for subgroups affected by the interactions. The R 2 improvement detected is only marginal. According to the sample level performance measures used, not involving a considerable number of morbidity interactions forms no relevant loss in accuracy.

10.1002/hec.3277.abstractZh: 自二十年前引入风险均衡公式以来，其方法已经得到了改进。由于变量之间存在的复杂性和多种可能的相互作用，实际上很少有相互作用被考虑在内。本研究采用了回归树方法来系统地寻找这些相互作用，这是一种在风险均衡领域的新方法。分析基于来自德国一家主要社会健康保险公司的数据集，该数据集包含近290万个体数据。研究采用了两步法：第一步是基于学习数据集构建回归树。具有多个疾病组划分的终端节点代表了不同疾病组的相互作用效应。第二步中，通过添加由树检测到的所有相互作用项，对“传统”的加权最小二乘回归方程进行了扩展，并重新计算回归系数。结果表明，调整后的R²从25.43%提高到了25.81%。对于受相互作用影响的子组，还计算了预测比率。虽然检测到的R²改善幅度较小，但根据所使用的样本水平性能指标，不涉及大量疾病相互作用并不会导致准确性的显著下降。

abstract.text: Unemployment has been shown to have adverse effects on different aspects of a person's life, and even the fear of losing a job affects individuals negatively. In addition, not only the individuals directly affected but also their spouses and other family members might be affected. Using data from the German Socio-economic Panel, this study analyzes the relationship between individual job worries and spouse's mental well-being. The empirical results remain robust to different specifications and indicate that fear of job loss is negatively related to spouses' mental well-being and that this relationship seems to be stronger in single-income than in dual-income households.

10.1002/hec.3279.abstractZh: 研究表明，失业会对个人的生活多个方面产生负面影响，甚至对失业的恐惧也会对个体造成不利影响。此外，不仅直接受影响的个人，其配偶和其他家庭成员也可能受到影响。本研究利用德国社会经济调查的数据，分析了个人工作担忧与配偶心理健康之间的关系。实证结果在不同假设下依然保持稳定，表明对失业的恐惧与配偶的心理健康呈负相关，且这种关系在单收入家庭中的表现比双收入家庭更为显著。

abstract.text: At the end of 1998, China launched a government-run mandatory insurance program, the urban employee basic medical insurance (UEBMI), to replace the previous medical insurance system. Using the UEBMI reform in China as a natural experiment, this study identifies variations in patient cost sharing that were imposed by the UEBMI reform and examines their effects on the demand for healthcare services. Using data from the 1991-2006 waves of the China Health and Nutrition Survey, we find that increased cost sharing is associated with decreased outpatient medical care utilization and expenditures but not with decreased inpatient care utilization and expenditures. Patients from low-income and middle-income households or with less severe medical conditions are more sensitive to prices. We observe little impact on patient's health, as measured by self-reported health status.

10.1002/hec.3281.abstractZh: 在1998年底，中国推出了由政府主导的强制性保险计划——城市职工基本医疗保险（UEBMI），以取代之前的医疗保险体系。本研究以中国的UEBMI改革为自然实验，分析了改革带来的患者费用分担方式的差异，并探讨了这些差异对医疗服务需求的影响。通过1991年至2006年中国健康与营养调查的数据分析，我们发现费用分担的增加与门诊医疗服务的利用和支出减少有关，但与住院医疗服务的利用和支出减少无关。来自低收入和中等收入家庭或医疗状况较轻的患者对价格更为敏感。此外，我们观察到患者健康状况方面的影响很小，这一结果通过自我报告的健康状况得以体现。

abstract.text: A common state legislative maneuver to combat rising healthcare costs is to reform the tort system by implementing caps on noneconomic damages awardable in medical malpractice cases. Using the implementation of caps in several states and large database of private insurance claims, I estimate the effect of damage caps on the amount providers charge to insurance companies as well as the amount that insurance companies reimburse providers for medical services. The amount providers charge insurers is unresponsive to tort reform, but the amount that insurers reimburse providers decreases for some procedures.

10.1002/hec.3283.abstractZh: 为了应对不断上升的医疗保健成本，一项常见的州立法举措是通过改革侵权法体系，对医疗过失案件中的非经济损害赔偿金额设定上限。通过几个州实施此类上限措施的情况，并结合大型私人保险索赔数据库，我估算了损害赔偿上限对医疗服务提供者向保险公司收费金额以及保险公司对医疗服务补偿金额的影响。结果显示，医疗服务提供者向保险公司收费的金额并未因侵权法改革而发生变化，但保险公司对某些医疗程序的补偿金额却有所减少。

abstract.text: We examine the relationship between total mortality, deaths due to motor vehicle accidents, cardiovascular disease and measures of business cycles for the USA, using a time-varying parameter model for the periods 1961-2010. We first present a theoretical model to outline the transmission mechanism from business cycles to health status, to motivate our empirical framework and to explain why the relationship between mortality and the economy may have changed over time. We find overwhelming evidence of structural breaks in the relationship between mortality and business cycles over the sample period. Overall, the relationship between total mortality, cardiovascular mortality and the economy has become less procyclical over time and even countercyclical in recent times for certain age groups. Deaths due to motor vehicle accidents have remained strongly procyclical. Using drugs and medical patent data and data on hours worked, we argue that important advances in medical technology and changes in the effects that working hours have on health are important reasons for this time-varying relationship.

10.1002/hec.3285.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国总死亡率、因机动车事故导致的死亡人数、心血管疾病以及商业周期指标之间的关系，采用了1961-2010年期间的时间变化参数模型进行分析。首先，我们提出了一个理论模型，以阐明商业周期与健康状况之间的传递机制，从而为我们的实证框架提供支撑，并解释为什么死亡率与经济之间的关系随时间发生了变化。我们发现，在样本期间，死亡率与商业周期之间的关系存在明显的结构性断裂。总体而言，总死亡率、心血管死亡率与经济之间的关系随着时间的推移变得不那么顺周期，甚至在某些年龄群体中出现了逆周期趋势。因机动车事故导致的死亡人数则仍然表现出强烈的顺周期特征。通过利用药物和医疗专利数据以及工作时间数据，我们认为，医学技术的重大进步以及工作时间对健康影响的变化是这种时间变化关系的重要原因。

abstract.text: In this paper, we estimate the effect of psychiatric disorders on labor market outcomes using a structural equation model with a latent index for mental illness, an approach that acknowledges the continuous nature of psychiatric disability. We also address the potential endogeneity of mental illness using an approach proposed by Lewbel (2012) that relies on heteroscedastic covariance restrictions rather than questionable exclusion restrictions for identification. Data come from the US National Comorbidity Survey - Replication and the National Latino and Asian American Study. We find that mental illness adversely affects employment and labor force participation and also reduces the number of weeks worked and increases work absenteeism. To assist in the interpretation of findings, we simulate the labor market outcomes of individuals meeting diagnostic criteria for mental disorder if they had the same mental health symptom profile as individuals not meeting diagnostic criteria. We estimate potential gains in employment for 3.5 million individuals, and reduction in workplace costs of absenteeism of $21.6 billion due to the resultant improvement in mental health.

10.1002/hec.3286.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用结构方程模型来估计精神疾病对劳动力市场结果的影响，该模型包含一个用于表征精神疾病的潜在指标，这种方法承认了精神疾病残疾的持续性特征。我们还探讨了精神疾病的潜在内生性问题，采用了Lewbel（2012）提出的方法，该方法依赖于异方差协方差限制，而非存在争议的排除限制来进行识别。数据来源于美国国家共病调查-复制研究以及国家拉丁裔和亚裔美国人研究。我们发现，精神疾病会对就业和劳动力参与率产生负面影响，同时会减少工作周数并增加缺勤次数。为了帮助解释研究结果，我们模拟了符合精神疾病诊断标准的个体在面临相同心理健康症状时，其劳动力市场的结果。我们估计了350万个体在就业方面的潜在收益，以及由于心理健康状况改善而导致的216亿美元的工作场所缺勤成本减少。

abstract.text: This study investigated the effects of workplace clean indoor air law (CIAL) coverage on worksite compliance with CIALs, smoking participation among indoor workers, and secondhand smoke (SHS) exposure among nonsmoker indoor workers. This study improved on previous research by using the probability of a resident in a county covered by workplace CIALs, taking into account the state, county, and city legislation. The county-level probability of being covered by a CIAL is merged into two large nationally representative US surveys on smoking behaviors: Tobacco Use Supplement of the Current Population Survey (2001-2010) and Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (2000-2006) based on the year of the survey and respondent's geographic location to identify respondents' CIAL coverage. This study estimated several model specifications of including and not including state or county fixed effects, and the effects of workplace CIALs are consistent across models. Increased coverage by workplace CIALs significantly increased likelihood of reporting a complete smoking restriction by 8% and 10% for the two different datasets, decreased smoking participation among indoor workers by 12%, and decreased SHS exposure among nonsmokers by 28%.

10.1002/hec.3288.abstractZh: 本研究调查了工作场所清洁室内空气法规的覆盖情况对工作场所遵守该法规的影响，以及室内工作者吸烟参与率和非吸烟室内工作者二手烟暴露情况的影响。本研究通过结合各州、县和市的相关立法，利用一个县内被工作场所清洁室内空气法规覆盖的居民比例数据，对先前的研究进行了改进。将县级覆盖比例数据整合到两项具有全国代表性的美国吸烟行为调查数据中：当前人口调查中的烟草使用补充调查（2001-2010年）和基于调查年份和受访者地理位置的行为风险因素监测系统调查（2000-2006年），以识别受访者所在地区的清洁室内空气法规覆盖情况。本研究通过多种模型设定，分别考察了包含和不包括州或县固定效应对结果的影响，结果发现，工作场所清洁室内空气法规的覆盖增加显著提高了报告完全遵守吸烟限制规定的可能性，分别增加了8%和10%；同时，室内工作者的吸烟参与率下降了12%，非吸烟者的二手烟暴露量则下降了28%。

abstract.text: This paper uses unconditional quantile regression to estimate whether smokers' responses to tobacco control policies change across the distribution of smoking levels. I measure smoking behavior with the number of cigarettes smoked per day and also with serum cotinine levels, a continuous biomarker of nicotine exposure, using individual-level repeated cross-section data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Surveys. I find that the cigarette taxes lead to reductions in both the number of cigarettes smoked per day and in smokers' cotinine levels. These reductions are most pronounced in the middle quantiles of both distributions in terms of marginal effects, but most pronounced in the lower quantiles in terms of tax elasticities. I do not find that higher cigarette taxes lead to statistically significant changes in the amount of nicotine smokers ingest from each cigarette.

10.1002/hec.3289.abstractZh: 本文采用无条件分位数回归方法，研究吸烟者对烟草控制政策的反应是否会随着吸烟水平的分布而变化。我们通过每天吸烟的支数以及血清可替宁水平来衡量吸烟行为，其中血清可替宁水平是尼古丁暴露的连续生物标志物。研究基于全国健康与营养调查中的个体重复横截面数据。研究发现，香烟税的增加会导致每天吸烟支数和吸烟者血清可替宁水平的下降。在边际效应方面，这种下降在两种分布的中间分位数最为明显；而在税收弹性方面，则在下限分位数最为显著。研究并未发现较高的香烟税会导致吸烟者每支香烟摄入的尼古丁量发生统计学意义上的显著变化。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether alcohol consumption is related to long-term labor market outcomes. We use twin data for Finnish men and women matched to register-based individual information on employment and earnings. The twin data allow us to account for the shared environmental and genetic factors. The quantity of alcohol consumption was measured by weekly average consumption using self-reported data from three surveys (1975, 1981 and 1990). The average of an individual's employment months and earnings were measured in adulthood over the period 1990-2009. The models that account for the shared environmental and genetic factors reveal that former drinkers and heavy drinkers both have almost 20% lower earnings compared with moderate drinkers. On average, former drinkers work annually approx. 1 month less over the 20-year observation period. These associations are robust to the use of covariates, such as education, pre-existing health endowment and smoking.

10.1002/hec.3290.abstractZh: 本文探讨了酒精消费与长期劳动力市场结果之间是否存在关联。我们采用了芬兰男女双胞胎数据，这些数据与基于登记的个人就业和收入信息相匹配。双胞胎数据使我们能够考虑共享的环境和遗传因素。酒精消费量通过三项调查（1975年、1981年和1990年）中的自我报告数据来测量，即每周平均消费量。个体在1990至2009年期间的平均就业月份和收入情况被记录下来。考虑共享环境和遗传因素的模型显示，曾经饮酒者和重度饮酒者与适度饮酒者相比，收入分别低了近20%。在20年的观察期内，曾经饮酒者每年平均少工作约1个月。这些关联在纳入教育、已有健康状况以及吸烟等协变量后依然成立。

abstract.text: Mixed payment systems have become a prominent alternative to paying physicians through fee-for-service and capitation. While theory shows mixed payment systems to be superior, causal effects on physicians' behavior when introducing mixed systems are not well understood empirically. We systematically analyze the influence of fee-for-service, capitation, and mixed payment systems on physicians' service provision. In a controlled laboratory setting, we implement an exogenous variation of the payment method. Medical and non-medical students in the role of physicians in the lab (N = 213) choose quantities of medical services affecting patients' health outside the lab. Behavioral data reveal significant overprovision of medical services under fee-for-service and significant underprovision under capitation, although less than predicted when assuming profit maximization. Introducing mixed payment systems significantly reduces deviations from patient-optimal treatment. Although medical students tend to be more patient regarding, our results hold for both medical and non-medical students. Responses to incentive systems can be explained by a behavioral model capturing individual altruism. In particular, we find support that altruism plays a role in service provision and can partially mitigate agency problems, but altruism is heterogeneous in the population.

10.1002/hec.3292.abstractZh: 混合支付系统已成为替代按服务费和承包制支付医生费用的一种重要选择。虽然理论表明混合支付系统更为优越，但在引入混合支付系统时对医生行为的影响机制尚不清楚。我们系统分析了按服务费、承包制和混合支付系统对医生服务提供的影响。在受控实验室环境中，我们引入了支付方式的外生变化。作为医生的医疗和非医学生（N=213）在实验室中选择了影响患者健康的医疗服务数量。行为数据显示，在按服务费制度下，医疗服务过度提供的情况较为明显，而在承包制下则出现过度提供的情况，尽管这种过度提供程度低于假设利润最大化时的预测。引入混合支付系统显著减少了偏离患者最优治疗方案的情况。尽管医学生在这一点上更倾向于患者利益，但我们的研究结果同样适用于医疗和非医学生。对激励系统的响应可以通过行为模型来解释，该模型能够捕捉到个体利他行为。具体而言，我们发现利他行为在医疗服务提供中起着作用，并能够部分缓解代理问题，但利他行为在人群中存在差异。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the impact on cost and utilization of a shift from fee-for-service to capitation payment of district hospitals by Vietnam's social health insurance agency. Hospital fixed effects analysis suggests that capitation leads to reduced costs. Hospitals also increased service provision to the uninsured who continue to pay out-of-pocket on a fee-for-service basis. The study points to the need to anticipate unintended effects of payment reforms, especially in the context of a multiple purchaser system. Copyright © The World Bank Health Economics

10.1002/hec.3294.abstractZh: 本文评估了越南社会健康保险机构从按服务收费模式转向按承包制支付对地区医院成本和利用率的影响。医院固定效应分析表明，承包制降低了成本。医院还增加了对未投保患者的服务供给，这些患者仍坚持按服务收费模式自付费用。研究指出，需要预见支付改革可能带来的意外影响，尤其是在多买方系统的背景下。版权所有 © 世界银行健康经济学

abstract.text: We provide evidence for the causal impact of social status on longevity by exploiting a natural experiment in which subjects undergo a shift in their social status without considerable economic impact. We gather data on 4190 scientists who were either nominated for or successfully elected to the Chinese Academy of Science or of Engineering. Being elected as an academician in China is a boost in social status (vice-ministerial level) with negligible direct economic impact (US$30 monthly before 2009). After correcting for two sources of bias, (1) some potential academicians decease too young to be elected, leading to selection bias in favor of academicians and (2) the endogenous relationship between health and social status, we find that the enhanced social status of becoming an academician leads to approximately 1.2 years longer life.

10.1002/hec.3300.abstractZh: 我们通过一项自然实验提供了关于社会地位对寿命影响的证据。在该实验中，实验对象的社会地位发生了转变，但经济影响并不显著。我们收集了4190名科学家的数据，这些科学家要么被提名，要么成功当选为中国科学院或中国工程院院士。在中国，当选为院士意味着社会地位的提升（相当于副部长级别），而直接的经济影响微乎其微（2009年之前每月仅30美元）。在纠正了两个偏见因素后：（1）一些潜在的院士因年龄太小而无法当选，导致选择偏差有利于院士；（2）健康与社会地位之间存在内生关系。我们发现，成为院士所带来的社会地位提升，使得寿命延长约1.2年。

abstract.text: Severe health shocks provide new information about one's personal health and have been shown to influence smoking behaviors. In this paper, we suggest that they may also convey information about the hard to predict financial consequences of illnesses. Relevant financial risk information is idiosyncratic and unavailable to the consumer preceding illness, and the information search costs are high. However, new and salient information about the health as well as financial consequences of smoking after a health shock may impact smoking responses. Using variation in the timing of health shocks and two features of the US health care system (uninsured spells and aging into the Medicare program at 65), we test for heterogeneity in the post-shock smoking decision according to plausibly exogenous changes in financial risk exposure to medical spending. We also explore the relationship between smoking and the evolution of out-of-pocket costs. Individuals experiencing a cardiovascular health shock during an uninsured spell have more than twice the cessation effect of those receiving the illness while insured. For those uninsured prior to age 65 years, experiencing a cardiovascular shock post Medicare eligibility completely offsets the cessation effect. We also find that older adults' medical spending changes separate from health shocks influence their smoking behavior.

10.1002/hec.3309.abstractZh: 严重的健康冲击提供了关于个人健康的新信息，并已被证明会影响吸烟行为。在本文中，我们提出这些冲击也可能传递有关疾病带来的难以预测的财务后果的信息。相关的财务风险信息在疾病发生前是独特的，且消费者无法获得这些信息，信息搜索成本很高。然而，健康冲击后关于吸烟对健康及财务后果的新且显著的信息可能会影响吸烟行为。通过研究健康冲击发生的时间差异以及美国医疗系统的两个特点（无保险期间和65岁进入医疗保险计划），我们测试了根据财务风险暴露程度的变化，冲击后吸烟决策的差异性。我们还探讨了吸烟与自付费用变化之间的关系。在无保险期间经历心血管健康冲击的个体，其戒烟效果是无保险期间患病但仍有保险个体的两倍以上。对于65岁之前无保险的人，在获得医疗保险资格后经历心血管冲击，其戒烟效果会被完全抵消。我们还发现，老年人因健康冲击而发生的医疗支出变化，会对其吸烟行为产生影响。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of smoking bans on self-assessed health in Germany taking into account heterogeneities by smoking status, gender and age. We exploit regional variation in the dates of enactment and dates of enforcement across German federal states. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, our difference-in-differences estimates show that non-smokers' health improves, whereas smokers report no or even adverse health effects in response to bans. We find statistically significant health improvements especially for non-smokers living in households with at least one smoker. Non smokers' health improvements materialise largely with the enactment of smoking bans.

10.1002/hec.3310.abstractZh: 我们研究了德国禁烟令对自我评估健康状况的影响，同时考虑了吸烟状况、性别和年龄等变量带来的差异。我们利用德国各联邦州在禁烟令实施日期和生效日期上的区域差异进行研究。通过德国社会经济面板数据，我们的差异估计结果显示，非吸烟者的健康状况有所改善，而吸烟者则报告称禁烟令并未对其健康产生负面影响，甚至有些负面影响。我们发现，尤其是那些生活在至少有一名吸烟者的家庭中的非吸烟者的健康状况得到了显著改善。非吸烟者的健康改善主要随着禁烟令的实施而显现。

abstract.text: Under the standard Medicare Part D benefit structure, copayments for medications change discontinuously at certain levels of accumulative drug spending. Beneficiaries pay 25% of the cost of medications in the initial phase, 100% in the coverage gap, and 5% in the catastrophic phase. We examine whether individuals anticipate these copayment changes and adjust their consumption in advance. We use variation in birth-months of beneficiaries who enroll in Part D plans when they first turn 65. Birth-months generate exogenous variation in the end-of-year price because those who enroll earlier in the year are more likely to reach the coverage gap than those who enroll later. We study the impact of variation in end-of-year price on the first three months of medication use immediately following enrollment. We use difference-in-differences to adjust for seasonal trends in use, by comparing our main study group with those who receive low-income subsidies, and therefore do not face a coverage gap. We find strong evidence of anticipatory behavior, with an implied elasticity with respect to future prices ranging from -0.2 to -0.5. In addition, we find that beneficiaries modify their consumption by changing the quantity of prescriptions filled, instead of switching between brand-name and generic drugs.

10.1002/hec.3311.abstractZh: 在标准的Medicare Part D福利结构下，药物的自付费用会随着累积药物支出的不同水平而发生变化。在初始阶段，受益人需支付药物费用的25%；在覆盖缺口阶段，需支付100%；在灾难性阶段，需支付5%。我们研究个体是否预见到这些自付费用的变化，并提前调整其用药行为。我们利用了受益人首次加入Part D计划时出生月份的差异作为外生变量，因为年初加入计划的人更有可能进入覆盖缺口阶段。我们研究了年末价格变化对初次用药三个月的影响。我们通过差异-差异法来消除季节性使用趋势的影响，通过将主要研究组与那些获得低收入补贴、因此不会面临覆盖缺口的人进行比较。我们发现存在强烈的预期行为，对未来价格的弹性范围在-0.2到-0.5之间。此外，我们发现受益人的用药行为是通过改变处方数量来调整的，而不是在品牌药和仿制药之间切换。

abstract.text: This paper discusses two types of response-scale heterogeneity, which may impact upon the EQ-5D. Response-scale heterogeneity in reporting occurs when individuals systematically differ in their use of response scales when responding to self-assessments. This type of heterogeneity is widely observed in relation to other self-assessed measures but is often overlooked with regard to the EQ-5D. Analogous to this, preference elicitation involving the EQ-5D could be subject to a similar type of heterogeneity, where variations across respondents may occur in the interpretations of the levels (response categories) being valued. This response-scale heterogeneity in preference elicitation may differ from variations in preferences for health states, which have been observed in the literature. This paper explores what these forms of response-scale heterogeneity may mean for the EQ-5D and the potential implications for researchers who rely on the instrument as a measure of health and quality of life. We identify situations where they are likely to be problematic and present potential avenues for overcoming these issues.

10.1002/hec.3313.abstractZh: 本文讨论了两种类型的反应尺度异质性，这些异质性可能会影响EQ-5D评估。在报告过程中出现的反应尺度异质性是指个体在回答自我评估时，使用反应尺度的方式存在系统性差异。这种异质性在其他自我评估指标中较为常见，但在EQ-5D评估中往往被忽视。类似地，涉及EQ-5D的偏好引导也可能出现类似的异质性，即不同受访者对评估等级的解释可能存在差异。这种偏好引导中的反应尺度异质性可能与文献中观察到的健康状态的偏好差异不同。本文探讨了这些类型的反应尺度异质性对EQ-5D评估的意义，以及对于依赖该工具来衡量健康和生活质量的研究人员来说，可能带来的影响。我们指出了这些异质性可能带来的问题，并提出了一些克服这些问题的途径。

abstract.text: The aim of this study was to examine the effect that the introduction of new medical interventions at birth has had on mortality among newborn babies in Norway during the period 1967-2011. During this period, there has been a significant decline in mortality, in particular for low birth weight infants. We identified four interventions that together explained about 50% of the decline in early neonatal and infant mortality: ventilators, antenatal steroids, surfactant and insure. The analyses were performed on a large set of data, encompassing more than 1.6 million deliveries (Medical Birth Registry of Norway). The richness of the data allowed us to perform several robustness tests. Our study indicates that the introduction of new medical interventions has been a very important channel through which the decline in mortality among newborn babies occurred during the second half of the last century.

10.1002/hec.3314.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨在1967年至2011年期间，挪威新生儿中新医疗干预措施的引入对新生儿死亡率的影响。在此期间，尤其是低出生体重婴儿的发病率显著下降。我们确定了四种医疗干预措施，它们共同解释了新生儿和婴儿死亡率下降约50%的原因：呼吸机、产前类固醇、表面活性剂和保险。分析基于大量数据，涵盖了超过160万次分娩记录（挪威医学出生登记系统）。数据的丰富性使我们能够进行多项稳健性测试。我们的研究表明，在过去半个世纪中，新医疗干预措施的引入是降低新生儿死亡率的重要途径。

abstract.text: In 2011, the USA had the second highest teen birth rate of any developed nation, according to the World Bank, . In an effort to lower teen pregnancy rates, several states have enacted policies requiring abstinence-based sex education. In this study, we utilize a difference-in-differences research design to analyze the causal effects of state-level sex education policies from 2000-2011 on various teen sexual health outcomes. We find that state-level abstinence education mandates have no effect on teen birth rates or abortion rates, although we find that state-level policies may affect teen sexually transmitted disease rates in some states.

10.1002/hec.3315.abstractZh: 根据世界银行的数据，2011年美国的青少年生育率在所有发达国家中排名第二。为了降低青少年怀孕率，一些州实施了要求以禁欲为基础的性教育政策。在这项研究中，我们采用了差异-差异研究设计，来分析2000年至2011年间各州性教育政策对青少年性健康各种结果的影响。我们发现，各州的禁欲教育规定对青少年生育率或堕胎率没有影响，不过我们发现某些州的性教育政策可能会影响青少年性传播疾病的发生率。

abstract.text: Periodontal disease has been linked to poor glycemic control among individuals with type 2 diabetes. Using integrated dental, medical, and pharmacy commercial claims from Truven MarketScan® Research Databases, we implement inverse probability weighting and doubly robust methods to estimate a relationship between a periodontal intervention and healthcare costs and utilization. Among individuals newly diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, we find that a periodontal intervention is associated with lower total healthcare costs (-$1799), lower total medical costs excluding pharmacy costs (-$1577), and lower total type 2 diabetes-related healthcare costs (-$408).

10.1002/hec.3316.abstractZh: 牙周病与2型糖尿病患者血糖控制不良之间存在关联。通过利用Truven MarketScan®研究数据库中的综合牙科、医疗和药学商业数据，我们采用了逆概率加权法和双重稳健方法来评估牙周干预措施与医疗成本及医疗使用之间的关系。在刚被诊断为2型糖尿病的人群中，我们发现牙周干预措施与较低的总医疗成本（-$1799）、较低的包括药学费用在内的总医疗费用（-$1577）以及较低的2型糖尿病相关医疗成本（-$408）相关。

abstract.text: This study shows that, in an unregulated fee-setting environment, specialist physicians practise price discrimination on the basis of their patients' income status. Our results are consistent with profit maximisation behaviour by specialists. These findings are based on a large population survey that is linked to administrative medical claims records. We find that, for an initial consultation, specialist physicians charge their high-income patients AU$26 more than their low-income patients. While this gap equates to a 19% lower fees for the poorest patients (bottom 25% of the household income distribution), it is unlikely to remove the substantial financial barriers they face in accessing specialist care. There are large variations across specialties, with neurologists exhibiting the largest fee gap between the high-income and low-income patients. Several possible channels for deducing the patient's income are examined. We find that patient characteristics such as age, health concession card status and private health insurance status are all used by specialists as proxies for income status. These characteristics are particularly important to further practise price discrimination among the low-income patients but are less relevant for the high-income patients.

10.1002/hec.3317.abstractZh: 本研究表明，在缺乏监管的费用设定环境中，专科医生会根据患者的收入状况进行价格歧视。我们的研究结果与专科医生追求利润最大化的行为一致。这些发现基于一项与行政医疗索赔记录相关的大规模人口调查。我们发现，对于初次咨询，专科医生对高收入患者的收费比低收入患者高出26澳元。虽然这一差距意味着最贫困患者（家庭收入分布最低的25%）的费用降低了19%，但这不太可能消除他们在获得专科护理时面临的巨大经济障碍。不同专科之间存在较大差异，其中神经科医生在高收入患者与低收入患者之间的费用差距最大。我们探讨了多种推断患者收入的方法。研究发现，年龄、健康优惠卡状态以及私人健康保险状态等患者特征都被专科医生用作收入状况的替代指标。这些特征对于进一步对低收入患者实施价格歧视尤为重要，而对于高收入患者则不太相关。

abstract.text: In Spain's 'MIR' system, medical school graduates are ranked by their performance on a national exam and then sequentially choose from the available residency training positions. We took advantage of a unique survey of participants in the 2012 annual MIR cycle to analyze preferences under two different choice scenarios: the residency program actually chosen by each participant when it came her turn (the 'real') and the program that she would have chosen if all residency training programs had been available (the 'counterfactual'). Utilizing conditional logit models with random coefficients, we found significant differences in medical graduates' preferences between the two scenarios, particularly with respect to three specialty attributes: work hours/lifestyle, prestige among colleagues, and annual remuneration. In the counterfactual world, these attributes were valued preferentially by those nearer to the top, while in the real world, they were valued preferentially by graduates nearer to the bottom of the national ranking. Medical graduates' specialty preferences, which we conclude, are not intrinsically stable but depend critically on the 'rules of the game'. The MIR assignment system, by restricting choice, effectively creates an externality in which those at the bottom, who have fewer choices, want what those at the top already have.

10.1002/hec.3318.abstractZh: 在西班牙的“MIR”招生系统中，医学院毕业生根据他们在全国考试中的表现进行排序，然后依次选择可用的住院医师培训职位。我们利用2012年度MIR周期中对参与者的独特调查，分析了两种不同选择情景下的偏好：一种是每个参与者实际选择的住院医师培训项目（即“现实情况”），另一种是如果所有住院医师培训项目都可用的情况下，该参与者会选择的培训项目（即“反事实情况”）。通过条件Logit模型分析，我们发现两种情景下医学毕业生的偏好存在显著差异，尤其是在三个专业属性方面：工作时间/生活方式、同事中的声望以及年度薪酬。在反事实情况下，这些属性更受排名靠前的毕业生青睐；而在现实情况下，这些属性更受排名靠后的毕业生青睐。我们认为，医学毕业生的专业偏好并非固有稳定，而是严重依赖于“游戏规则”。MIR的分配系统通过限制选择，实际上创造了一个外部性，即选择较少的底层毕业生想要的是顶层毕业生已经拥有的东西。

abstract.text: Public hospital reform is one priority area in the healthcare system reform that China launched in 2009. The Chinese government invested over $10bn for pilot projects in public hospital reform in rural China. However, little evidence exists on their effects. Using a quasi-natural experiment design, we evaluated the effects of a public hospital pilot project in Hubei province on inpatient spending. We obtained inpatient claims data from 1/1/2011 through 6/30/2013 for enrollees in the New Cooperative Medical Scheme in two counties: Danjiangkou, one of the pilot counties selected for reform in September 2012, and Laohekou, a similar, adjacent county serving as the control group. Using a difference-in-differences approach with propensity score weighting, we found that total inpatient spending increased ¥1160 (95% CI 1155-1166), out-of-pocket spending increased ¥385 (95% CI 382-389), length of stay increased 0.51 days (95% CI 0.50-0.52), but inpatient medication spending decreased ¥147 (95% CI 145-150), post-policy in Danjiangkou, relative to the control group. The overall reimbursement rate increased by 5.7 percentage points. One of the goals of the recent public hospital reform is to make inpatient services affordable to patients. We found that although patients spent less on inpatient medications, total out-of-pocket spending increased considerably after reform.

10.1002/hec.3320.abstractZh: 公立医院改革是中国在2009年启动的医疗体系改革中的一个重点领域。中国政府在农村地区的公立医院改革试点项目中投入了超过100亿美元。然而，关于这些改革效果的证据却很少。我们采用准自然实验设计，评估了湖北省一个公立医院试点项目对住院费用的影响。我们获得了2011年1月1日至2013年6月30日期间，两个县的新合作医疗计划参保者的住院费用数据：丹江口县是2012年9月被选为改革试点县的之一，而老河口县则作为对照组，位于其邻近地区。通过差异-差异方法结合倾向得分加权处理，我们发现，与对照组相比，丹江口县的住院总费用增加了1160元（95%置信区间：1155-1166元），自付费用增加了385元（95%置信区间：382-389元），住院天数增加了0.51天（95%置信区间：0.50-0.52天），但住院用药费用却减少了147元（95%置信区间：145-150元）。整体报销率上升了5.7个百分点。最近公立医院改革的目标之一就是使住院服务对病人来说更加可负担。我们发现，尽管病人住院用药费用减少了，但改革后总自付费用却显著增加了。

abstract.text: We document the recent profile of health insurance and health care among mid-aged and older Chinese using data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study conducted in 2011. Overall health insurance coverage is about 93%. Multivariate regressions show that respondents with lower income as measured by per capita expenditure have a lower chance of being insured, as do the less-educated, older, and divorced/widowed women and rural-registered people. Premiums and reimbursement rates of health insurance vary significantly by schemes. Inpatient reimbursement rates for urban people increase with total cost to a plateau of 60%; rural people receive much less. Demographic characteristics such as age, education, marriage status, per capita expenditure, and self-reported health status are not significantly associated with share of out-of-pocket cost after controlling community effects. For health service use, we find large gaps that vary across health insurance plans, especially for inpatient service. People with access to urban health insurance plans are more likely to use health services. In general, Chinese people have easy access to median low-level medical facilities. It is also not difficult to access general hospitals or specialized hospitals, but there exists better access to healthcare facilities in urban areas.

10.1002/hec.3322.abstractZh: 我们基于2011年进行的中国健康与退休纵向研究的数据，记录了中年及岁以上中国人在健康保险和医疗保健方面的现状。总体而言，健康保险覆盖率约为93%。多元回归分析显示，按人均支出衡量，收入较低的受访者参保几率较低，受教育程度较低、年龄较大、离婚或丧偶的女性以及农村户籍人口的参保几率也较低。健康保险的费用和报销比例因保险计划而异。城市居民的住院报销比例随着总费用的上升而趋于稳定，达到60%的峰值；而农村居民的报销比例则低得多。在控制社区效应后，年龄、教育程度、婚姻状况、人均支出以及自我报告的健康状况等人口统计特征与自付费用的比例并无显著关联。在医疗服务使用方面，我们发现不同健康保险计划之间存在较大差异，尤其是在住院服务方面。能够使用城市健康保险计划的人更有可能使用医疗服务。总体而言，中国人能够轻松获得中等水平的医疗设施。进入普通医院或专科医院也并非困难，但在城市地区，医疗设施的获取更为便捷。

abstract.text: Spending on prescription drugs (Rx) represents one of the fastest growing components of US healthcare spending and has coincided with an expansion of pharmaceutical promotional spending. Most (83%) of Rx promotion is directed at physicians in the form of visits by pharmaceutical representatives (known as detailing) and drug samples provided to physicians' offices. Such promotion has come under increased public scrutiny, with critics contending that physician-directed promotion may play a role in raising healthcare costs and may unduly affect physicians' prescribing habits towards more expensive, and possibly less cost-effective, drugs. In this study, we bring longitudinal evidence to bear upon the question of how detailing impacts physicians' prescribing behaviors. Specifically, we examine prescriptions and promotion for a particular drug class based on a nationally representative sample of 150,000 physicians spanning 24 months. The use of longitudinal physician-level data allows us to tackle some of the empirical concerns in the extant literature, virtually all of which have relied on aggregate national data. We estimate fixed-effects specifications that bypass stable unobserved physician-specific heterogeneity and address potential targeting bias. In addition, we also assess differential effects at both the extensive and intensive margins of prescribing behaviors and differential effects across physician-level and market-level characteristics, questions that have not been explored in prior work. The estimates suggest that detailing has a significant and positive effect on the number of new scripts written for the detailed drug, with an elasticity magnitude of 0.06. This effect is substantially smaller than those in the literature based on aggregate information, suggesting that most of the observed relationship between physician-directed promotion and drug sales is driven by selection bias. We find that detailing impacts selective brand-specific demand but does not have any substantial effects on class-level demand. The increase in brand-specific demand appears to crowd out demand for the substitute branded drug although not for the generic alternative. Results also indicate that most of the detailing response may operate at the extensive margin; detailing affects the probability of prescribing the drug more than it affects the number of prescriptions conditional on any prescribing. We draw some implications from these estimates with respect to effects on healthcare costs and public health.

10.1002/hec.3323.abstractZh: 处方药支出是美国医疗保健支出中增长最快的组成部分之一，其增长与药品促销支出的扩大同步。其中，83%的处方药促销是通过药品代表进行的拜访以及向医生办公室提供药品样品的形式进行的。这种促销方式受到了公众的更多关注，批评者认为，由医生主导的促销可能会推高医疗成本，并可能过度影响医生对更昂贵且可能不太经济的药物的处方行为。在这项研究中，我们提供了纵向数据来探讨拜访式促销对医生处方行为的影响。具体来说，我们基于一个代表全国150,000名医生的样本，在24个月内对某一特定药物类别的处方和促销进行了研究。使用纵向的医生级数据使我们能够解决现有文献中存在的部分实证问题，而这些问题几乎都依赖于汇总性的全国数据。我们采用了固定效应模型，从而避免了稳定的、未观察到的医生特定异质性，并解决了潜在的目标定位偏差问题。此外，我们还评估了处方行为在广泛和密集两个层面的差异效应，以及医生级和市场级特征之间的差异效应，这些问题在之前的研究中尚未被探讨。研究结果表明，拜访式促销对特定药物的处方数量有显著的正面影响，其弹性系数为0.06。这种效应比基于总体信息的文献中的效应要小得多，这表明医生主导的推广与药品销售之间观察到的关系，大部分是由选择偏差所驱动的。我们发现，详细分析特定品牌的需求影响是存在的，但对类别级别的需求则没有实质性影响。特定品牌需求的增加似乎挤占了替代品牌药品的需求，尽管对通用替代药品的需求并没有受到影响。结果还表明，大部分详细分析的反应可能发生在广泛边际上；详细分析对开药概率的影响大于对开药数量的影响。从这些估计中，我们可以得出一些关于对医疗成本和公共卫生影响的结论。

abstract.text: Misclassification errors in a dependent variable can introduce attenuation bias to covariate effects in a binary choice model. Misreporting of smoking behaviours by adolescents has been widely documented. However, the consequence in empirical studies of adolescent smoking participation has received little attention. This study uses the Health Survey for England (HSE) to investigate the extent and implication of misclassification errors in self-reported smoking among adolescents aged 11-15 years. The HSE contains both a self-reported smoking component and an objective measure of smoking obtained from saliva cotinine assays. Saliva cotinine concentration ≥12 ng/ml is considered the 'true' indicator of adolescent smoking participation against which self-reported smoking is compared. The findings show that smoking is misreported in this age group, resulting in a downwards bias of marginal effect estimates. Given the widespread use of self-reported smoking data, this study explores the performance of the Hausman, Abrevaya and Scott-Morton-modified maximum likelihood estimation (HAS approach) in recovering true estimates of covariate effects. In this context, the HAS approach performs better when the misclassification probabilities are treated as constants compared with when they are treated as conditionally dependent parameters.

10.1002/hec.3324.abstractZh: 在二元选择模型中，因变量的错误分类可能会引入对协变量效应的低估偏差。青少年吸烟行为的误报已被广泛记录。然而，在实证研究中对青少年吸烟参与行为的后果却鲜有关注。本研究利用英格兰健康调查数据，调查了11-15岁青少年自我报告的吸烟行为中错误分类的错误程度及其影响。英格兰健康调查包含自我报告的吸烟数据以及通过唾液可替宁检测获得的客观吸烟数据。唾液可替宁浓度≥12 ng/ml被视为青少年吸烟参与的“真实”指标，用于与自我报告的吸烟数据进行比较。研究结果表明，这一年龄段的吸烟数据存在误报现象，导致协变量效应的估计值出现低估偏差。鉴于自我报告的吸烟数据被广泛使用，本研究探讨了Hausman、Abrevaya和Scott-Morton修正的最大似然估计方法在恢复协变量效应真实估计值方面的表现。在本文中，当错误分类概率被视为常数时，HAS方法的性能优于将其视为条件依赖参数时的情况。

abstract.text: This paper considers the risk of incurring future medical expenditures in light of a family's resources available to pay for those expenditures as well as their choice of health insurance. We model non-premium medical out-of-pocket expenditures and use the estimates from our model to develop a prospective measure of medical care economic risk estimating the proportion of families who are at risk of incurring high non-premium out-of-pocket medical care expenses in relation to its resources. We further use the estimates from our model to compare the extent to which different types of insurance mitigate the risk of incurring non-premium expenditures by providing for increased utilization of medical care. We find that while 21.3% of families lack the resources to pay for the median expenditures for their insurance type, 42.4% lack the resources to pay for the 99 th percentile of expenditures for their insurance type. We also find the mediating effect of insurance on non-premium expenditures to outweigh the associated premium expense for expenditures above $1804 for employer-sponsored insurance and $4337 for direct purchase insurance for those younger than age 65; and above $12 118 of expenditures for Medicare supplementary plans for those aged 65 or older. Published 2016. This article is a U.S. Government work and is in the public domain in the USA.

10.1002/hec.3325.abstractZh: 本文探讨了未来医疗支出风险的问题，涉及家庭可用于支付这些支出的资源以及他们选择的医疗保险。我们模型化了非保费医疗自付支出，并利用模型得出的估计结果来制定一个前瞻性指标，用于衡量医疗经济风险，即相对于家庭资源而言，有多少家庭面临高额非保费医疗自付支出的风险。我们还利用模型得出的估计结果，比较不同类型的保险在减轻非保费支出风险方面的效果，包括通过增加医疗服务的利用来降低风险。研究发现，有21.3%的家庭缺乏支付其保险类型中位支出所需的资源，而42.4%的家庭则缺乏支付其保险类型第99百分位支出的资源。此外，我们发现，对于65岁以下的人群，雇主赞助保险中超过1804美元的支出以及直接购买保险中超过4337美元的支出，其保险对非保费支出的缓解作用超过了相关的保费支出；对于65岁及以上的人群，Medicare补充计划中的支出超过12,118美元时，保险对非保费支出的缓解作用同样超过相关保费支出。本文发表于2016年，属于美国政府资助的研究项目，在美国属于公共领域。

abstract.text: The Medicare Part D program introduced prescription drug coverage for seniors in 2006. We examine the impact of this program on the use of emergency department (ED) care. Using a difference-in-differences model, we find declines in the number of ED visits for non-emergency care but not for emergency care, suggesting that Part D may have led to better management of health and reduced unnecessary use of EDs.

10.1002/hec.3326.abstractZh: Medicare Part D计划于2006年为老年人引入了处方药覆盖服务。我们研究了该计划对急诊科就诊情况的影响。通过差异-差异模型分析发现，非紧急情况的急诊就诊次数有所下降，而紧急情况的就诊次数则没有变化，这表明Part D计划可能有助于更好地管理健康状况，并减少不必要的急诊就诊。

abstract.text: German hospitals receive subsidies for investment costs by federal states. Theoretically, these subsidies have to cover the whole investment volume, but in fact, only 50-60% are covered. Balance sheet data show that public hospitals exhibit higher levels of subsidies compared with for-profit hospitals. In this study, I examine the sources of this disparity by decomposing the differential in a so-called facilitation ratio, that is, the ratio of subsidies to tangible fixed assets, revealing to which extent assets are funded by subsidies. The question of interest is whether the differential can be attributed to observable hospital-specific and federal state-specific characteristics or to unobservable factors.

10.1002/hec.3327.abstractZh: 德国医院从各联邦州获得投资成本的补贴。理论上，这些补贴应覆盖全部投资金额，但实际上只有50-60%的资金得到补贴。资产负债表数据显示，公立医院的补贴水平高于营利性医院。本研究通过分解所谓的“促进比率”来探讨这种差异的来源，即补贴与有形固定资产的比例，从而揭示资产是由补贴还是其他方式资助的。我们感兴趣的问题是，这种差异是否可以归因于可观察到的医院和联邦州特性，还是归因于不可观察的因素。

abstract.text: How donor organs are allocated for transplant can affect their scarcity. In 2008, Israel's Parliament passed an Organ Transplantation Law granting priority on organ donor waiting lists to individuals who had previously registered as organ donors. Beginning in November 2010, public awareness campaigns advertised the priority policy to the public. Since April 2012, priority has been added to the routine medical criteria in organ allocation decisions. We evaluate the introduction of priority for registered organ donors using Israeli data on organ donor registration from 1992 to 2013. We find that registrations increased when information about the priority law was made widely available. We find an even larger increase in registration rates in the 2 months leading up to a program deadline, after which priority would only be granted with a 3-year delay. We also find that the registration rate responds positively to public awareness campaigns, to the ease of registration (i.e. allowing for registering online and by phone) and to an election drive that included placing registration opportunities in central voting locations.

10.1002/hec.3328.abstractZh: 捐赠器官的分配方式会影响其稀缺性。2008年，以色列议会通过了《器官移植法》，规定先前已登记为器官捐赠者的个人在器官捐赠者等候名单上享有优先权。自2010年11月起，公共宣传活动向公众宣传这一优先权政策。自2012年4月起，优先权在器官分配决策中成为常规医疗标准之一。我们利用1992年至2013年间的以色列器官捐赠登记数据，评估为已登记器官捐赠者提供优先权的政策效果。研究发现，当优先权政策的信息被广泛传播时，登记人数有所增加。在政策截止日期前的两个月内，登记率进一步上升，之后优先权仅在三年后才会被授予。此外，我们还发现，公共宣传活动、登记流程的便利性（例如允许在线和电话登记）以及将登记机会设置在中央投票地点的选举活动，都对登记率产生了积极影响。

abstract.text: It is well known that immigrants tend to be healthier than US natives and that this advantage erodes with time spent in the USA. However, we know less about the heterogeneity of these trajectories among arrival cohorts. Recent studies have shown that later arrival cohorts of immigrants have lower entry wages and experience less economic assimilation. In this paper, we investigate whether similar cohort effects can be observed in the weight assimilation of immigrants in the USA. Focusing on obesity, we show that more recent immigrant cohorts arrive with higher obesity rates and experience a faster 'unhealthy assimilation' in terms of weight gain.

10.1002/hec.3331.abstractZh: 众所周知，移民通常比美国本土居民更健康，但这种优势会随着在美时间的延长而逐渐减弱。然而，我们对不同移民群体在体重适应方面的差异了解较少。最近的研究表明，较晚到达的移民群体在入职时的工资较低，且经济适应程度也较低。在本文中，我们探讨了在美移民在体重适应方面是否也存在类似的群体效应。以肥胖为例，我们发现较新到达的移民群体肥胖率较高，并且在体重增加方面经历了更快的“不健康适应”。

abstract.text: In this paper we analysed healthcare costs in a sample of elderly patients suffering from multimorbidity. On the one hand, multimorbid individuals consume a disproportionally large share of healthcare resources. On the other hand, the patient specific number and combination of co-occurring single diseases result in inhomogeneous data leading to biased estimates when using traditional regression techniques. Therefore, we applied a mixture of regressions in order to control for unobserved heterogeneity focussing on the identification of multimorbidity patterns. We used a subsample of N = 1050 patients from a multicentre prospective cohort study of randomly selected multimorbid primary care patients aged 65 to 85 years in Germany (ISRCTN 89818205) who completed a detailed questionnaire on healthcare utilization during the 6-month period preceding the interview. Disease combinations of 1047 were included. We detected four different groups of patients with regard to total costs. These groups corresponded largely to findings from the epidemiological literature. The effect of the presence of an additional disease on costs differed between groups. Moreover, two diametrically opposed cost trends were detected with respect to the number of co-occurring diseases. While in one group costs increased with the number of co-occurring diseases, in a second group cost tended to decrease.

10.1002/hec.3334.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了患有多种疾病的老年患者的医疗成本。一方面，患有多种疾病的患者消耗了不成比例的医疗资源。另一方面，患者所患的单一疾病的数量和组合导致了数据的不均匀性，这在使用传统回归技术时会导致估计结果的偏差。因此，我们采用了混合回归方法来控制未观察到的异质性，以识别多种疾病的模式。我们选取了来自德国一项多中心前瞻性队列研究的1050名患者的子样本，这些患者年龄在65至85岁之间，是随机选取的患有多种疾病的初级保健患者（ISRCTN 89818205），他们在访谈前的6个月内完成了详细的医疗使用问卷调查。研究纳入了1047种疾病组合。我们发现，根据总成本，患者可以分为四组。这些组别与流行病学文献中的研究结果大体一致。不同疾病存在对成本的影响在不同组别间存在差异。此外，还发现了两种截然相反的成本趋势，这与所患疾病的数量有关。在一个组别中，随着所患疾病数量的增加，成本上升；而在另一个组别中，成本则趋于下降。

abstract.text: For many years, evidence from the USA has pointed out to the existence of upcoding in management practices. Upcoding is defined as classifying patients in diagnosis-related groups codes associated with larger payments. The incentive for upcoding is not restricted to private providers of care. Conceptually, any patient classification system that is used for payment purposes may be vulnerable to this sort of strategic behaviour by providers. We document here that upcoding occurs in a National Health Service where public hospitals have their payment (budget) tied to the classification of treatment episodes. Using diagnosis-related groups data from Portugal, we found that the practice of upcoding has been used in the hospitals in a way leading to larger budgets (age of patients plays a key role). The effect is quantitatively small.

10.1002/hec.3335.abstractZh: 多年来，美国的证据表明，在管理实践中存在过度编码的现象。过度编码指的是将患者分类到与更高支付额相关的诊断相关组别中。过度编码的动机不仅限于私人医疗服务提供者。从概念上讲，任何用于支付目的的患者分类系统都可能受到这种策略性行为的干扰。我们在此记录，在国民健康服务体系中，公立医院的治疗费用与治疗方案的分类直接相关。通过利用葡萄牙的诊断相关组数据，我们发现，这些医院确实采用了过度编码的做法，从而导致更高的预算（患者的年龄起着关键作用）。不过，这种影响在数量上并不显著。

abstract.text: Does increasing incomes improve health? In 1999, the UK government implemented minimum wage legislation, increasing hourly wages to at least £3.60. This policy experiment created intervention and control groups that can be used to assess the effects of increasing wages on health. Longitudinal data were taken from the British Household Panel Survey. We compared the health effects of higher wages on recipients of the minimum wage with otherwise similar persons who were likely unaffected because (1) their wages were between 100 and 110% of the eligibility threshold or (2) their firms did not increase wages to meet the threshold. We assessed the probability of mental ill health using the 12-item General Health Questionnaire. We also assessed changes in smoking, blood pressure, as well as hearing ability (control condition). The intervention group, whose wages rose above the minimum wage, experienced lower probability of mental ill health compared with both control group 1 and control group 2. This improvement represents 0.37 of a standard deviation, comparable with the effect of antidepressants (0.39 of a standard deviation) on depressive symptoms. The intervention group experienced no change in blood pressure, hearing ability, or smoking. Increasing wages significantly improves mental health by reducing financial strain in low-wage workers.

10.1002/hec.3336.abstractZh: 收入增加是否有助于改善健康？1999年，英国政府实施了最低工资立法，将每小时工资提高到至少3.60英镑。这一政策实验创建了干预组和对照组，以评估工资增加对健康的影响。数据来自英国家庭面板调查。我们比较了最低工资领取者与其他类似人群在健康方面的差异，这些其他人群可能未受显著影响，因为：(1) 他们的工资在资格门槛的100%到110%之间，或者(2) 他们的公司并未提高工资以达到该门槛。我们使用12项一般健康问卷来评估精神健康问题的概率。我们还评估了吸烟、血压以及听力能力的变化（作为对照条件）。干预组的工资高于最低工资，其精神健康问题的概率低于对照组1和对照组2。这种改善相当于0.37个标准差，与抗抑郁药对抑郁症状的影响相当（0.39个标准差）。干预组的血压、听力能力和吸烟情况均未发生变化。增加工资显著改善了低薪工人的心理健康，通过减轻经济压力来实现。

abstract.text: The low quality of health care in developing countries reduces the poor's incentives to use quality health services and their demand for health insurance. Using data from a field experiment in India, I show that randomly offering insurance policyholders a free preventive checkup with a qualified doctor has a twofold effect: receiving this additional benefit raises willingness to pay to renew health insurance by 53%, doubling the likelihood of hypothetical renewal; exposed individuals are 10 percentage points more likely to consult a qualified practitioner when ill after the checkup. Both effects are concentrated on poorer households. There is no effect on health knowledge and healthcare spending. This suggests that exposing insured households to quality preventive care can be a cost-effective way of raising the demand for quality health care and retaining policyholders in the insurance scheme.

10.1002/hec.3337.abstractZh: 发展中国家医疗服务的低质量降低了贫困人口使用优质医疗服务的意愿，同时也减少了他们对健康保险的需求。通过印度一项实地实验的数据分析，我发现随机向保险客户提供由合格医生进行的免费预防性检查具有双重效果：获得这一额外福利使保险续保的意愿增加了53%，从而将假设续保的可能性翻倍；在检查后，患病时寻求合格医生咨询的意愿增加了10个百分点。这两种效应都集中在贫困家庭身上。而这对健康知识和医疗支出并没有影响。这表明，让保险客户接触高质量的预防性护理是一种成本效益高的方式，能够提升对优质医疗服务的需求，并留住保险计划中的客户。

abstract.text: Productivity growth is a key measure against which National Health Service (NHS) achievements are judged. We measure NHS productivity growth as a set of paired year-on-year comparisons from 1998/1999-1999/2000 through 2012/2013-2013/2014, which are converted into a chained index that summarises productivity growth over the entire period. Our measure is as comprehensive as data permit and accounts for the multitude of diverse outputs and inputs involved in the production process and for regular revisions to the data used to quantify outputs and inputs. Over the full-time period, NHS output increased by 88.96% and inputs by 81.58%, delivering overall total factor productivity growth of 4.07%. Productivity growth was negative during the first two terms of Blair's government, with average yearly growth rate of -1.01% per annum (pa) during the first term (to 2000/2001) and -1.49% pa during the second term (2000/2001-2004/2005). Productivity growth was positive under Blair's third term (2004/2005-2007/2008) at 1.41% pa and under the Brown government (2007/2008-2010/2011), averaging 1.13% pa. Productivity growth remained positive under the Coalition (2010/2011-2013/2014), averaging 1.56% pa.

10.1002/hec.3338.abstractZh: 生产率增长是衡量国家卫生服务系统（NHS）成就的关键指标。我们将NHS的生产率增长视为从1998/1999-1999/2000年到2012/2013-2013/2014年的一系列同比比较数据，这些数据被转化为一个连锁指数，以概括整个时期的生产率增长情况。我们的衡量方法尽可能全面，考虑了生产过程中涉及的多种产出和投入，并且定期对用于量化产出和投入的数据进行修订。在整个工作时间段内，NHS的产出增加了88.96%，投入增加了81.58%，整体全要素生产率增长了4.07%。在布莱尔政府的前两个任期内，生产率增长为负，第一任期的年均增长率为-1.01%（以2000/2001年为准），第二任期为-1.49%每年。在布莱尔的第三个任期（2004/2005-2007/2008年）期间，生产率增长为1.41%每年，在布朗政府期间（2007/2008-2010/2011年）平均为1.13%每年。在联盟政府期间（2010/2011-2013/2014年），生产率增长保持在1.56%每年。

abstract.text: While reducing the transmission of sexually transmitted infections is a common argument for regulating sex work, relatively little empirical evidence is available regarding the effectiveness of these policies. We investigate the effects of highly publicized sex work regulations introduced in 2005 in Tijuana, Mexico on the incidence of trichomoniasis. State-level, annual data for the 1995-2012 period are employed that include the incidence rates of trichomoniasis by age group and predictor variables. We find that the regulations led to a decrease in the incidence rate of trichomoniasis. Specifically, while our estimates are somewhat noisy, the all-ages incidence rate in the 2005-2012 period is roughly 37% lower than what is predicted by our synthetic control estimates and corresponds to approximately 800 fewer reported cases of trichomoniasis per year. We find that the decreases are especially pronounced for 15-24 and 25-44 age cohorts.

10.1002/hec.3339.abstractZh: 虽然减少性传播感染的传播是规范性工作的常见理由，但关于这些政策有效性的实证证据相对较少。我们研究了2005年墨西哥蒂华纳实施的、广为人知的性工作法规对滴虫病发病率的影响。研究采用了1995年至2012年的年度数据，这些数据包含了按年龄组划分的滴虫病发病率以及相关预测变量。研究发现，这些法规确实降低了滴虫病的发生率。具体而言，尽管我们的估计结果存在一定误差，但在2005年至2012年期间，全年龄段的滴虫病发病率比综合控制估计值低约37%，相当于每年报告的滴虫病病例减少了约800例。我们发现，这种下降在15-24岁和25-44岁年龄组中尤为明显。

abstract.text: The study examines long-term effects of cancer on the work status and annual earnings of cancer survivors who had a strong attachment to the labor market prior to their cancer diagnosis. We use linkage data combining Canadian 1991 Census microdata with administrative records from the Canadian Cancer Registry, the Vital Statistics Registry and longitudinal personal income tax records. We estimate changes in the magnitude of cancer effects during the first 3 years following the year of the diagnosis using a large sample of cancer survivors diagnosed at ages 25 to 61. The comparison group consists of similar workers never diagnosed with cancer. The empirical strategy combines coarsened exact matching and regression models to deal with observed and unobserved differences between the cancer and comparison groups. The results show moderate negative cancer effects on work status and annual earnings. Over the 3-year period following the year of the diagnosis, the probability of working is 5 percentage points lower for cancer survivors than for the comparison group, and their earnings are 10% lower. Our findings also suggest that the effects of cancer on labor market outcomes differ for high and low survival rate cancer categories.

10.1002/hec.3342.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了癌症对癌症幸存者工作状态和年度收入的长期影响，这些幸存者在癌症诊断前对劳动力市场的依赖性较强。我们结合了加拿大1991年人口普查微观数据以及加拿大癌症登记处、人口统计登记处和纵向个人所得税记录的行政数据来构建研究样本。我们通过大量25至61岁被诊断出癌症的幸存者数据，估计了诊断后前3年内癌症对工作和收入影响的程度变化。对照组由未患癌症的类似工人组成。研究采用精确匹配和回归模型相结合的方法，以处理癌症组和对照组之间观察到的及未观察到的差异。研究结果显示，癌症对工作状态和年度收入有中等程度的负面影响。在诊断后3年期间，癌症幸存者工作的概率比对照组低5个百分点，他们的收入也低10%。研究结果还表明，癌症对劳动力市场结果的影响因癌症存活率的差异而有所不同。

abstract.text: From 2004 to 2012, the German social health insurance levied a co-payment for the first doctor visit in a calendar quarter. We develop a new model for estimating the effect of such a co-payment on the individual number of visits per quarter. The model combines a one-time increase in the otherwise constant hazard rate determining the timing of doctor visits with a difference-in-differences strategy to identify the reform effect. An extended version of the model accounts for a mismatch between reporting period and calendar quarter. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we do not find an effect of the co-payment on demand for doctor visits.

10.1002/hec.3343.abstractZh: 从2004年到2012年，德国社会健康保险在每日历季度内的首次就诊时征收了共同支付费用。我们开发了一个新的模型，用于估算这种共同支付费用对每季度就诊次数的影响。该模型结合了一次性的、原本恒定的风险率变化，以确定就诊时间，并采用差异-差异策略来识别改革的效果。该模型的扩展版本考虑了报告周期与日历季度之间的不匹配问题。利用德国社会经济面板数据，我们没有发现共同支付费用对就诊需求产生任何影响。

abstract.text: This paper designs a bio-economic model to examine the use of substitute antibiotic drugs (analogs) sold by an industry that has open access to the resource of the antibiotic class's susceptibility (treatment effectiveness). Antibiotics are characterized by different expected recovery rates and production costs, which in conjunction with the class's treatment susceptibility determines their relative effectiveness. Our analysis reveals that the high-quality antibiotic drug loses its comparative advantage over time making the low-quality drug the treatment of last resort in the market equilibrium and the social optimum when antibiotic susceptibility cannot replenish. However, when antibiotic susceptibility is renewable, both antibiotics may be used in the long run, and the comparative advantage of the high-quality drug may be restored in the social optimum that allows lowering infection in the long run. We develop the optimal tax/subsidy scheme that would induce antibiotic producers under open access to behave optimally and account for the social cost of infection and value of antibiotic susceptibility. We show that the welfare loss associated with the uncorrected open-access allocation is highest; when the resource of antibiotic susceptibility is non-renewable, high morbidity costs are incurred by individuals, and low social discount rates apply.

10.1002/hec.3348.abstractZh: 本文设计了一个生物经济模型，用于研究一家能够自由获取抗生素类资源易感性的行业所销售的替代抗生素药物（类似药）的使用情况。抗生素具有不同的预期恢复率和生产成本，这些因素与该类抗生素的治疗易感性共同决定了它们的相对有效性。我们的分析表明，高质量的抗生素药物随着时间的推移会失去其比较优势，导致低质量的抗生素药物成为市场均衡和社会最优中的最后选择，尤其是在抗生素易感性无法恢复的情况下。然而，当抗生素易感性是可再生时，从长远来看，两种抗生素都可能被使用，高质量抗生素药物的比较优势可以在降低感染率方面发挥作用。我们提出了最优的税收/补贴方案，以促使在开放获取条件下的抗生素生产商采取最优行为，并考虑到感染的社会成本和抗生素易性的价值。研究表明，当抗生素易感性不可再生时，个体将面临较高的发病率成本，且社会折现率较低时，未纠正的开放获取分配所带来的福利损失最大。

abstract.text: In this paper, we analyze optimal risk adjustment for direct risk selection (DRS). Integrating insurers' activities for risk selection into a discrete choice model of individuals' health insurance choice shows that DRS has the structure of a contest. For the contest success function (csf) used in most of the contest literature (the Tullock-csf), optimal transfers for a risk adjustment scheme have to be determined by means of a restricted quantile regression, irrespective of whether insurers are primarily engaged in positive DRS (attracting low risks) or negative DRS (repelling high risks). This is at odds with the common practice of determining transfers by means of a least squares regression. However, this common practice can be rationalized for a new csf, but only if positive and negative DRSs are equally important; if they are not, optimal transfers have to be calculated by means of a restricted asymmetric least squares regression. Using data from German and Swiss health insurers, we find considerable differences between the three types of regressions. Optimal transfers therefore critically depend on which csf represents insurers' incentives for DRS and, if it is not the Tullock-csf, whether insurers are primarily engaged in positive or negative DRS.

10.1002/hec.3352.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了直接风险选择的最优风险调整问题。将保险公司进行风险选择的活动纳入个体健康保险选择的离散选择模型后，发现直接风险选择具有竞争结构。对于大多数竞争文献中使用的竞争成功函数（Tullock-csf），无论保险公司主要参与的是正向风险选择（吸引低风险）还是负向风险选择（排斥高风险），都需要通过限制性分位数回归来确定最优风险调整方案。这与通常通过最小二乘回归来确定转移量的做法相悖。然而，这种常见做法对于新的竞争成功函数来说是可以合理的，但前提是正向和负向风险选择同样重要；如果它们并不重要，那么就需要通过限制性非对称最小二乘回归来计算最优转移量。利用德国和瑞士健康保险公司的数据，我们发现这三种回归方法之间存在显著差异。因此，最优转移量在很大程度上取决于哪种竞争成功函数能够反映保险公司对风险选择的激励，如果不是Tullock-csf，还需要考虑保险公司主要参与的是正向还是负向风险选择。

abstract.text: We evaluate consumption responses to the non-linear Medicare Part D prescription drug benefit. We compare propensity-matched older patients with diabetes and Part D Standard or low-income-subsidy (LIS) coverage. We evaluate monthly adherence to branded oral anti-diabetics, with high end-of-year donut hole prices (>$200) for Standard patients and consistent, low (≤$6) prices for LIS. As an additional control, we examine adherence to generic anti-diabetics, with relatively low, consistent prices for Standard patients. If Standard patients are forward looking, they will reduce branded adherence in January, and LIS-Standard differences will be constant through the year. Contrary to this expectation, branded adherence is lower for Standard patients in January and diverges from LIS as the coverage year progresses. Standard-LIS generic adherence differences are minimal. Our findings suggest that seniors with chronic conditions respond myopically to the nonlinear Part D benefit, reducing consumption in response to high deductible, initial coverage and gap prices. Thus, when the gap is fully phased out in 2020, cost-related nonadherence will likely remain in the face of higher spot prices for more costly branded medications. These results contribute to studies of Part D plan choice and medication adherence that suggest that seniors may not make optimal healthcare decisions.

10.1002/hec.3355.abstractZh: 我们评估了消费者对非线性Medicare Part D处方药福利的响应。我们比较了患有糖尿病且享有Part D标准或低收入补贴覆盖的老年患者之间的倾向匹配情况。我们评估了他们对品牌口服降糖药的月度依从性，其中标准患者的年终缺口价格超过200美元，而低收入补贴患者的价格则一直保持在6美元以下。作为额外的控制变量，我们还研究了他们对通用降糖药的依从性，标准患者的通用药品价格相对较低且稳定。如果标准患者具有前瞻性思维，他们会在1月份减少品牌药物的依从性，而低收入补贴标准患者的依从性差异则会在全年保持不变。然而，与这一预期相反，标准患者在1月份的品牌药物依从性较低，并且随着覆盖年度的推进，其依从性与低收入补贴患者的依从性出现差异。标准患者与低收入补贴患者在通用药物依从性上的差异很小。我们的研究结果表明，患有慢性疾病的老年人对非线性Part D福利的反应是短视的，他们会因高免赔额、初始覆盖范围和缺口价格而减少用药。因此，当2020年缺口完全取消时，尽管品牌药物的现货价格上升，但由于成本原因，患者仍可能继续不依从。这些结果有助于研究Part D计划选择和药物依从性问题，表明老年人可能无法做出最佳的医疗保健决策。

abstract.text: Non-compliance with medication therapy remains an unsolved and expensive problem for healthcare systems around the world, yet we know little about the factors that affect a patient's decision to follow treatment recommendations. In particular, there is little evidence on the extent to which doctors can influence patient adherence behavior. This study uses a unique panel dataset comprising all prescription drug users, physicians, and all prescription drug sales in Denmark over 7 years to analyze the contributions of doctor-specific, patient-specific, and drug-specific factors to the adherence decision. We find that physicians exert substantial influence on patient compliance. Further, the quality of the match between a doctor and a patient accounts for a substantial portion of the variation in adherence outcomes. This suggests that the sorting of patients across doctors is an important mechanism that affects patient adherence beyond the effects of individual patient-specific and physician-specific factors.

10.1002/hec.3357.abstractZh: 不遵守药物治疗仍然是全球医疗系统面临的一个未解决且成本高昂的问题，然而我们对影响患者是否遵循治疗建议的因素知之甚少。特别是，关于医生在多大程度上能够影响患者的依从性，目前几乎没有相关证据。本研究使用了丹麦7年间所有处方药使用者、医生以及处方药销售数据的独特面板数据集，来分析医生特定因素、患者特定因素以及药物特定因素对依从性决策的影响。我们发现，医生对患者的依从性有着显著的影响。此外，医生与患者之间的匹配质量在依从性结果的变化中占据了重要部分。这表明，将患者分配到不同的医生手中是一种重要的机制，它超越了个体患者特定因素和医生特定因素的影响，对患者的依从性产生了重要影响。

abstract.text: We study the impact of language deficiency on the health status of childhood migrants to Australia. Our identification strategy relies on a quasi-experiment comparing immigrants arriving at different ages and from different linguistic origins. In the presence of considerable non-classical measurement error in self-reported language proficiency, our results provide lower and upper bounds for a strong negative effect of English deficiency on health of between one half and a full standard deviation in the health score.

10.1002/hec.3358.abstractZh: 我们研究了语言缺陷对澳大利亚儿童移民健康状况的影响。我们的识别策略依赖于一项准实验，该实验比较了不同年龄和语言背景的移民。在自我报告的语言能力存在相当大的非经典测量误差的情况下，我们的研究结果提供了英语能力缺陷对健康的强烈负面影响的上下界限，健康评分的偏差范围在半个标准差到一个完整标准差之间。

abstract.text: Eating disorders are currently the deadliest mental disorder in the United States, affecting an estimated 12%-25% of all college women. Previous research has found a positive correlation between sorority membership and eating disorders, but the causal link has not been firmly established. We contribute to the literature by investigating a possible causal link among sororities and diagnosed eating disorders, measurable weight outcomes, and disordered-eating behaviors using data from the American College Health Association Survey. We handle the potential endogeneity of sorority membership using propensity score matching and instrumental variable methods to determine whether joining a sorority is a cause of the weight-related outcomes we study. We find that sorority members exhibit worse weight-related outcomes than those not in a sorority. However, our propensity score matching and instrumental variable results suggest that, other than BMI, this is merely a correlation, and there is little evidence that sorority membership is a cause of the outcomes we study.

10.1002/hec.3360.abstractZh: 饮食失调目前是美国最致命的精神疾病之一，估计有12%至25%的大学女性受到其影响。先前的研究发现，加入姐妹会与饮食失调之间存在正相关关系，但因果关系尚未得到明确证实。我们通过使用美国大学健康协会调查的数据，探讨姐妹会与确诊的饮食失调、可测量的体重结果以及饮食失调行为之间可能存在的因果关系。为了处理加入姐妹会这一变量可能存在的内生性问题，我们采用了倾向得分匹配和工具变量方法，以确定加入姐妹会是导致我们所研究体重相关结果的原因。研究发现，加入姐妹会的女性在体重相关结果方面表现更差。然而，我们的倾向得分匹配和工具变量分析结果表明，除了BMI之外，这种相关性仅仅是巧合，几乎没有证据表明加入姐妹会是导致我们所研究结果的原因。

abstract.text: The emergence and spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is still an unresolved problem worldwide. In intensive care units (ICUs), first-line antibiotic therapy is highly standardized and widely empiric while treatment failure because of AMR often has severe consequences. Simultaneously, there is a limited number of reserve antibiotics, whose prices and/or side effects are substantially higher than first-line therapy. This paper explores the implications of resistance-induced substitution effects in ICUs. The extent of such substitution effects is shown in a dynamic fixed effect regression analysis using a panel of 66 German ICUs with monthly antibiotic use and resistance data between 2001 and 2012. Our findings support the hypothesis that demand for reserve antibiotics substantially increases when resistance towards first-line agents rises. For some analyses the lagged effect of resistance is also significant, supporting the conjecture that part of the substitution effect is caused by physicians changing antibiotic choices in empiric treatment by adapting their resistance expectation to new information on resistance prevalence. The available information about resistance rates allows physicians to efficiently balance the trade-off between exacerbating resistance and ensuring treatment success. However, resistance-induced substitution effects are not free of charge. These effects should be considered an indirect burden of AMR.

10.1002/hec.3363.abstractZh: 抗菌素耐药性的出现和扩散仍然是全球范围内一个未解决的问题。在重症监护病房中，一线抗生素治疗具有高度标准化且基于经验进行，而由于抗菌素耐药性导致的治疗失败往往会产生严重的后果。同时，储备抗生素的数量有限，其价格和/或副作用远高于一线治疗。本文探讨了耐药性引起的替代效应在重症监护病房中的影响。通过使用包含66个德国重症监护病房的数据进行动态固定效应回归分析，这些数据涵盖了2001至2012年间每月的抗生素使用量和耐药性数据，从而揭示了这种替代效应的程度。我们的研究结果支持以下假设：当对一线药物的耐药性上升时，对储备抗生素的需求会显著增加。在某些分析中，耐药性的滞后效应也很显著，这支持了部分替代效应是由医生根据新的耐药性信息调整经验性治疗中的抗生素选择所导致的推测。关于耐药率的现有信息使医生能够有效平衡加剧耐药性和确保治疗成功之间的权衡。然而，耐药性引起的替代效应并非无成本。这些效应应被视为抗菌素耐药性带来的间接负担。

abstract.text: In this paper, we assemble five large administrative data sets in Taiwan to investigate the short-run and long-run effects of birth weight. Comparing with previous studies, our results are more precisely estimated due to the large sample size. Using administrative data sets, the problems arising from self-reported samples are also mitigated. Moreover, we are able to examine both singletons by controlling sibling fixed effects and twins by controlling twin fixed effects. Our results show that an infant's birth weight has positive influence on health and education. Our twin fixed-effects estimates confirm the finding of a long-lasting, but diminishing in the longer run, effects of birth weight.

10.1002/hec.3367.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们整合了台湾的五组大型行政数据集，以研究出生体重的短期和长期影响。与以往的研究相比，由于样本量较大，我们的结果估计更为精确。利用行政数据集，也缓解了自报样本所带来的问题。此外，我们通过控制兄弟姐妹的固定效应来研究单胎婴儿的情况，并通过控制双胞胎的固定效应来研究双胞胎婴儿的情况。我们的结果显示，婴儿的出生体重对健康和教育有积极影响。我们的双胞胎固定效应估计结果证实了出生体重具有长期影响，但随着时间的推移这种影响会逐渐减弱。

abstract.text: We evaluate the long-term effects of famine on chronic diseases using China's Great Leap Forward Famine as a natural experiment. Using a unique health survey, we explore the heterogeneity of famine intensity across regions and find strong evidence supporting both the adverse effect and the selection effect. The two offsetting effects co-exist and their magnitudes vary in different age cohorts at the onset of famine. The selection effect is dominant among the prenatal/infant famine-exposed cohort, while the adverse effect appears dominant among the childhood/puberty famine-exposed cohort. The net famine effects are more salient in rural residents and non-migrants subsamples. Gender differences are also found, and are sensitive to smoking and drinking behaviors. Our conclusion is robust to various specifications.

10.1002/hec.3371.abstractZh: 我们利用中国的“大跃进饥荒”作为自然实验，评估了饥荒对慢性疾病的长期影响。通过一项独特的健康调查，我们探讨了不同地区饥荒强度的差异性，并发现了支持不利影响和选择效应的有力证据。这两种相互抵消的影响在饥荒发生时的不同年龄群体中存在，其程度也有所不同。在产前/婴儿期暴露于饥荒的群体中，选择效应更为显著；而在儿童期/青春期暴露于饥荒的群体中，不利影响更为明显。在农村居民和非移民样本中，饥荒的净影响更为显著。我们还发现了性别差异，这些差异对吸烟和饮酒行为具有敏感性。我们的结论在不同假设下都是稳健的。

abstract.text: The relationship between income and health is one of the most explored topics in health economics but less is known about this relationship at different points of the health distribution. Analysis based solely on the mean may miss important information in other parts of the distribution. This is especially relevant when clinical concern is focused on the tail of the distribution and when evaluating the income gradient at different points of the distribution and decomposing income-related inequalities in health is of interest. We use the unconditional quantile regression approach to analyse the income gradient across the entire distribution of objectively measured blood-based biomarkers. We apply an Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition at various quantiles of the biomarker distributions to analyse gender differentials in biomarkers and to measure the contribution of income (and other covariates) to these differentials. Using data from the Health Survey for England, we find a non-linear relationship between income and health and a strong gradient with respect to income at the highest quantiles of the biomarker distributions. We find that there is heterogeneity in the association of health to income across genders, which accounts for a substantial percentage of the gender differentials in observed health.

10.1002/hec.3372.abstractZh: 收入与健康状况之间的关系是健康经济学中研究最为深入的话题之一，但关于这一关系在健康分布的不同阶段的具体表现，我们了解得还不够多。仅基于平均值的分析可能会遗漏分布其他部分的重要信息。当临床关注点集中在分布的尾部时，这一点尤为突出，此时评估分布不同阶段的收入梯度以及分解与收入相关的健康不平等现象就变得非常重要。我们采用无条件分位数回归方法，来分析整个分布中客观测量的血液生物标志物与收入之间的关系。通过对生物标志物分布的不同分位数进行Oaxaca-Blinder分解，我们可以分析性别在生物标志物上的差异，并衡量收入（及其他协变量）对这些差异的影响。利用英格兰健康调查的数据，我们发现收入与健康之间存在非线性关系，并且在生物标志物分布的最高分位数处，收入与健康状况之间存在明显的梯度差异。我们还发现，不同性别之间健康与收入之间的关联存在异质性，这一异质性占观察到的性别健康差异的相当大比例。

abstract.text: After a period of steady decline, out-of-pocket (OOP) costs for general practitioner (GP) consultations in Australia began increasing in the mid-1990s. Following the rising community concerns about the increasing costs, the Australian Government introduced the Strengthening Medicare reforms in 2004 and 2005, which included a targeted incentive for GPs to charge zero OOP costs for consultations provided to children and concession cardholders (older adults and the poor), as well as an increase in the reimbursement for all GP visits. This paper examines the impact of those reforms using longitudinal survey and administrative data from a large national sample of women. The findings suggest that the reforms were effective in reducing OOP costs by an average of $A0.40 per visit. Decreases in OOP costs, however, were not evenly distributed. Those with higher pre-reform OOP costs had the biggest reductions in OOP costs, as did those with concession cards. However, results also reveal increases in OOP costs for most people without a concession card. The analysis suggests that there has been considerable heterogeneity in GP responses to the reforms, which has led to substantial changes in the fees charged by doctors and, as a result, the OOP costs incurred by different population groups.

10.1002/hec.3376.abstractZh: 在经历了一段时间的稳步下降之后，澳大利亚全科医生咨询的自付费用在20世纪90年代中期开始上升。随着社区对费用增加的担忧日益加剧，澳大利亚政府在2004年和2005年推出了《加强医疗保险改革》，其中包括对全科医生为儿童和持有优惠卡（老年人和贫困人群）患者提供的咨询服务收取零自付费用的激励措施，以及提高所有全科医生就诊的报销比例。本文利用对大量全国女性样本的纵向调查和行政数据，研究了这些改革的影响。研究结果表明，这些改革有效地将每次就诊的自付费用平均降低了0.40澳元。然而，自付费用的降低并非均匀分布。改革前自付费用较高的群体以及持有优惠卡的人群自付费用下降幅度最大。不过，研究也显示，大多数没有优惠卡的人群的自付费用却有所上升。分析表明，全科医生对改革的反应存在相当大的差异，这导致了医生收费的显著变化，进而影响了不同人群的自付费用。

abstract.text: Recent policy attempts to set high nutrition standards for the School Breakfast Program (SBP) and National School Lunch Program (NSLP) aim to improve children's health outcomes. A timely and policy-relevant task evaluates to what extent school meal programs contribute to child body mass index (BMI) outcomes to assess those school meal policies' potential impacts. This study examines children's weight progress from 1st through 8th grade, while recognizing the potential effects on those children participating in both programs compared with those children participating in only one program. We used difference-in-differences (DID) and average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) methodologies and focused on free- and reduced-price meal-eligible children to filter out income effects. The DID results show that short-term participation in only NSLP increases the probability that children will be overweight, and these results are more prominent in the South, Northeast, and rural areas. ATT results show that participation in both programs from 1st through 8th grade increases the probability that these students will be overweight. With the Community Eligibility Provision having taken effect across the nation in the 2014-2015 school year, the need to continue examining the impacts of these programs on child BMI is even greater.

10.1002/hec.3378.abstractZh: 近期，政府试图为学校早餐计划和国家学校午餐计划设定较高的营养标准，以改善儿童的身体健康状况。一项及时且符合政策要求的评估工作，旨在了解学校餐食计划在多大程度上影响儿童的身体质量指数，从而评估这些学校餐食政策可能产生的效果。本研究考察了从一年级到八年级儿童体重的变化情况，同时考虑了同时参与两个计划与仅参与一个计划的孩子之间的潜在差异。我们采用了差异中差异（DID）方法和平均处理效应对受处理者（ATT）方法，并重点关注符合免费或减价餐食条件的儿童，以排除收入因素的影响。DID结果显示，仅参与NSLP会在短期内增加儿童超重的概率，这一效应在南方、东北部和农村地区更为明显。ATT结果显示，从一年级到八年级，同时参与两个计划会使学生超重的概率增加。随着2014-2015学年全国范围内社区资格条款的实施，继续研究这些计划对儿童BMI的影响显得尤为重要。

abstract.text: While many economic studies have explored the role of prenatal care in infant health production, the literature is sporadic on the effects of prenatal care on the mother. This research contributes to this understudied but important area using a unique large dataset of sibling newborns delivered by 0.17 million mothers. We apply within-mother estimators to find robust evidence that poor prenatal care utilization due to late onset of care, low frequency of care visits, or combinations of the two significantly increases the risks of maternal insufficient gestational weight gain, prenatal smoking, premature rupture of membranes, precipitous labor, no breastfeeding, postnatal underweight, and postpartum smoking. The magnitude of the estimates relative to the respective sample means of the outcome variables ranges from 3% to 33%. The results highlight the importance of receiving timely and sufficient prenatal care in improving maternal health and health behaviors during pregnancy as well as after childbirth.

10.1002/hec.3380.abstractZh: 虽然许多经济学研究探讨了产前护理对婴儿健康的影响，但关于产前护理对母亲影响的文献却较为稀少。本研究利用了一个独特的大型数据集，该数据集包含了由17万母亲所生育的兄弟姐妹新生儿的数据，为这一被忽视但重要的领域提供了研究支持。我们通过使用母体内估计方法，发现了一些有力的证据：由于产前护理开始时间晚、护理频率低或两者兼有的原因导致的产前护理不足，会显著增加母亲妊娠期间体重增长不足、产前吸烟、胎膜早破、急产、不母乳喂养、产后体重过轻以及产后吸烟的风险。这些估计值相对于相应样本变量的均值，其差异范围在3%到33%之间。研究结果强调了及时且充分的产前护理在改善母亲健康和孕期及产后健康行为方面的重要性。

abstract.text: This research provides the first in-depth analysis of the effect that increased cigarette taxes have on exercise behavior. Smoking may diminish the ability to exercise; individuals may also use exercise to compensate for the harmful health effects of smoking or to avoid gaining weight if they cut back. Our conceptual model highlights these and several other avenues for effect and reveals that the predicted effect of cigarette costs on exercise behavior is theoretically ambiguous. To investigate the relationship empirically, 1994-2012 data from the behavioral risk factor surveillance system are combined with state level cigarette tax rates and other state level variables.
