10.1002/hec.3477.abstractZh: 个人对长期健康状况的更好管理有助于改善健康状况并减少医疗支出。然而，关于自我管理活动的决定因素和后果的相关证据有限。本研究调查了两种自我管理形式的决定因素——锻炼和放松，以及它们对3472名长期患有健康问题的个体在1年内的健康和福祉的影响。我们使用同时递归三变量模型来估计这两种干预措施对三个健康和福祉指标的影响：EuroQol五维评分、自我评估的健康状况以及幸福感。我们考虑了时间和知识的机会成本，以及就业状态和教育程度的影响，发现就业会减少放松时间，而教育程度则会增加锻炼时间。我们发现，锻炼和放松都不会影响EuroQol五维评分，但锻炼能提升自我评估的健康状况，而放松则能增加幸福感。研究结果表明，个体会根据经济约束调整自己的自我管理活动，从而对其效用的不同方面产生影响。鼓励自我管理的干预措施应考虑到不同的效果和约束条件。

abstract.text: One of the main concerns about capitation-based reimbursement systems is that tertiary institutions may be underfunded due to insufficient reimbursements of more complicated cases. We test this hypothesis with a data set from New Zealand that, in 2003, introduced a capitation system where public healthcare provider funding is primarily based on the characteristics of the regional population. Investigating the funding for all cases from 2003 to 2011, we find evidence that tertiary providers are at a disadvantage compared with secondary providers. The reasons are that tertiary providers not only attract the most complicated, but also the highest number of cases. Our findings suggest that accurate risk adjustment is crucial to the success of a capitation-based reimbursement system.

10.1002/hec.3478.abstractZh: 关于按费用计酬的报销制度，主要的一个担忧是，由于对较为复杂的病例的报销不足，高等教育机构可能会面临资金不足的问题。我们通过新西兰的数据集来验证这一假设。2003年，新西兰引入了按费用计酬的报销制度，该制度下公共医疗保健机构的资金主要依据区域人口的特征来确定。通过对2003年至2011年间所有病例的经费情况进行分析，我们发现高等教育机构相对于中等教育机构而言处于劣势。原因在于，高等教育机构不仅吸引了最为复杂的病例，而且病例数量也最多。我们的研究结果表明，准确的风险调整对于按费用计酬的报销制度的成功至关重要。

abstract.text: Much criticism has been directed at the licencing requirements for medical devices (MDs) as they often result in a lack of robust evidence to inform health technology assessment (HTA) decisions. To better understand the current international decisional framework on MD technologies, we undertook three linked research studies: a review of the device regulatory procedures, a survey of current HTA practices and an empirical comparison of HTA reports of drugs versus MDs. Our review confirms that current device regulatory processes across the globe are substantially less stringent than drugs. As a result, international HTA agencies report that they face a number of challenges when assessing MDs, including reliance on suboptimal data to make clinical and cost-effectiveness decisions. Whilst many HTA agencies have adapted their processes and procedures to handle MD technology submissions, in our comparison of HTA reports we found little evidence of the application of methodologies that take account of device-specific issues, such as incremental development. Overall, our research reinforces the need for better linkage between licencing and HTA and the development and application of innovative HTA methodologies with the objective of securing faster patient access for those technologies that can be shown to represent good value for money.

10.1002/hec.3479.abstractZh: 对于医疗器械的许可要求，一直存在许多批评，因为这些要求往往导致缺乏强有力的证据来为健康技术评估决策提供依据。为了更好地理解当前国际上对医疗器械技术的决策框架，我们进行了三项相关的研究：对设备监管程序的回顾、对当前健康技术评估实践的调查，以及药物与医疗器械的评估报告的实证比较。我们的回顾表明，全球范围内的设备监管流程远不如药物严格。因此，国际健康技术评估机构报告称，在评估医疗器械时面临许多挑战，包括依赖次优数据来做出临床和成本效益决策。虽然许多健康技术评估机构已经调整了流程和程序以处理医疗器械技术提交，但在我们对评估报告的比较中，我们发现几乎没有证据表明采用了考虑设备特定问题的方法论，例如渐进式开发。总体而言，我们的研究强调了加强许可与健康技术评估之间联系的重要性，以及开发和应用创新的健康技术评估方法论的必要性，以便为那些被证明具有良好性价比的技术提供更快的患者获取途径。

abstract.text: The 2003 Health Economics paper by Dolan, Olsen, Menzel and Richardson on 'An inquiry into the different perspectives that can be used when eliciting preferences in health' presents a conceptual framework of six perspectives along two dimensions: preferences (personal, social, and socially inclusive personal) and context (ex ante and ex post). The objective of our paper is to re-think this framework. We ask four questions concerning: the patient, or the user of the treatment; the payer of the treatment; the assessor of the value of treatment; and the timing of the illness and the nature of its risk. These questions refine the preference and context dimensions, and lead to the identification of perspectives not classified by the original framework. We propose an extended framework with five preferences (personal, non-use, proxy, social, and socially inclusive personal) and five contexts (one of which is ex post and four ex ante): since two of these cells are empty, this results in 23 possible perspectives. Online Supplementary Information presents 11 of these more formally to clearly distinguish between them and uses monetary and non-monetary (time trade-off) valuation tasks as examples.

10.1002/hec.3480.abstractZh: Dolan、Olsen、Menzel和Richardson在2003年发表的《健康经济学》论文《探究在引出健康偏好时可以采用的不同视角》提出了一个由六个视角组成的概念框架，这些视角分为两个维度：偏好（个人、社会及社会包容性个人）和情境（事前与事后）。我们的论文旨在重新思考这一框架。我们提出了四个问题来探讨：患者或治疗使用者、治疗支付者、治疗价值评估者，以及疾病发生的时间及其风险性质。这些问题进一步细化了偏好和情境维度，并识别出原始框架中未涵盖的视角。我们提出了一个扩展的框架，包含五个偏好维度（个人、非使用、代理、社会及社会包容性个人）和五个情境维度（其中一个为事后情境，四个为事前情境）。由于其中两个维度为空，因此共有23种可能的视角。在线补充信息中列出了这11种视角，并以货币和非货币（时间权衡）评估任务为例进行了详细说明。

abstract.text: We investigate sibling correlations in youth health status using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics. We do so by estimating the covariance structure of a system of equations in latent variables using methods that have hitherto not been used in the literature on intergenerational transmissions of health. Across a battery of outcomes, we find that between 50 and 60% of health status can be attributed to shared familial or neighborhood characteristics. Taking the principal component across all outcomes, we obtain a sibling correlation of about 53%. These estimates, which are larger than previous estimates of sibling correlations in health that rely on linear models, are more in-line with sibling correlations in income and suggest that health status, like other measures of socioeconomic success, is strongly influenced by family background.

10.1002/hec.3483.abstractZh: 我们使用“收入动态面板研究”来探讨青少年健康状况中的兄弟姐妹相关性。我们通过使用以往在代际健康传递研究中没有使用过的方法，估计了一个潜在变量方程组的协方差结构。在一系列结果中，我们发现50%到60%的健康状况可以归因于共同的家庭或社区特征。通过将所有结果综合成一个主成分，我们得到了大约53%的兄弟姐妹相关性。这些估计值比之前基于线性模型得出的兄弟姐妹健康相关性估计值要高，更符合收入方面的兄弟姐妹相关性，并表明健康状况，就像其他社会经济成功指标一样，受到家庭背景的强烈影响。

abstract.text: In July 2009, the World Health Organization declared the first flu pandemic in nearly 40 years. Although the health effects of the pandemic have been studied, there is little research examining the labor productivity consequences. Using unique sick leave data from the Chilean private health insurance system, we estimate the effect of the pandemic on missed days of work. We estimate that the pandemic increased mean flu days missed by 0.042 days per person-month during the 2009 peak winter months (June and July), representing an 800% increase in missed days relative to the sample mean. Calculations using the estimated effect imply a minimum 0.2% reduction in Chile's labor supply.

10.1002/hec.3485.abstractZh: 2009年7月，世界卫生组织宣布了近40年来首次流感大流行。尽管已经对这次大流行的健康影响进行了研究，但关于其对劳动生产率影响的研究却很少。我们利用智利私人健康保险系统的独特病假数据，估算了这次大流行对缺勤天数的影响。研究结果显示，在2009年冬季高峰期（6月和7月），流感大流行导致每人每月平均缺勤天数增加了0.042天，与样本平均值相比，缺勤天数增加了800%。根据估算结果，智利劳动力供应至少减少了0.2%。

abstract.text: This paper explores the role of incentives in the English National Health Service. Until financial year 2009/2010, elective procedures that were cancelled after admission received a fixed reimbursement associated with a specific healthcare resource group code. We investigate whether this induced trusts to admit and then cancel, rather than cancel before admission and/or to cancel low fee over high fee work. As the tariff was ended in April 2010, we conduct an interrupted time series analysis to examine if their behaviour was affected after the tariff removal. The results indicate a small, yet statistically significant, decline in the probability of a last minute cancellation in the post-tariff period, especially for certain types of patients and diagnoses.

10.1002/hec.3486.abstractZh: 本文探讨了激励措施在英国国家健康服务体系中的作用。在2009/2010财政年度之前，被取消的择期手术会获得与特定医疗资源代码相关的固定报销。我们研究了这是否促使医疗机构选择先收治患者后再取消手术，而不是在手术前就取消手术，或者选择以较低费用替代较高费用的服务。由于收费标准在2010年4月被取消，我们进行了间断时间序列分析，以研究在收费标准取消后，医疗机构的行为是否受到影响。结果表明，在收费标准取消后的时期，最后一刻取消手术的概率有所下降，尤其是在某些类型的患者和诊断情况下，这种下降幅度虽小，但具有统计学意义。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of unanticipated economic shocks on the use of contraceptives for childbirth control in Uganda using a nationally representative panel of women. To complement our reduced form analysis, we use both intra-village and inter-village variation in rainfall shocks between 2009 and 2012 to identify the impact of agricultural income on the adoption of contraceptives by Ugandan women and their husbands. Our results indicate that women in Uganda, along with their husbands, use contraceptives strategically to postpone childbirth during negative shocks. Our baseline coefficient estimate reveals that a 0.10 log-point adverse rainfall shock increases the demand for contraceptives by 3.8 percentage points. This translates to a 6.7% increase in the likelihood of contraceptives demand. Results from the two-stage least-square instrumental variable estimation for the impact of income complements the strategic birth control story from the reduced form estimates of this paper. More importantly, we find suggestive evidence-linking preventive childbirth decisions to food insecurity during drought.

10.1002/hec.3487.abstractZh: 我们研究了意外经济冲击对乌干达妇女使用避孕措施以控制分娩的影响，研究采用了全国代表性妇女样本。为了补充我们的简化模型分析，我们利用了2009年至2012年间村内和村际降雨冲击的差异，以探讨农业收入对乌干达妇女及其丈夫采用避孕措施的影响。研究结果表明，乌干达的妇女及其丈夫会在经济冲击期间采取策略性措施推迟分娩。我们的基线系数估计显示，每出现0.10个对数点的降雨冲击，避孕需求就会增加3.8个百分点，即避孕需求的可能性增加6.7%。通过两阶段最小二乘法工具变量估计，我们进一步证实了收入互补性与策略性避孕之间的关系。更重要的是，我们发现预防分娩的决策与干旱期间的食物不安全之间存在关联。

abstract.text: In this analysis, we examine the effect of wages on obesity by constructing pseudo-panels to conduct a dynamic estimation of Grossman's human capital model. The results indicate that wages have an increasing effect on obesity status. After accounting for past health status, the protective effect of wages commonly disseminated in the literature reverses on obesity status. The results may also indicate possible asymmetric consumption behavior between foods/nutrients that improve diet quality versus those that degrade it. Individuals may be more keen to adhere to prophylactic diet strategies that abate consumption of unhealthy food/nutrients rather than measures which increase healthy nutrient consumption. Additionally, wages have an increasing effect on overall total calories consumed. These findings suggest that higher wage earners may focus their diet efforts on reducing consumption of specific nutrients but compensate by overconsuming other types of nutrients increasing overall calorie intake.

10.1002/hec.3488.abstractZh: 在这项分析中，我们通过构建伪面板来动态估计Grossman的人力资本模型，以研究工资对肥胖的影响。研究结果表明，工资对肥胖状况有积极影响。在考虑过去健康状况后，文献中通常提到的工资对肥胖的保护作用在肥胖状况上却呈现相反的效果。这些结果还可能表明，在改善饮食质量的食品/营养素与降低饮食质量的食品/营养素之间，个体可能存在不对称的消费行为。个体可能更倾向于遵循减少不健康食品/营养素摄入的预防性饮食策略，而不是增加健康营养素摄入的措施。此外，工资对总热量摄入也有积极影响。这些发现表明，收入较高的个体可能会将饮食努力集中在减少特定营养素的摄入上，但会过度摄入其他类型的营养素，从而导致总体热量摄入增加。

abstract.text: If two partners smoke, their quit behavior may be related through correlation in unobserved individual characteristics and through common shocks. However, there may also be a causal effect whereby the quit behavior of one partner is affected by the quit decision of the other partner. If so, there is a spousal peer effect on the decision to quit smoking. We use data containing retrospective information of Dutch partnered individuals about their age of onset of smoking and their age of quitting smoking. We estimate mixed proportional hazard models of starting rates and quit rates of smoking in which we allow unobserved heterogeneity to be correlated across partners. Using a timing of events approach, we determine whether the quitting-to-smoke decision of one partner has a causal effect on the quitting-to-smoke decision of the other partner. We find no evidence of substantial spousal peer effects in the decision to quit smoking. Apparently, love conquers all but nicotine addiction.

10.1002/hec.3489.abstractZh: 如果两位伴侣都吸烟，他们的戒烟行为可能通过未观察到的个体特征之间的相关性以及共同的影响因素而相互关联。然而，也可能存在一种因果效应，即一位伴侣的戒烟决定会受到另一位伴侣的戒烟行为的影响。如果存在这种效应，那么伴侣之间就存在同伴效应，会影响戒烟决策。我们使用了包含荷兰伴侣个体吸烟开始年龄和戒烟年龄的回顾性数据。我们建立了混合比例风险模型，用于估计吸烟的开始率和戒烟率，并允许未观察到的异质性在伴侣之间产生相关性。通过事件时间分析的方法，我们确定了一位伴侣的戒烟决定是否会对另一位伴侣的戒烟决策产生因果影响。我们发现，在戒烟决策方面，伴侣之间并没有显著的同伴效应。显然，爱情能够战胜一切，包括尼古丁成瘾。

abstract.text: Using Monte-Carlo simulations, we compare the two-stage least-squares estimator with two-stage residual inclusion estimators, with varying forms of residuals, to estimate the local average treatment effect parameter for a binary outcome and endogenous binary treatment model in the presence of binary covariates and a binary instrumental variable. We vary the rarity of both the outcome and the treatment and find different estimators to produce the least bias in different settings. We develop guidance for applied researchers and illustrate the utility of this guidance with estimating the effects of long-term care insurance on a variety of binary health care use outcomes among the near-elderly using the Health and Retirement Study.

10.1002/hec.3490.abstractZh: 通过蒙特卡洛模拟，我们比较了两种两阶段最小二乘估计量以及两种具有不同残差形式的两阶段残差包含估计量，用于估计在存在二元协变量和二元工具变量的情况下，二元结果和内生二元处理模型的局部平均处理效应参数。我们改变了结果和处理的稀有性，并发现不同的估计量在不同情况下能够产生最小的偏差。我们为应用研究人员提供了指导，并通过健康与退休研究实例说明了这种指导的实用性，即如何利用该研究估计长期护理保险对近老年人群体各种二元医疗保健使用结果的影响。

abstract.text: I study the effect of prescription drug essential health benefits (EHB) requirements from the Affordable Care Act on prescription drug formularies of health insurance marketplace plans. The EHB regulates the number of drugs covered but leaves other dimensions (cost sharing and utilization management) of the formulary unregulated. Using data on almost all formularies in the country, I demonstrate that requiring insurers to cover one additional drug adds 0.22 drugs (3.3%) to the average formulary, mostly owing to firms increasing the number of drugs covered to comply with the EHB requirement. The EHB requirement also increases the probability that a drug is subject to utilization management and is assigned to a higher (more costly) formulary tier. My results suggest that newly covered drugs are 22.3 percentage points more likely to be subject to utilization management, compared to 36.7% for the average covered drug. Using formularies for Medicare Advantage plans, which are subject to uniform, nationwide benefit design standards, and the formulary status of newly approved drugs that do not satisfy the EHB requirement, I reject the hypotheses that consumer demand or effects on plan entry can explain my results.

10.1002/hec.3491.abstractZh: 我研究了《平价医疗法案》中关于处方药基本健康福利要求对医疗保险市场计划中的处方药目录的影响。该要求规定了所覆盖药物的数量，但其他方面（如费用分担和用药管理）则由市场自行决定。通过对比全国几乎所有医疗保险计划中的药物目录数据，我发现要求保险公司额外覆盖一种药物会使平均目录中的药物数量增加0.22种（3.3%），这主要是由于保险公司为了符合基本要求而增加所覆盖药物的数量。此外，该要求还增加了药物受到用药管理的情况，并使这些药物被分配到更高（更昂贵）的目录层级。我的研究结果表明，新覆盖的药物更容易受到用药管理，其概率比平均覆盖药物高出22.3个百分点。通过对比医疗保险优势计划中的药物目录，这些目录遵循全国统一的福利设计标准，以及不符合基本要求的新批准药物在目录中的状态，我排除了消费者需求或计划准入对研究结果的影响。

abstract.text: Like other countries seeking a progressive path to universalism, Peru has attempted to reduce inequalities in access to health care by granting the poor entitlement to tax-financed basic care without charge. We identify the impact of this policy by comparing the target population's change in health care utilization with that of poor adults already covered through employment-based insurance. There are positive effects on receipt of ambulatory care and medication that are largest among the elderly and the poorest. The probability of getting formal health care when sick is increased by almost two fifths, but the likelihood of being unable to afford treatment is reduced by more than a quarter. Consistent with the shallow coverage offered, there is no impact on use of inpatient care. Neither is there any effect on average out-of-pocket health care expenditure, but medical spending is reduced by up to 25% in the top quarter of the distribution.

10.1002/hec.3492.abstractZh: 与其他寻求实现普遍化目标的国家一样，秘鲁也试图通过为贫困人群提供免费的基础医疗服务来减少医疗服务的获取不平等。我们通过比较目标人群与已通过就业保险覆盖的贫困成年人之间的医疗服务利用情况，来评估这一政策的影响。结果显示，在门诊护理和药物获取方面，老年人和最贫困人群受益最大。患病时获得正规医疗服务的机会增加了近五分之二，而难以负担治疗费用的可能性则减少了超过四分之一。与所提供的医疗服务范围有限相对应的是，住院护理的使用并未受到影响。平均自付医疗费用也没有变化，但在收入最高的四分之一人群中，医疗支出减少了高达25%。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of early retirement on mortality using Dutch administrative micro panel data. An unexpected temporary decrease in the eligibility age for retirement benefits for civil servants is used to instrument the retirement choice. We find that induced early retirement decreased the probability that a man dies within 5 years by 2.6 percentage points. The result is robust to alternative specifications and data selection criteria.

10.1002/hec.3493.abstractZh: 本文利用荷兰行政微观面板数据，估计了提前退休对死亡率的影响。通过引入公务员退休福利资格年龄的意外临时下降这一变量来模拟退休选择。研究发现，因提前退休导致的男性在5年内死亡的概率降低了2.6个百分点。这一结果在采用不同的模型设定和数据选择标准后依然保持稳定。

abstract.text: Universal access and generous coverage are important goals of the Dutch long-term care (LTC) system. It is a legal requirement that everyone eligible for LTC should be able to receive it. Institutional care (IC) made up for 90% of Dutch LTC spending. To investigate whether access to IC is as equitable as the Dutch government aspires, we explored practice variation in entitlements to IC across Dutch regions. We used a unique dataset that included all individual applications for Dutch LTC in January 2010-December 2013 (N = 3,373,358). This dataset enabled an accurate identification of the need for care. We examined the local variation in the probability of being granted long-term IC and in the intensity of the care granted given that individuals have applied for LTC. We also investigated whether the variation observed was related to differences in the local availability of care facilities. Although our analyses indicated the presence of some practice variation, its magnitude was very small by national and international standards (up to 3%). Only a minor part of the practice variation could be accounted for by local supply differences in care facilities. Overall, we conclude that, unlike many other developed countries, the Dutch system ensured equitable access to long-term IC.

10.1002/hec.3494.abstractZh: 普及性和广泛的覆盖是荷兰长期护理系统的关键目标。法律规定，所有符合资格的人都应能够接受长期护理。机构护理占荷兰长期护理支出的90%。为了探究获得机构护理的公平性是否如荷兰政府所期望的那样，我们研究了荷兰各地区的机构护理资格分配情况。我们使用了独特的数据集，涵盖了2010年1月至2013年12月期间所有个人长期护理申请记录（N=3,373,358）。该数据集使我们能够准确识别护理需求。我们研究了获得机构护理的概率以及所提供的护理强度在不同地区的差异。我们还调查了这些差异是否与当地护理设施的可用性有关。尽管我们的分析表明存在一定的实践差异，但其幅度按照国家和国际标准来看非常小（最高为3%）。只有一小部分实践差异可以归因于当地护理设施的供应差异。总体而言，我们得出结论，与许多其他发达国家不同，荷兰的系统确保了长期护理的公平获取。

abstract.text: We analyze the evolution of mortality-based health indicators in 27 European countries before and after the start of the Great Recession. We find that in the countries where the crisis has been particularly severe, mortality reductions in 2007-2010 were considerably bigger than in 2004-2007. Panel models adjusted for space-invariant and time-invariant factors show that an increase of 1 percentage point in the national unemployment rate is associated with a reduction of 0.5% (p < .001) in the rate of age-adjusted mortality. The pattern of mortality oscillating procyclically is found for total and sex-specific mortality, cause-specific mortality due to major causes of death, and mortality for ages 30-44 and 75 and over, but not for ages 0-14. Suicides appear increasing when the economy decelerates-countercyclically-but the evidence is weak. Results are robust to using different weights in the regression, applying nonlinear methods for detrending, expanding the sample, and using as business cycle indicator gross domestic product per capita or employment-to-population ratios rather than the unemployment rate. We conclude that in the European experience of the past 20 years, recessions, on average, have beneficial short-term effects on mortality of the adult population.

10.1002/hec.3495.abstractZh: 我们分析了27个欧洲国家在大衰退开始前后基于死亡率的健康指标的变化情况。研究发现，在危机尤为严重的国家，2007-2010年的死亡率下降幅度明显大于2004-2007年。经过调整空间不变和时间不变因素的面板模型显示，国家失业率每上升1个百分点，年龄调整后的死亡率就会下降0.5%（p < .001）。总体死亡率以及按性别划分的死亡率、主要死因导致的死亡率，以及30-44岁和75岁及以上人群的死亡率都表现出顺周期性波动，但0-14岁人群的死亡率则没有这种趋势。当经济放缓时，自杀率似乎会上升——但这种证据并不充分。研究结果在采用不同的回归权重、应用非线性方法去除趋势影响、扩大样本范围，以及使用人均国内生产总值或就业人口比而非失业率作为商业周期指标时仍然保持稳定。我们得出结论，在过去20年的欧洲经验中，经济衰退平均对成年人口的死亡率产生了有益的短期影响。

abstract.text: Using data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics for years 1999-2013, we investigate the impact of physical and mental illnesses on household consumption and financial status. In comparison to severe physical health problems, mental illnesses lead to larger decreases in labor income. Increases in public and private transfers following the onset of a mental illness do not completely offset the decline in labor income. Consequently, we find a significant decrease in consumption expenditures after the household head experiences a mental problem. On the other hand, public and private transfers and accumulated wealth offset the relatively smaller decline in labor income and enable households with severe physical problems to smooth their consumption. Health insurance helps to prevent larger drops in consumption after the onset of a mental health problem.

10.1002/hec.3496.abstractZh: 我们利用1999-2013年的收入动态面板研究数据，调查了身体和心理健康问题对家庭消费和财务状况的影响。与严重的身体健康问题相比，心理健康问题导致的劳动收入下降幅度更大。在心理健康问题出现后，公共和私人转移的增加并不能完全抵消劳动收入的下降。因此，我们发现家庭主人在遇到心理健康问题时，消费支出会显著减少。另一方面，公共和私人转移以及积累的财富能够弥补劳动收入相对较小的下降，使有严重身体健康问题的家庭能够平稳消费。健康保险有助于在心理健康问题出现后防止消费进一步下降。

abstract.text: The U.S. health care system is undergoing significant changes. Two prominent shifts include millions added to Medicaid and greater integration and consolidation among firms. We empirically assess if these two industry trends may have implications for each other. Using experimentally derived ("secret shopper") data on primary care physicians' real-world behavior, we observe their willingness to accept new privately insured and Medicaid patients across 10 states. We combine this measure of patient acceptance with detailed information on physician and commercial insurer market structure and show that insurer and provider concentration are each positively associated with relative improvements in appointment availability for Medicaid patients. The former is consistent with a smaller price discrepancy between commercial and Medicaid patients and suggests a beneficial spillover from greater insurer market power. The findings for physician concentration do not align with a simple price bargaining explanation but do appear driven by physician firms that are not vertically integrated with a health system. These same firms also tend to rely more on nonphysician clinical staff.

10.1002/hec.3497.abstractZh: 美国的医疗保健系统正在经历重大变革。其中两个显著的变化包括数百万人口被纳入医疗补助计划，以及各医疗机构之间的更大程度整合与合并。我们通过实证研究来探讨这两种行业趋势是否相互影响。利用关于初级保健医生实际行为的实验数据，我们观察到他们在10个州内愿意接受新的私人保险客户和医疗补助患者。我们将这一患者接受度指标与关于医生和商业保险公司市场结构的详细信息相结合，发现保险公司和医疗服务提供者的集中程度与医疗补助患者的预约可用性改善程度呈正相关。前者与商业保险客户和医疗补助客户之间的价格差异较小相一致，表明更强的保险公司市场力量能够带来积极影响。关于医生集中度的研究结果并不符合简单的价格谈判解释，而是似乎由那些并未与医疗系统垂直整合的医生企业所驱动。这些企业还倾向于更多地依赖非医生的临床人员。

abstract.text: Background China has experienced a rapid growth in childhood adiposity in recent years. Although a large number of studies examine the effect of maternal employment on children's adiposity in developed countries, only a few studies investigate the issue in developing countries. Moreover, existing studies tend to suffer from a potential endogeneity issue. Aims We provide new evidence on the causal effect of maternal employment on children's adiposity in China. Materials and methods We employ a difference-in-difference strategy that takes advantage of China's 1995 legislative change to labor regulations, which reduced the number of workdays from 6 to 5 days per week. Using longitudinal data from the China Health and Nutrition Survey (CHNS), we compare children whose mothers are wage-earning employees to those whose mothers are self-employed because the reform only affected the former. Results Although maternal employment and childhood obesity in China exhibits the same positive association as in the United States, our difference-in-difference estimates present a different picture. We find that a reduction in the maternal labor supply led to children's weight gain. Further investigation reveals that the effect was stronger among children who were male, younger, in urban areas, and from households with low socioeconomic status. Discussion Our evidence suggests that a change in maternal behaviors was likely responsible for children's weight gain. In particular, a greater proportion of treatment group mothers cooked and also devoted more time to cooking after the reform, which led to an increased caloric intake by their children. Such weight gain was beneficial for children who were previously underweight but harmful to those who became overweight. Conclusion The finding implies that additional maternal time at home likely has a different effect in China compared to the United States.

10.1002/hec.3498.abstractZh:
背景：近年来，中国的儿童肥胖率迅速上升。尽管在发达国家有许多研究探讨母亲就业对儿童肥胖的影响，但在发展中国家的相关研究却相对较少。此外，现有研究往往存在潜在的内生性问题。

目的：我们为中国母亲就业对儿童肥胖的因果效应提供了新的证据。

材料与方法：我们采用差异差异策略，利用中国1995年劳动法规的立法变更——将工作天数从每周6天减少到5天这一因素。通过中国健康与营养调查的数据，我们将母亲为工资性雇员与母亲为自雇者的儿童进行比较，因为该改革仅影响了前者。

结果：尽管中国母亲就业与儿童肥胖之间存在相同的正相关关系，但我们的差异差异估计显示情况有所不同。我们发现，母亲劳动供应减少导致了儿童体重增加。进一步调查发现，这种影响在男性、年龄较小的儿童、居住在城市地区以及来自低社会经济地位家庭中的儿童身上更为明显。

讨论：我们的证据表明，母亲行为的变化可能是儿童体重增加的原因。特别是，改革后，治疗组母亲中烹饪的比例增加，并且花费更多时间烹饪，这导致儿童摄入的热量增加。这种体重增加对原本体重不足的儿童是有益的，但对体重超标的儿童则是有害的。结论 研究结果表明，在中国，母亲在家的时间与在美国相比，可能具有不同的影响。

abstract.text: When assessing socioeconomic health inequalities, researchers often draw upon measures of income inequality that were developed for ratio scale variables. As a result, the use of categorical data (such as self-reported health status) produces rankings that may be arbitrary and contingent to the numerical scale adopted. In this paper, we develop a method that overcomes this issue by providing conditions for which these rankings are invariant to the numerical scale chosen by the researcher. In doing so, we draw on the insight provided by Allison and Foster (2004) and extend their method to the dimension of socioeconomic inequality by exploiting the properties of rank-dependent indices such as Wagstaff (2002) achievement and extended concentration indices. We also provide an empirical illustration using the National Institute of Health Survey 2012.

10.1002/hec.3499.abstractZh: 在评估社会经济健康不平等时，研究人员通常会使用为比率尺度变量开发的收入不平等衡量指标。因此，使用分类数据（如自我报告的健康状况）得出的排名可能具有任意性，并且取决于研究者所采用的数值尺度。在本文中，我们开发了一种方法，通过提供条件使得这些排名不受研究者选择的数值尺度的影响而保持不变。为此，我们借鉴了Allison和Foster（2004）提供的见解，并扩展他们的方法，利用与排名相关的指数属性，如Wagstaff（2002）的成就指数和扩展的集中指数，来研究社会经济不平等的维度。我们还使用2012年美国国家健康调查的数据进行了实证分析。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of the implementation of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) in 2014 on the decision to be self-employed. Using data from the Current Population Survey, we employ two identification strategies. Utilizing prereform variation in state nongroup health insurance market regulations, we find that the ACA did not increase self-employment overall in states that lacked similar provisions in their nongroup markets prior to 2014. In specifications that utilize variation across individuals in characteristics that could make it harder for them to purchase insurance if they left their current employer, we also do not find that the ACA differentially increased self-employment. However, in states that lacked the ACA nongroup market provisions, we do find a statistically significant increase in the second year of implementation (when individuals had more time to adjust behavior and the exchanges functioned properly) among individuals eligible for insurance subsidies, suggesting that a combination of time to adjust, low uncertainty and low insurance costs may be necessary for nongroup health insurance reforms to impact self-employment.

10.1002/hec.3500.abstractZh: 本文估算了2014年《平价医疗法案》实施对个体经营者决策的影响。通过《当前人口调查》的数据，我们采用了两种识别策略。利用改革前各州非团体健康保险市场法规的差异，我们发现，在2014年之前非团体市场就缺乏类似规定的州，ACA并未增加个体经营者的数量。在考虑个体特征差异的模型中，这些特征可能会使他们离开现有雇主后难以购买保险，但我们同样未发现ACA导致个体经营者数量增加。然而，在缺乏ACA非团体市场规定的州，我们确实发现，在实施后的第二年，有资格获得保险补贴的个体经营者数量出现了显著增长（此时个体有更多时间调整行为，且保险交易机制运行正常）。这表明，非团体健康保险改革要影响个体经营者数量，可能需要结合时间调整、低不确定性以及低保险成本等因素。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of parental health on cognitive and noncognitive development in Australian children. The underlying nationally representative panel data and a child fixed effects estimator are used to deal with unobserved heterogeneity. We find that only father's serious mental illness worsens selected cognitive and noncognitive skills of children. Maternal poor health also deteriorates some cognitive and noncognitive outcomes of children of lone mothers only. Our results demonstrate that either failing to account for parent-child fixed effects or using child noncognitive skills reported by parents could overestimate the harmful impact of poor parental health on child development.

10.1002/hec.3501.abstractZh: 本文探讨了父母健康状况对澳大利亚儿童认知与非认知发展影响的研究。通过全国代表性面板数据及儿童固定效应估计方法，我们处理了未观测到的异质性问题。研究发现，只有父亲的严重精神疾病会恶化儿童的某些认知与非认知技能。而母亲健康状况不佳也会对仅由单亲母亲抚养的儿童产生负面影响，导致某些认知与非认知结果恶化。我们的研究结果表明，如果未能考虑父母-子女固定效应，或者仅依据父母报告的儿童非认知技能，可能会高估不良父母健康对儿童发展的负面影响。

abstract.text: When a clinic system is acquired by an integrated delivery system (IDS), the ownership change includes both vertical integration with the hospital(s), and horizontal integration with the IDS's previously owned or "legacy" clinics, causing increased market concentration in physician services. Although there is a robust literature on the impact of hospital market concentration, the literature on physician market concentration is sparse. The objective of this study is to determine the impact on physician prices when two IDSs acquired three multispecialty clinic systems in Minneapolis-St Paul, Minnesota at the end of 2007, using commercial claims data from a large health plan (2006-2011). Using a difference-in-differences model and nonacquired clinics as controls, we found that four years after the acquisitions (2011), average physician price indices in the acquired clinic systems were 32-47% higher than expected in absence of the acquisitions. Average physician prices in the IDS legacy clinics were 14-20% higher in 2011 than expected. Procedure-specific prices for common office visit and inpatient procedures also increased following the acquisitions.

10.1002/hec.3502.abstractZh: 当一家诊所系统被一家综合医疗服务系统收购时，所有权变更既包括与医院的垂直整合，也包括与系统先前拥有的或“传统”诊所的水平整合，这导致医生服务市场的集中度增加。尽管关于医院市场集中度影响的文献非常丰富，但关于医生市场集中度的文献却相对较少。本研究的目的是利用一家大型健康计划的商业索赔数据（2006-2011年），在2007年底两家综合医疗服务系统收购了明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗市的三家多专科诊所系统后，分析这对医生价格的影响。通过差异-差异模型并以未被收购的诊所作为对照组，我们发现，在收购后的四年（2011年），被收购诊所系统的平均医生价格比没有收购时高出32-47%。2011年，综合医疗服务系统传统诊所的平均医生价格比预期高出14-20%。此外，常见门诊和住院手术的价格在收购后也有所上升。

abstract.text: The relationship between health care expenditure and health outcomes has been the subject of recent academic inquiry in order to inform cost-effectiveness thresholds for health technology assessment agencies. Previous studies in public health systems have relied upon data aggregated at the national or regional level; however, there remains debate about whether the supply side effect of changes to expenditure are identifiable using data at this level of aggregation. We use detailed patient data derived from electronic neonatal records across England along with routinely available cost data to estimate the effect of changes to patient expenditure on clinical health outcomes in a well-defined patient population. A panel of 32 neonatal intensive care units for the period 2009-2013 was constructed. Accounting for the potential endogeneity of expenditure a £100 increase in the cost per intensive care cot day (sample average cost: £1,127) is estimated to reduce the risk of mortality of 0.38 percentage points (sample average mortality: 11.0%) in neonatal intensive care. This translates into a cost per life saved in neonatal intensive care of approximately £420,000.

10.1002/hec.3503.abstractZh: 关于医疗保健支出与健康结果之间的关系，一直是近期学术研究的重点，旨在为健康技术评估机构的成本效益阈值提供参考。以往关于公共卫生系统的研究主要依赖国家或地区级别的数据汇总；然而，关于通过这种汇总级别的数据是否能够识别支出变化对医疗服务供给方面的影响，仍然存在争议。本研究利用英格兰电子新生儿记录中的详细患者数据，结合常规可用的成本数据，来估算患者支出变化对临床健康结果的影响。研究选取了2009-2013年期间32个新生儿重症监护病房作为样本。考虑到支出的潜在内生性，研究发现，每提高一个重症监护床位日的成本（样本平均成本：1,127英镑），新生儿重症监护中的死亡风险可降低0.38个百分点（样本平均死亡率：11.0%）。这意味着，每挽救一名新生儿的生命，大约需要花费约420,000英镑。

abstract.text: Accurate information on individuals' health service use is important for evaluating health policies and analyzing health care demand. Although register data are considered to be more reliable than survey data, little is known about the extent and effect of censoring of the expenditure distribution in register data. We exploit a recent change in the health provider remuneration system in several Swiss cantons to empirically investigate whether censoring occurs when individuals do not have to disclose their health service use below their deductible level. Applying a difference-in-differences approach, we find that between CHF 6.70 (1.7%) to CHF 9.64 (2.4%) of all health service use paid out-of-pocket are not observed (per capita per year). This effect seems to be driven by high-deductible plans where observed out-of-pocket expenditures declined by CHF 30.34 (7.6%) after the change. Although statistically significant, these effects are almost negligible in economic terms. We therefore concluded that, if anything, censoring is a very limited issue in Swiss health insurance claims data.

10.1002/hec.3504.abstractZh: 准确了解个人在医疗服务上的使用情况对于评估健康政策和分析医疗需求非常重要。尽管登记数据被认为比调查数据更可靠，但关于登记数据中支出数据被审查的程度和影响的了解却很少。我们利用瑞士几个州在医疗服务提供者薪酬体系上的最新变化，实证研究在个人无需披露低于免赔额水平的医疗服务使用情况时，是否会发生数据审查。通过差异-差异方法分析，我们发现，在所有自付的医疗服务支出中，有6.70瑞士法郎（1.7%）到9.64瑞士法郎（2.4%）的支出未被记录（每年人均）。这种效应似乎是由高免赔额计划引起的，在该计划下，观察到的自付支出在变化后减少了30.34瑞士法郎（7.6%）。尽管这些效应在统计上显著，但在经济层面上几乎可以忽略不计。因此，我们得出结论，在瑞士的医疗保险索赔数据中，数据审查是一个非常有限的问题。

abstract.text: Learning curves in health are of interest for a wide range of medical disciplines, healthcare providers, and policy makers. In this paper, we distinguish between three types of learning when identifying overall learning curves: economies of scale, learning from cumulative experience, and human capital depreciation. In addition, we approach the question of how treating more patients with specific characteristics predicts provider performance. To soften collinearity problems, we explore the use of least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression as a variable selection method and Theil-Goldberger mixed estimation to augment the available information. We use data from the Belgian Transcatheter Aorta Valve Implantation (TAVI) registry, containing information on the first 860 TAVI procedures in Belgium. We find that treating an additional TAVI patient is associated with an increase in the probability of 2-year survival by about 0.16%-points. For adverse events like renal failure and stroke, we find that an extra day between procedures is associated with an increase in the probability for these events by 0.12%-points and 0.07%-points, respectively. Furthermore, we find evidence for positive learning effects from physicians' experience with defibrillation, treating patients with hypertension, and the use of certain types of replacement valves during the TAVI procedure.

10.1002/hec.3505.abstractZh: 在健康领域，学习曲线引起了众多医学学科、医疗保健提供者和政策制定者的兴趣。在识别整体学习曲线时，我们将学习分为三种类型：规模经济、从累积经验中学习以及人力资本折旧。此外，我们探讨了如何通过治疗具有特定特征的患者来预测医疗服务提供者的表现。为了缓解共线性问题，我们采用了最小绝对收缩与选择算子回归作为变量选择方法，并使用Theil-Goldberger混合估计方法来补充现有信息。我们使用了比利时经导管主动脉瓣植入术登记数据，该数据包含了比利时前860例经导管主动脉瓣植入术的信息。研究发现，每增加一名经导管主动脉瓣植入术患者，2年生存率的概率增加约0.16个百分点。对于肾衰竭和中风等不良事件，我们发现每次手术之间增加一天的时间，这些事件的概率分别增加0.12个百分点和0.07个百分点。此外，我们还发现了一些积极的学习效应，例如医生在除颤、治疗高血压患者以及在使用某些类型的替代瓣膜进行经导管主动脉瓣植入术过程中的经验。

abstract.text: We compare individual survival curves constructed from objective (actual mortality) and elicited subjective information (probability of survival to a given target age). We develop a methodology to estimate jointly subjective and objective individual survival curves accounting for rounding on subjective reports of perceived survival. We make use of the long follow-up period in the Health and Retirement Study and the high quality of mortality data to estimate individual survival curves that feature both observed and unobserved heterogeneity. This allows us to compare objective and subjective estimates of remaining life expectancy for various groups and compare welfare effects of objective and subjective mortality risk using the life cycle model of consumption. We find that subjective and objective hazards are not the same. The median welfare loss from misperceptions of mortality risk when annuities are not available is 7% of current wealth at age 65 whereas more than 25% of respondents have losses larger than 60% of wealth. When annuities are available and exogenously given, the welfare loss is substantially lower.

10.1002/hec.3506.abstractZh: 我们比较了从客观数据（实际死亡率）和主观信息（达到特定目标年龄的生存概率）构建的个体生存曲线。我们开发了一种方法来同时估计主观和客观个体生存曲线，并考虑到对感知生存的主观报告中的四舍五入问题。我们利用“健康与退休研究”中的长期随访数据以及高质量的死亡数据，来估计具有观测和未观测异质性的个体生存曲线。这使我们能够比较不同群体的客观和主观剩余预期寿命估计值，并使用消费生命周期模型比较客观和主观死亡风险对福利的影响。我们发现，主观和客观风险并不相同。在65岁时，如果无法获得年金，由于对死亡风险的误解而导致的平均福利损失占当前财富的7%，而超过25%的受访者损失超过了财富的60%。当年金是可获得且外生给定的情况下，福利损失显著降低。

abstract.text: Payers often assess the benefits of new drugs relative to costs for reimbursement purposes, but they frequently exclude some drugs' option-related benefits, reducing their reimbursement chances, and making them less attractive R&D investments. We develop and test a real options model of R&D investment that shows that excluding option-related benefits heightens drug developers' incentives to avoid high-risk (volatile) R&D investments and instead encourages them to focus on "safer" (positively skewed) investments. Our model and empirical results could partly explain the decline in the number of risky new molecular entities.

10.1002/hec.3507.abstractZh: 支付方通常根据成本来评估新药的收益，用于报销目的，但他们经常忽略某些药物与选择相关的收益，这降低了药物的报销机会，也使得这些药物作为研发投资变得不那么有吸引力。我们开发并测试了一个关于研发投资的真实期权模型，该模型表明，忽略与选择相关的收益会增强药物开发者避免高风险（波动性大的）研发投资的动机，反而促使他们专注于“更安全”（正偏态）的投资。我们的模型和实证结果可以部分解释为什么有风险的新分子实体数量有所减少。

abstract.text: We present data of a contingent valuation survey, testing the effect of evaluation mode on the monetary valuation of preventing road accidents. Half of the interviewees was asked to state their willingness to pay (WTP) to reduce the risk of having only 1 type of injury (separate evaluation, SE), and the other half of the sample was asked to state their WTP for 4 types of injuries evaluated simultaneously (joint evaluation, JE). In the SE group, we observed lack of sensitivity to scope while in the JE group WTP increased with the severity of the injury prevented. However, WTP values in this group were subject to context effects. Our results suggest that the traditional explanation of the disparity between SE and JE, namely, the so-called "evaluability," does not apply here. The paper presents new explanations based on the role of preference imprecision.

10.1002/hec.3508.abstractZh: 我们呈现了一项条件估值调查的数据，旨在测试评估方式对预防道路事故的经济价值评估的影响。一半受访者被要求说明他们愿意支付多少费用来降低仅发生一种类型伤害的风险（单独评估），而另一半受访者则被要求对同时发生的四种类型伤害的风险进行评估（联合评估）。在单独评估组中，我们发现受访者对伤害范围的变化缺乏敏感性；而在联合评估组中，受访者愿意支付的费用随着预防的伤害严重程度而增加。然而，该组中的支付意愿还受到情境因素的影响。我们的研究结果表明，传统上用来解释单独评估与联合评估之间差异的解释——即所谓的“评估可能性”——在这里并不适用。本文提出了基于偏好不确定性作用的新解释。

abstract.text: Healthcare funding decisions in the UK rely on health state valuations of the general public. However, it has been shown that there is disparity between the valuation of the impact of hypothetical conditions on health and the reported health by those experiencing them. Patients' adaptation to health states is among the most common explanations for this discrepancy. Being diagnosed with a disease appears to affect individual perception of health over time so that better subjective health may be reported over a disease trajectory. This paper examines adaptation to health states using a longitudinal dataset. We use four waves of the British Cohort Study (BCS70), which tracks a sample of British individuals since birth in 1970 and contains information on self-assessed health (SAH), morbidity, and socioeconomic characteristics. We implement a dynamic ordered probit model controlling for health state dependence. Results are supportive of the existence of adaptation: Time since diagnosis has a positive impact on SAH. Moreover, adaptation happens over relatively long durations. We do not find significant results proving different adaptation paths for patients reporting prior better SAH. The analysis by specific conditions generally supports the existence of adaptation, but results are statistically significant only for a subset of conditions.

10.1002/hec.3509.abstractZh: 英国的医疗保健资金决策依赖于对普通公众健康状态的评估。然而，研究表明，对假设性条件对健康影响的评估与那些实际经历这些条件的人所报告的健康状况之间存在差异。患者对健康状态的适应是这种差异最常见的解释之一。被诊断出患有疾病似乎会影响个人对健康的感知，因此患者在疾病过程中可能会报告更好的主观健康状态。本文利用纵向数据集来研究对健康状态的适应。我们使用了英国队列研究（BCS70）的四个数据波，该研究自1970年起跟踪了一批英国个体，并包含自我评估的健康状况、发病率以及社会经济特征的信息。我们采用动态有序Probit模型，以控制健康状态的依赖性。研究结果支持适应的存在：自诊断以来的时间对自我评估的健康状况有积极影响。此外，适应的过程相对较长。我们没有发现显著的结果来证明那些之前报告有较好健康状况的患者有不同的适应路径。针对特定条件的分析通常支持适应的存在，但结果仅在部分条件下具有统计学意义。

abstract.text: An important, yet unsettled, question in public health policy is the extent to which unemployment causally impacts mental health. The recent literature yields varying findings, which are likely due to differences in data, methods, samples, and institutional settings. Taking a more general approach, we provide comparable evidence for four countries with different institutional settings-Australia, Germany, the UK, and the United States-using a nonparametric bounds analysis. Relying on fairly weak and partially testable assumptions, our paper shows that unemployment has a significant negative effect on mental health in all countries. Our results rule out effects larger than a quarter of a standard deviation for Germany and half a standard deviation for the Anglo-Saxon countries. The effect is significant for both men and women and materialises already for short periods of unemployment. Public policy should hence focus on early prevention of mental health problems among the unemployed.

10.1002/hec.3510.abstractZh: 在公共卫生政策中，一个重要但尚未得到充分解答的问题是失业在多大程度上会导致心理健康问题。最近的文献研究结果不一，这可能是由于数据、方法、样本以及制度环境的不同所导致的。我们采用一种更为通用的方法，利用非参数界限分析，为四个具有不同制度环境的国家——澳大利亚、德国、英国和美国——提供了可比的证据。基于相当弱且部分可检验的假设，我们的研究表明，在所有国家中，失业都对心理健康有显著的负面影响。我们的研究结果排除了德国失业对心理健康的影响超过标准偏差四分之一的可能性，而盎格鲁-撒克逊国家则低于标准偏差的一半。这种影响对男性和女性都显著，并且会在较短的失业期间显现出来。因此，公共政策应重点关注对失业人群心理健康问题的早期预防。

abstract.text: In theory, health care providers may adapt their professional behavior to the financial incentives resulting from their remuneration. Our research question is whether the users of health care services anticipate such behavior from their general practitioner (GP) and, if they do, what consequences such anticipation has on their preferences regarding financial incentives. Our theoretical model explains users' preferences for one or another incentives scheme, disentangling the financial motives (incentives amounts, wealth) from the behavioral ones (perceived GPs' sensitivity to incentives). We empirically test our theoretical predictions using data from a survey that elicits individual preferences for either patient or provider hypothetical incentives in France. The empirical results confirm the theoretical ones: users tend to prefer incentives to patients rather than to GPs when the amount of GP incentives is high, when the amount of patient incentives is low, when they anticipate that their GP's medical decisions are affected by financial incentives or when their wealth is high. Otherwise, they prefer their GP to face financial incentives.

10.1002/hec.3511.abstractZh: 理论上，医疗服务提供者可能会根据薪酬所带来的经济激励来调整其职业行为。我们的研究问题是：医疗服务的使用者是否预期到全科医生会采取这种行为？如果预期如此，这种预期会对他们对经济激励的偏好产生什么影响？我们的理论模型解释了使用者对不同激励方案的偏好，将经济动机（激励金额、财富）与行为动机（对激励的感知反应）区分开来。我们通过一项调查数据来实证验证理论预测，该调查收集了法国消费者对患者或医疗服务提供者假设的激励方案的偏好。实证结果证实了理论预测：当全科医生的激励金额较高、患者的激励金额较低、使用者预期全科医生的医疗决策会受到经济激励的影响，或者他们的财富较高时，他们更倾向于选择接受激励的全科医生。否则，他们更希望全科医生能够面对经济激励。

abstract.text: Claims databases consisting of routinely collected longitudinal records of medical expenditures are increasingly utilized for estimating expected medical costs of patients with a specific condition. Survival data of the patients of interest are usually highly censored, and observed expenditures are incomplete. In this study, we propose a survival-adjusted estimator for estimating mean lifetime costs, which integrates the product of the survival function and the mean cost function over the lifetime horizon. The survival function is estimated by a new algorithm of rolling extrapolation, aided by external information of age- and sex-matched referents simulated from national vital statistics. The mean cost function is estimated by a weighted average of mean expenditures of patients in a number of months prior to their death, of which the number could be determined by observed costs in their final months, and the weights depend on extrapolated hazards. We evaluate the performance of the proposed approach in comparison with that of a popular method using simulated data under various scenarios and 2 cohorts of intracerebral hemorrhage and ischemic stroke patients with a maximum follow-up of 13 years and conclude that our new method estimates the mean lifetime costs more accurately.

10.1002/hec.3512.abstractZh: 由定期收集的医疗支出纵向记录构成的索赔数据库，越来越多地被用于估算特定疾病患者的预期医疗成本。相关患者的生存数据通常受到高度审查，而观察到的支出则不够完整。在本研究中，我们提出了一种经过生存调整的指数，用于估算平均寿命成本，该指数将生存函数与平均成本函数在整个生命周期内的乘积结合起来。生存函数通过一种新的滚动外推算法进行估计，该算法借助从国家人口统计数据中模拟出的年龄和性别匹配的参照对象的信息。平均成本函数则通过患者在死亡前若干个月的平均支出加权平均值来估计，其中该数量可以通过他们在最后几个月的观察支出来确定，而权重则取决于外推出的风险参数。我们通过在不同情景下使用模拟数据，并对比使用两种队列的脑内出血和缺血性中风患者数据，对提出的方法与一种常用方法的性能进行了评估，最长随访时间为13年。结果表明，我们的新方法能够更准确地估算平均寿命成本。

abstract.text: The friction cost approach has been proposed as an alternative to the human capital approach in estimating productivity costs. However, it is difficult, in practice, to apply this approach due to limited availability of context-specific data. Using national and firm-level data on vacancy durations sourced from 4 organisations, we estimated vacancy durations, and consequently, length of friction period for the United Kingdom disaggregated by occupational classification. We found comparable estimates to previously reported friction periods elsewhere. The disaggregated friction period analysis confirmed occupational class has an effect on the estimated length of the friction period. The research presents estimates on vacancy durations and friction periods necessary to use the friction cost approach in a practical way in economic evaluations.

10.1002/hec.3513.abstractZh: 摩擦成本方法被提出作为估算生产率成本时，相对于人力资本方法的替代方案。然而，在实践中，由于缺乏特定情境的数据，很难应用这种方法。我们利用来自4个组织的国家和企业层面的空缺持续时间数据，估算了英国的空缺持续时间，进而按职业分类细分了摩擦期的长度。我们发现，这些估算结果与其他地区先前报告的摩擦期长度相当。细分后的摩擦期分析证实，职业类别对估算的摩擦期长度有显著影响。该研究提供了关于空缺持续时间和摩擦期的估算结果，以便在经济评估中实际应用摩擦成本方法。

abstract.text: Malaria is one of the leading causes of death in sub-Saharan Africa. Artemisinin-based combination therapies are used as first-line treatment drugs, but their market is far from competitive. Market failures include limited availability, low quality, lack of information, and high costs of access. We estimated the theoretical demand for one of the most common artemisinin-based combination therapies, artemether-lumefantrine (AL), and its determinants among caregivers of children with malaria seeking care at public health facilities, thus, entitled to receive drugs for free, in southern Mozambique (year 2012). The predicted theoretical demand was contrasted with international and local private market AL prices. Respondents stated high willingness to pay but lower ability to pay (ATP), which was defined as the theoretical demand. The ATP was on average of 0.94 USD for the treatment of a malaria episode. This implied an average gap of 1.04 USD between average local private prices and theoretical demand. Predicted ATP decreased by 14% for every additional malaria episode that the child had suffered during the malaria season. The market price was unaffordable for a large share of our sample, highlighting an unequal welfare distribution between suppliers and potential consumers, as well as issues of inequity in the private delivery of AL.

10.1002/hec.3514.abstractZh: 疟疾是撒哈拉以南非洲地区的主要死亡原因之一。青蒿素为基础的联合疗法被用作一线治疗药物，但其市场竞争程度远远不够。市场失灵包括供应有限、质量低下、信息不足以及获取成本过高等问题。我们估算了莫桑比克南部地区（2012年）那些有资格免费获得药物的疟疾患儿护理人员在青蒿素为基础的联合疗法之一——青蒿琥酯- Lumefantrine（AL）方面的理论需求，并分析了其决定因素。预测的理论需求与国际及当地私人市场的AL价格进行了对比。受访者表示愿意支付较高的费用，但支付能力较低，这里的支付能力被定义为理论需求。平均而言，治疗一次疟疾所需的支付能力为0.94美元。这意味着当地私人市场价格与理论需求之间存在1.04美元的差距。每有一个疟疾患儿在疟疾季节中再次发病，预测支付能力就会下降14%。对于样本中的大部分人群来说，市场价格是无法承受的，这凸显了供应商与潜在消费者之间的福利分配不均，以及青蒿素联合疗法在私人市场中的不公平问题。

abstract.text: Using a panel dataset of 70 countries spanning 42 years (1970-2011), we investigate the distinct effects of social globalisation and trade openness on national trends in markers of diet quality (supplies of animal proteins, free fats and sugar, average body mass index, and diabetes prevalence). Our key methodological contribution is the application of a grouped fixed-effects estimator, which extends linear fixed-effects models. The grouped fixed-effects estimator partitions our sample into distinct groups of countries in order to control for time-varying unobserved heterogeneity that follows a group-specific pattern. We find that increasing social globalisation has a significant impact on the supplies of animal protein and sugar available for human consumption, as well as on mean body mass index. Specific components of social globalisation such as information flows (via television and the Internet) drive these results. Trade openness has no effect on dietary outcomes or health. These findings suggest that the social and cultural aspects of globalisation should receive greater attention in research on the nutrition transition.

10.1002/hec.3521.abstractZh: 我们采用了一个包含70个国家、覆盖42年（1970-2011年）的面板数据集，研究了社会全球化与贸易开放程度对各国饮食质量指标（动物蛋白质供应、游离脂肪和糖含量、平均体重指数以及糖尿病患病率）的影响。我们的主要方法学贡献在于应用了分组固定效应估计器，该估计器扩展了线性固定效应模型。分组固定效应估计器将样本划分为不同的国家组，以控制随时间变化的未观测异质性，这些异质性呈现出群体特定的模式。我们发现，社会全球化程度的增加对可供人类消费的动物蛋白质和糖的供应以及平均体重指数有显著影响。社会全球化的特定组成部分，如通过电视和互联网的信息传播，也推动了这些结果。贸易开放程度对饮食结果或健康状况没有影响。这些发现表明，在关于营养转型的研究中，全球化中的社会和文化方面应得到更多的关注。

abstract.text: We consider the use of difference in differences (DD) to evaluate the effect of an activity assistance program on the health of severely disabled Koreans. There are, however, 2 problems in the data: the number of response categories for self-assessed health changed over the waves of the repeated cross-section survey and the "parallel untreated response path" assumption for DD is suspect. We show how to overcome these problems by renormalizing parameters and applying "generalized difference in differences (GDD)." We find a significantly positive effect of the program with DD, but not with GDD. Our solutions should prove useful in applications in which one or other of these problems arise.

10.1002/hec.3526.abstractZh: 我们研究了使用差异差异法（DD）来评估一项针对严重残疾韩国人的活动援助计划对健康状况的影响。然而，数据中存在两个问题：自我评估健康状况的响应类别数量在重复横截面调查的不同阶段有所变化，以及DD模型中的“平行未处理响应路径”假设存在疑点。我们展示了如何通过重新调整参数并应用“广义差异差异法（GDD）”来克服这些问题。研究发现，使用DD法时，该计划对健康状况有显著的正面影响，而使用GDD法则没有这种效果。我们的解决方案在出现这些问题的情况下，应该具有实际应用价值。

abstract.text: Little is known about the price sensitivity of demand for home care of the disabled elderly. We partially fill this knowledge gap by using administrative data on the beneficiaries of the main French home care subsidy program in a department and exploiting interindividual variation in provider prices. We address the potential endogeneity of prices by taking advantage of the unequal spatial coverage of providers and instrumenting price by the number of municipalities served by a provider. We estimate a price elasticity of around -0.4 that is significantly different from both 0 and -1. This less than proportionate response of consumption to price has implications for the efficiency and redistributive impact of variation in the level of copayments in home care subsidy schemes.

10.1002/hec.3531.abstractZh: 关于残疾老年人对家庭护理需求的价格敏感性，目前知之甚少。我们通过使用法国某个省份主要家庭护理补贴计划受益人的行政数据，并利用不同提供者在价格上的差异，来部分填补这一知识空白。我们通过利用提供者的空间覆盖差异，并以提供者服务的市镇数量作为工具变量，来探讨价格的内生性。我们的估计结果显示，价格弹性约为-0.4，这一数值与0和-1都有显著不同。这种消费对价格的反应程度低于比例，这对家庭护理补贴计划中共同支付额变化的效率及再分配效果具有影响。

abstract.text: Policymakers and organizations representing people with disabilities have highlighted the importance of promoting the employment prospects of disabled individuals as a determinant to ensure their broader integration into the society. Policy reforms that attempt to incentivise disabled individuals to work typically involve reduced financial punishments for earning above a predetermined threshold (substantial gainful activity). This paper exploits a Spanish reform that entirely eliminated any disincentives for disabled individuals to work. Partially disabled individuals in Spain are subject to income taxation in all regions except in the province of Bizkaia. Before 2007, partially disabled individuals in Bizkaia were exempt from income taxation if they did not work. In December 2006, a new law was passed in Bizkaia that distinguished between individuals aged 55 or younger, who were no longer tax-exempt, and those who were older than 55 years, who continued to be tax-exempt if they did not work. I exploit this change in the legislation and employ both a difference-in-difference strategy comparing the employment outcomes of disabled young men across provinces and time as well as a triple difference model with disabled men older than 55 years, who are unaffected by the policy. My results show that the reform increased the probability of working by 6.5 percentage points for disabled men aged 55 or younger.

10.1002/hec.3533.abstractZh: 政策制定者和代表残疾人的组织强调了促进残疾人士就业前景的重要性，这是确保他们更广泛融入社会的关键。旨在激励残疾人士工作的政策改革通常包括对超过预定收入门槛的残疾人士减少经济处罚。本文研究了西班牙的一项改革，该改革完全消除了对残疾人士工作的任何阻碍。在西班牙，部分残疾人士除比斯开省外，在所有地区都需要缴纳所得税。2007年之前，比斯开省的残疾人士如果不工作，则无需缴纳所得税。2006年12月，比斯开省通过了一项新法律，将55岁或以下的残疾人士与55岁以上且继续不工作的残疾人士区分开来，55岁以上的残疾人士仍享有免税待遇。我利用这一法律变化，采用了差异-差异策略来比较不同省份和时期残疾青年人的就业状况，同时使用了三重差异模型来研究55岁以上且不受该政策影响的残疾男性。我的研究结果显示，这项改革使55岁或以下的残疾男性工作的概率增加了6.5个百分点。

abstract.text: We study how changes in Diagnosis-Related Group price regulation affect hospital behaviour in quasi-markets with exclusive provision by public hospitals. Exploiting a quasi-natural experiment, we use a difference-in-differences approach to test whether public hospitals respond to an exogenous change in Diagnosis-Related Group tariffs by increasing C-section rates and/or by upcoding. Controlling for a detailed set of mother characteristics, we find that price changes did not affect the probability of a C-section. We do however find evidence of upcoding: Conditional on the birth delivery method (either a C-section or a vaginal delivery), public hospitals experiencing the largest price change exhibit a higher probability of treating patients coded as complicated. This finding suggests that even public hospitals may be sensitive to market incentives.

10.1002/hec.3541.abstractZh: 我们研究了诊断相关组价格调控的变化如何影响公立医院在准市场中的行为。通过准自然实验的方法，我们采用差异-差异法来检验公立医院是否会对诊断相关组收费的外生变化作出反应，比如增加剖宫产率或提高编码等级。在控制了详细的母亲特征后，我们发现价格变化并未影响剖宫产的概率。不过，我们确实发现了编码等级提高的现象：在分娩方式（剖宫产或阴道分娩）固定的条件下，价格变化最大的公立医院更倾向于对复杂病例进行治疗。这一发现表明，即使是公立医院也可能对市场激励因素敏感。

abstract.text: Informal care may substitute for formal long-term care that is often publicly funded or subsidized. The costs of informal caregiving are borne by the caregiver and may consist of worse health outcomes and, if the caregiver has not retired, worse labor market outcomes. We estimate the impact of providing informal care to one's partner on the caregiver's health using data from the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe. We use statistical matching to deal with selection bias and endogeneity. We find that in the short run caregiving has a substantial effect on the health of caregivers and, for female caregivers, on their health care use. These effects should be taken into account when comparing the costs and benefits of formal and informal care provision. The health effects may, however, be short-lived, as we do not find any evidence that they persist after 4 or 7 years.

10.1002/hec.3542.abstractZh: 非正式护理可以替代通常由公共资金或补贴支持的正式长期护理。非正式护理的成本由护理者承担，这可能导致护理者的健康状况恶化，如果护理者尚未退休，还可能导致其劳动力市场表现不佳。我们利用《欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查》的数据，评估为伴侣提供非正式护理对护理者健康的影响。我们通过统计匹配方法来处理选择偏差和内生性问题。研究发现，短期内，护理对护理者的健康有显著影响，对于女性护理者来说，还影响了她们的医疗使用情况。在比较正式与非正式护理提供的成本和收益时，应考虑到这些影响。然而，这些健康影响可能是短暂的，因为我们没有发现它们在4年或7年后仍然持续存在的证据。

abstract.text: Waiting times are a major policy concern in publicly funded health systems across OECD countries. Economists have argued that, in the presence of excess demand, waiting times act as nonmonetary prices to bring demand for and supply of health care in equilibrium. Using administrative data disaggregated by region and surgical procedure over 2010-2014 in Italy, we estimate demand and supply elasticities with respect to waiting times. We employ linear regression models with first differences and instrumental variables to deal with endogeneity of waiting times. We find that demand is inelastic to waiting times while supply is more elastic. Estimates of demand elasticity are between -0.15 to -0.24. Our results have implications on the effectiveness of policies aimed at increasing supply and their ability to reduce waiting times.

10.1002/hec.3545.abstractZh: 在经合组织国家的公共资助医疗系统中，等待时间是一个重要的政策问题。经济学家认为，在需求过剩的情况下，等待时间起到了非货币价格的作用，从而使医疗服务的供需达到平衡。本研究利用意大利2010-2014年间按地区和手术类型划分的行政数据，估计了需求与等待时间之间的弹性。我们采用了线性回归模型以及第一差分解和工具变量方法来处理等待时间的内生性问题。研究发现，需求对等待时间缺乏弹性，而供应则更具弹性。需求弹性的估计值在-0.15到-0.24之间。我们的研究结果对旨在增加供应以及减少等待时间的政策的有效性具有重要意义。

abstract.text: The problem of sample selection complicates the process of drawing inference about populations. Selective sampling arises in many real world situations when agents such as doctors and customs officials search for targets with high values of a characteristic. We propose a new method for estimating population characteristics from these types of selected samples. We develop a model that captures key features of the agent's sampling decision. We use a generalized method of moments with instrumental variables and maximum likelihood to estimate the population prevalence of the characteristic of interest and the agents' accuracy in identifying targets. We apply this method to tuberculosis (TB), which is the leading infectious disease cause of death worldwide. We use a national database of TB test data from South Africa to examine testing for multidrug resistant TB (MDR-TB). Approximately one quarter of MDR-TB cases was undiagnosed between 2004 and 2010. The official estimate of 2.5% is therefore too low, and MDR-TB prevalence is as high as 3.5%. Signal-to-noise ratios are estimated to be between 0.5 and 1. Our approach is widely applicable because of the availability of routinely collected data and abundance of potential instruments. Using routinely collected data to monitor population prevalence can guide evidence-based policy making.

10.1002/hec.3547.abstractZh: 样本选择的问题使得对总体进行推断的过程变得复杂。在许多现实世界中，诸如医生和海关官员这样的代理人会寻找具有较高特征值的目标对象，这就产生了选择性抽样的问题。我们提出了一种新方法，用于从这类选定的样本中估计总体特征。我们开发了一个模型，能够捕捉代理人抽样决策的关键特征。我们使用广义矩估计方法，结合工具变量和最大似然估计，来估算感兴趣特征的群体患病率以及代理人识别目标的准确性。我们将这种方法应用于结核病，这是全球主要的传染病死亡原因。我们使用了南非的结核病检测数据全国数据库，来研究多重耐药结核病的检测情况。在2004年至2010年间，大约四分之一的多重耐药结核病病例未被诊断出来。因此，官方估计的2.5%的患病率过低，实际患病率可能高达3.5%。信号与噪声的比例估计在0.5到1之间。我们的方法具有广泛的适用性，因为常规收集的数据和丰富的潜在工具都可供使用。利用常规收集的数据来监测群体患病率，可以指导基于证据的政策制定。

abstract.text: In this paper, we extend the 4-random-component closed skew-normal stochastic frontier model by including exogenous determinants of hospital persistent (long-run) and transient (short-run) inefficiency, separated from unobserved heterogeneity. We apply this new model to a dataset composed by 133 Italian hospitals during the period 2008-2013. We show that average total inefficiency is about 23%, higher than previous estimates; hence, a model where the different types of inefficiency and hospital unobserved characteristics are not confounded allows us to get less biased estimates of hospital inefficiency. Moreover, we find that transient efficiency is more important than persistent efficiency, as it accounts for 60% of the total one. Last, we find that ownership (for-profit hospitals are more transiently inefficient and less persistently inefficient than not-for-profit ones, whereas public hospitals are less transiently inefficient than not-for-profit ones), specialization (specialized hospitals are more transiently inefficient than general ones; i.e., there is evidence of scope economies in short-run efficiency), and size (large-sized hospitals are better than medium and small ones in terms of transient inefficiency) are determinants of both types of inefficiency, although we do not find any statistically significant effect of multihospital systems and teaching hospitals.

10.1002/hec.3557.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过引入外生因素来扩展4个随机成分的封闭偏态正态随机前沿模型，这些因素与未观察到的异质性无关，分别影响医院长期和短期效率的低下。我们将这一新模型应用于2008-2013年期间133家意大利医院的数据集。结果显示，平均总效率低下约为23%，高于之前的估计值；因此，一个不混淆不同类型效率低下与医院未观察到特征的新模型，能够得出更无偏的医院效率低下估计值。此外，我们发现短期效率的重要性高于长期效率，后者占总效率的60%。最后，我们发现所有权因素（营利性医院在短期效率上的低下程度高于非营利性医院，而公立医院在短期效率上的低下程度低于非营利性医院）、专业化因素（专业医院在短期效率上的低下程度高于普通医院，即存在短期效率中的范围经济现象）以及规模因素（大型医院在短期效率上的低下程度优于中型和小型医院）都是这两种效率低下的决定因素，尽管我们没有发现多医院系统和教学医院有任何统计学上的显著效应。

abstract.text: We use spatial econometric methods to analyse spillovers in hospital expenditures across Health Districts of the Emilia-Romagna Region (Italy). We estimate spatial models that allow for global spillovers and distinguish between the expenditures associated with potentially inappropriate hospitalizations and those associated with complex medical procedures. We also investigate the relative contribution of geographical and institutional proximity in explaining spatial dependence, by explicitly modelling different connectivity structures and exploiting them to build alternative spatial weight matrices. We find that interactions largely differ between types of expenditures, with positive spatial effects for potentially inappropriate admissions, the effect being generally not significant for high-complexity expenditure. Relying on the estimated direct and indirect effects, we also test for the presence of spatial spillovers across districts. Finally, the paper draws policy implications for the public health planner.

10.1002/hec.3558.abstractZh: 我们使用空间计量经济学方法分析意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区各卫生区之间医院支出的溢出效应。我们建立了能够反映全球溢出效应的空间模型，并区分了与潜在不适当住院相关的支出以及与复杂医疗程序相关的支出。我们还研究了地理和制度邻近性在解释空间依赖性方面的相对贡献，通过明确建模不同的连通性结构并利用它们来构建不同的空间权重矩阵。我们发现，不同类型的支出的相互作用存在很大差异，对于潜在不适当的住院，空间效应呈正相关，而对于高复杂性的支出，这种效应通常并不显著。基于估计的直接和间接效应，我们还测试了各卫生区之间是否存在空间溢出效应。最后，本文为公共卫生规划者提供了政策建议。

abstract.text: Although the literature suggests that nursing home location is instrumental to the efficient functioning of the long-term care industry, there has been little research directly focused on the spatial distribution of nursing homes. We discuss factors that may influence nursing home location choice, emphasizing agglomeration economies around hospitals. We estimate econometric models of location using information on all freestanding, MediCal-licensed long-term care facilities in the state of California. We find that nursing homes are more likely to locate in the same Census tract as a hospital and are more likely to locate in tracts nearer to those containing a hospital.

10.1002/hec.3567.abstractZh: 尽管文献表明养老院的位置对长期护理行业的有效运作至关重要，但针对养老院空间分布的研究却相对较少。我们探讨了可能影响养老院选址的因素，重点分析了医院周边集聚经济效应。我们基于加利福尼亚州所有独立运营的、获得MediCal许可的长期护理设施的信息，建立了选址的经济计量模型。研究发现，养老院更有可能位于与医院相同的统计区，并且更可能位于靠近已有医院的区域。

abstract.text: We investigate whether hospitals in the English National Health Service change their quality or efficiency in response to changes in quality or efficiency of neighbouring hospitals. We first provide a theoretical model that predicts that a hospital will not respond to changes in the efficiency of its rivals but may change its quality or efficiency in response to changes in the quality of rivals, though the direction of the response is ambiguous. We use data on eight quality measures (including mortality, emergency readmissions, patient reported outcome, and patient satisfaction) and six efficiency measures (including bed occupancy, cancelled operations, and costs) for public hospitals between 2010/11 and 2013/14 to estimate both spatial cross-sectional and spatial fixed- and random-effects panel data models. We find that although quality and efficiency measures are unconditionally spatially correlated, the spatial regression models suggest that a hospital's quality or efficiency does not respond to its rivals' quality or efficiency, except for a hospital's overall mortality that is positively associated with that of its rivals. The results are robust to allowing for spatially correlated covariates and errors and to instrumenting rivals' quality and efficiency.

10.1002/hec.3569.abstractZh: 我们研究英格兰国家卫生服务系统中的医院是否会根据邻近医院的质量或效率变化来调整自身的质量或效率。首先，我们提出了一个理论模型，该模型预测医院不会对其竞争对手的效率变化作出反应，但可能会根据竞争对手的质量变化来调整自身的质量或效率，尽管这种反应的方向并不明确。我们使用2010/11至2013/14年间八项质量指标（包括死亡率、急诊再入院率、患者报告结果和患者满意度）以及六项效率指标（包括床位占用率、手术取消率和成本）的数据，对公立医院的空间横截面数据和空间固定效应及随机效应面板数据模型进行了估计。研究发现，尽管质量和效率指标在空间上呈正相关，但空间回归模型表明，医院的质量或效率并不受竞争对手的质量或效率影响，除了总体死亡率与竞争对手的死亡率呈正相关这一例外。这些结果在考虑空间相关协变量和误差，以及使用工具变量来反映竞争对手的质量与效率的情况下仍然成立。

abstract.text: Understanding the role that drug adherence has on health outcomes in everyday clinical practice is central for the policy maker. This is particularly true when patients suffer from asymptomatic chronic conditions (e.g., hypertension, hypercholesterolaemia, and diabetes). By exploiting a unique longitudinal dataset at patient and physician level in Italy, we show that patients and physicians unobserved characteristics play an important role in determining health status, at least as important as drug adherence. Most importantly, we find that both adherence and prescribed treatment regimen effects are highly heterogeneous across physicians, highlighting their crucial role in shaping patients' health status.

10.1002/hec.3570.abstractZh: 理解药物依从性对日常临床实践中健康结果的影响，对于政策制定者来说至关重要。这一点在患者患有无症状的慢性疾病时尤为明显（例如高血压、高胆固醇血症和糖尿病）。通过利用意大利患者和医生层面的独特纵向数据集，我们发现患者和医生的未观测特征在决定健康状况方面起着重要作用，其重要性至少与药物依从性相当。最重要的是，我们发现药物依从性和处方治疗方案的效果在医生之间存在高度异质性，这凸显了它们在塑造患者健康状况中的关键作用。

abstract.text: We provide a new assessment of the effect of hospital proximity in an emergency situation-road-traffic accidents-exploiting the exogenous variation in the proximity to cities that are legally allowed to have a hospital on the basis of their population size. Our instrumental variable results show that a one-standard-deviation increase in the distance to the nearest hospital (5 km) raises the fatality rate by 13.84% at the sample average. This figure is equal to 0.92 additional deaths per 100 accidents. We show that both ordinary least squares and difference-in-differences estimates, common approaches in the literature, provide a downward-biased measure of the true effect of hospital proximity because they do not fully solve spatial sorting problems. Proximity is more important when the level of road safety is low, when emergency services are less responsive, and when the nearest hospital has relatively low quality standards.

10.1002/hec.3571.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的评估方法，用于分析在交通事故等紧急情况中医院距离对事故影响的作用。我们利用了法律允许根据人口规模在多个城市设立医院这一因素，来研究医院距离的变化对事故死亡率的影响。我们的工具变量分析结果显示，距离最近医院的距离每增加一个标准差（5公里），事故的平均死亡率将增加13.84%。这一数值相当于每100起事故多发生0.92例死亡。我们指出，文献中常用的普通最小二乘法和差异估计方法，并不能准确反映医院距离对事故死亡率的真实影响，因为它们未能完全解决空间排序问题。在道路安全水平较低、紧急服务响应较慢，以及最近医院的质量标准较低的情况下，医院距离的重要性更为显著。

abstract.text: On the basis of a Salop model with regulated prices, we investigate quality provision behaviour of competing hospitals before and after a merger. For this, we use a controlled laboratory experiment where subjects decided on the level of treatment quality as head of a hospital. We find that the post-merger average quality is significantly lower than the average pre-merger quality. However, for merger insiders and outsiders, average quality choices are significantly higher than predicted for pure profit-maximising hospitals. This upward deviation is potentially driven by altruistic behaviour towards patients. Furthermore, we find that in the case where sufficient cost synergies are realised by the merged hospitals, there is a significant increase in average quality choices compared to the scenario without synergies. Finally, we find that our results do not change when comparing individual decisions to team decisions.

10.1002/hec.3574.abstractZh: 基于一个具有管制价格的Salop模型，我们研究了竞争医院在合并前后在服务质量提供方面的行为。为此，我们使用了一个受控实验室实验，参与者作为医院负责人来决定服务质量水平。我们发现，合并后的平均服务质量明显低于合并前的平均水平。然而，对于合并内部人士和外部人士而言，他们选择的平均服务质量水平显著高于纯利润最大化医院的预期。这种向上的偏差可能是由对患者 altruistic 行为所驱动的。此外，我们发现，如果合并后的医院能够实现足够的成本协同效应，那么平均服务质量的选择将显著优于没有协同效应的情景。最后，我们发现，当比较个体决策与团队决策时，我们的研究结果并未发生变化。

abstract.text: Health care is a credence good, and its market is plagued by asymmetric information. In this paper, we use a laboratory experiment to test the performance of a potential remedy discussed in the applied literature, the separation of prescription and treatment activities. We observe a significant amount of overtreatment (and a smaller nonpredicted amount of undertreatment) in our baseline environment. Requiring a different than the treating physician to provide diagnosis and prescription for free is an effective way to reduce overtreatment in our laboratory setting. This effect, however, is partially offset by an increased frequency of undertreatment. Allowing prescription and treatment physicians to independently set prices for their services reduces efficiency due to coordination failures: In sum, prices are often higher than expected benefit of patients, who in turn do not attend to the physician. Also contrary to theory, bargaining power does not play a significant role for the distribution of profits between physicians.

10.1002/hec.3575.abstractZh: 医疗保健是一种信任商品，其市场受到信息不对称问题的困扰。在本文中，我们通过实验室实验来测试应用文献中讨论的一种潜在解决方案的效果，即分离处方和治疗活动。我们在基线环境中观察到大量过度治疗现象（以及少量非预期的治疗不足）。要求不同于治疗医生的医生免费提供诊断和处方是一种有效减少过度治疗的方法。然而，这种效果部分被治疗频率的增加所抵消。允许处方和治疗医生独立设定服务价格会降低效率，因为存在协调失败的问题：总体而言，价格往往高于患者预期的利益，而患者则不会重视医生的建议。此外，与理论预测相反，议价能力对医生之间利润分配的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: We explore how competition between physicians affects medical service provision. Previous research has shown that, without competition, physicians deviate from patient-optimal treatment under payment systems like capitation and fee-for-service. Although competition might reduce these distortions, physicians usually interact with each other repeatedly over time and only a fraction of patients switches providers at all. Both patterns might prevent competition to work in the desired direction. To analyze the behavioral effects of competition, we develop a theoretical benchmark that is then tested in a controlled laboratory experiment. Experimental conditions vary physician payment and patient characteristics. Real patients benefit from provision decisions made in the experiment. Our results reveal that, in line with the theoretical prediction, introducing competition can reduce overprovision and underprovision, respectively. The observed effects depend on patient characteristics and the payment system, though. Tacit collusion is observed and particularly pronounced with fee-for-service payment, but it appears to be less frequent than in related experimental research on price competition.

10.1002/hec.3583.abstractZh: 我们探讨了医生之间的竞争如何影响医疗服务提供。先前的研究表明，在没有竞争的情况下，医生会在按人头付费或按服务收费等支付体系中偏离对患者最有利的治疗方案。虽然竞争可能会减少这些扭曲现象，但医生通常会长期相互交流，只有少数患者才会更换医疗服务提供者。这两种情况都可能阻碍竞争朝着预期的方向发挥作用。为了分析竞争的行为效应，我们提出了一个理论基准，并在一个受控的实验室实验中进行了验证。实验条件包括不同的医生支付方式和患者特征。真实的患者可以从实验中的决策中受益。我们的研究结果表明，与理论预测一致，引入竞争可以分别减少过度提供和服务不足的情况。不过，观察到的效应还取决于患者特征和支付体系。在按服务收费的支付体系中，隐性勾结现象较为明显，但这种情况似乎比在关于价格竞争的相关实验研究中更为少见。

abstract.text: Annual vaccination is the most effective way to prevent seasonal influenza. However, globally, the recommendations vary from country to country, ranging from universal recommendations, risk-group-specific recommendations, to no recommendation at all. Due to high diversity both in recommendation practice and country-specific preconditions, it is difficult to determine the effect of different recommendations on vaccine uptake. This incentivised laboratory experiment (N = 288) tests the behavioural consequences of different recommendations in a repeated interactive vaccination game. The participants are part of heterogeneous groups, comprised of low- and high-risk type of players. They receive either a universal, risk-group-specific or no recommendation prior to their vaccination decisions. Results show that individuals are sensitive to the recommendations. In detail, a risk-group-specific recommendation increases vaccine uptake of high-risk types. However, at the same time, it decreases vaccine uptake of low-risk types. The results imply that when the proportion of low-risk types in a population is considerably larger than the high-risk group, a risk-group-specific (vs. universal) recommendation comes at the cost of decreased social benefit of vaccination due to the overall lower vaccine uptake. Policy decision-making should therefore complement epidemiological considerations with potential positive and negative behavioural consequences of vaccination recommendations.

10.1002/hec.3584.abstractZh: 年度疫苗接种是预防季节性流感最有效的方法。然而，全球范围内，各国的建议各不相同，有的实行普遍接种，有的针对特定风险群体，有的则完全不推荐接种。由于建议实施和各国具体条件的高度差异，很难确定不同建议对疫苗接种率的影响。本研究通过一项激励性实验室实验（N=288）来测试不同建议在重复互动疫苗接种游戏中的行为后果。参与者分为两类：低风险和高风险群体。他们在做出接种决策之前会收到普遍接种、针对特定风险群体的建议或完全不推荐接种的信息。结果显示，个体对建议非常敏感。具体而言，针对特定风险群体的建议会增加高风险群体的疫苗接种率，但同时会降低低风险群体的疫苗接种率。这意味着，当人群中低风险群体的比例远高于高风险群体时，针对特定风险群体的建议会以降低疫苗接种的社会效益为代价。因此，政策决策应结合流行病学分析，同时考虑疫苗接种建议可能带来的积极和消极行为后果。

abstract.text: Behavioral responses to surveys can significantly affect inferences about population prevalence unless correctly modeled statistically. An important case study is the prevalence of nicotine dependence, a formal psychiatric disorder satisfying clinical criteria. Data from the National Epidemiologic Survey on Alcohol and Related Conditions in the United States are used, along with a flexible semi-nonparametric sample selection model. Corrections for sample selection responses to "gateway" survey questions lead to significantly higher estimates of the prevalence of nicotine dependence among current daily smokers. These corrections also imply even higher levels of the decades-long and lifetime-long persistence of nicotine dependence after the onset of smoking.

10.1002/hec.3614.abstractZh: 对调查的行为反应会显著影响对人群患病率的分析结果，除非在统计上正确地进行了建模。一个重要的案例研究是尼古丁依赖的患病率，这是一种符合临床标准的正式精神疾病。本研究使用了美国酒精及相关疾病全国流行病学调查的数据，并采用了一种灵活的半非参数样本选择模型。通过对样本选择对“入门”调查问题的反应进行校正后，得出当前每天吸烟人群中尼古丁依赖患病率的高估结果。这些校正还表明，在开始吸烟后，尼古丁依赖的持续性在数十年甚至终生都会保持较高水平。

abstract.text: In this study, we introduce the opportunity for physicians to sort into capitation or fee-for-service payment. Using a controlled medically framed laboratory experiment with a sequential within-subject design allows isolating sorting from incentive effects. We observe a strong preference for fee-for-service payment, which does not depend on subjects' prior experience with one of the two payment schemes. Further, we identify a significant sorting effect. Subjects choosing capitation deviate ex ante less from patient-optimal medical treatment than subjects who sort into fee-for-service payment. Particularly the latter become even less patient-oriented after introducing the choice option. Consequently, the opportunity to choose between fee-for-service and capitation payment worsens patient treatment, if at all. Our results hold for medical and for nonmedical students.

10.1002/hec.3616.abstractZh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了医生可以选择按人头付费或按服务收费的支付方式。通过一项具有顺序被试内设计的医学实验，我们能够将选择支付方式与激励效应分离开来。我们发现，人们普遍更倾向于选择按服务收费的支付方式，这一偏好并不取决于受试者对两种支付方式的先前经验。此外，我们还发现选择按人头付费的受试者与选择按服务收费的受试者相比，在事前更不会偏离最优医疗方案。特别是在引入选择选项后，后者甚至更加不注重患者的需求。因此，在按服务收费和按人头付费之间做出选择的机会，实际上会恶化患者的治疗效果。我们的研究结果适用于医学专业和非医学专业的学生。

abstract.text: Vaccination involves a tradeoff between two risky alternatives, namely, susceptibility and immunization. By designing a controlled laboratory experiment, we investigate the association between risk preferences and immunization decisions. To contrast the role of risk preferences in vaccination decisions with other domains, we implemented four frames: vaccination, surgery, complex neutral, and simple neutral. We found direct framing effects for females but not for males. For the former, the demand for the safer alternative is significantly larger in the surgery frame than in all other frames. For male subjects, we found a significant association between stated risk preferences and choice behavior in the simple neutral frame but not in the other three frames. For female subjects, we observed the exact opposite. Although the complexity of the decision problem matters, there is no indication of differential roles of risk preferences for a given complexity. We found that the share of consistent choices is significantly larger in the surgery frame as compared to the two neutral frames, that is, context improves decision making. This does not apply to the vaccination frame, so there is something about vaccinations that prevents individuals from better understanding the decision problem at hand.

10.1002/hec.3620.abstractZh: 疫苗接种涉及两种风险选择之间的权衡，即易感性和免疫效果。通过设计一项受控实验室实验，我们研究了风险偏好与免疫决策之间的关系。为了将风险偏好在疫苗接种决策中的作用与其他领域进行对比，我们采用了四种框架：疫苗接种、手术、复杂中性框架和简单中性框架。我们发现女性在框架效应方面表现出明显的差异，而男性则没有这种效应。在手术框架中，对更安全的疫苗的选择需求明显大于其他所有框架。对于男性受试者，我们发现在简单中性框架中，表述的风险偏好与选择行为之间存在显著关联，但在其他三个框架中则没有这种关联。对于女性受试者，观察结果则完全相反。尽管决策问题的复杂性很重要，但并没有迹象表明风险偏好在给定复杂性下的作用存在差异。我们发现，在手术框架中，一致选择的比例明显高于两个中性框架，这表明情境对决策过程有积极影响。这一结论不适用于疫苗接种框架，因此疫苗接种本身存在某种因素，使得个体无法更好地理解当前的决策问题。

abstract.text: The aim of this paper is to investigate how risk attitudes in medical decisions for others vary across health contexts. A lab experiment was designed to elicit the risk attitudes of 257 medical and nonmedical students by assigning them the role of a physician who must decide between treatments for patients. An interval regression model was used to estimate individual coefficients of relative risk aversion, and an estimation model was used to test for the effect of type of medical decision and experimental design characteristics on elicited risk aversion. We find that (a) risk attitudes vary across different health contexts, but risk aversion prevails in all of them; (b) students enrolled in health-related degrees show a higher degree of risk aversion; and (c) real rewards for third parties (patients) make subjects less risk-averse. The results underline the importance of accounting for attitudes towards risk in medical decision making.

10.1002/hec.3628.abstractZh: 本文旨在研究不同健康背景下，人们在医疗决策中对风险的态度是否存在差异。通过设计一项实验室实验，对257名医学专业和非医学专业的学生进行了风险态度的调查，要求他们扮演医生的角色，为病人选择治疗方案。采用区间回归模型来估计个体对相对风险的厌恶程度，并通过估计模型来检验医疗决策类型及实验设计特征对风险态度的影响。研究发现：(a) 不同健康背景下的风险态度存在差异，但所有情况下都存在风险厌恶现象；(b) 攻读健康相关专业的学生表现出更高的风险厌恶程度；(c) 第三方（病人）的实际回报使得受试者对风险的厌恶程度降低。这些结果强调了在医疗决策中考虑风险态度的重要性。

abstract.text: Does tort reform reduce defensive medicine and thus healthcare spending? Several (though not all) prior studies, using a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach, find lower Medicare spending for hospital care after states adopt caps on non-economic or total damages ("damage caps"), during the "second" reform wave of the mid-1980s. We re-examine this issue in several ways. We study the nine states that adopted caps during the "third reform wave," from 2002 to 2005. We find that damage caps have no significant impact on Medicare Part A spending, but predict roughly 4% higher Medicare Part B spending. We then revisit the 1980s caps, and find no evidence of a post-adoption drop (or rise) in spending for these caps.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.11.001.abstractZh: 侵权法改革是否会减少防御性医疗，进而降低医疗支出？一些研究（但并非全部）采用差异-差异法（DiD）来分析，发现在1980年代中期“第二次”改革浪潮期间，各州对非经济损失或总赔偿金额设定上限后，医疗保险中的医院护理支出有所下降。我们从多个角度重新探讨了这一问题。我们研究了在“第三次改革浪潮”期间（2002年至2005年）设定上限的九个州的情况。研究发现，赔偿金额上限对医疗保险A部分的支出没有显著影响，但预计B部分的支出会增加约4%。随后，我们重新审视了1980年代的这些上限措施，发现这些措施实施后，支出并没有出现下降或上升的情况。

abstract.text: This paper develops a dynamic model to illustrate how diet and body weight change when novel food products become available to consumers. We propose a microfounded test to empirically discriminate between habit and taste formation in intertemporal preferences. Moreover, we show that 'novelty consumption' and endogenous preferences can explain the persistent correlation between economic development and obesity.
