By empirically studying the German reunification, we find that East Germans consumed more novel Western food and gained more weight than West Germans when a larger variety of food products became readily accessible after the fall of the Wall. The observed consumption patterns suggest that food consumption features habit formation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.11.002.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个动态模型，用以说明当新型食品可供消费者选择时，饮食和体重会发生怎样的变化。我们提出了一种基于微观基础的测试方法，以实证区分跨时期偏好中的习惯形成与口味形成。此外，我们发现“新奇消费”和内生偏好可以解释经济发展与肥胖之间的持续关联。通过实证研究德国统一时期的情况，我们发现东德人在柏林墙倒塌后，随着更多西方食品变得易于获取，他们的消费量增加，体重也增加了。观察到的消费模式表明，食品消费具有习惯形成的特征。

abstract.text: This paper explores how provider and insurer market power affect which markets an insurer chooses to operate in. A 2011 policy change required that certain private insurance plans in Medicare form provider networks de novo; in response, insurers cancelled two-thirds of the affected plans. Using detailed data on pre-policy provider and insurer market structure, I compare markets where insurers built networks to those they exited. Overall, insurers in the most concentrated hospital and physician markets were 9 and 13 percentage points more likely to exit, respectively, than those in the least concentrated markets. Conversely, insurers with more market power were less likely to exit than those with less, and an insurer's market power had the largest effect on exit in concentrated hospital markets. These findings suggest that concentrated provider markets contribute to insurer exit and that insurers with less market power have more difficulty surviving in concentrated provider markets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.11.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了提供者和保险公司的市场力量如何影响保险公司选择经营的市场。2011年的政策变更要求Medicare中的某些私人保险计划必须重新建立提供者网络；作为回应，三分之二的受影响计划取消了该网络。通过详细的数据分析提供者和保险公司的市场结构，我比较了保险公司建立网络与退出网络后的市场状况。总体而言，在最为集中的医院和医生市场中，保险公司退出市场的可能性分别比在最少集中的市场中高出9个百分点和13个百分点。相反，拥有更多市场力量的保险公司比那些市场力量较小的保险公司更难以退出市场，而保险公司的市场力量对集中医院的市场的退出影响最为显著。这些发现表明，集中的提供者市场会导致保险公司退出市场，而市场力量较小的保险公司在集中的提供者市场中生存更为困难。

abstract.text: Approval of new drugs is increasingly reliant on "surrogate endpoints," which correlate with but imperfectly predict clinical benefits. Proponents argue surrogate endpoints allow for faster approval, but critics charge they provide inadequate evidence. We develop an economic framework that addresses the value of improvement in the predictive power, or "quality," of surrogate endpoints, and clarifies how quality can influence decisions by regulators, payers, and manufacturers. For example, the framework shows how lower-quality surrogates lead to greater misalignment of incentives between payers and regulators, resulting in more drugs that are approved for use but not covered by payers. Efficient price-negotiation in the marketplace can help align payer incentives for granting access based on surrogates. Higher-quality surrogates increase manufacturer profits and social surplus from early access to new drugs. Since the return on better quality is shared between manufacturers and payers, private incentives to invest in higher-quality surrogates are inefficiently low.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.001.abstractZh: 新药的审批越来越依赖于“替代终点”，这些终点与临床受益相关，但预测能力并不完美。支持者认为，替代终点能加快审批流程，但批评者指出，这些终点提供的证据不足。我们提出了一个经济框架，以评估替代终点预测能力或“质量”提升的价值，并阐明质量如何影响监管机构、支付方和制造商的决策。例如，该框架显示，质量较低的替代终点会导致支付方与监管机构之间的激励严重不匹配，从而导致更多药物获得批准但未被支付方覆盖。市场中的高效价格谈判有助于调整支付方的激励，使其基于替代终点来决定是否批准药物。质量较高的替代终点则能增加制造商的利润以及从早期药物获取中获得的社會剩余。由于更高质量的回报由制造商和支付方共同分享，私人投资高质量替代终点的动机实际上非常低。

abstract.text: Parallel reimbursement regimes, under which providers have some discretion over which payer gets billed for patient treatment, are a common feature of health care markets. In the U.S., the largest such system is under Workers' Compensation (WC), where the treatment workers with injuries that are not definitively tied to a work accident may be billed either under group health insurance plans or under WC. We document that there is significant reclassification of injuries from group health plans into WC, or "claims shifting", when the financial incentives to do so are strongest. In particular, we find that injuries to workers enrolled in capitated group health plans (such as HMOs) see a higher incidence of their claims for soft-tissue injuries (which are hard to classify specifically as work related) under WC than under group health, relative to those in non-capitated plans. Such a pattern is not evident for workers with traumatic injuries. Moreover, we find that such reclassification is more common in states with higher WC fees, once again for soft tissue but not traumatic injuries. Our results imply that a significant shift towards capitated reimbursement, or reimbursement reductions, under GH could lead to a large rise in the cost of WC plans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.002.abstractZh: 并行报销制度是一种常见的情况，在这种制度下，医疗服务提供者在一定程度上可以自行决定将患者治疗的费用报给哪个支付方。在美国，这种制度最典型的例子就是工伤赔偿制度。在这种制度下，那些与工作事故没有明确关联的伤害，可以由团体健康保险计划或工伤赔偿制度来支付费用。我们发现，当经济激励措施最强时，团体健康保险计划中的伤害会被重新分类为工伤赔偿案件，这种现象被称为“索赔转移”。具体来说，与那些参加非固定预算的团体健康保险计划的工人相比，参加固定预算团体健康保险计划的工人，在工伤赔偿制度下，软组织损伤（这类伤害难以明确归类为与工作相关的伤害）的索赔比例更高。然而，对于遭受创伤性伤害的工人来说，这种重新分类现象并不明显。此外，我们发现，在工伤赔偿费用较高的州，这种重新分类现象更为常见，同样适用于软组织损伤而非创伤性伤害。我们的研究结果表明，如果工伤赔偿制度转向固定预算报销方式，或者报销费用减少，那么工伤赔偿计划的成本将会大幅上升。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of US public health insurance programs for children on health. Previous work in this area has typically focused on the relationship between current program eligibility and current health. But because health is a stock variable which reflects the cumulative influence of health inputs, it would be preferable to estimate the impact of total program eligibility during childhood on longer-term health outcomes. I provide such estimates by using longitudinal data to construct Medicaid and CHIP eligibility measures that are observed from birth through age 18 and estimating the effect of cumulative program exposure on a variety of health outcomes observed in early adulthood. To account for the endogeneity of program eligibility, I exploit variation in Medicaid and CHIP generosity across states and over time for children of different ages. I find that an additional year of public health insurance eligibility during childhood improves a summary index of adult health by.079 standard deviations, and substantially reduces health limitations, chronic conditions and asthma prevalence while improving self-rated health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.003.abstractZh: 本文旨在评估美国儿童公共健康保险计划对健康的效应。以往的相关研究通常关注当前计划资格与当前健康状况之间的关系。但由于健康是一个反映健康投入累积影响的存量变量，因此更适宜评估儿童时期总计划资格对长期健康结果的影响。我通过纵向数据构建从出生到18岁的医疗补助和CHIP资格指标，并估算累积计划参与对成年早期各种健康结果的影响。为考虑计划资格的内生性，我利用不同州以及不同时期医疗补助和CHIP福利差异来研究不同年龄儿童的情况。研究发现，儿童时期多一年公共健康保险资格可使成人健康综合指标改善0.079个标准差，并显著减少健康限制、慢性疾病和哮喘患病率，同时提升自我健康评价。

abstract.text: Medicare beneficiaries are eligible for health insurance through the public option of traditional Medicare (TM) or may join a private Medicare Advantage (MA) plan. Both are highly subsidized but in different ways. Medicare pays for most of costs directly in TM, and subsidizes MA plans based on a "benchmark" for each beneficiary choosing a private plan. The level of this benchmark is arguably the most important policy decision Medicare makes about the MA program. Many analysts recommend equalizing Medicare's subsidy across the options - referred to in policy circles as a "level playing field." This paper studies the normative question of how to set the level of the benchmark, applying the versatile model developed by Einav and Finkelstein (EF) to Medicare. The EF framework implies unequal subsidies to counteract risk selection across plan types. We also study other reasons to tilt the field: the relative efficiency of MA vs. TM, market power of MA plans, and institutional features of the way Medicare determines subsidies and premiums. After review of the empirical and policy literature, we conclude that in areas where the MA market is competitive, the benchmark should be set below average costs in TM, but in areas characterized by imperfect competition in MA, it should be raised in order to offset output (enrollment) restrictions by plans with market power. We also recommend specific modifications of Medicare rules to make demand for MA more price elastic.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.004.abstractZh: Medicare受益人可以通过传统的Medicare计划获得健康保险，或者选择加入私人的Medicare Advantage计划。这两种方式都得到了高额补贴，但补贴的方式有所不同。Medicare直接为大部分费用提供支付，而私人Medicare Advantage计划的补贴则基于每个受益人的“基准”来确定。这一基准水平可以说是Medicare在Medicare Advantage计划方面做出的最重要的政策决策之一。许多分析师建议将Medicare的补贴在两种选择之间均衡化，这在政策界被称为“公平竞争环境”。本文研究了如何设定基准水平的问题，运用了Einav和Finkelstein开发的模型来分析Medicare的情况。EF框架意味着需要不平等的补贴来抵消不同计划类型之间的风险选择差异。我们还研究了其他可能导致补贴倾斜的原因：Medicare Advantage计划相对于Medicare计划的相对效率、私人Medicare Advantage计划的市场力量，以及Medicare确定补贴和保费的方式的制度特征。在回顾了相关实证和政策文献后，我们得出结论：在Medicare Advantage市场竞争较为激烈的领域，基准水平应设定在Medicare的平均成本以下；而在Medicare Advantage市场竞争不充分的领域，则应将基准水平提高，以抵消具有市场力量的计划对参保人数的限制。我们还建议对Medicare规则进行具体修改，以使对Medicare Advantage计划的需求更具价格弹性。

abstract.text: The Rational Addiction (RA) model is increasingly often estimated using individual level panel data with mixed results; in particular, with regard to the implied rate of time discount. This paper suggests that the odd values of the rate of discount frequently found in the literature may in fact be a consequence of the saddle-point dynamics associated with individual level inter-temporal optimization problems. We report the results of Monte Carlo experiments estimating RA-type difference equations that seem to suggest the possibility that the presence of both a stable and an unstable root in the dynamic process may create serious problems for the estimation of RA equations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.005.abstractZh: 理性成瘾（RA）模型通常使用个体层面面板数据进行估计，但结果并不一致；特别是在时间折现率的设定上。本文指出，文献中常见的折现率的非整数值，实际上可能是个体层面跨时期优化问题所涉及的鞍点动态的结果。我们报告了蒙特卡洛实验的结果，这些实验用于估计RA型差分方程，结果表明动态过程中同时存在稳定根和不稳定根的情况，可能会给RA方程的估计带来严重问题。

abstract.text: Policymakers are increasingly interested in reducing healthcare costs and inefficiencies through innovative payment strategies. These strategies may have heterogeneous impacts across geographic areas, potentially reducing or exacerbating geographic variation in healthcare spending. In this paper, we exploit a major payment reform for home health care to examine whether reductions in reimbursement lead to differential changes in treatment intensity and provider costs depending on the level of competition in a market. Using Medicare claims, we find that while providers in more competitive markets had higher average costs in the pre-reform period, these markets experienced larger proportional reductions in treatment intensity and costs after the reform relative to less competitive markets. This led to a convergence in spending across geographic areas. We find that much of the reduction in provider costs is driven by greater exit of "high-cost" providers in more competitive markets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.006.abstractZh: 政策制定者越来越关注通过创新的支付策略来降低医疗保健成本和低效性。这些策略在不同地理区域可能会产生不同的影响，可能会减少或加剧医疗保健支出的地域差异。在本文中，我们以家庭健康护理的支付改革为例，研究报销金额的减少是否会导致治疗强度和提供者成本的变化因市场的竞争程度而异。通过利用Medicare的索赔数据，我们发现，在改革前，竞争更激烈的市场中的提供者平均成本更高，但改革后，这些市场的治疗强度和成本比例都比竞争较弱的市场有所减少。这导致各地理区域的支出趋于一致。我们发现，提供者成本的降低很大程度上是由于在竞争更激烈的市场中，“高成本”提供者的退出率更高所导致的。

abstract.text: Health systems are employing physicians in growing numbers. The implications of this trend are poorly understood and controversial. We use rich data from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services to examine the effects of a set of physician acquisitions by hospital systems on outpatient utilization and spending. We find that financial integration systematically produces economically large changes in the acquired physicians' behavior, but has less consistent effects at the acquiring system level.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.007.abstractZh: 医疗体系正在越来越多地雇佣医生。这一趋势的影响尚不清楚，且存在争议。我们利用美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心提供的丰富数据，研究医院系统收购医生对门诊利用和支出的影响。我们发现，财务整合会系统性地导致被收购医生的行为发生显著的经济变化，但在收购方层面，这种影响则不太明显。

abstract.text: Using Canadian administrative data from multiple sources, we provide the first nationally representative estimates for the effect of spouses' cancer diagnoses on individuals' employment and earnings and on family income. Our identification strategy exploits unexpected health shocks and combines matching with individual fixed effects in a generalized difference-in-differences framework to control for observable and unobservable heterogeneity. While the effect of spousal health shocks on labor supply is theoretically ambiguous, we find strong evidence for a decline in employment and earnings of individuals whose spouses are diagnosed with cancer. We interpret this result as individuals reducing their labor supply to provide care to their sick spouses and to enjoy joint leisure. Family income substantially declines after spouses' cancer diagnoses, suggesting that the financial consequences of such health shocks are considerable.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.008.abstractZh: 我们利用来自多个来源的加拿大行政数据，首次提供了关于配偶癌症诊断对个人就业、收入以及家庭收入影响的全国代表性估计。我们的识别策略利用了意外的健康冲击，并在广义差异中差异框架中结合了匹配和个体固定效应，以控制可观测和不可观测的异质性。虽然配偶健康冲击对劳动力供给的影响在理论上存在不确定性，但我们发现了强有力的证据，表明配偶被诊断出癌症后，个人的就业和收入会下降。我们将这一结果解释为个人减少劳动力供给，以便照顾生病的配偶并享受共同休闲时光。配偶癌症诊断后，家庭收入显著下降，这表明这种健康冲击带来的财务后果相当严重。

abstract.text: We provide the first analysis of the relationship between economic conditions and the use of illicit drugs other than marijuana. Drawing on US data from 2002 to 2015, we find mixed evidence on the cyclicality of illicit drug use. However, we find robust evidence that economic downturns lead to increases in the intensity of prescription pain reliever use as well as increases in clinically relevant substance use disorders involving opioids. These effects are concentrated among working-age white males with low educational attainment. We conclude that policymakers should consider devoting more, not fewer, resources to treating substance use disorders during economic downturns.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.12.009.abstractZh: 我们首次分析了经济状况与除大麻以外的非法药物使用之间的关系。基于2002至2015年的美国数据，我们发现关于非法药物使用的周期性变化存在混合性的证据。然而，我们发现经济衰退会导致处方止痛药使用的强度增加，以及涉及阿片类药物的临床相关物质使用障碍的加剧。这些影响主要出现在低教育水平的劳动年龄白人男性中。我们得出结论，政策制定者在经济衰退期间应投入更多资源来治疗物质使用障碍，而不是减少资源投入。

abstract.text: Much of the risk adjustment literature has focused on how persons should be classified and given weights. It has given less attention to the amount of funds in the risk adjustment pool. If, however, there is an outside option, as there is in the principal American risk adjustment systems, there can be favorable or adverse selection in the risk pool. To address any such selection requires that the risk adjustment system not be zero sum; the main American risk adjustment systems differ in this respect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.01.001.abstractZh: 许多关于风险调整的研究都集中在如何对个体进行分类并赋予其权重上。而对风险调整池中的资金数量则关注较少。然而，如果像美国主要的风险调整系统那样存在外部选择，那么风险池中可能会出现有利或不利的选择。要应对这种选择，风险调整系统不能采用零和模式；美国主要的风险调整系统在这方面有所不同。

abstract.text: I provide novel evidence on the effectiveness of two vaccination policies - simple non-binding recommendations to vaccinate versus mandates requiring vaccination prior to childcare or kindergarten attendance - in the context of the only disease whose institutional features permit a credible examination of both: hepatitis A. Using provider-verified immunization data I find that recommendations significantly increased hepatitis A vaccination rates among young children by at least 20 percentage points, while mandates increase rates by another 8 percentage points. These policies also significantly reduced population hepatitis A incidence. My results suggest a range of policy options for addressing suboptimally low population vaccination rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.01.002.abstractZh: 我提供了关于两种疫苗接种政策有效性的新证据——简单的非强制建议接种疫苗与要求在儿童保育或幼儿园入学前接种疫苗的强制政策——在唯一一种具有可验证特征的疾病的背景下进行考察，这种疾病就是甲型肝炎。通过利用由提供者验证的免疫数据，我发现建议接种疫苗显著提高了幼儿甲的疫苗接种率，至少提高了20个百分点，而强制政策则使接种率提高了8个百分点。这些政策还显著降低了人群中的甲型肝炎发病率。我的研究结果为应对较低的人群疫苗接种率问题提供了多种政策选择。

abstract.text: In response to increasing public awareness and negative long-term health effects of concussions, the National Football League implemented the "Crown-of-the-Helmet Rule" (CHR). The CHR imposes penalties on players who initiate contact using the top of the helmet. This paper examines the intended effect of this policy and its potential for unintended consequences. We find evidence supporting the intended effect of the policy- a reduction in weekly concussion reports among defensive players by as much as 32% (34% for all head and neck injuries), but also evidence of an increase in weekly lower extremity injury reports for offensive players by as much as 34%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.01.004.abstractZh: 为了应对公众对于脑震荡的日益关注以及其潜在的长期健康危害，美国国家橄榄球联盟实施了“头盔冠规则”。该规则对使用头盔顶部发起接触的球员处以罚款。本文探讨了该政策的预期效果及其可能带来的意外后果。我们发现，该政策确实起到了预期的效果——防守球员的每周脑震荡报告减少了32%（所有头部和颈部受伤的病例减少了34%），但同时，进攻球员的每周下肢受伤报告增加了34%。

abstract.text: We investigate the implementation of Medicare Part D and estimate that this prescription drug benefit program reduced elderly mortality by 2.2% annually. This was driven primarily by a reduction in cardiovascular mortality, the leading cause of death for the elderly. There was no effect on deaths due to cancer, a condition whose drug treatments are covered under Medicare Part B. We validate these results by demonstrating that the changes in drug utilization following the implementation of Medicare Part D match the mortality patterns we observe. We calculate that the value of the mortality reduction is equal to $5 billion per year.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.01.005.abstractZh: 我们研究了Medicare Part D的实施情况，并估计该处方药福利计划每年使老年人口的死亡率降低了2.2%。这一下降主要源于心血管死亡率的减少，而心血管死亡是老年人主要的死亡原因。对于因癌症导致的死亡，该计划并未产生任何影响，因为癌症的药物治疗属于Medicare Part B的覆盖范围。我们通过证明Medicare Part D实施后的药物使用变化与我们观察到的死亡模式一致，来验证这些结果。我们计算出，这种死亡率降低带来的经济效益每年可达50亿美元。

abstract.text: We use register data of 88,948 sick-listed workers in Denmark over the period 2008-2011 to investigate the effect of active labor market programs on the duration until returning to non-subsidized employment and the duration of this employment. To identify causal treatment effects, we exploit over-time variation in the use of active labor market programs in 98 job centers and time-to- event. We find that ordinary education and subsidized job training have significant positive employment effects. Subsidized job training has a large, positive effect on the transition into employment but no effect on the subsequent employment duration. In contrast, ordinary education has a positive effect on employment duration but no effect on the transition into employment. The latter effect is the result of two opposing effects, a large positive effect of having completed education and a large negative lock-in effect, with low re-employment chances during program participation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.01.006.abstractZh: 我们利用2008-2011年间丹麦88,948名病假工人登记数据，研究活跃的劳动力市场计划对返回非补贴就业的时间以及该就业持续时间的影響。为了识别因果处理效应，我们利用了98个就业中心中活跃劳动力市场计划使用情况的随时间变化数据。研究发现，普通教育和补贴性职业培训对就业有显著的积极影响。补贴性职业培训对进入就业状态的过渡有显著的正面影响，但对后续就业持续时间没有影响。相比之下，普通教育对就业持续时间有正面影响，但对进入就业状态的过渡没有影响。后一种影响是由两种相反的效果共同导致的：完成教育带来的显著正面效果，以及参与计划期间较低的再就业机会所带来的显著负面锁定效应。

abstract.text: Proponents of hospital consolidation claim that mergers lead to significant cost savings, but there is little systematic evidence backing these claims. For a large sample of hospital mergers between 2000 and 2010, I estimate difference-in-differences models that compare cost trends at acquired hospitals to cost trends at hospitals whose ownership did not change. I find evidence of economically and statistically significant cost reductions at acquired hospitals. On average, acquired hospitals realize cost savings between 4 and 7 percent in the years following the acquisition. These results are robust to a variety of different control strategies, and do not appear to be easily explained by post-merger changes in service and/or patient mix. I then explore several extensions of the results to examine (a) whether the acquiring hospital/system realizes cost savings post-merger and (b) if cost savings depend on the size of the acquirer and/or the geographic overlap of the merging hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.01.007.abstractZh: 医院合并的支持者声称，合并能够带来显著的成本节约，但几乎没有系统性的证据支持这些说法。通过对2000年至2010年间大量医院合并案例的研究，我构建了差异-差异模型，比较了被合并医院与所有权未发生变化的医院在成本方面的变化。研究发现，被合并医院在成本上确实实现了经济和统计上的显著降低。平均而言，被合并医院在合并后的几年内实现了4%到7%的成本节约。这些结果在采用不同的控制策略后依然保持稳定，并且似乎无法用合并后的服务模式和患者构成的变化来解释。随后，我进一步探讨了这些结果的几种扩展情况，以检验：(a) 合并方是否能在合并后实现成本节约；(b) 成本节约是否取决于合并方的规模以及合并医院之间的地理重叠程度。

abstract.text: The behavior of noncoresident family members motivates much of the literature on consumption smoothing, risk-sharing, and informal networks, yet little is known empirically on the topic due to a lack of data simultaneously observing multiple households in an extended family. This study utilizes genealogically linked longitudinal data to examine how extended family networks insure against financial risks from severely limiting health conditions. We find that nonhealth consumption of unmarried households declines in response to worsening health, whereas married households smooth expenditures in a way that is consistent with full insurance. Families mitigate losses by reallocating home production, drawing down home equity, holding formal health insurance, collecting social security, and receiving transfers from noncoresident relatives. We illustrate that the costs of health shocks are transmitted throughout family networks, and that noncoresident children draw down their assets and consumption when responding to a parent's health decline.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.02.001.abstractZh: 非共同居住家庭成员的行为是消费平滑、风险分担和非正式网络相关文献的主要研究主题，但由于缺乏同时观察大家庭中多个家庭的数据，关于这一主题的实证研究非常有限。本研究利用家谱相关的纵向数据，探讨大家庭网络如何为因严重健康状况导致的财务风险提供保障。研究发现，未婚家庭的非健康消费会在健康状况恶化时减少，而已婚家庭则通过与全额保险一致的方式平滑支出。家庭通过重新分配家庭收入、提取家庭资产、持有正式健康保险、领取社会保障以及接受非共同居住亲属的转移支付来减轻损失。研究还表明，健康冲击的成本会在家庭网络中传递，非共同居住子女在父母健康状况恶化时会减少自己的资产和消费。

abstract.text: A primary purpose of health insurance is to protect families from medical expenditure risk. Despite this goal and despite the fact that research has found that Medicaid can crowd out private coverage, little is known about the effect of Medicaid on families' spending patterns. This paper implements a simulated instrumental variables strategy with data from the Consumer Expenditure Survey to estimate the effect of an additional family member becoming eligible for Medicaid on family-level health insurance coverage and spending. The results indicate that an additional family member becoming eligible for Medicaid increases the number of people in the family with Medicaid coverage by about 0.135-0.142 and decreases the likelihood that a family has any medical spending in a quarter by 2.7 percentage points. As previous research often finds with different data sets, I find evidence that Medicaid expansions crowd out some private coverage. Unlike most other data sets, the Consumer Expenditure Survey allows for considering the financial implications of crowd-out. The results indicate that families that transition from private coverage to Medicaid are able to spend significantly less on health insurance expenses, meaning Medicaid expansions can be welfare improving for families even when crowd-out occurs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.02.002.abstractZh: 健康保险的主要目的之一是保护家庭免受医疗支出的风险。尽管有研究表明医疗补助可能会挤占私人保险市场，但关于医疗补助对家庭支出模式的影响，目前仍缺乏足够的了解。本文采用模拟工具变量策略，利用消费者支出调查的数据，来估算新增家庭成员获得医疗补助后，家庭层面的健康保险覆盖率和支出情况的变化。研究结果表明，新增家庭成员获得医疗补助后，家庭中有医疗补助覆盖的人口比例会增加约0.135-0.142，同时家庭在一个季度内出现医疗支出的可能性会降低2.7个百分点。与以往研究使用不同数据集得出的结果一致，我们发现医疗补助的扩大确实会挤占部分私人保险市场。与大多数其他数据集不同，消费者支出调查能够考虑这种挤占所带来的经济影响。研究结果表明，从私人保险转向医疗补助的家庭，在健康保险支出上的花费会显著减少，这意味着即使存在挤占现象，医疗补助的扩大也能为家庭带来福利提升。

abstract.text: This paper provides an analysis of the role of prices in determining food purchases and nutrition using very detailed transaction-level observations for a large, nationally-representative sample of US consumers over the period 2002-2007. Using product-specific nutritional information, we develop a new method of partitioning the product space into relevant nutritional clusters that define a set of nutritionally-bundled goods, which parsimoniously characterize consumer choice sets. We then estimate a large utility-derived demand system over this joint product-nutrient space that allows us to calculate price and expenditure elasticities. Using our structural demand estimates, we simulate the role of product taxes on soda, sugar-sweetened beverages, packaged meals, and snacks, and nutrient taxes on fat, salt, and sugar. We find that a 20% nutrient tax has a significantly larger impact on nutrition than an equivalent product tax, due to the fact that these are broader-based taxes. However, the costs of these taxes in terms of consumer utility are only about 70 cents per household per day. A sugar tax in particular is a powerful tool to induce healthier nutritive bundles among consumers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.02.003.abstractZh: 本文通过分析2002至2007年间美国消费者大规模、具有全国代表性的样本数据，从交易层面详细观察价格对食品购买和营养状况的影响。利用产品特定的营养信息，我们提出了一种将产品空间划分为相关营养集群的新方法，这些集群定义了营养组合商品，从而简洁地描述了消费者的选择行为。随后，我们基于这一产品-营养联合空间，构建了一个大型效用需求系统，以计算价格和支出的弹性。通过这一结构需求模型，我们模拟了针对苏打水、含糖饮料、包装餐食和零食的产品税，以及针对脂肪、盐和糖的营养税的影响。研究发现，20%的营养税对营养状况的影响比同等程度的产品税更为显著，因为营养税的影响范围更广。然而，这些税收对消费者效用的成本仅约为每户家庭每天70美分。特别是糖税是一种有效的工具，能够促使消费者选择更健康的营养组合。

abstract.text: Using premium subsidies for private coverage, an individual mandate, and Medicaid expansion, the Affordable Care Act (ACA) has increased insurance coverage. We provide the first comprehensive assessment of these provisions' effects, using the 2012-2015 American Community Survey and a triple-difference estimation strategy that exploits variation by income, geography, and time. Overall, our model explains 60% of the coverage gains in 2014-2015. We find that coverage was moderately responsive to price subsidies, with larger gains in state-based insurance exchanges than the federal exchange. The individual mandate's exemptions and penalties had little impact on coverage rates. The law increased Medicaid among individuals gaining eligibility under the ACA and among previously-eligible populations ("woodwork effect") even in non-expansion states, with no resulting reductions in private insurance. Overall, exchange premium subsidies produced 40% of the coverage gains explained by our ACA policy measures, and Medicaid the other 60%, of which 1/2 occurred among previously-eligible individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.02.004.abstractZh: 通过实施保费补贴以推动私人保险覆盖、个人强制保险政策以及医疗补助扩展计划，《平价医疗法案》增加了保险覆盖范围。我们首次对这些政策效果进行了全面评估，使用了2012-2015年的美国社区调查数据，并采用了一种三重差异估计策略，该策略考虑了收入、地理和时间因素的差异。总体而言，我们的模型能够解释2014-2015年间保险覆盖率的60%增长。我们发现，价格补贴对保险覆盖率的提升有显著作用，州级保险交易所的覆盖率提升幅度大于联邦保险交易所。个人强制保险政策的豁免和处罚对保险覆盖率的影响较小。该法律使得在《平价医疗法案》下获得资格的个人以及之前就有资格的人群在医疗补助计划中的覆盖率增加，即使在非扩展州也是如此，同时并未导致私人保险市场的减少。总体而言，保险交易所的保费补贴解释了我们评估的《平价医疗法案》政策措施带来的40%的保险覆盖率增长，而医疗补助计划则贡献了剩余的60%，其中一半增长发生在之前就有资格的人群中。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the causal long-term consequences of an exposure to war in utero and during childhood on the risk of obesity and the probability of having a chronic health condition in adulthood. Using the plausibly exogenous city-by-cohort variation in the intensity of WWII destruction as a unique quasi-experiment, I find that individuals who were exposed to WWII destruction during the prenatal and early postnatal periods have higher BMIs and are more likely to be obese as adults. I also find an elevated incidence of chronic health conditions such as stroke, hypertension, diabetes, and cardiovascular disorder in adulthood among these wartime children.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.02.005.abstractZh: 本文估计了在胎儿期和儿童期暴露于战争对肥胖风险以及成年后慢性健康状况发生概率的长期因果影响。通过利用二战破坏程度在城市群体间的独特差异作为唯一实验变量，我发现那些在胎儿期和早期 postnatal 时期暴露于二战破坏中的个体，其体重指数较高，成年后肥胖的可能性也更大。我还发现，这些战时儿童在成年后患有中风、高血压、糖尿病和心血管疾病等慢性健康状况的发生率也较高。

abstract.text: This study investigates the impact of and behavioral responses to cost sharing in Korea's National Cancer Screening Program, which provides free stomach and breast cancer screenings to those with an income below a certain cutoff. Free cancer screening substantially increases the screening take up rate, yielding more cancer detections. However, the increase in cancer detection is quickly crowded out by cancer detection through other channels such as diagnostic testing and private cancer screening. Further, compliers are much less likely to have cancer than never takers. Crowd-out and selection help explain why the program has been unable to reduce cancer mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.02.006.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了韩国国家癌症筛查计划中成本分担政策的影响及其对行为反应的影响。该计划为收入低于一定门槛的人群提供免费的胃癌和乳腺癌筛查服务。免费癌症筛查显著提高了筛查参与率，从而增加了癌症的发现数量。然而，通过其他渠道如诊断测试和私人癌症筛查发现的癌症数量迅速超过了免费筛查带来的癌症发现数量。此外，参与筛查的人患癌症的可能性远低于从未参与筛查的人。这种拥挤效应和选择性效应有助于解释为何该计划未能降低癌症死亡率。

abstract.text: Evidence on insurers' behavior in environments with both risk selection and market power is largely missing. We fill this gap by providing one of the first empirical accounts of how insurers adjust plan features when faced with potential changes in selection. Our strategy exploits a 2012 reform allowing Medicare enrollees to switch to 5-star contracts at anytime. This policy increased enrollment into 5-star contracts, but without risk selection worsening. Our findings show that this is due to 5-star plans lowering both premiums and generosity, thus becoming more appealing for most beneficiaries, but less so for those in worse health conditions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.02.007.abstractZh: 关于在风险选择和市场力量并存的环境中，保险公司行为的证据仍然非常缺乏。我们通过提供首个关于保险公司如何在面临选择变化时调整计划特征的实证分析来填补这一空白。我们的研究利用了2012年的一项改革，该改革允许医疗保险参保人在任何时候转换为5星级合同。这一政策增加了5星级合同的注册量，但并未导致风险选择的恶化。我们的研究发现表明，这是因为5星级计划降低了保费和福利水平，因此对于大多数受益人来说更具吸引力，但对于健康状况较差的受益人来说则不然。

abstract.text: The aim of this article is to estimate the type of selection that exists in the supplemental health insurance market in Colombia where compulsory coverage is implemented through managed care competition. We build a panel database that combines individuals' information from the Ministry of Health and a database provided by two private health insurers. We perform the correlation test for consumption of health services frequency and supplemental coverage. Following Fang et al. (2008), we condition the estimation on health controls that are available to the econometrician but not to insurers. In both cases we obtain a positive correlation, suggesting that adverse selection predominates. In order to rule out some moral hazard effects, we estimate the correlation between previous frequency of healthcare service consumption and supplemental insurance purchase. The positive correlation obtained is robust to the inclusion of controls for diagnosis implemented by health insurers, suggesting that despite some risk selection strategies, they are not protected from adverse selection. We conclude that some subsidies to supplemental coverage purchase would lower public expenditure in Colombia.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.02.008.abstractZh: 本文旨在评估哥伦比亚补充健康保险市场中存在的选择类型，该市场通过管理式医疗竞争实施强制性保险覆盖。我们构建了一个面板数据库，结合了卫生部提供的个人信息以及两家私人健康保险公司提供的数据库。我们进行了健康服务消费频率与补充保险覆盖之间的相关性测试。根据Fang等人（2008年）的研究方法，我们将估计结果条件化于可供计量经济学家使用但不可供保险公司使用的健康控制变量。在两种情况下，我们都发现了正相关关系，这表明逆向选择现象较为普遍。为了排除某些道德风险效应，我们进一步估计了以往健康服务消费频率与补充保险购买之间的相关性。所得到的正相关关系在纳入健康保险公司实施的诊断控制变量后仍然保持，这表明尽管存在一些风险选择策略，但这些策略并未能免受逆向选择的冲击。我们得出结论，对补充保险购买提供一些补贴可以降低哥伦比亚的公共支出。

abstract.text: Many competitive health insurance markets adjust payments to participating health plans according to their enrollees' risk - including based on diagnostic information. We investigate responses of German health plans to the introduction of morbidity-based risk adjustment in the Statutory Health Insurance in 2009, which triggers payments based on "validated" diagnoses by providers. Using the regulator's data from office-based physicians, we estimate a difference-in-difference analysis of the change in the share and number of validated diagnoses for ICD codes that are inside or outside the risk adjustment but are otherwise similar. We find a differential increase in the share of validated diagnoses of 2.6 and 3.6 percentage points (3-4%) between 2008 and 2013. This increase appears to originate from both a shift from not-validated toward validated diagnoses and an increase in the number of such diagnoses. Overall, our results indicate that plans were successful in influencing physicians' coding practices in a way that could lead to higher payments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.001.abstractZh: 许多竞争性的健康保险市场会根据参与健康计划的参保人的风险来调整支付金额，这包括基于诊断信息的风险调整。我们研究了德国健康计划在2009年引入基于发病率的风险调整政策后的反应，该政策使得支付金额基于医疗服务提供者提供的“验证”诊断结果。利用监管机构从诊所医生那里获取的数据，我们通过差异分析估计了处于风险调整范围内外但其他方面相似的ICD编码的验证诊断比例和数量的变化。研究发现，从2008年到2013年，验证诊断的比例分别增加了2.6个百分点和3.6个百分点（3-4%）。这种增长似乎既源于从未验证诊断转向验证诊断，也源于此类诊断数量的增加。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，这些健康计划成功地影响了医生的编码实践，从而可能导致更高的支付金额。

abstract.text: This study uses a unique dataset linking the birth records of two generations of children born in California and Florida (1970-2009) to analyze the mechanisms behind the generational decline observed in birth outcomes of children of Mexican origin. Calibrating a simple model of intergenerational transmission of birth weight, I show that modest positive selection on health at the time of migration can account for the initial advantage in birth outcomes of second-generation Mexicans. Moreover, accounting for the socioeconomic differences between second-generation Mexicans and white natives and the observed intergenerational correlation in birth weight, the model predicts a greater deterioration than that observed in the data. Using a subset of siblings and holding constant grandmother quasi-fixed effects, I show that the persistence of healthier behaviors among second-generation Mexican mothers can explain more than half of the difference between the model prediction and the observed birth outcomes of third-generation Mexicans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.002.abstractZh: 本研究使用了一个独特的数据集，该数据集将加利福尼亚和佛罗里达州出生的两代儿童的出生记录进行了关联，以分析墨西哥裔儿童出生结果中观察到的代际下降现象背后的机制。通过校准一个简单的代际出生体重传递模型，我发现，在迁移时对健康进行适度的正向选择可以解释第二代墨西哥裔在出生结果上的初始优势。此外，考虑到第二代墨西哥裔与白人原住民之间的社会经济差异，以及观察到的出生体重的代际相关性，该模型预测的下降幅度比实际数据观察到的更为严重。通过选取一部分兄弟姐妹作为样本，并保持不变的祖母准固定效应，我发现，第二代墨西哥裔母亲所保持的健康行为可以解释模型预测结果与第三代墨西哥裔实际出生结果之间差异的半数以上部分。

abstract.text: Many states have banned electronic cigarette sales to minors under the rationale that using e-cigarettes leads to smoking traditional combustion cigarettes. Such sales bans would be counterproductive, however, if e-cigarettes and traditional cigarettes are substitutes, as bans might push teenagers back to smoking the more dangerous combustion cigarettes. We provide evidence that these sales bans reduce the incidence of smoking conventional cigarettes among high school seniors. Moreover, we provide evidence suggesting that sales bans reduced e-cigarette usage as well. This evidence suggests that not only are e-cigarettes and smoking regular cigarettes positively related and not substitutes for young people, banning retail sales to minors is an effective policy tool in reducing tobacco use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.003.abstractZh: 许多州已经禁止向未成年人销售电子香烟，其理由是使用电子香烟会导致青少年转而使用传统燃烧型香烟。然而，如果电子香烟和传统香烟是替代品，那么这种销售禁令反而会产生反效果，因为禁令可能会促使青少年重新选择更危险的燃烧型香烟。我们提供了证据，表明这些销售禁令能够降低高中毕业生使用传统香烟的比例。此外，我们还发现，销售禁令也减少了电子香烟的使用。这些证据表明，电子香烟与传统香烟之间不仅存在正相关关系，而且不是替代品。因此，禁止向未成年人零售销售电子香烟是减少烟草使用的一种有效政策手段。

abstract.text: In 23 states and Washington D.C., alcohol retailers are required by law to post alcohol warning signs (AWS) that warn against the risks of drinking during pregnancy. Using the variation in the adoption of these laws across states and within states over time, I find a statistically significant reduction in prenatal alcohol use associated with AWS. I then use this plausibly exogenous change in drinking behavior to establish a causal link between prenatal alcohol exposure and birth outcomes. I find that AWS laws are associated with decreases in the odds of very low birth weight and very pre-term birth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.004.abstractZh: 在23个州和华盛顿特区，酒精零售商依法必须张贴酒精警告标志，以提醒人们怀孕期间饮酒的风险。通过研究这些法律在不同州以及各州内部随时间的变化情况，我发现张贴酒精警告标志显著减少了孕妇饮酒的行为。我利用这一看似由外部因素引起的饮酒行为变化，建立了孕期酒精暴露与出生结果之间的因果关系。研究发现，张贴酒精警告标志与极低出生体重和早产的发生率降低有关。

abstract.text: There is widespread agreement that the US healthcare system wastes as much as 5% of GDP, yet much less agreement on the source of the waste. This paper uses the effectively random assignment of patients to ambulance companies to generate comparisons across similar patients treated at different hospitals. We find that assignment to hospitals whose patients receive large amounts of care over the three months following a health emergency have only modestly better survival outcomes compared to hospitals whose patients receive less. Outcomes are related to different forms of spending. Patients assigned to hospitals with high levels of inpatient spending are more likely to survive to one year, while high levels of outpatient spending result in lower survival. In particular, we discovered that downstream spending at skilled nursing facilities (SNF) is a strong predictor of mortality. Our results highlight SNF admissions as a quality measure to complement the commonly used measure of hospital readmissions and suggest that in the search for waste in the US healthcare, post-acute SNF care is a prime candidate.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.005.abstractZh: 普遍认为，美国的医疗系统浪费了高达5%的GDP，但关于浪费的来源却存在较大分歧。本文通过对患者进行随机分配到不同救护车公司的实验，来比较在不同医院接受治疗的相似患者的情况。研究发现，在健康突发事件发生后的三个月内，被分配到那些患者接受大量护理的医院的患者，其生存结果仅略优于那些患者接受较少护理的医院。这些结果与不同类型的支出有关：被分配到住院支出较高的医院的患者，其存活至一年的可能性更高；而门诊支出较高的医院则会导致较低的存活率。特别是，我们发现，在专业护理机构进行的后续支出是预测死亡率的一个重要指标。我们的研究结果强调了护理机构的入院情况作为衡量医疗系统效率的指标的重要性，并提示在寻找美国医疗系统中的浪费问题时，急性病后护理机构的后续服务是一个重要的候选对象。

abstract.text: In many medical care markets with limited profit potential, firms often have little incentive to innovate. These include the market for rare diseases, "neglected" tropical diseases, and personalized medicine. Governments and not-for-profit organizations promote innovation in such markets but empirical evidence on the policy effect is limited. We study this issue by analyzing the impact of a demand-side policy in Japan, which reduces the cost sharing of patients with some rare and intractable diseases and attempts to establish and promote the treatment of those diseases. Using clinical trials data taken from public registries, we identify the effect of the policy using a difference-in-difference approach. We find that the demand-side policy increased firms' incentive to innovate: firm-sponsored clinical trials increased 181% (0.16 per disease per year) when covered by the policy. This result indicates that the demand-side policy can be an important part of innovation policies in markets with limited profit potential.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.006.abstractZh: 在许多利润潜力有限的医疗领域，企业往往缺乏创新的动力。这些领域包括罕见病市场、“被忽视”的热带病市场以及个性化医疗领域。政府和非营利组织在这些市场中推动创新，但关于政策效果的实证证据有限。我们通过分析日本一项需求侧政策的影响来研究这个问题。该政策降低了一些罕见且难治性疾病患者的费用分担比例，并试图建立和促进这些疾病的治疗。利用来自公共登记系统的临床试验数据，我们使用差异分解方法来确定该政策的效果。研究发现，需求侧政策增加了企业创新的动力：当政策覆盖时，企业赞助的临床试验数量增加了181%（每年每疾病0.16次）。这一结果表明，需求侧政策可以成为利润潜力有限的医疗领域创新政策的重要组成部分。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the short- and longer-term effects of retirement on mental health in ten European countries. It exploits thresholds created by state pension ages in an individual-fixed effects instrumental-variable set-up, borrowing intuitions from the regression-discontinuity design literature, to deal with endogeneity in retirement behaviour. The results display no short-term effects of retirement on mental health, but a large negative longer-term impact. This impact survives a battery of robustness tests, and applies to women and men as well as people of different educational and occupational backgrounds similarly. Overall, the findings suggest that reforms inducing people to postpone retirement are not only important for making pension systems solvent, but with time could also pay a mental health dividend among the elderly and reduce public health care costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.007.abstractZh: 本文分析了退休对十个欧洲国家民众心理健康产生的短期和长期影响。研究采用个体固定效应工具变量设置，利用国家养老金退休年龄设定的阈值，并借鉴回归不连续设计文献中的思路，来处理退休行为的内生性问题。研究结果表明，退休对心理健康没有短期影响，但存在显著的长期负面影响。这一影响在一系列稳健性测试中得到了验证，并且无论性别、教育背景或职业背景如何，这种影响都存在。总体而言，研究认为，促使人们推迟退休的改革不仅有助于确保养老金系统的可持续性，而且随着时间的推移，还能为老年人带来心理健康上的益处，并降低公共医疗保健成本。

abstract.text: Worldwide, the leading causes of death could be avoided with health behaviors that are low-cost but also difficult to adopt. We show that exogenous health shocks could facilitate the adoption of these behaviors and provide long-lasting effects on health outcomes. Specifically, we exploit the spatial and temporal variation of the 2009 H1N1 influenza pandemic in Mexico and show that areas with a higher incidence of H1N1 experienced larger reductions in diarrhea-related cases among young children. These reductions continue even three years after the shock ended. Health improvements and evidence of information seeking via Google searches were consistent with changes in hand washing behaviors. Several robustness checks validate our findings and mechanism.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.008.abstractZh: 在全球范围内，一些主要的死亡原因可以通过低成本且易于采纳的健康行为来避免。我们发现，外部健康冲击可以促进这些行为的采纳，并对健康结果产生长期影响。具体来说，我们利用了2009年墨西哥H1N1流感大流行的空间和时间变化，发现H1N1发病率较高的地区，幼儿腹泻病例的减少幅度更大。这些减少效果在冲击结束后的三年内仍然持续。健康状况的改善以及通过谷歌搜索进行信息寻求的行为，与洗手行为的改变相一致。多项稳健性检验验证了我们的发现和机制。

abstract.text: To equalize differences in health plan premiums due to differences in risk pools, the German legislature introduced a simple Risk Adjustment Scheme (RAS) based on age, gender and disability status in 1994. In addition, effective 1996, consumers gained the freedom to choose among hundreds of existing health plans, across employers and state-borders. This paper (a) estimates RAS pass-through rates on premiums, financial reserves, and expenditures and assesses the overall RAS impact on market price dispersion. Moreover, it (b) characterizes health plan switchers and investigates their annual and cumulative switching rates over time. Our main findings are based on representative enrollee panel data linked to administrative RAS and health plan data. We show that sickness funds with bad risk pools and high pre-RAS premiums lowered their total premiums by 42 cents per additional euro allocated by the RAS. Consequently, post-RAS, health plan prices converged but not fully. Because switchers are more likely to be white collar, young and healthy, the new consumer choice resulted in more risk segregation and the amount of money redistributed by the RAS increased over time.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.03.009.abstractZh: 为了平衡因风险池差异导致的健康计划保费差异，德国立法机构在1994年引入了一项基于年龄、性别和残疾状况的简单风险调整方案。此外，自1996年起，消费者可以在跨越雇主和州界的数百种现有健康计划中进行选择。本文（a）估算了风险调整方案对保费、财务储备和支出的传递率，并评估了该方案对市场价格分散性的整体影响。此外，本文（b）对健康计划转换者进行了特征分析，并研究了他们随时间的年度和累积转换率。我们的主要研究结果基于与行政风险调整方案和健康计划数据相关的代表性注册者面板数据。我们发现，风险池较差且RAS实施前保费较高的疾病基金，其总保费每增加一欧元，就降低了42美分。因此，RAS实施后，健康计划价格趋于一致，但并未完全实现。由于转换者更可能是白领、年轻且健康的人群，新的消费者选择导致了更多的风险隔离，而RAS随着时间的推移重新分配的资金金额也有所增加。

abstract.text: Many people object to the creation of a market for kidneys on the grounds that such reform would hurt those patients unable to afford the market price of a kidney and that donors do not understand the risks they are taking when donating. In this paper, we propose a mechanism, the kidney co-operative, designed to provide sufficient incentives to alleviate the kidney shortage while at the same time addressing the concerns regarding the potential losers from reform. We show that it is reasonable to expect that the number of transplants will be larger under the kidney co-operative mechanism than under either the status quo or a conventional market mechanism.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.04.001.abstractZh: 许多人反对建立肾脏市场的改革，因为他们认为这种改革会伤害那些无法支付市场价格的患者，同时捐赠者也不了解他们捐赠时所承担的风险。在本文中，我们提出了一种机制——肾脏合作机制，旨在提供足够的激励措施来缓解肾脏短缺问题，同时解决人们对改革可能带来的损失者的担忧。我们表明，在肾脏合作机制下，移植手术的数量预计会比现状或传统市场机制下更多。

abstract.text: In developed countries, women are expected to live about 4-5 years longer than men. In this paper, we develop a novel approach to gauge the extent to which gender differences in longevity can be attributed to gender-specific preferences and health behavior. We set up a physiologically founded model of health deficit accumulation and calibrate it using recent insights from gerontology. From fitting life cycle health expenditure and life expectancy, we obtain estimates of the gender-specific preference parameters. We then perform the counterfactual experiment of endowing women with the preferences of men. In our benchmark scenario, this reduces the gender gap in life expectancy from 4.6 to 1.4 years. When we add gender-specific preferences for unhealthy consumption, the model can motivate up to 89 percent of the gender gap. Our theory offers also an economic explanation for why the gender gap declines with rising income.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.04.002.abstractZh: 在发达国家，女性的寿命预计比男性长4-5年。本文提出了一种新颖的方法，用于评估性别差异在寿命上的影响是否可归因于性别特定的偏好和健康行为。我们建立了一个基于生理学的健康赤字累积模型，并利用老年学的最新研究成果对其进行校准。通过拟合生命周期中的健康支出和预期寿命数据，我们获得了性别特定偏好参数的估计值。随后，我们进行了反事实实验，假设女性拥有男性的偏好。在我们的基准情景中，这种假设将性别差异导致的寿命差距从4.6年缩小到1.4年。当我们将性别特定的不健康消费偏好纳入模型时，模型能够解释高达89%的性别差异。我们的理论还为为什么性别差异会随着收入的增加而缩小提供了经济上的解释。

abstract.text: Gasoline content regulations are designed to curb pollution and improve health, but their impact on health has not been quantified. By exploiting both the timing of regulation and spatial variation in children's exposure to highways, I estimate the effect of gasoline content regulation on pollution and child health. The introduction of cleaner-burning gasoline in California in 1996 reduced asthma admissions by 8% in high exposure areas. Reductions are greatest for areas downwind from highways and heavy traffic areas. Stringent gasoline content regulations can improve child health, and may diminish existing health disparities.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.04.003.abstractZh: 汽油含量规定旨在减少污染并改善健康，但其对健康的影响尚未得到量化。通过利用规定的实施时机以及儿童接触高速公路的时空差异，我估算了汽油含量规定对污染和儿童健康的影响。1996年加州引入更清洁燃烧的汽油后，高暴露地区的哮喘患者就诊率下降了8%。减少幅度最大的地区是高速公路下风向和交通繁忙区域。严格的汽油含量规定可以改善儿童健康，并可能缩小现有的健康差异。

abstract.text: I develop a model of insurer price-setting and consumer welfare under risk-adjustment, a policy commonly used to combat inefficient sorting due to adverse selection in health insurance markets. I use the model to illustrate graphically that risk-adjustment causes health plan prices to be based on costs not predicted by the risk-adjustment model ("residual costs") rather than total costs, either weakening or exacerbating selection problems depending on the correlation between demand and costs predicted by the risk-adjustment model. I then use a structural model to estimate the welfare consequences of risk-adjustment, finding a welfare gain of over $600 per person-year.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.04.004.abstractZh: 我开发了一个关于保险定价和消费者福利的模型，该模型基于风险调整机制，这种策略常被用于解决健康保险市场中因逆向选择导致的效率低下问题。通过模型分析，我发现风险调整机制使得健康计划的价格基于风险调整模型无法预测的“剩余成本”，而非总成本。这一机制可能会削弱或加剧选择问题，具体取决于需求与风险调整模型预测的成本之间的相关性。随后，我使用结构模型来估算风险调整机制的福利影响，结果发现，每人的年福利收益超过600美元。

abstract.text: This paper exploits variations in aerial spraying across time and space in Colombia and employs a panel of individual health records in order to study the causal effects of the aerial spraying of herbicides (glyphosate) on short-term health-related outcomes. Our results show that exposure to the herbicide used in aerial spraying campaigns increases the number of medical consultations related to dermatological and respiratory illnesses, as well as the number of miscarriages. These findings are robust to the inclusion of individual fixed effects, which compare the prevalence of these medical conditions for the same person under different levels of exposure to the herbicide used in the aerial spraying program over a period of 5 years. Also, our results are robust to controlling for the extent of illicit coca cultivation in the municipality of residence.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.04.005.abstractZh: 本文研究了哥伦比亚不同时间和空间范围内空中喷洒活动的差异，并利用个体健康记录数据来研究除草剂（草甘膦）空中喷洒对短期健康相关结果的因果效应。研究结果表明，接触空中喷洒活动中使用的除草剂会增加与皮肤病和呼吸系统疾病相关的医疗咨询次数，以及流产的发生率。这些发现在纳入个体固定效应后依然保持稳定，这些固定效应比较了同一人在5年时间内不同暴露水平下这些疾病的发生率。此外，研究结果在控制居住地区非法种植古柯植物的程度后依然具有稳定性。

abstract.text: In 2012, Kentucky implemented Medicaid managed care statewide, auto-assigned enrollees to three plans, and allowed switching. Using administrative data, we find that the state's auto-assignment algorithm most heavily weighted cost-minimization and plan balancing, and placed little weight on the quality of the enrollee-plan match. Immobility - apparently driven by health plan inertia - contributed to the success of the cost-minimization strategy, as more than half of enrollees auto-assigned to even the lowest quality plans did not opt-out. High-cost enrollees were more likely to opt-out of their auto-assigned plan, creating adverse selection. The plan with arguably the highest quality incurred the largest initial profit margin reduction due to adverse selection prior to risk adjustment, as it attracted a disproportionate share of high-cost enrollees. The presence of such selection, caused by differential degrees of mobility, raises concerns about the long run viability of the Medicaid managed care market without such risk adjustment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.04.006.abstractZh: 2012年，肯塔基州在全州范围内实施了医疗补助管理式护理制度，将参保者自动分配到三个计划，并允许更换计划。通过行政数据分析，我们发现该州的自动分配算法主要侧重于成本最小化和计划平衡，而对参保者-计划匹配的质量重视程度较低。参保者的固定性——显然是由健康计划的惯性所驱动——有助于成本最小化策略的成功，因为超过一半的参保者即使被分配到最低质量的计划，也没有选择退出。高成本的参保者更有可能选择退出自动分配的计划，从而导致逆向选择现象。可以说，质量最高的计划在风险调整之前，由于逆向选择的影响，其初始利润空间缩减最大，因为它吸引了大量高成本的参保者。这种因参保者流动性差异而产生的逆向选择现象，引发了人们对没有这种风险调整的情况下，医疗补助管理式护理市场长期可行性的担忧。

abstract.text: The relationship between health and work is frequently investigated using self-assessments of disability from social surveys. The complication is that respondents may overstate their level of disability to justify non-employment and welfare receipt. This study provides new evidence on the existence and magnitude of justification bias by exploiting a novel feature of a large longitudinal survey: each wave respondents are asked identical disability questions twice; near the beginning and end of the face-to-face interview. Prior to answering the second disability question, respondents are asked a series of questions that increase the salience of their employment and welfare circumstances. Justification bias is identified by comparing the variation between the two measures within-individuals over time, with the variation in employment status over time. Results indicate substantial and statistically significant justification bias; especially for men and women who receive disability pensions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.05.001.abstractZh: 关于健康与工作之间的关系，通常通过社会调查中的自我残疾评估来研究。问题在于，受访者可能会夸大自己的残疾程度，以作为不就业和领取福利的借口。本研究通过利用一项大型纵向调查的新特征，提供了关于这种借口偏差存在及其程度的新证据：在面对面访谈的开始和结束时，受访者会两次被问到相同的残疾问题。在回答第二个残疾问题之前，受访者会接受一系列问题，这些问题会增加他们对就业和福利状况的关注度。通过比较个体在一段时间内两次测量值之间的差异，以及就业状况随时间的变化，可以识别出借口偏差。研究结果表明，存在显著且统计上显著的借口偏差；尤其是在领取残疾养老金的男性和女性中。

abstract.text: In recent years, English local authorities have been forced to make significant cuts to devolved expenditure. In this paper, we examine the impact of reductions in local expenditure on one particular public health target: reducing rates of teen pregnancy. Contrary to predictions made at the time of the cuts, panel data estimates provide no evidence that areas which reduced expenditure the most have experienced relative increases in teenage pregnancy rates. Rather, expenditure cuts are associated with small reductions in teen pregnancy rates, a result which is robust to a number of alternative specifications and tests for causality. Underlying socio-economic factors such as education outcomes and alcohol consumption are found to be significant predictors of teen pregnancy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.05.002.abstractZh: 近年来，英国的地方政府被迫大幅削减下放的支出。本文探讨了地方支出削减对某个特定公共卫生目标的影响：降低青少年怀孕率。与削减时的预测相反，面板数据估计结果显示，那些削减支出最多的地区并没有出现青少年怀孕率相对上升的情况。相反，支出削减与青少年怀孕率的轻微下降有关，这一结果在多种替代模型分析和因果关系检验中均得到了验证。教育成果和酒精消费等社会经济因素是青少年怀孕的重要预测因素。

abstract.text: We study a model of reputational concerns when doctors differ in their degree of altruism and they can signal their altruism by their (observable) quality. When reputational concerns are high, following the introduction or enhancement of public reporting, the less altruistic (bad) doctor mimics the more altruistic (good) doctor. Otherwise, either a separating or a semi-separating equilibrium arises: the bad doctor mimics the good doctor with probability less than one. Pay-for-performance incentive schemes are unlikely to induce crowding out, unless some dimensions of quality are unobservable. Under the pooling equilibrium a purchaser can implement the first-best quality by appropriately choosing a simple payment scheme with a fixed price per unit of quality provided. This is not the case under the separating equilibrium. Therefore, policies that enhance public reporting complement pay-for-performance schemes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.05.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个关于医生在利他主义程度上存在差异时的声誉问题模型。医生可以通过其（可观察到的）品质来表明自己的利他主义行为。当声誉问题较为严重时，随着公共报告制度的引入或加强，那些不太利他主义的医生会模仿那些更利他主义的医生。否则，就会出现分离均衡或半分离均衡：不太利他主义的医生模仿利他主义医生的几率小于一。除非某些品质维度是不可观察的，否则基于绩效的激励方案不太可能导致其他医生的退出。在合并均衡下，购买者可以通过选择合适的简单支付方案来实现最优品质，即按单位品质支付固定价格。但在分离均衡下，情况并非如此。因此，加强公共报告制度的政策可以补充基于绩效的激励方案。

abstract.text: Adverse selection in health insurance markets leads to two types of inefficiency. On the demand side, adverse selection leads to plan price distortions resulting in inefficient sorting of consumers across health plans. On the supply side, adverse selection creates incentives for plans to inefficiently distort benefits to attract profitable enrollees. Reinsurance, risk adjustment, and premium categories address these problems. Building on prior research on health plan payment system evaluation, we develop measures of the efficiency consequences of price and benefit distortions under a given payment system. Our measures are based on explicit economic models of insurer behavior under adverse selection, incorporate multiple features of plan payment systems, and can be calculated prior to observing actual insurer and consumer behavior. We illustrate the use of these measures with data from a simulated market for individual health insurance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.05.004.abstractZh: 健康保险市场中的逆向选择会导致两种类型的效率低下。在需求方面，逆向选择导致计划价格扭曲，从而使得消费者在健康计划之间的选择变得低效。在供应方面，逆向选择促使计划通过不恰当地扭曲福利来吸引盈利的参保者。再保险、风险调整以及保费类别可以解决这些问题。基于之前关于健康计划支付系统评估的研究，我们开发了衡量在给定支付系统下价格和福利扭曲所带来的效率后果的指标。这些指标基于在逆向选择情况下保险公司的明确经济模型，包含了计划支付系统的多个特征，并且可以在观察实际的保险公司和消费者行为之前进行计算。我们通过一个模拟个人健康保险市场的数据来说明这些指标的使用方法。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of social health insurance on financial risk by utilizing data from a natural experiment created by the phased roll-out of a social health insurance program for the poor in India. We estimate the distributional impact of insurance on of out-of-pocket costs and incorporate these results with a stylized expected utility model to compute associated welfare effects. We adjust the standard model, accounting for conditions of developing countries by incorporating consumption floors, informal borrowing, and asset selling which allow us to separate the value of financial risk reduction from consumption smoothing and asset protection. Results show that insurance reduces out-of-pocket costs, particularly in higher quantiles of the distribution. We find reductions in the frequency and amount of money borrowed for health reasons. Finally, we find that the value of financial risk reduction outweighs total per household costs of the insurance program by two to five times.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.002.abstractZh: 本文利用印度为贫困人口逐步实施的社会医疗保险计划所创造的自然实验数据，估算了社会医疗保险对财务风险的影响。我们评估了保险对自付费用的分布性影响，并将这些结果与一种简化的期望效用模型相结合，以计算相关的福利效应。我们通过调整标准模型，考虑到发展中国家的实际情况，纳入了消费底线、非正式借贷和资产出售等因素，从而将财务风险降低的价值与消费平滑和资产保护区分开来。研究结果显示，保险能够降低自付费用，尤其是在收入分配较高的群体。我们发现，因健康原因借款的频率和金额都有所减少。最后，我们发现财务风险降低的价值是保险计划总家庭成本的两到五倍。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of advertising on demand for vitamins-products with spiraling sales despite little evidence of efficacy. We merge seven years (2003-2009) of advertising data from Kantar Media with the Simmons National Consumer Survey to estimate individual-level vitamin print and television ad exposure effects. Identification relies on exploiting exogenous variation in year-to-year advertising exposure by controlling for each individual's unique media consumption. We find that increasing advertising exposure from zero to the mean number of ads increases the probability of consumption by 1.2 and 0.8% points (or 2 and 1.4%) in print and television respectively. Stratifications by the presence of health conditions suggests that in print demand is being driven by both healthy and sick individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.003.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了广告对维生素产品需求的影响，尽管几乎没有证据表明这些产品的有效性，但其销量却呈螺旋式上升。我们结合了Kantar Media在7年（2003-2009年）内的广告数据以及Simmons全国消费者调查的数据，以估算个人层面维生素产品通过印刷媒体和电视广告的曝光率。通过控制每个个体独特的媒体消费行为，我们得以利用年度间广告曝光的外部差异来进行分析。研究发现，广告曝光量从零增加到平均水平时，维生素产品的消费概率分别增加了1.2%和0.8%（即2%和1.4%）。根据健康状况的区分，我们发现印刷媒体的广告对健康人群和患病人群的需求都有影响。

abstract.text: This study examines how regulations in private health insurance markets affect coverage of public insurance. We focus on mental health parity laws, which mandate private health insurance to provide equal coverage for mental and physical health services. The implementation of mental health parity laws may improve a quality dimension of private health insurance but at increased costs. We graphically develop a conceptual framework and then empirically examine whether the regulations shift individuals from private to public insurance. We exploit state-by-year variation in policy implementation in 1999-2008 and focus on a sample of veterans, who have better access to public insurance than non-veterans. Using data from the Current Population Survey, we find that the parity laws reduce employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) coverage by 2.1% points. The drop in ESI is largely offset by enrollment gains in public insurance, namely through the Veterans Affairs (VA) benefit and Medicaid/Medicare programs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.006.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了私人健康保险市场的监管措施如何影响公共保险的覆盖范围。我们重点关注心理健康平等法，该法律要求私人健康保险为心理健康和身体健康服务提供同等覆盖。实施心理健康平等法可能会提升私人健康保险的质量，但成本也会相应增加。我们通过图表形式构建了一个概念框架，并实证分析这些监管措施是否会使人们从私人保险转向公共保险。我们利用了1999年至2008年间各州政策实施情况的差异，并重点关注退伍军人这一群体，因为与普通人相比，他们更容易获得公共保险。根据当前人口调查的数据，我们发现心理健康平等法导致雇主赞助保险覆盖率下降了2.1个百分点。这一下降被公共保险的参保增加所部分抵消，尤其是通过退伍军人事务部福利和医疗补助/医疗保险计划实现的参保增加。

abstract.text: The use of risk-adjustment formulae in setting payments to Medicare Advantage (MA) plans reduces the potential for advantageous selection on factors included in the formulae, but can theoretically worsen overall selection if plans are able to target beneficiaries based on excluded factors. Since MA medical risk-adjustment excludes prescription drug utilization, demand for drugs can be exploited by plans to induce advantageous selection. We show evidence that the introduction of Medicare Part D provided a mechanism for MA plans to increase selection, and that consumers responded, increasing MA market shares among beneficiaries taking drugs associated with the strongest advantageous selection incentives. For the average Medicare beneficiary in our sample, we estimate that this change in advantageous selection following the introduction of Medicare Part D increased the probability of enrolling in an MA plan by about 7.1%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.007.abstractZh: 在设定Medicare Advantage计划的支付时，使用风险调整公式会减少在公式中包含的因素上做出有利选择的可能性，但如果计划能够根据被排除的因素来定位受益人，则理论上可能会恶化整体选择效果。由于Medicare Advantage的医疗风险调整排除了处方药的使用情况，因此计划可以利用这一情况来诱导有利选择。我们的研究表明，Medicare Part D的引入为Medicare Advantage计划提供了增加选择机制的途径，消费者对此做出了反应，使得与最有利选择激励相关的药物在受益人中占据了更大的市场份额。对于我们样本中的平均Medicare受益人来说，估计Medicare Part D的引入后，有利选择的变化使他们加入Medicare Advantage计划的概率增加了约7.1%。

abstract.text: "Consumer-Directed" Health Plans (CDHPs), those with high deductibles and personal medical accounts, have been shown to reduce health care spending. The impact of CDHPs on preventive care is unclear. On the one hand CDHPs might increase use of preventive care as such care is exempt from the deductible. However, CDHPs also decrease visits to physicians which might results in less screening. Prior research has found conflicting results. In this study, using data from 37 employers we examine the effects of CDHPs on the use of cancer screenings up to three years after the initial CDHP offering with ITT and LATE approaches. Being offered a CDHP or enrolling in a CDHP had little or no effect on cancer screening rates but individuals increase screenings prior to enrolling in a CDHP. Our findings suggest the importance of examining CDHP effects on periodic care over the longer-term and carefully controlling for anticipatory stockpiling.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.008.abstractZh: “消费者主导”健康计划（CDHPs），那些具有较高免赔额和个人医疗账户的计划，已被证明能够减少医疗支出。CDHPs对预防性护理的影响尚不清楚。一方面，CDHPs可能会增加预防性护理的使用，因为这类护理不受免赔额限制。然而，CDHPs也会减少患者就诊次数，这可能导致筛查次数减少。先前的研究结果存在矛盾。本研究利用37家雇主的数据，通过ITT和LATE方法，考察了CDHPs在最初提供后长达三年内对癌症筛查使用的影响。被提供CDHP或加入CDHP对癌症筛查率几乎没有影响，但在加入CDHP之前，个体会增加筛查次数。我们的研究结果表明，需要长期考察CDHP对定期护理的影响，并仔细控制预期储备效应。

abstract.text: We investigate the effects on health care costs and utilization of team-based primary care delivery: Quebec's Family Medicine Groups (FMGs). FMGs include extended hours, patient enrolment and multidisciplinary teams, but they maintain the same remuneration scheme (fee-for-service) as outside FMGs. In contrast to previous studies, we examine the impacts of organizational changes in primary care settings in the absence of changes to provider payment and outside integrated care systems. We built a panel of administrative data of the population of elderly and chronically ill patients, characterizing all individuals as FMG enrollees or not. Participation in FMGs is voluntary and we address potential selection bias by matching on GP propensity scores, using inverse probability of treatment weights at the patient level, and then estimating difference-in-differences models. We also use appropriate modelling strategies to account for the distributions of health care cost and utilization data. We find that FMGs significantly decrease patients' health care services utilization and costs in outpatient settings relative to patients not in FMGs. The number of primary care visits decreased by 11% per patient per year among FMG enrolees and specialist visits declined by 6%. The declines in costs were of roughly equal magnitude. We found no evidence of an effect on hospitalizations, their associated costs, or the costs of ED visits. These results provide support for the idea that primary care organizational reforms can have impacts on the health care system in the absence of changes to physician payment mechanisms. The extent to which the decline in GP visits represents substitution with other primary care providers warrants further investigation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.009.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于团队的初级保健服务对医疗保健成本和使用率的影响：魁北克的家庭医学小组。这些小组提供延长的工作时间、患者登记以及多学科团队服务，但其薪酬制度与外部初级保健小组相同，即按服务收费制。与以往的研究不同，我们研究了初级保健环境中的组织变革对医疗保健成本和使用率的影响，同时未对提供者的支付机制进行任何调整，且未纳入综合护理系统。我们收集了老年和慢性病患者的人口统计数据，将所有个体分为参与或未参与家庭医学小组两类。参与家庭医学小组是自愿的，我们通过匹配全科医生的倾向评分、使用逆概率处理权重，以及估计差异-差异模型，来消除潜在的选择偏差。我们还采用了适当的建模策略来处理医疗保健成本和使用率数据的分布问题。研究发现，与未参与家庭医学小组的患者相比，参与小组的患者在门诊环境中的医疗保健服务使用率和成本显著下降。家庭医学小组成员每年的初级保健就诊次数减少了11%，而专科就诊次数减少了6%。成本下降的幅度大致相同。我们没有发现对住院率、相关成本或急诊就诊成本的影响。这些结果支持了这样一个观点：即使在没有改变医生支付机制的情况下，初级保健组织的改革也能对医疗保健系统产生影响。全科医生就诊次数的减少是否代表了其他初级保健提供者的替代，这一点需要进一步研究。

abstract.text: We examine public policy toward the use of genetic information by insurers. Individuals engage in unobservable primary prevention and have access to different prevention technologies. Thus, insurance markets are affected by moral hazard and adverse selection. Individuals can choose to take a genetic test to acquire information about their prevention technology. Information has positive decision-making value, that is, individuals may adjust their behavior based on the result of the test. However, testing also exposes individuals to uncertainty over the available insurance contract, so-called classification risk, which lowers the value of information. In our analysis we distinguish between four different policy regimes, determine the value of information under each regime and associated equilibrium outcomes on the insurance market. We show that the policy regimes can be Pareto ranked, with a duty to disclose being the preferred regime and an information ban the least preferred one.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.010.abstractZh: 我们研究了保险公司对遗传信息使用的公共政策。个体进行不可观测的初级预防，并能够使用不同的预防技术。因此，保险市场受到道德风险和逆向选择的影响。个体可以选择进行遗传测试以获取有关其预防技术的信息。信息具有积极的决策价值，即个体可以根据测试结果调整自己的行为。然而，测试也会使个体面临保险合同的不确定性，即所谓的分类风险，这会降低信息的价值。在我们的分析中，我们区分了四种不同的政策体制，确定了每种体制下信息的价值以及与之相关的保险市场均衡结果。我们发现，这些政策体制可以按照帕累托排序，其中披露义务是最优体制，而信息禁止则是最不理想的体制。

abstract.text: Why do many firms in the healthcare sector adopt non-profit status? One argument is that non-profit status serves as a signal of quality when consumers are not well informed. A testable implication is that an increase in consumer information may lead to a reduction in the number of non-profits in a market. We test this idea empirically by exploiting an exogenous increase in consumer information in the US nursing home industry. We find that the information shock led to a reduction in the share of non-profit homes, driven by a combination of home closure and sector switching. The lowest quality non-profits were the most likely to exit. Our results have important implications for the effects of reforms to increase consumer provision in a number of public services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.011.abstractZh: 为什么许多医疗保健领域的企业选择非营利组织身份？一种观点认为，在消费者信息不足的情况下，非营利组织身份可以作为一种质量信号。一个可验证的推论是，消费者信息的增加可能会减少市场上的非营利组织数量。我们通过利用美国养老院行业消费者信息的外生增加这一因素来实证验证这一想法。研究发现，信息冲击导致非营利养老院的比例下降，这一变化是由家庭关闭和行业转换共同驱动的。质量最低的非营利组织最有可能退出市场。我们的研究结果对于提高多项公共服务的消费者供给的改革具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Exploiting the Danish roll-out of same-day discharge policies after uncomplicated births, we find that treated newborns have a higher probability of hospital readmission in the first month after birth. While these short-run effects may indicate substitution of hospital stays with readmissions, we also find that-in the longer run-a same-day discharge decreases children's 9th grade GPA. This effect is driven by children and mothers, who prior to the policy change would have been least likely to experience a same-day discharge. Using administrative and survey data to assess potential mechanisms, we show that a same-day discharge impacts those parents' health investments and their children's medium-run health. Our findings point to important negative effects of policies that expand same-day discharge policies to broad populations of mothers and children.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.012.abstractZh: 通过研究丹麦在简单分娩后实施当日出院政策的实施情况，我们发现接受治疗的新生儿在分娩后的第一个月内再次住院的概率更高。虽然这些短期效应可能表明医院住院时间被再次住院所替代，但我们还发现，从长期来看，当日出院会降低儿童在九年级的成绩。这一效应主要受到儿童和母亲的影响，因为在政策改变之前，他们最不可能获得当日出院的机会。通过利用行政数据和调查数据来评估潜在机制，我们发现当日出院会影响这些父母的健康投资以及他们孩子的长期健康。我们的研究结果指出了将当日出院政策扩展到更广泛的母亲和儿童群体所带来的重要负面影响。

abstract.text: EQ-5D is used in cost-effectiveness studies underlying many important health policy decisions. It comprises a survey instrument describing health states across five domains, and a system of utility values for each state. The original 3-level version of EQ-5D is being replaced with a more sensitive 5-level version but the consequences of this change are uncertain. We develop a multi-equation ordinal response model incorporating a copula specification with normal mixture marginals to analyse joint responses to EQ-5D-3L and EQ-5D-5L in a survey of people with rheumatic disease, and use it to generate mappings between the alternative descriptive systems. We revisit a major cost-effectiveness study of drug therapies for rheumatoid arthritis, mapping the original EQ-5D-3L measure onto a 5L valuation basis. Working within a comprehensive, flexible econometric framework, we find that use of simpler restricted specifications can make very large changes to cost-effectiveness estimates with serious implications for decision-making.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.013.abstractZh: EQ-5D被用于许多重要健康政策决策的成本效益研究中。它包含一种调查工具，用于描述五个领域的健康状况，以及为每个状态设定的效用值系统。原始的3级EQ-5D版本正在被更敏感的5级版本所取代，但这一变化的后果尚不确定。我们开发了一个多方程序数响应模型，该模型采用了Copula规范与正态混合边际，以分析风湿性疾病患者对EQ-5D-3L和EQ-5D-5L的联合反应，并用于生成两种描述系统之间的映射关系。我们重新审视了一项关于类风湿性关节炎药物治疗的成本效益研究，将原始的EQ-5D-3L测量值映射到5L估值基础上。在全面且灵活的经济计量学框架内，我们发现使用更简单的限制规范可以对成本效益估计产生巨大影响，这对决策制定具有重大意义。

abstract.text: One of private health insurers' main roles in the United States is to negotiate physician payment rates on their beneficiaries' behalf. We show that these rates are often set in reference to a government benchmark, and ask how often private insurers customize their fee schedules away from this default. We exploit changes in Medicare's payments and dramatic bunching in markups over Medicare's rates to address this question. Although Medicare's rates are influential, 25 percent of physician services in our data, representing 45 percent of covered spending, deviate from the benchmark. Heterogeneity in the pervasiveness and direction of deviations suggests that the private market coordinates around Medicare's pricing for simplicity but abandons it when sufficient value is at stake.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.001.abstractZh: 在美国，私人健康保险公司的主要职责之一就是代表其受益人协商医生收费标准。我们发现，这些收费标准往往参照政府的基准设定，并探讨私人保险公司是否经常调整收费计划以偏离这一基准。为了研究这个问题，我们分析了医疗保险支付方式的变动以及收费标准的显著差异。尽管医疗保险的收费标准具有影响力，但我们的数据表明，有25%的医生服务费用偏离了基准，而这些服务占覆盖支出的45%。不同地区以及不同方向的偏差表明，私人市场为了简单起见，会围绕医疗保险的定价标准进行协调，但在价值受到威胁时则会放弃这一标准。

abstract.text: Publicly funded family planning clinics provide low-cost and free contraception to nearly 1.5 million teens each year. In recent years, several states have considered legislation to defund family planning services, although little is known about how these cuts affect teen pregnancy. This paper fills this knowledge gap by exploiting a policy change in Texas that reduced funding for family planning services by 67% and resulted in over 80 clinic closures. I estimate the effects of the funding cuts on teen health outcomes using a difference-in-differences approach that compares the changes in teen birth rates in Texas counties that lost family planning funding to changes in counties outside of Texas with publicly funded clinics. I find that reducing funding for family planning services in Texas increased teen birth rates by approximately 3.4% over four years with effects concentrated 2-3 years after the initial cuts.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.002.abstractZh: 由公共资金支持的计划生育诊所每年为近150万青少年提供低成本且免费的避孕服务。近年来，一些州考虑通过立法削减计划生育服务的资金，但关于这些削减措施对青少年怀孕的影响知之甚少。本文通过研究德克萨斯州的一项政策变化来填补这一知识空白：该政策将计划生育服务的资金削减了67%，导致超过80家诊所关闭。我采用差异-差异方法，比较了德克萨斯州那些失去计划生育资金县的青少年出生率变化与德克萨斯州以外拥有公共资金诊所的县的变化，以评估资金削减对青少年健康结果的影响。研究发现，德克萨斯州计划生育服务资金削减在四年内使青少年出生率增加了约3.4%，且影响主要集中在削减后的2-3年内。

abstract.text: Higher asthma rates are one of the more obvious ways that health inequalities between African American and other children are manifested beginning in early childhood. In 2010, black asthma rates were double non-black rates. Some but not all of this difference can be explained by factors such as a higher incidence of low birth weight (LBW) among blacks; however, even conditional on LBW, blacks have a higher incidence of asthma than others. Using a unique data set based on the health records of all children born in New Jersey between 2006 and 2010, we show that when we split the data by whether or not children live in a "black" zip code, this racial difference in the incidence of asthma among LBW children entirely disappears. All LBW children in these zip codes, regardless of race, have a higher incidence of asthma. Our results point to the importance of residential segregation and neighborhoods in explaining persistent racial health disparities.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.003.abstractZh: 较高的哮喘发病率是非洲裔美国儿童与其他儿童之间健康不平等在幼儿时期就开始显现的明显表现之一。2010年时，黑人儿童的哮喘发病率是非黑人的两倍。这种差异部分但并非全部可以由一些因素解释，比如黑人儿童中低出生体重的发病率较高；然而，即使考虑到低出生体重的因素，黑人的哮喘发病率仍然高于其他人。我们利用2006至2010年间新泽西州所有儿童的健康记录数据，发现当按照儿童是否居住在“黑人聚居区”来划分数据时，黑人儿童中低出生体重儿童哮喘发病率的种族差异完全消失了。在这些聚居区中，所有低出生体重儿童，无论种族如何，其哮喘发病率都较高。我们的研究结果强调了住宅隔离和社区环境在解释持续存在的种族健康差异方面的重要性。

abstract.text: The demand for healthcare professionals is predicted to grow significantly over the next decade. Securing an adequate workforce is of primary importance to ensure the health and wellbeing of the population in an efficient manner. Occupational licensing laws and related restrictions on scope of practice (SOP) are features of the market for healthcare professionals and are also controversial. At issue is a balance between protecting the public health and removing anticompetitive barriers to entry and practice. In this paper, we examine the case of SOP restrictions for certified nurse midwives (CNMs) and evaluate the effects of changes in states' SOP laws on markets for CNMs and on maternal and infant outcomes. We find that SOP laws are neither helpful nor harmful in regards to health outcomes but states that have no SOP-based barriers have lower rates of induced labor and Cesarean section births. We discuss the implications for state policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.004.abstractZh: 预计未来十年对医疗专业人员的需求将显著增长。确保有足够的劳动力对于有效保障民众的健康和福祉至关重要。职业许可法律以及相关的执业范围限制是医疗专业人员市场的特点，同时也存在争议。问题在于如何在保护公众健康与消除进入和执业方面的反竞争障碍之间找到平衡。本文以认证护士助产士的执业范围限制为例，评估各州执业法律的变化对助产士市场以及母婴健康结果的影响。我们发现，从健康结果来看，执业法律对助产士并无实际帮助或负面影响；而那些没有基于执业限制的州，其引产和剖宫产的发生率较低。我们进一步讨论了这对州政策的影响。

abstract.text: This paper tests the effectiveness of performance pay and bonuses among government childcare workers in India. In a controlled study of 160 ICDS centers serving over 4000 children, we randomly assign workers to either fixed bonuses or payments based on the nutritional status of children in their care, and also collect data from a control group receiving only standard salaries. In all three study arms mothers receive nutrition information. We find that performance pay reduces underweight prevalence by about 5 percentage points over 3 months, and height improves by about one centimeter. Impacts on weight continue when incentives are renewed and return to parallel trends thereafter. Fixed bonuses are less expensive but lead to smaller and less precisely estimated effects than performance pay, especially for children near malnutrition thresholds. Both treatments improve worker effort and communication with mothers, who in turn feed a more calorific diet to children at home.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.005.abstractZh: 本文测试了绩效薪酬和奖金在印度政府儿童保育工作者中的有效性。在一项针对160个ICDS中心的对照研究中，这些中心服务着超过4000名儿童，我们将工作人员随机分配到固定奖金或根据所照顾儿童的营养状况进行支付的组别，同时收集了仅获得标准工资的对照组的数据。在所有三个研究组中，母亲们都获得了营养信息。研究发现，在3个月内，绩效薪酬使体重不足的发生率降低了约5个百分点，身高也增加了约1厘米。当激励措施再次实施时，这些影响仍然持续，并回归到类似的趋势。固定奖金的成本较低，但导致的效果较小且估计精度较低，尤其是在营养不良临界值附近的儿童身上。这两种处理方式都能提高工作者的工作积极性以及与母亲的沟通效果，而母亲们也会在家庭中为儿童提供更高热量的饮食。

abstract.text: We estimate within-year price elasticities of demand for detailed health care services using an instrumental variable strategy, in which individual monthly cost shares are instrumented by employer-year-plan-month average cost shares. A specification using backward myopic prices gives more plausible and stable results than using forward myopic prices. Using 171 million person-months spanning 73 employers from 2008 to 2014, we estimate that the overall demand elasticity by backward myopic consumers is -0.44, with higher elasticities of demand for pharmaceuticals (-0.44), specialists visits (-0.32), MRIs (-0.29) and mental health/substance abuse (-0.26), and lower elasticities for prevention visits (-0.02) and emergency rooms (-0.04). Demand response is lower for children, in larger firms, among hourly waged employees, and for sicker people. Overall the method appears promising for estimating elasticities for highly disaggregated services although the approach does not work well on services that are very expensive or persistent.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.007.abstractZh: 我们采用工具变量策略，估算了详细医疗服务需求在年度内的价格弹性。其中，个人每月的成本份额通过雇主-年份-月份平均成本份额作为工具变量进行估计。使用向后近视价格模型得出的结果比使用向前近视价格模型更为合理且稳定。基于2008至2014年间73个雇主提供的1.71亿人月数据，我们估计，向后近视消费者整体的需求弹性为-0.44。其中，药品需求弹性最高，为-0.44；专科就诊需求弹性为-0.32；MRI检查需求弹性为-0.29；心理健康/药物滥用服务需求弹性为-0.26。而预防性就诊和急诊服务的需求弹性则较低，分别为-0.02和-0.04。总体而言，该方法对于估算高度细分服务的弹性表现较为有前景，尽管该方法在非常昂贵或持续性较高的服务上效果不佳。

abstract.text: In many countries, general practitioners (GPs) are assigned the task of controlling the validity of their own patients' insurance claims. At the same time, they operate in a market where patients are customers free to choose their GP. Are these roles compatible? Can we trust that the gatekeeping decisions are untainted by private economic interests? Based on administrative registers from Norway with records on sick pay certification and GP-patient relationships, we present evidence to the contrary: GPs are more lenient gatekeepers the more competitive is the physician market, and a reputation for lenient gatekeeping increases the demand for their services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.008.abstractZh: 在许多国家，全科医生被赋予了审核患者保险索赔有效性的职责。同时，他们又在一个市场中运作，患者可以自由选择自己的全科医生。这两种角色是否相容？我们能否相信这些审核决策不会受到私人经济利益的干扰？基于挪威的行政登记数据，这些数据记录了病假证明和全科医生与患者之间的关系，我们发现相反的情况：在医生市场竞争越激烈的情况下，全科医生对审核的宽松程度越高，而以宽松审核著称的医生服务需求反而会增加。

abstract.text: We examine how deaths and emergency department (ED) visits related to use of opioid analgesics (opioids) and other drugs vary with macroeconomic conditions. As the county unemployment rate increases by one percentage point, the opioid death rate per 100,000 rises by 0.19 (3.6%) and the opioid overdose ED visit rate per 100,000 increases by 0.95 (7.0%). Macroeconomic shocks also increase the overall drug death rate, but this increase is driven by rising opioid deaths. Our findings hold when performing a state-level analysis, rather than county-level; are primarily driven by adverse events among whites; and are stable across time periods.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.009.abstractZh: 我们研究了与阿片类镇痛药及其他药物使用相关的死亡人数和急诊就诊人数如何随宏观经济状况而变化。随着失业率每上升一个百分点，每10万人的阿片类药物死亡人数增加0.19（3.6%），每10万人的阿片类药物过量急诊就诊人数增加0.95（7.0%）。宏观经济冲击也会增加整体药物死亡人数，但这一增长主要是由阿片类药物死亡人数的增加所驱动的。我们的研究结果在进行州级分析时依然成立，而不是县级分析；这些结果主要由白人中的不良事件所驱动；并且这些结果在不同时间段内保持稳定。

abstract.text: In this paper, I estimate the impact of city-level public health regulations in the market for cow's milk on the mortality of infants and young children between 1900 and 1920. I find that the introduction of city-level dairy farm inspections reduced mortality from Diarrhea & Enteritis for one-year-old children by 1.3 annual deaths per thousand, a 14 percent effect relative to the baseline rate for this cause and a 3 percent effect relative to the baseline rate for all causes for this age group. Back-of-the-envelope calculations reveal that the benefits from these regulations exceeded costs by at least a factor of two.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.010.abstractZh: 在本文中，我估计了1900至1920年间城市级公共卫生法规对牛奶市场的影响，以及这些法规对婴儿和幼儿死亡率的影响。研究发现，城市级奶牛场检查的引入使一岁儿童因腹泻与肠炎导致的死亡率减少了1.3例/千人，相对于该病因的基线率，这一效果为14%，而相对于该年龄组所有病因的基线率，这一效果为3%。粗略计算表明，这些法规带来的好处至少是其成本的两倍。

abstract.text: The extent to which premium subsidies can influence health insurance choices is an open question. In this paper, we explore the regional variation in subsidy schemes in Switzerland, designed as either in-kind or cash transfers, to study their impact on the choice of health insurance deductibles. Using health survey data and a difference-in-differences methodology, we find that in-kind transfers increase the likelihood of choosing a low deductible plan by approximately 4 percentage points (or 7%). Our results indicate that the response to in-kind transfers is strongest among women, middle-aged and unmarried individuals, which we explain by differences in risk-taking behavior, health status, financial constraints, health insurance and financial literacy. We discuss our results in the light of potential extra-marginal effects on the demand for health care services, which are however not supported by our data.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.08.002.abstractZh: 补贴对健康保险选择的影响程度仍是一个未解之谜。本文探讨了瑞士地区性补贴方案的差异，这些补贴以实物或现金形式提供，旨在研究其对健康保险免赔额选择的影响。通过健康调查数据和差异比较分析方法，我们发现实物补贴使选择低免赔额计划的可能性增加了约4个百分点（或7%）。我们的研究结果表明，实物补贴对女性的影响最为显著，且这一效应在中年未婚人群中更为明显。我们认为这种现象源于风险行为、健康状况、经济约束、健康保险知识以及金融素养的差异。我们还讨论了这些结果可能带来的对医疗服务需求的额外影响，不过这些数据并未支持这一假设。

abstract.text: We study the effects of in utero exposure to terrorism in Spain on birth outcomes, focusing on terrorism perpetrated by ETA during the period 1980-2003.
