Knowing that a consumer is naive increases a monopolistic or competitive firm's willingness to generate inefficiency to exploit the consumer's mistakes, so naïveté-based discrimination is not Pareto-improving, can be Pareto-damaging, and often lowers total welfare when classical preference-based discrimination does not. Moreover, the effect on total welfare depends on a hitherto unemphasized market feature: the extent to which the exploitation of naive consumers distorts trade with different types of consumers. If the distortion is homogeneous across naive and sophisticated consumers, then under an arguably weak and empirically testable condition, naïveté-based discrimination lowers total welfare. In contrast, if the distortion arises only for trades with sophisticated consumers, then perfect naïveté-based discrimination maximizes social welfare, although imperfect discrimination often lowers welfare. If the distortion arises only for trades with naive consumers, then naïveté-based discrimination has no effect on welfare. We identify applications for each of these cases. In our primary example, a credit market with present-biased borrowers, firms lend more than is socially optimal to increase the amount of interest naive borrowers unexpectedly pay, creating a homogeneous distortion. The condition for naïveté-based discrimination to lower welfare is then weaker than prudence.

10.1093/qje/qjw042.abstractZh: 我们开始研究基于天真度的歧视行为，即根据消费者对外部信息的天真程度来设定交易条件的做法。了解到消费者天真时，垄断或竞争企业更有可能通过制造低效率来利用消费者的错误，因此基于天真度的歧视并不具有帕累托改进性，反而可能损害福利，尤其是在传统基于偏好的歧视无效的情况下。此外，对总福利的影响取决于一个迄今未被充分重视的市场特征：利用天真消费者所造成的与不同类型消费者的交易扭曲程度。如果这种扭曲在天真消费者和成熟消费者之间的交易中都存在，那么在一种较弱且可实证检验的条件下，基于天真度的歧视会降低总福利。相反，如果这种扭曲仅发生在与成熟消费者的交易中，那么完美的基于天真度的歧视会最大化社会福利，尽管不完美的歧视通常会降低福利。如果这种扭曲仅发生在与天真消费者的交易中，那么基于天真度的歧视对福利没有影响。我们为每种情况都确定了应用实例。在我们的主要例子中，一个以当前利益为导向的借贷市场，企业为了增加天真借款人意外支付的利息金额而提供超过社会最优的贷款，从而造成了一种同质性的扭曲。在这种情况下，基于天真度的歧视导致福利降低的条件比基于谨慎性的条件更为宽松。

abstract.text: We investigate how multinational firms contribute to the transmission of shocks across countries using a large multicountry firm-level data set that contains cross-border ownership information. We use these data to document two novel empirical patterns. First, foreign affiliate and headquarter sales exhibit strong positive comovement: a 10% growth in the sales of the headquarter is associated with a 2% growth in the sales of the affiliate. Second, shocks to the source country account for a significant fraction of the variation in sales growth at the source-destination level. We propose a parsimonious quantitative model to interpret these findings and to evaluate the role of multinational firms for international business cycle transmission. For the typical country, the impact of foreign shocks transmitted by all foreign multinationals combined is non-negligible, accounting for about 10% of aggregate productivity shocks. On the other hand, since bilateral multinational production shares are small, interdependence between most individual country pairs is minimal. Our results do reveal substantial heterogeneity in the strength of this mechanism, with the most integrated countries significantly more affected by foreign shocks.

10.1093/qje/qjw043.abstractZh: 我们研究了跨国企业如何通过包含跨境所有权信息的大型多国企业级数据集，促进冲击在各国之间的传播。我们利用这些数据发现了两个新的实证现象。首先，外国子公司和总部的销售额表现出强烈的正共动性：总部销售额增长10%，子公司销售额相应增长2%。其次，源国的冲击在源-目的地层面销售额增长的变化中占据了重要比例。我们提出了一个简洁的定量模型来解释这些发现，并评估跨国企业在国际商业周期传播中的作用。对于典型国家而言，所有外国跨国企业共同传递的外国冲击的影响是不可忽视的，约占总生产率冲击的10%。另一方面，由于双边跨国生产份额较小，大多数国家之间的相互依赖性较低。我们的研究确实揭示了这一机制强度的显著异质性，最紧密整合的国家受到外国冲击的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: We disaggregate the self-employed into incorporated and unincorporated to distinguish between “entrepreneurs” and other business owners. We show that the incorporated self-employed and their businesses engage in activities that demand comparatively strong nonroutine cognitive abilities, while the unincorporated and their firms perform tasks demanding relatively strong manual skills. People who become incorporated business owners tend to be more educated and—as teenagers—score higher on learning aptitude tests, exhibit greater self-esteem, and engage in more illicit activities than others. The combination of “smart” and “illicit” tendencies as youths accounts for both entry into entrepreneurship and the comparative earnings of entrepreneurs. Individuals tend to experience a material increase in earnings when becoming entrepreneurs, and this increase occurs at each decile of the distribution.

10.1093/qje/qjw044.abstractZh: 我们将自雇人士分为有公司形式的和无公司形式的，以区分“企业家”和其他商业所有者。我们发现，有公司形式的自雇人士及其企业从事的活动需要相对较强的非常规认知能力，而无公司形式的自雇人士及其企业则从事需要相对较强手工技能的任务。成为有公司形式的商业所有者的个人往往受教育程度更高，在青少年时期的学习能力测试成绩也更高，自尊心更强，并且从事更多非法活动。作为年轻人时，“聪明”和“非法”倾向的结合，既解释了他们进入创业领域的动机，也解释了企业家相对较高的收入。个人在成为企业家后，收入往往会显著增加，而且这种增加在收入的各个分位数中都会发生。

abstract.text: I analyze the behavior of risk premia in financial crises, wars, and recessions in an international panel spanning over 140 years and 14 countries. I document that expected returns, or risk premia, increase substantially in financial crises, but not in the other episodes. Asset prices decline in all episodes, but the decline in financial crises is substantially larger than the decline in fundamentals so that expected returns going forward are large. However, drops in consumption and consumption volatility are fairly similar across financial crises and recessions and are largest during wars, so asset pricing models based on aggregate consumption have trouble matching these facts. Comparing crises to “deep” recessions strengthens these findings further. By disentangling financial crises from other bad macroeconomic times, the results suggest that financial crises are particularly important to understanding why risk premia vary. I discuss implications for theory more broadly and discuss both rational and behavioral models that are consistent with the facts. Theories where asset prices are related to the health of the financial sector appear particularly promising.

10.1093/qje/qjw045.abstractZh: 我分析了金融危机、战争和经济衰退期间风险溢价的行为，研究样本涵盖了140多年、14个国家的国际数据。研究发现，在金融危机中，预期回报或风险溢价会显著上升，但在其他情况下则不会如此。所有情况下资产价格都会下降，但在金融危机中，资产价格的下降幅度远大于基本面的下降幅度，因此未来的预期回报较高。然而，消费水平的下降和消费波动性的变化在金融危机和经济衰退中大致相似，而在战争期间这种变化最为显著，因此基于总体消费的资产定价模型难以准确反映这些现象。将危机与“深度”经济衰退进行比较，进一步强化了这些发现。通过区分金融危机与其他严重的宏观经济状况，研究结果表明，金融危机对于理解风险溢价的变化尤为重要。我进一步讨论了这些发现对理论的意义，并探讨了与事实相符的理性模型和行为模型。那些认为资产价格与金融部门健康状况相关的理论显得尤为有前景。

abstract.text: Conventional value-added models (VAMs) compare average test scores across schools after regression-adjusting for students’ demographic characteristics and previous scores. This article tests for VAM bias using a procedure that asks whether VAM estimates accurately predict the achievement consequences of random assignment to specific schools. Test results from admissions lotteries in Boston suggest conventional VAM estimates are biased, a finding that motivates the development of a hierarchical model describing the joint distribution of school value-added, bias, and lottery compliance. We use this model to assess the substantive importance of bias in conventional VAM estimates and to construct hybrid value-added estimates that optimally combine ordinary least squares and lottery-based estimates of VAM parameters. The hybrid estimation strategy provides a general recipe for combining nonexperimental and quasi-experimental estimates. While still biased, hybrid school value-added estimates have lower mean squared error than conventional VAM estimates. Simulations calibrated to the Boston data show that, bias notwithstanding, policy decisions based on conventional VAMs that control for lagged achievement are likely to generate substantial achievement gains. Hybrid estimates that incorporate lotteries yield further gains.

10.1093/qje/qjx001.abstractZh: 传统增值模型（VAMs）通过回归调整学生的 demographic 特征和先前成绩，来比较不同学校的平均测试成绩。本文采用一种程序来检验 VAM 的偏差问题，即评估 VAM 估计是否能够准确预测随机分配到特定学校所带来的学业成果。波士顿入学抽签实验的结果表明，传统 VAM 估计存在偏差，这一发现促使我们开发了一个层次模型，用于描述学校增值、偏差和抽签遵守行为的联合分布。我们利用该模型来评估偏差在传统 VAM 估计中的实质性重要性，并构建了一种混合增值估计方法，该方法能够最优地结合普通最小二乘法和基于抽签的 VAM 参数估计。这种混合估计策略为结合非实验性和准实验性估计提供了一种通用方法。尽管仍然存在偏差，但混合学校增值估计的平均平方误差低于传统 VAM 估计。针对波士顿数据进行的模拟表明，尽管存在偏差，但基于传统 VAM 的政策决策，如果能够控制滞后性学业成绩，很可能会带来显著的学业收益。而结合抽签的混合估计则能带来更大的收益。

abstract.text: We conduct a randomized experiment that generates exogenous variation in the access to foreign markets for rug producers in Egypt. Combined with detailed survey data, we causally identify the impact of exporting on firm performance. Treatment firms report 16–26% higher profits and exhibit large improvements in quality alongside reductions in output per hour relative to control firms. These findings do not simply reflect firms being offered higher margins to manufacture high-quality products that take longer to produce. Instead, we find evidence of learning-by-exporting whereby exporting improves technical efficiency. First, treatment firms have higher productivity and quality after controlling for rug specifications. Second, when asked to produce an identical domestic rug using the same inputs and same capital equipment, treatment firms produce higher quality rugs despite no difference in production time. Third, treatment firms exhibit learning curves over time. Finally, we document knowledge transfers with quality increasing most along the specific dimensions that the knowledge pertained to.

10.1093/qje/qjx002.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项随机实验，旨在为埃及地毯制造商在外国市场的准入带来外生变化。结合详细的调查数据，我们揭示了出口对企业绩效的影响。实验组企业报告的利润比对照组高出16-26%，并且在质量上表现出显著提升，同时每小时的产出也有所减少。这些发现并非仅仅是因为企业获得了更高的利润空间来生产质量更高但生产时间更长的产品。相反，我们发现出口能够提升技术效率。首先，在控制地毯规格因素后，实验组企业的生产效率和质量都更高。其次，当要求实验组企业使用相同的投入和资本设备生产相同规格的国内地毯时，尽管生产时间没有差异，但实验组企业生产出的地毯质量更高。第三，实验组企业随着时间推移呈现出学习曲线效应。最后，我们发现知识转移现象明显，质量提升主要体现在与知识相关的特定维度上。

abstract.text: We study how women's choices over labor activities in village economies correlate with poverty and whether enabling the poorest women to take on the activities of their richer counterparts can set them on a sustainable trajectory out of poverty. To do this we conduct a large-scale randomized control trial, covering over 21,000 households in 1,309 villages surveyed four times over a seven-year period, to evaluate a nationwide program in Bangladesh that transfers livestock assets and skills to the poorest women. At baseline, the poorest women mostly engage in low return and seasonal casual wage labor while wealthier women solely engage in livestock rearing. The program enables poor women to start engaging in livestock rearing, increasing their aggregate labor supply and earnings. This leads to asset accumulation (livestock, land, and business assets) and poverty reduction, both sustained after four and seven years. These gains do not crowd out the livestock businesses of noneligible households while the wages these receive for casual jobs increase as the poor reduce their labor supply. Our results show that (i) the poor are able to take on the work activities of the nonpoor but face barriers to doing so, and, (ii) one-off interventions that remove these barriers lead to sustainable poverty reduction.

10.1093/qje/qjx003.abstractZh: 我们研究了农村经济中女性对劳动活动的选择与贫困之间的关联，以及让最贫困的女性承担较富裕女性的劳动活动是否能够帮助她们走上可持续的脱贫之路。为此，我们开展了一项大规模的随机对照试验，在七年的时间里对1,309个村庄的21,000多户家庭进行了四次调查，以评估孟加拉国一项将牲畜资产和技能转移给最贫困女性的全国性计划的效果。在基线阶段，最贫困的女性主要从事回报低且季节性的临时工，而较富裕的女性则主要从事牲畜养殖。该计划使贫困女性开始从事牲畜养殖，增加了她们的总劳动供给和收入。这导致了资产积累（牲畜、土地和商业资产）和贫困减少，且这种改善在四年和七年后都得以持续。这些收益并没有挤占非贫困家庭的牲畜经营业务，同时，由于贫困女性减少了劳动供给，她们在临时工作中获得的工资也有所增加。我们的研究结果表明：(i) 贫困女性能够承担非贫困群体的劳动活动，但面临诸多障碍；(ii) 一次性消除这些障碍的干预措施能够带来可持续的贫困减少。

abstract.text: By analyzing 20 developed economies over 1920–2012, we find the following evidence of overoptimism and neglect of crash risk by bank equity investors during credit expansions: (i) bank credit expansion predicts increased bank equity crash risk, but despite the elevated crash risk, also predicts lower mean bank equity returns in subsequent one to three years; (ii) conditional on bank credit expansion of a country exceeding a 95th percentile threshold, the predicted excess return for the bank equity index in subsequent three years is −37.3%; and (iii) bank credit expansion is distinct from equity market sentiment captured by dividend yield and yet dividend yield and credit expansion interact with each other to make credit expansion a particularly strong predictor of lower bank equity returns when dividend yield is low.

10.1093/qje/qjx004.abstractZh: 通过对1920年至2012年间20个发达经济体的分析，我们发现银行股权投资者在信贷扩张期间存在过度乐观和忽视违约风险的倾向，具体表现为： (i) 银行信贷扩张会增加银行股权违约风险，但尽管违约风险上升，银行股权在随后一到三年的平均回报却较低； (ii) 如果一个国家的银行信贷扩张超过第95百分位的阈值，银行股权指数在随后三年的超额回报为-37.3%； (iii) 银行信贷扩张与股票市场的情绪表现不同，后者通过股息收益率来反映，然而股息收益率与信贷扩张之间存在相互作用，当股息收益率较低时，信贷扩张成为银行股权回报降低的显著预测因素。

abstract.text: We study the effects of a credit crunch on consumer spending in a heterogeneous-agent incomplete-market model. After an unexpected permanent tightening in consumers’ borrowing capacity, constrained consumers are forced to repay their debt, and unconstrained consumers increase their precautionary savings. This depresses interest rates, especially in the short run, and generates an output drop, even with flexible prices. The output drop is larger with sticky prices, if the zero lower bound prevents the interest rate from adjusting downward. Adding durable goods to the model, households take larger debt positions and the output response can be larger.

10.1093/qje/qjx005.abstractZh: 我们研究信贷紧缩对异质代理人不完全市场模型中消费者支出的影响。在消费者借贷能力意外被永久限制后，受限消费者被迫偿还债务，而不受限消费者则增加预防性储蓄。这导致利率下降，尤其是在短期内，并导致产出下降，即使价格保持灵活。如果零下限限制使得利率无法下降， sticky价格条件下产出下降幅度更大。在模型中加入耐用品后，家庭承担的债务负担增加，产出反应也可能更大。

abstract.text: Examining the performance of cashiers in a French grocery store chain, we find that manager bias negatively affects minority job performance. In the stores studied, cashiers work with different managers on different days and their schedules are determined quasi-randomly. When minority cashiers, but not majority cashiers, are scheduled to work with managers who are biased (as determined by an implicit association test), they are absent more often, spend less time at work, scan items more slowly, and take more time between customers. This appears to be because biased managers interact less with minorities, leading minorities to exert less effort. Manager bias has consequences for the average performance of minority workers: while on average minority and majority workers perform equivalently, on days where managers are unbiased, minorities perform significantly better than do majority workers. The findings are consistent with statistical discrimination in hiring whereby because minorities underperform when assigned to biased managers, the firm sets a higher hiring standard for minorities to get similar average performance from minority and nonminority workers.

10.1093/qje/qjx006.abstractZh: 在一项针对法国连锁杂货店收银员绩效的研究中，我们发现经理的偏见会对少数族裔员工的绩效产生负面影响。在所研究的店铺中，收银员在不同日期与不同的经理合作，他们的工作时间安排几乎是随机的。当少数族裔收银员与有偏见的经理合作时（通过隐性关联测试确定），他们缺勤的频率更高，工作时间更短，扫描商品的速度更慢，以及每次接待顾客之间的间隔时间更长。这可能是因为有偏见的经理与少数族裔员工的互动较少，导致少数族裔员工付出的努力也较少。经理的偏见会对少数族裔员工的平均绩效产生影响：虽然少数族裔和多数族裔员工的平均表现相当，但在经理没有偏见的日子里，少数族裔员工的绩效明显优于多数族裔员工。这些发现与招聘中的统计歧视现象一致，即由于少数族裔员工在与有偏见的经理合作时表现不佳，企业会为少数族裔员工设定更高的招聘标准，以确保他们能够取得与多数族裔员工相当的平均绩效。

abstract.text: This study investigates how banks design financial products to cater to yield-seeking investors. We focus on a large market of investment products targeted exclusively at households: retail structured products. These products typically offer a high return under their best-case scenario—the headline rate—that is nested in a complex payoff formula. Using a text analysis of the payoff formulas of the 55,000 products issued in Europe from 2002 to 2010, we measure product headline rates, complexity, and risk. Over this period, product headline rates depart from the prevailing interest rates as the latter decrease, complexity increases, and risky products become more common. In the cross section, the headline rate of a product is positively correlated with its level of complexity and risk. Higher headline rate, more complex, and riskier products appear more profitable to the banks distributing them. Our results suggest that financial complexity is a by-product of banks catering to yield-seeking investors.

10.1093/qje/qjx007.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了银行如何设计金融产品以迎合追求收益的投资者。我们重点关注一个专门针对家庭的投资产品市场：零售结构化产品。这些产品在最佳情况下通常能提供高回报——即标准利率——而这一回报嵌套在复杂的收益公式中。通过对2002年至2010年间欧洲发行的55,000种产品的收益公式进行文本分析，我们测量了产品的标准利率、复杂性和风险。在此期间，随着现行利率的下降、复杂性的增加以及风险产品的普遍化，产品的标准利率与现行利率出现了偏离。从横截面来看，产品的标准利率与其复杂性和风险水平呈正相关。对于发行这些产品的银行而言，更高标准利率、更复杂且风险更高的产品似乎更有利可图。我们的研究结果表明，金融产品的复杂性是银行迎合追求收益的投资者需求所产生的结果。

abstract.text: The nature of the relationship between employers and employees has been changing over the past three decades, with firms increasingly relying on contractors, temp agencies, and franchises rather than hiring employees directly. We investigate the impact of this transformation on the wage structure by following jobs that are moved outside the boundary of lead employers to contracting firms. We develop a new method for identifying outsourcing of food, cleaning, security, and logistics services in administrative data using the universe of social security records in Germany. We document a dramatic growth of domestic outsourcing in Germany since the early 1990s. Event-study analyses show that wages in outsourced jobs fall by approximately 10–15% relative to similar jobs that are not outsourced. We find evidence that the wage losses associated with outsourcing stem from a loss of firm-specific rents, suggesting that labor cost savings are an important reason firms choose to contract out these services. Finally, we tie the increase in outsourcing activity to broader changes in the German wage structure, in particular showing that outsourcing of cleaning, security, and logistics services alone accounts for around 9% of the increase in German wage inequality since the 1980s.

10.1093/qje/qjx008.abstractZh: 在过去三十年中，雇主与雇员之间的关系发生了变化，企业越来越依赖承包商、临时工中介和特许经营，而不是直接雇佣员工。我们通过追踪那些从主要雇主转移到承包公司的职位，来研究这种转变对工资结构的影响。我们开发了一种新的方法，利用德国的社会保障记录，在行政数据中识别食品、清洁、安保和物流服务的外包情况。我们发现，自20世纪90年代初以来，德国的国内外包活动出现了显著增长。事件研究分析表明，外包职位的工资相比非外包类似职位下降了约10-15%。我们发现，与外包相关的工资损失源于企业特定租金的丧失，这表明劳动力成本的节省是企业在选择外包这些服务时的重要原因。最后，我们将外包活动的增加与德国工资结构的更广泛变化联系起来，特别是发现，仅清洁、安保和物流服务的外包就占自20世纪80年代以来德国工资不平等加剧的约9%。

abstract.text: To reduce poverty and food insecurity in Africa requires raising productivity in agriculture. Systematic use of fertilizer and hybrid seed is a pathway to increased productivity, but adoption of these technologies remains low. We investigate whether the quality of agricultural inputs can help explain low take-up. Testing modern products purchased in local markets, we find that 30% of nutrient is missing in fertilizer, and hybrid maize seed is estimated to contain less than 50% authentic seeds. We document that such low quality results in low average returns. If authentic technologies replaced these low-quality products, however, average returns are high. To rationalize the findings, we calibrate a learning model using data from our agricultural trials. Because agricultural yields are noisy, farmers’ ability to learn about quality is limited and this can help explain the low quality equilibrium we observe, but also why the market has not fully collapsed.

10.1093/qje/qjx009.abstractZh: 要减少非洲的贫困和粮食不安全，就需要提高农业生产力。系统地使用化肥和杂交种子是提高生产力的途径，但这些技术的采用率仍然很低。我们研究了农业投入品的质量是否有助于解释这种低采用率的现象。通过对当地市场购买的现代产品进行测试，我们发现30%的肥料缺乏营养成分，而杂交玉米种子的真实性估计不足50%。我们的研究还表明，这种低质量会导致平均回报较低。然而，如果采用真实的技术替代这些低质量产品，平均回报将会很高。为了解释这些发现，我们使用农业试验的数据校准了一个学习模型。由于农业产量存在不确定性，农民学习质量的能力有限，这可以帮助解释我们观察到的低质量均衡现象，同时也能解释为什么市场尚未完全崩溃。

abstract.text: This article studies technology adoption in a cluster of soccer-ball producers in Sialkot, Pakistan. We invented a new cutting technology that reduces waste of the primary raw material and gave the technology to a random subset of producers. Despite the clear net benefits for nearly all firms, after 15 months take-up remained puzzlingly low. We hypothesize that an important reason for the lack of adoption is a misalignment of incentives within firms: the key employees (cutters and printers) are typically paid piece rates, with no incentive to reduce waste, and the new technology slows them down, at least initially. Fearing reductions in their effective wage, employees resist adoption in various ways, including by misinforming owners about the value of the technology. To investigate this hypothesis, we implemented a second experiment among the firms that originally received the technology: we offered one cutter and one printer per firm a lump-sum payment, approximately a month’s earnings, conditional on demonstrating competence in using the technology in the presence of the owner. This incentive payment, small from the point of view of the firm, had a significant positive effect on adoption. The results suggest that misalignment of incentives within firms is an important barrier to technology adoption in our setting.

10.1093/qje/qjx010.abstractZh: 本文研究了巴基斯坦锡亚尔科特地区一群足球球生产商的技术采纳情况。我们发明了一种新的切割技术，能够减少主要原材料的浪费，并将该技术提供给部分生产商。尽管该技术对几乎所有企业都有明显的净收益，但15个月后的采纳率却低得令人困惑。我们认为，缺乏采纳的一个重要原因是企业内部激励机制的失调：关键员工（切割工和打印工）通常按件计酬，没有减少浪费的动机，而新技术至少在初期会减缓他们的工作效率。由于担心工资减少，员工会以各种方式抵制技术的采纳，包括向企业主虚假宣传该技术的价值。为了验证这一假设，我们在最初获得技术的小组中进行了第二次实验：我们向每家企业的切割工和打印工提供一次性付款，大约相当于一个月的工资，前提是他们在企业主面前能够熟练使用该技术。从企业的角度来看，这种激励措施虽然金额不大，但对技术采纳产生了显著的积极影响。结果表明，企业内部激励机制的失调是我们这一环境中技术采纳的重要障碍。

abstract.text: We examine the health plan choices that 23,894 employees at a U.S. firm made from a large menu of options that differed only in financial cost-sharing and premium. These decisions provide a clear test of the predictions of the standard economic model of insurance choice in the absence of choice frictions because plans were priced so that nearly every plan with a lower deductible was financially dominated by an otherwise identical plan with a high deductible. We document that the majority of employees chose dominated plans, which resulted in excess spending equivalent to 24% of chosen plan premiums. Low-income employees were significantly more likely to choose dominated plans, and most employees did not switch into more financially efficient plans in the subsequent year. We show that the choice of dominated plans cannot be rationalized by standard risk preference or any expectations about health risk. Testing alternative explanations with a series of hypothetical-choice experiments, we find that the popularity of dominated plans was not primarily driven by the size and complexity of the plan menu, nor informed preferences for avoiding high deductibles, but by employees’ lack of understanding of health insurance. Our findings challenge the standard practice of inferring risk preferences from insurance choices and raise doubts about the welfare benefits of health reforms that expand consumer choice.

10.1093/qje/qjx011.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国一家公司的23,894名员工在众多健康保险选择中的决策行为。这些选择仅在财务费用分担和保费方面存在差异。这些决策清晰地检验了标准经济模型关于保险选择行为的预测，即在没有选择摩擦的情况下，由于保险计划的定价方式，几乎每一个 deductible 较低的计划都会被另一个 deductible 较高的、功能相同的计划所主导。我们发现，大多数员工选择了被主导的保险计划，这导致他们的额外支出相当于所选保险计划保费的24%。低收入员工更有可能选择被主导的保险计划，而且大多数员工在随后的一年里并没有转向更经济高效的保险计划。我们的研究表明，选择被主导的保险计划无法用标准的风险偏好或对健康风险的预期来解释。通过一系列假设性选择实验，我们发现被主导的保险计划的受欢迎程度并非主要受到保险计划种类和复杂性的影响，也不是出于避免高 deductible 的知情偏好，而是因为员工对健康保险缺乏了解。我们的研究结果挑战了从保险选择中推断风险偏好的标准做法，并对扩大消费者选择范围的医疗改革所带来的福利效益提出了质疑。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of legislative competition in which voters care about local candidate valence and national party positions that are determined by the parties’ median legislators. As long as election outcomes are sufficiently predictable, the only stable equilibria exhibit policy divergence between the parties. If the degree of uncertainty about election outcomes decreases, and if voters place less weight on local candidates’ valence, polarization between the parties increases. Furthermore, a systematic electoral shock makes the party favored by the shock more moderate, while the disadvantaged party becomes more extreme. Finally, we examine data on state elections and the ideological positions of state legislatures and find patterns that are consistent with key predictions of our model.

10.1093/qje/qjx012.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种立法竞争理论，其中选民关注地方候选人的价值以及由政党中位议员决定的全国性政党立场。只要选举结果具有足够的可预测性，唯一稳定的均衡状态会表现为政党之间的政策分歧。如果选举结果的不确定性降低，且选民对地方候选人价值的重视程度下降，政党之间的两极分化就会加剧。此外，系统性选举冲击会使受冲击的政党变得更加温和，而处于劣势的政党则变得更加极端。最后，我们研究了州级选举的数据以及州立法机构的意识形态立场，发现这些结果与我们模型的关键预测一致。

abstract.text: Measuring consumer responsiveness to medical care prices is a central issue in health economics and a key ingredient in the optimal design and regulation of health insurance markets. We leverage a natural experiment at a large self-insured firm that required all of its employees to switch from an insurance plan that provided free health care to a nonlinear, high-deductible plan. The switch caused a spending reduction between 11.8% and 13.8% of total firm-wide health spending. We decompose this spending reduction into the components of (i) consumer price shopping, (ii) quantity reductions, and (iii) quantity substitutions and find that spending reductions are entirely due to outright reductions in quantity. We find no evidence of consumers learning to price shop after two years in high-deductible coverage. Consumers reduce quantities across the spectrum of health care services, including potentially valuable care (e.g., preventive services) and potentially wasteful care (e.g., imaging services). To better understand these changes, we study how consumers respond to the complex structure of the high-deductible contract. Consumers respond heavily to spot prices at the time of care, reducing their spending by 42% when under the deductible, conditional on their true expected end-of-year price and their prior year end-of-year marginal price. There is no evidence of learning to respond to the true shadow price in the second year post-switch.

10.1093/qje/qjx013.abstractZh: 衡量消费者对医疗价格的反应是健康经济学中的一个核心问题，也是设计和优化医疗保险市场的关键要素。我们借助了一家大型自保公司的自然实验，该公司要求所有员工从提供免费医疗服务的保险计划转向非线性、高免赔额计划。这一转变导致公司整体医疗支出减少了11.8%至13.8%。我们将这一支出减少分解为以下三个部分：(i)消费者价格选择，(ii)数量减少，以及(iii)数量替代。研究发现，支出减少完全是由于数量的直接减少。我们没有发现消费者在高免赔额覆盖期两年后学会了价格选择的行为。消费者在各类医疗服务中减少了消费，包括可能有价值的服务（如预防服务）和可能浪费的服务（如影像服务）。为了更好地理解这些变化，我们研究了消费者对高免赔额合同复杂结构的反应。消费者对治疗时的即时价格反应强烈，当免赔额较低时，他们的支出减少了42%，这一变化基于他们真实的年度末价格以及前一年的年度末边际价格。我们没有发现消费者在转换后第二年学会了根据真实的影子价格做出反应。

abstract.text: Using U.S. data from 1929 to 2015, we show that elevated credit-market sentiment in year t − 2 is associated with a decline in economic activity in years t and t + 1. Underlying this result is the existence of predictable mean reversion in credit-market conditions. When credit risk is aggressively priced, spreads subsequently widen. The timing of this widening is, in turn, closely tied to the onset of a contraction in economic activity. Exploring the mechanism, we find that buoyant credit-market sentiment in year t − 2 also forecasts a change in the composition of external finance: net debt issuance falls in year t, while net equity issuance increases, consistent with the reversal in credit-market conditions leading to an inward shift in credit supply. Unlike much of the current literature on the role of financial frictions in macroeconomics, this article suggests that investor sentiment in credit markets can be an important driver of economic fluctuations.

10.1093/qje/qjx014.abstractZh: 通过利用1929年至2015年的美国数据，我们发现，在t-2年信贷市场情绪高涨时，t年和t+1年的经济活动会下降。这一结果的基础是信贷市场状况存在可预测的平均回归现象。当信贷风险被充分定价时，利差会随之扩大。这种扩大的时机与经济活动收缩的开始时间密切相关。通过机制分析，我们发现t-2年信贷市场情绪高涨还会影响外部融资结构的改变：t年净债务发行量下降，而净股权发行量上升，这与信贷市场状况逆转导致信贷供应向内转移的趋势一致。与当前许多关于金融摩擦在宏观经济中作用的文献不同，本文认为信贷市场中的投资者情绪可以成为经济波动的重要驱动因素。

abstract.text: We propose a model of job search with reference-dependent preferences, with loss aversion relative to recent income (the reference point). In this model, newly unemployed individuals search hard since consumption is below their reference point. Over time, though, they get used to lower income and thus reduce their search effort. In anticipation of a benefit cut, their search effort rises again, then declines once they get accustomed to the lower postcut benefit level. The model fits the typical pattern of exit from unemployment, even with no unobserved heterogeneity. To distinguish between this and other models, we use a unique reform in the unemployment insurance (UI) benefit path. In 2005, Hungary switched from a single-step UI system to a two-step system, with overall generosity unchanged. The system generated increased hazard rates in anticipation of, and especially following, benefit cuts in ways the standard model has a hard time explaining. We estimate a model with optimal consumption, endogenous search effort, and unobserved heterogeneity. The reference-dependent model fits the hazard rates substantially better than plausible versions of the standard model, including habit formation. Our estimates indicate a slow-adjusting reference point and substantial impatience, likely reflecting present-bias.

10.1093/qje/qjx015.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个基于参考点偏好和损失厌恶效应的求职模型。在这个模型中，新失业者由于消费水平低于参考点而面临较大的求职压力。然而，随着时间的推移，他们逐渐适应较低的收入水平，从而减少求职努力。在预期福利削减的情况下，他们的求职努力又会上升，但一旦适应了较低的福利水平后，求职努力又会下降。该模型能够很好地描述失业者退出失业状态的典型模式，即使没有未观察到的异质性。为了区分该模型与其他模型，我们在失业保险福利路径上采用了一种独特的改革措施。2005年，匈牙利从单步式失业保险制度转变为双步式制度，总体福利水平保持不变。然而，这种制度在预期福利削减时，尤其是福利削减之后，会导致风险率的增加，而标准模型很难解释这一现象。我们建立了一个包含最优消费、内生求职努力和未观察到的异质性的模型。基于参考点的模型能够比标准模型的合理版本更好地解释风险率的变化，包括习惯形成的影响。我们的估计结果显示，参考点调整过程较为缓慢，且存在显著的急躁情绪，这可能反映了当前偏见的影响。

abstract.text: Can a democracy attract competent leaders, while attaining broad representation? Economic models suggest that free-riding incentives and lower opportunity costs give the less competent a comparative advantage at entering political life. Moreover, if elites have more human capital, selecting on competence may lead to uneven representation. This article examines patterns of political selection among the universe of municipal politicians and national legislators in Sweden, using extraordinarily rich data on competence traits and social background for the entire population. We document four new facts that together characterize an “inclusive meritocracy.” First, politicians are on average significantly smarter and better leaders than the population they represent. Second, this positive selection is present even when conditioning on family (and hence social) background, suggesting that individual competence is key for selection. Third, the representation of social background, whether measured by parental earnings or occupational social class, is remarkably even. Fourth, there is at best a weak trade-off in selection between competence and social representation, mainly due to strong positive selection of politicians of low (parental) socioeconomic status. A broad implication of these facts is that it is possible for democracy to generate competent and socially representative leadership.

10.1093/qje/qjx016.abstractZh: 民主能否吸引有能力的领导者，同时实现广泛的代表性？经济模型表明，免费搭便车的行为激励和较低的机会成本使得能力较差的人在进入政治领域时具有比较优势。此外，如果精英拥有更多的人力资本，那么基于能力的选择可能会导致代表性不均衡。本文利用关于整个人口的能力特征和社会背景的丰富数据，研究了瑞典市政政治家和国家立法者中的政治选拔模式。我们发现四个新的事实，共同构成了“包容性精英统治”的特征。首先，政治家平均而言比他们所代表的人群更聪明、更优秀。其次，即使考虑到家庭（及社会）背景的影响，这种积极的选择仍然存在，这表明个人能力是选拔的关键。第三，社会背景的代表性非常均衡，无论是通过父母收入还是职业社会阶层来衡量。第四，在选拔过程中，能力与社会代表性之间几乎没有权衡，主要是因为低社会经济地位的政治家受到强烈的积极选择。这些事实的一个广泛含义是，民主有可能产生有能力和具有社会代表性的领导层。

abstract.text: An increase in the household debt to GDP ratio predicts lower GDP growth and higher unemployment in the medium run for an unbalanced panel of 30 countries from 1960 to 2012. Low mortgage spreads are associated with an increase in the household debt to GDP ratio and a decline in subsequent GDP growth, highlighting the importance of credit supply shocks. Economic forecasters systematically over-predict GDP growth at the end of household debt booms, suggesting an important role of flawed expectations formation. The negative relation between the change in household debt to GDP and subsequent output growth is stronger for countries with less flexible exchange rate regimes. We also uncover a global household debt cycle that partly predicts the severity of the global growth slowdown after 2007. Countries with a household debt cycle more correlated with the global household debt cycle experience a sharper decline in growth after an increase in domestic household debt.

10.1093/qje/qjx017.abstractZh: 在1960至2012年间，对于30个不平衡面板国家而言，家庭债务与GDP比率的增加会在中期预测较低的GDP增长和较高的失业率。低抵押利率与家庭债务与GDP比率的增加以及随后GDP增长的下降有关，这凸显了信贷供应冲击的重要性。经济预测者系统性地高估了家庭债务繁荣结束时GDP的增长，这表明错误的预期形成起着重要作用。家庭债务与GDP比率的变化与随后产出增长之间的负相关关系在汇率制度不够灵活的国家中更为明显。我们还发现一个全球性的家庭债务周期，该周期在一定程度上预测了2007年之后全球经济增长放缓的严重程度。那些家庭债务周期与全球家庭债务周期更为相关的国家，在家庭债务增加之后，经济增长的下降幅度更为显著。

abstract.text: What shapes the optimal degree of progressivity of the tax and transfer system? On the one hand, a progressive tax system can counteract inequality in initial conditions and substitute for imperfect private insurance against idiosyncratic earnings risk. On the other hand, progressivity reduces incentives to work and to invest in skills, distortions that are especially costly when the government must finance public goods. We develop a tractable equilibrium model that features all of these trade-offs. The analytical expressions we derive for social welfare deliver a transparent understanding of how preference, technology, and market structure parameters influence the optimal degree of progressivity. A calibration for the U.S. economy indicates that endogenous skill investment, flexible labor supply, and the desire to finance government purchases play quantitatively similar roles in limiting optimal progressivity. In a version of the model where poverty constrains skill investment, optimal progressivity is close to the U.S. value. An empirical analysis on cross-country data offers support to the theory.

10.1093/qje/qjx018.abstractZh: 什么决定了税收和转移支付制度的最优累进程度？一方面，累进税制可以在初始条件下抵消不平等现象，并替代对特殊收入风险的不完全私人保险。另一方面，累进性会降低工作和技能投资的动力，这种扭曲在政府必须为公共产品融资时尤为严重。我们开发了一个包含所有这些权衡的可行均衡模型。我们推导出的社会福利分析表达式清晰地揭示了偏好、技术和市场结构参数如何影响最优累进程度。对美国经济的校准表明，内生技能投资、灵活的劳动力供应以及为政府采购融资的意愿在限制最优累进程度方面起着相似的作用。在贫困限制了技能投资的模型版本中，最优累进程度接近美国的数值。对跨国数据的实证分析支持了这一理论。

abstract.text: We present a new channel for the transmission of monetary policy, the deposits channel. We show that when the Fed funds rate rises, banks widen the spreads they charge on deposits, and deposits flow out of the banking system. We present a model where this is due to market power in deposit markets. Consistent with the market power mechanism, deposit spreads increase more and deposits flow out more in concentrated markets. This is true even when we control for lending opportunities by only comparing different branches of the same bank. Since deposits are the main source of liquid assets for households, the deposits channel can explain the observed strong relationship between the liquidity premium and the Fed funds rate. Since deposits are also a uniquely stable funding source for banks, the deposits channel impacts bank lending. When the Fed funds rate rises, banks that raise deposits in concentrated markets contract their lending by more than other banks. Our estimates imply that the deposits channel can account for the entire transmission of monetary policy through bank balance sheets.

10.1093/qje/qjx019.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的货币政策传导渠道——存款渠道。我们发现，当美联储基金利率上升时，银行会扩大其存款的利率差，导致存款从银行体系流出。我们建立了一个模型，表明这一现象是由于存款市场的市场力量所致。与市场力量机制一致，在集中化的市场中，存款利率差的增加幅度更大，存款的流出也更为显著。即使我们通过比较同一银行的不同分支机构来控制贷款机会，这一现象仍然成立。由于存款是家庭流动资产的主要来源，存款渠道能够解释流动性溢价与美联储基金利率之间存在的强相关性。此外，由于存款也是银行独特的稳定资金来源，存款渠道还会影响银行的贷款行为。当美联储基金利率上升时，在集中化的市场中，那些增加存款的银行会比其他银行减少更多的贷款。我们的估计表明，存款渠道能够解释货币政策通过银行资产负债表传导的整个过程。

abstract.text: We present evidence that a significant fraction of commuters on the London Underground do not travel on their optimal route. We show that a strike on the Underground, which forced many commuters to experiment with new routes, brought lasting changes in behavior. This effect is stronger for commuters who live in areas where the Underground map is more distorted, which points to the importance of informational imperfections. Information resulting from the strike improved network efficiency. Search costs alone are unlikely to explain the suboptimal behavior.

10.1093/qje/qjx020.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明伦敦地铁上相当一部分乘客并未选择最优路线出行。研究表明，地铁罢工迫使许多乘客尝试新的路线，这带来了行为的持久变化。对于那些居住在地铁线路分布更为混乱地区的乘客来说，这种影响更为明显，这凸显了信息不完备性的问题。罢工带来的信息改进了地铁网络的效率。仅考虑搜索成本不太能解释这种次优行为。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of endogenous uncertainty and business cycles in which short-lived shocks can generate long-lasting recessions. In the model, higher uncertainty about fundamentals discourages investment. Since agents learn from the actions of others, information flows slowly in times of low activity and uncertainty remains high, further discouraging investment. The economy displays uncertainty traps: self-reinforcing episodes of high uncertainty and low activity. Although the economy recovers quickly after small shocks, large temporary shocks may have long-lasting effects on the level of activity. The economy is subject to an information externality but uncertainty traps may remain in the efficient allocation. Embedding the mechanism in a standard business cycle framework, we find that endogenous uncertainty increases the persistence of large recessions and improves the performance of the model in accounting for the Great Recession.

10.1093/qje/qjx021.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种关于内生不确定性与商业周期的理论，其中短暂的冲击可能会引发长期的衰退。在该模型中，对基本面的不确定性增加会抑制投资。由于参与者会从他人的行为中学习，因此在低活动水平下信息流动缓慢，不确定性持续存在，进一步抑制投资。经济会出现不确定性陷阱：高不确定性与低活动的自我强化现象。尽管经济在小型冲击后能够迅速恢复，但大型临时冲击可能会对活动水平产生长期影响。经济受到信息外部性的影响，但不确定性陷阱可能会妨碍有效的资源配置。将这一机制嵌入标准的商业周期框架中，我们发现内生不确定性增加了大型衰退的持续性，并改善了模型对大衰退的模拟效果。

abstract.text: The labor market increasingly rewards social skills. Between 1980 and 2012, jobs requiring high levels of social interaction grew by nearly 12 percentage points as a share of the U.S. labor force. Math-intensive but less social jobs—including many STEM occupations—shrank by 3.3 percentage points over the same period. Employment and wage growth were particularly strong for jobs requiring high levels of both math skill and social skills. To understand these patterns, I develop a model of team production where workers “trade tasks” to exploit their comparative advantage. In the model, social skills reduce coordination costs, allowing workers to specialize and work together more efficiently. The model generates predictions about sorting and the relative returns to skill across occupations, which I investigate using data from the NLSY79 and the NLSY97. Using a comparable set of skill measures and covariates across survey waves, I find that the labor market return to social skills was much greater in the 2000s than in the mid-1980s and 1990s.

10.1093/qje/qjx022.abstractZh: 劳动力市场越来越重视社交技能的价值。在1980年至2012年间，需要高度社交互动的工作在美国劳动力中的占比增加了近12个百分点。而数学要求高但社交需求较低的工作——包括许多STEM职业——在同一时期减少了3.3个百分点。需要同时具备高数学技能和社交技能的工作，其就业和工资增长尤为显著。为了理解这些现象，我构建了一个团队生产模型，其中工人通过“交换任务”来发挥各自的比较优势。该模型表明，社交技能可以降低协调成本，使工人能够更高效地专业化并协同工作。该模型还预测了职业间技能排序以及技能的相对回报，我通过NLSY79和NLSY97的数据来验证这些预测。通过比较不同调查周期中的技能指标和协变量，我发现，在2000年代，劳动力市场对社交技能的重视程度远高于1980年代中期和1990年代。

abstract.text: We propose a local measure of the relationship between parameter estimates and the moments of the data they depend on. Our measure can be computed at negligible cost even for complex structural models. We argue that reporting this measure can increase the transparency of structural estimates, making it easier for readers to predict the way violations of identifying assumptions would affect the results. When the key assumptions are orthogonality between error terms and excluded instruments, we show that our measure provides a natural extension of the omitted variables bias formula for nonlinear models. We illustrate with applications to published articles in several fields of economics.

10.1093/qje/qjx023.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种局部度量方法，用于衡量参数估计值与其所依赖的数据矩之间的关系。即使对于复杂的结构模型，这种度量也可以以微不足道的成本进行计算。我们认为，报告这种度量可以提高结构估计的透明度，使读者更容易预测识别假设违反会对结果产生的影响。当关键假设是误差项与排除的工具变量之间的正交性时，我们表明我们的度量方法为非线性模型提供了遗漏变量偏差公式的自然扩展。我们通过几个经济学领域的已发表文章来说明这一方法的应用。

abstract.text: Starting in the early 1990s, countries in southern Europe experienced low productivity growth alongside declining real interest rates. We use data for manufacturing firms in Spain between 1999 and 2012 to document a significant increase in the dispersion of the return to capital across firms, a stable dispersion of the return to labor, and a significant increase in productivity losses from capital misallocation over time. We develop a model with size-dependent financial frictions that is consistent with important aspects of firms’ behavior in production and balance sheet data. We illustrate how the decline in the real interest rate, often attributed to the euro convergence process, leads to a significant decline in sectoral total factor productivity as capital inflows are misallocated toward firms that have higher net worth but are not necessarily more productive. We show that similar trends in dispersion and productivity losses are observed in Italy and Portugal but not in Germany, France, and Norway.

10.1093/qje/qjx024.abstractZh: 从20世纪90年代初开始，南欧国家经历了低生产率增长以及实际利率的下降。我们利用1999年至2012年间西班牙制造业企业的数据，发现企业间资本回报的分散程度显著上升，劳动力回报的分散程度保持稳定，而由于资本配置不当导致的生产率损失也显著增加。我们建立了一个包含规模依赖型金融摩擦的模型，该模型与企业在生产和资产负债表数据中的行为特征相符。我们说明了实际利率的下降——通常被认为是由欧元趋同过程引起的——会导致部门总要素生产率显著下降，因为资本流入被错误地分配给了那些净资产较高，但并不一定更具生产能力的企业。我们在意大利和葡萄牙也观察到了类似的分散度和生产率损失趋势，但在德国、法国和挪威则没有这种现象。

abstract.text: This article performs a welfare analysis of markets with private information in which agents condition on prices in the rational expectations tradition. Price-contingent strategies introduce two externalities in the use of private information: a pecuniary externality and a learning externality. The pecuniary externality induces agents to put too much weight on private information and in the standard case, when the allocation role of the price prevails over its informational role, overwhelms the learning externality which impinges in the opposite way. The price may be very informative but at the cost of an excessive dispersion of the actions of agents. The welfare loss at the market solution may be increasing in the precision of private information. The analysis provides insights into optimal business cycle policy and a rationale for a Tobin-like tax for financial transactions.

10.1093/res/rdw062.abstractZh: 本文对具有私人信息的市场进行了福利分析，其中代理人基于理性预期传统中的价格进行决策。价格依赖策略在利用私人信息时引入了两种外部性：金钱外部性和学习外部性。金钱外部性导致代理人过度依赖私人信息，在标准情况下，当价格的作用优先于其信息作用时，学习外部性的影响会被削弱。价格虽然可能具有很高信息价值，但会导致代理人行为的过度分散。市场解决方案下的福利损失可能随着私人信息的精确度增加而加剧。该分析为最优商业周期政策提供了见解，并为实施类似托宾的金融交易税提供了理论依据。

abstract.text: All individuals face some risk of ending up old, sick, alone, and poor. Is there a role for social insurance for these risks and, if so, what is a good programme? A large literature has analysed the costs and benefits of pay-as-you-go public pensions and found that the costs exceed the benefits. This article, instead, considers means-tested social insurance (MTSI) programmes for retirees such as Medicaid and Supplemental Security Income. We find that the welfare gains from these programmes are large. Moreover, the current scale of MTSI in the U.S. is too small in the following sense. If we condition on the current Social Security programme, increasing the scale of MTSI by 1/3 benefits both the poor and the affluent when a payroll tax is used to fund the increase.

10.1093/restud/rdw016.abstractZh: 所有个体都面临着年老、疾病、孤独和贫困的风险。对于这些风险，社会保障是否应该发挥作用？如果发挥作用，那么什么样的计划才合适呢？大量文献分析了现收现付型公共养老金的成本与收益，发现成本超过了收益。而本文则探讨了针对退休人员的福利性社会保障计划，例如医疗补助和补充安全收入计划。我们发现，这些计划的福利收益是巨大的。此外，美国目前的社会保障计划规模太小，如果以当前的社会保障计划为基础，将社会保障计划的规模增加三分之一，那么无论是穷人还是富人都会受益，因为这部分增加的费用可以通过工资税来支付。

abstract.text: Using a new narrative measure of fiscal policy shocks for the U.K., we show that households with mortgage debt exhibit large and significant consumption responses to tax changes.Homeowners without a mortgage, in contrast, do not adjust their expenditure, with responses not statistically different from zero at all horizons.We compare our findings to the predictions of traditional and newer theories of liquidity constraints, providing a novel interpretation for the aggregate effects of tax changes on the macroeconomy.

10.1093/restud/rdw021.abstractZh: 通过使用一种新的财政政策冲击衡量方法对英国进行研究，我们发现拥有抵押贷款的家庭对税收变化表现出较大且显著的消费反应。相比之下，没有抵押贷款的房主则不会调整其支出，其反应在任意时间点上都与零无显著差异。我们将我们的研究结果与传统理论及更新的流动性约束理论所提出的预测进行了比较，为税收变化对宏观经济总体影响的解释提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: Many health care treatments are not urgent and may be delayed if patients so choose. Because insurance coverage is typically determined by the treatment date, individuals may have incentives to strategically delay treatments to minimize out-of-pocket costs. The strategic delay of treatment—a particular form of moral hazard—can be an important source of subsequent adverse selection, in which ex ante identical individuals select insurance coverage based on their differing accumulation of previously delayed treatments. This article investigates these forces empirically in the context of the missing market for dental insurance. Using rich claim-level data, my analysis reveals that approximately 40% of individuals strategically delay dental treatments when incentivized to do so, and this flexibility in delaying treatment can explain why the market for dental insurance has largely unraveled. More generally, the counterfactual analysis suggests features such as open enrolment periods and contracting on pre-existing conditions may be helpful tools in overcoming adverse selection in insurance contexts where the timing of uncertainty is not contractible.

10.1093/restud/rdw022.abstractZh: 许多医疗保健治疗并不紧急，患者可以选择推迟治疗。由于保险覆盖通常根据治疗日期来确定，个人可能会有动机策略性地推迟治疗，以最小化自付费用。这种治疗的战略性延迟——一种特殊形式的道德风险——可能是后续不良选择的来源，在这种情况下，原本相同的个体会根据之前推迟治疗的累积情况来选择保险覆盖。本文通过实证分析探讨了这些现象在牙科保险缺失市场的背景下。利用丰富的索赔数据，我的分析显示，大约40%的个体在受到激励时会策略性地推迟牙科治疗，这种延迟治疗的灵活性可以解释为什么牙科保险市场已经基本瓦解。更普遍地说，反事实分析表明，诸如开放注册期和对既往病史的承保等特征，可能是克服保险领域不良选择的有效工具，尤其是在不确定性无法被契约化的情况下。

abstract.text: Decentralization can improve service delivery, but it can also generate externalities across jurisdictional boundaries. We examine the nature and size of water pollution externalities as rivers flow across jurisdictions. Panel data on water pollution in Brazilian rivers coupled with county splits that change the locations of borders allow us to identify the spatial patterns of pollution as rivers approach and cross borders, controlling for fixed effects and trends specific to each location. The theory of externalities predicts that pollution should increase at an increasing rate as the river approaches the downstream exit border, that there should be a structural break in the slope of the pollution function at the border, and that a larger number of managing jurisdictions should exacerbate pollution externalities. We find support for all four predictions in the data. Satellite data on growth in night-time lights along rivers show that local authorities allow more settlements to develop close to rivers in the downstream portions of counties, which is the likely underlying mechanism. The border effects on pollution are not as pronounced when the cost of inter-jurisdictional coordination is lower.

10.1093/restud/rdw023.abstractZh: 去中心化可以提高服务交付效率，但同时也可能在不同管辖区域之间产生外部性。我们研究了河流流经不同管辖区域时，水污染外部性的性质和规模。通过巴西河流的水污染面板数据，并结合改变边界位置的县级划分，我们能够识别出河流接近和穿越边界时污染的空间分布模式，同时控制了各地区的固定效应和趋势。外部性理论预测，随着河流接近下游出口边界，污染率应以递增的速度上升；在边界处，污染函数的斜率应出现结构性突变；而且，管理区域数量的增加会加剧污染外部性。我们在数据中发现了所有这四个预测的支持。关于河流沿线夜间灯光增长的卫星数据表明，当地当局允许更多的定居点在县级区域的下游部分靠近河流发展，这可能是潜在的机制。当跨管辖区域协调的成本较低时，边界对污染的影响就不那么明显了。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of contracts with limited enforcement in the context of a dynamic relationship. The seller is privately informed on his persistent cost, while the buyer remains uninformed. Public enforcement relies on remedies for breaches. Private enforcement comes from terminating the relationship. We first characterize enforcement constraints under asymmetric information. Those constraints ensure that parties never breach contracts. In particular, a high-cost seller may be tempted to trade high volumes at high prices at the beginning of the relationship before breaching the contract later on. Such “take-the-money-and-run” strategy becomes less attractive as time passes. It can thus be prevented by backloading payments and increasing volumes over a transitory phase. In a mature phase, enforcement constraints are slack and the optimal contract, although keeping memory of the shadow cost of enforcement constraints binding earlier on, looks stationary. Second-best distortions depend on a modified virtual cost that encapsulates this shadow cost of enforcement.

10.1093/restud/rdw024.abstractZh: 我们在一个动态关系的背景下，发展了一种有限执行合同的理论。卖方对其持续成本有私人信息，而买方则一无所知。公共执行依赖于违约的补救措施，而私人执行则通过终止关系来实现。我们首先描述了在信息不对称情况下的执行约束。这些约束确保各方永远不会违约。特别是，高成本的卖方可能会在关系初期试图以高价交易大量商品，之后再违约。这种“收钱就跑”的策略随着时间的推移变得不那么有吸引力。因此，可以通过在过渡阶段逐步增加支付和交易量来防止这种情况。在成熟阶段，执行约束变得宽松，最优合同虽然保留了早期执行约束的影子成本，但看起来是稳定的。次优的扭曲取决于一个修改后的虚拟成本，该成本包含了执行约束的影子成本。

abstract.text: While neoclassical theory emphasizes the impact of trade on wage inequality between occupations and sectors, more recent theories of firm heterogeneity point to the impact of trade on wage dispersion within occupations and sectors. Using linked employer–employee data for Brazil, we show that much of overall wage inequality arises within sector–occupations and for workers with similar observable characteristics; this within component is driven by wage dispersion between firms; and wage dispersion between firms is related to firm employment size and trade participation. We then extend the heterogenous-firm model of trade and inequality from Helpman et al. (2010) and estimate it with Brazilian data. We show that the estimated model provides a close approximation to the observed distribution of wages and employment. We use the estimated model to undertake counterfactuals, in which we find sizable effects of trade on wage inequality.

10.1093/restud/rdw025.abstractZh: 新古典理论强调贸易对职业和行业间工资不平等的影响，而近期关于企业异质性的理论则指出贸易对职业和行业内部工资差异的影响。我们利用巴西的雇主-雇员关联数据发现，总体工资不平等在很大程度上源于行业内部以及具有相似特征的工作者之间的工资差异；这种内部差异是由企业间的工资差异驱动的，而企业间的工资差异又与企业的规模及贸易参与程度有关。随后，我们基于Helpman等人（2010年）提出的异质企业贸易与不平等模型，使用巴西数据对该模型进行了实证检验。结果显示，该模型能够很好地近似反映观察到的工资和就业分布。我们利用该模型进行了反事实分析，发现贸易对工资不平等具有显著的影响。

abstract.text: This article studies the structural transformation of Russia in 1885–1940 from an agrarian to an industrial economy through the lens of a two-sector neoclassical growth model. We construct a data set that covers Tsarist Russia during 1885–1913 and Soviet Union during 1928–1940. We develop a methodology that allows us to identify the types of frictions and economic mechanisms that had the largest quantitative impact on Russian economic development. We find that entry barriers and monopoly power in the non-agricultural sector were the most important reason for Tsarist Russia’s failure to industrialize before World War I. Soviet industrial transformation after 1928 was achieved primarily by reducing such frictions, albeit coinciding with a significantly lower performance of productivity in both agricultural and non-agricultural sectors. We find no evidence that Tsarist agricultural institutions were a significant barrier to labour reallocation to manufacturing, or that “Big Push” mechanisms were a major driver of Soviet growth.

10.1093/restud/rdw026.abstractZh: 本文通过双部门新古典增长模型的研究视角，探讨了1885至1940年间俄罗斯从农业经济向工业经济的结构性转变。我们构建了一个涵盖1885至1913年沙俄时期以及1928至1940年苏联时期的数据集。我们开发了一种研究方法，能够识别出对俄罗斯经济发展产生最大量化影响的摩擦和经济机制。研究发现，非农业部门的进入壁垒和垄断力量是沙俄在第一次世界大战前未能实现工业化的主要原因。1928年之后的苏联工业转型主要是通过减少这些摩擦实现的，尽管在此过程中农业和非农业部门的生产效率都显著下降。我们没有发现沙俄的农业制度对劳动力向制造业转移构成重大障碍，也没有发现“大推动”机制是苏联经济增长的主要驱动力。

abstract.text: Principals often operate on misspecified models of their agents’ preferences. When preferences are such that non-local incentive constraints may bind in the optimum, even slight misspecification of the preferences can lead to large and non-vanishing losses. Instead, we propose a two-step scheme whereby the principal: (1) identifies the model-optimal menu; and (2) modifies prices by offering to share with the agent a fixed proportion of the profit she would receive if an item were sold at the model-optimal price. We show that her loss is bounded and vanishes smoothly as the model converges to the truth. Finally, two-step mechanisms without a sharing rule like (2) will not yield a valid approximation.

10.1093/restud/rdw030.abstractZh: 委托人常常基于错误的模型来推断代理人偏好的情况。当偏好存在非局部激励约束时，即使偏好的轻微错误也可能导致巨大且不可消除的损失。因此，我们提出了一种两步机制：首先，委托人确定模型最优的菜单方案；其次，通过提供与代理人分享在模型最优价格下获得的利润的固定比例，来修改价格。我们证明，随着模型逐渐接近真实情况，代理人的损失是有界的，并且会平滑地消失。最后，没有像第二步那样分享机制的两步机制无法得到有效的近似解。

abstract.text: Individual earnings are higher in bigger cities.We consider three reasons: spatial sorting of initially more productive workers, static advantages from workers' current location, and learning by working in bigger cities. Using rich administrative data for Spain, we find that workers in bigger cities do not have higher initial unobserved ability as reflected in fixed effects. Instead, they obtain an immediate static premium and accumulate more valuable experience. The additional value of experience in bigger cities persists after leaving and is stronger for those with higher initial ability. This explains both the higher mean and greater dispersion of earnings in bigger cities.

10.1093/restud/rdw031.abstractZh: 在较大的城市中，个人的收入更高。我们提出了三个原因：最初生产力更高的工人在空间上的排序、工人当前所在位置的静态优势，以及在较大城市中工作的学习机会。利用西班牙丰富的行政数据，我们发现较大城市的工人并没有表现出更高的初始未观测能力，这一点从固定效应中可以看出。相反，他们立即获得了静态优势，并积累了更有价值的经验。在较大城市中获得的经验价值在离开后仍然持续存在，并且对于初始能力较高的工人来说这种价值更为显著。这解释了较大城市收入均值较高且分布较广的现象。

abstract.text: Searching for partners involves informational persistence that reduces future traders’ matching probability. In this article, traders who are no longer available but who left tracks on the market are called phantoms. We examine a dynamic matching market in which phantoms are a by-product of search activity, no coordination frictions are assumed, and non-phantom traders may lose time trying to match with phantoms. The resulting aggregate matching technology features increasing returns to scale in the short run, but has constant returns to scale in the long run. We embed a generalized version of this matching function in the canonical continuous-time equilibrium search unemployment model. Long-run constant returns to scale imply there is a unique steady state, whereas short-run increasing returns generate excess volatility in the short run and endogenous fluctuations based on self-fulfilling prophecies.

10.1093/restud/rdw032.abstractZh: 寻找合作伙伴涉及信息持续性的影响，这会降低未来交易者的匹配概率。在本文中，那些不再在市场上活跃但留下了痕迹的交易者被称为“幽灵”。我们研究了一个动态匹配市场，在这个市场中，幽灵是搜索活动的副产品，假设没有协调摩擦，非幽灵交易者可能会花费时间试图与幽灵进行匹配。由此产生的整体匹配技术在短期内具有规模报酬递增的特点，但在长期内则保持规模报酬不变。我们将这种匹配函数的一个广义版本嵌入到典型的连续时间均衡搜索失业模型中。长期规模报酬不变意味着存在唯一的稳定状态，而短期规模报酬递增则会导致短期的过度波动，以及基于自我实现的预言而产生的内生波动。

abstract.text: Affluent households can respond to taxation with means that are not economically viable for the rest of the population, such as sophisticated tax plans and international tax arbitrage. This article studies an economy in which an inequality-averse social planner faces agents who have access to a tax-avoidance technology with subadditive costs, and who can shape the risk profile of their income as they see fit. Subadditive avoidance costs imply that optimal taxation cannot be progressive at the top. This in turn may trigger excessive risk-taking. When the avoidance technology consists in costly migration between two countries that compete fiscally, we show that an endogenous increase in inequality due to risk-taking makes progressive taxation more fragile, which vindicates in turn risk-taking and can lead to equilibria with regressive tax rates at the top, and high migrations of wealth towards the smaller country.

10.1093/restud/rdw033.abstractZh: 富裕家庭可以通过其他在经济上不可行的手段来应对税收，例如复杂的税务规划和国际税务套利。本文研究了一个经济环境，其中一位厌恶不平等的社会规划者面对的是那些能够使用具有次加性成本的避税技术的代理人，他们可以自行决定其收入的风险特征。次加性避税成本意味着最优税收制度不可能在顶层实现累进性。这反过来可能会引发过度冒险行为。当避税技术表现为在财政上竞争的两国之间进行昂贵的迁移时，我们发现由于冒险行为导致的不平等内生性增加会使累进税制更加脆弱，这反过来又支持了冒险行为，并可能导致顶层税率的递减，以及财富大量向较小的国家迁移的均衡状态。

abstract.text: In many markets, goods flow from initial producers to final customers travelling through many layers of intermediaries and information is asymmetric. We study a dynamic model of bargaining in networks that captures these features. We show that the equilibrium price demanded over time is non-monotonic, but the sequence of transaction prices declines over time, with the possible exception of the last period. The price dynamic is, therefore, reminiscent of fire-sales and hot-potato trading. Traders who intermediate the object arise endogenously and make a positive profit. The profit-earning intermediaries are not necessarily traders with many connections; for the case of multilayer networks, they belong to the path that reaches the maximum number of potential buyers using the minimal number of intermediaries. This is not necessarily the path of the network that maximizes the probability of consumption by traders who value the most the object (i.e. welfare).

10.1093/restud/rdw034.abstractZh: 在许多市场中，商品从初始生产者流向最终消费者，过程中会经过多层中间商，信息呈不对称状态。我们研究了一个动态网络中的讨价还价模型，以捕捉这些特征。我们发现，随着时间的推移，均衡价格呈现非单调变化，但交易价格序列会随时间下降，最后一个时期可能除外。因此，价格动态类似于抢购和炒货交易。从事商品中介交易的中介机构是内生产生的，并且能够获得正利润。这些盈利的中介机构不一定拥有大量人脉；在多层网络的情况下，它们属于能够用最少的中介机构联系到最多潜在买家的路径。这并不一定是最能最大化交易者消费概率的网络路径（即最有利于福利的路径）。

abstract.text: We explore subjective performance reviews in long-term employment relationships. We show that firms benefit from separating the task of evaluating the worker from the task of paying him. The separation allows the reviewer to better manage the review process, and can, therefore, reward the worker for his good performance with not only a good review contemporaneously, but also a promise of better review in the future. Such reviews spread the reward for the worker’s good performance across time and lower the firm’s maximal temptation to renege on the reward. The manner in which information is managed exhibits patterns consistent with a number of well-documented biases in performance reviews.

10.1093/restud/rdw035.abstractZh: 我们探讨了长期雇佣关系中的主观绩效评估问题。我们发现，将评估员工的工作任务与支付薪酬的任务分开，对公司是有益的。这种分离使得评估者能够更好地管理评估过程，因此，不仅可以立即给予员工良好的评估作为奖励，还可以承诺未来给予更好的评估。这样的评估方式将员工良好表现的奖励分散到不同时间，从而降低了公司放弃这种奖励的最大诱惑。信息的管理方式呈现出与许多已记录的绩效评估偏见一致的模式。

abstract.text: We study optimal taxation of bequests and inter vivos transfers in a model where altruistic parents and their offspring disagree on intertemporal trade-offs. We show that the laissez-faire equilibrium is Pareto inefficient, and whenever offspring are impatient from their parents’ perspective, optimal policy involves a positive tax on parental transfers. Cautioned by the technical complications present in this class of models, our normative prescriptions do not rely on the assumption of differentiability of the agents’ policy functions.

10.1093/restud/rdw036.abstractZh: 我们研究在一种模型中遗产和生前转让的最优税收问题，该模型中的利他主义父母与其后代在跨时期的权衡上存在分歧。我们指出，放任自由的均衡是帕累托无效的，而且当后代从父母的角度来看缺乏耐心时，最优政策包括对父母转让征收正税。鉴于这类模型中存在的技术复杂性，我们的规范性建议并不依赖于代理人政策函数可微分的假设。

abstract.text: We analyse conditions facilitating profitable deception in a simple model of a competitive retail market. Firms selling homogenous products set anticipated prices that consumers understand and additional prices that naive consumers ignore unless revealed to them by a firm, where we assume that there is a binding floor on the anticipated prices. Our main results establish that “bad” products (those with lower social surplus than an alternative) tend to be more reliably profitable than “good” products. Specifically, (1) in a market with a single socially valuable product and sufficiently many firms, a deceptive equilibrium—in which firms hide additional prices—does not exist and firms make zero profits. But perversely, (2) if the product is socially wasteful, then a profitable deceptive equilibrium always exists. Furthermore, (3) in a market with multiple products, since a superior product both diverts sophisticated consumers and renders an inferior product socially wasteful in comparison, it guarantees that firms can profitably sell the inferior product by deceiving consumers. We apply our framework to the mutual fund and credit card markets, arguing that it explains a number of empirical findings regarding these industries.

10.1093/restud/rdw037.abstractZh: 我们在一个简单的竞争性零售市场模型中分析了促进盈利性欺骗的条件。销售同质产品的企业会设定消费者能够理解的预期价格，以及一些天真消费者会忽略的额外价格，除非企业向消费者揭示这些信息。我们假设预期价格存在一个约束性的下限。我们的主要结果表明，“劣质”产品（那些社会剩余低于替代品的商品）往往比“优质”产品更有可能实现盈利。具体来说，(1)在一个只有一种具有社会价值的商品和足够多的企业的市场中，不存在企业隐藏额外价格的欺骗性均衡，企业也不会获得任何利润。但反常的是，(2)如果该产品具有社会浪费性，那么总是存在盈利性的欺骗性均衡。此外，(3)在有多款产品的市场中，由于优质产品能够吸引精明的消费者，并使劣质产品显得更加社会浪费，因此企业可以通过欺骗消费者来盈利地销售劣质产品。我们将这一框架应用于共同基金和信用卡市场，认为它能够解释这些行业中的许多实证发现。

abstract.text: We propose and analyse a general model of priority races. Researchers privately have breakthroughs and decide how long to let their ideas mature before disclosing them, thereby establishing priority. Two-researcher, symmetric priority races have a unique equilibrium that can be characterized by a differential equation. We study how the shapes of the breakthrough distribution and of the returns to maturation affect maturation delays and research quality, both in dynamic and comparative statics analyses. Making researchers better at discovering new ideas or at developing them has contrasted effects on research quality. Being closer to the technological frontier enhances the value of maturation for researchers, which mitigates the negative impact on research quality of the race for priority. Finally, when researchers differ in their abilities to do creative work or in the technologies they use to develop their ideas, more efficient researchers always let their ideas mature more than their less efficient opponents. Our theoretical results shed light on academic competition, patent races, and innovation quality.

10.1093/restud/rdw038.abstractZh: 我们提出并分析了一个关于优先竞争的一般模型。研究人员在私下取得突破后，会决定让这些想法成熟多久后再公开，从而确立自己的优先权。具有两位研究人员的对称优先竞争机制存在一个独特的均衡状态，该均衡可以通过微分方程来描述。我们研究了突破分布和成熟回报的形态如何影响成熟延迟以及研究质量，这些研究既涉及动态分析，也涉及静态分析。让研究人员更擅长发现新想法或开发新想法，会对研究质量产生不同的影响。更接近技术前沿的研究人员，其成熟所带来的价值更高，这在一定程度上缓解了优先权竞争对研究质量的负面影响。最后，当研究人员在创造性工作能力或用于开发想法的技术方面存在差异时，更有效率的研究人员总是会让自己的想法比那些效率较低的对手成熟得更多。我们的理论结果为学术竞争、专利竞争以及创新质量提供了有益的启示。

abstract.text: We study the manipulability of stable matching mechanisms. To quantify incentives to manipulate stable mechanisms, we consider markets with random cardinal utilities, which induce ordinal preferences over match partners. We show that most agents in large matching markets are close to being indifferent of overall stable matchings. In one-to-one matching, the utility gain by manipulating a stable mechanism does not exceed the gap between utilities from the best and worst stable partners. Thus, most agents in a large market would not have significant incentives to manipulate stable mechanisms. The incentive compatibility extends to many-to-one matching when agents employ truncation strategies and capacity manipulations in a Gale—Shapley mechanism.

10.1093/restud/rdw041.abstractZh: 我们研究了稳定匹配机制的操纵可能性。为了量化操纵稳定机制的激励，我们考虑了具有随机基数效用的市场，这些效用会引发对匹配对象的序数偏好。我们表明，在大型匹配市场中，大多数代理人对整体稳定匹配几乎无差别。在一对一匹配中，操纵稳定机制所获得的效用增益不会超过最佳和最差匹配对象之间的效用差距。因此，在大型市场中，大多数代理人不会有显著的动机去操纵稳定机制。当代理人采用截断策略并在Gale-Shapley机制中进行容量操纵时，这种激励相容性也适用于多对一匹配。

abstract.text: We show that healthcare providers face a tradeoff between increasing the number of patients they treat and improving their quality of care. To measure the magnitude of this quality-quantity tradeoff, we estimate a model of dialysis provision that explicitly incorporates a centre’s unobservable and endogenous choice of treatment quality while allowing for unobserved differences in productivity across centres. We find that a centre that reduces its quality standards such that its expected rate of septic infections increases by 1 percentage point can increase its patient load by 1.6%, holding productivity, capital, and labour fixed; this corresponds to an elasticity of quantity with respect to quality of |$-$|0.2. Notably, our approach provides estimates of productivity that control for differences in quality, whereas traditional methods would misattribute lower-quality care to greater productivity.

10.1093/restud/rdw042.abstractZh: 我们指出，医疗服务提供者面临着一个权衡：是增加治疗的患者数量，还是提高护理质量。为了衡量这一质量与数量之间的权衡程度，我们建立了一个透析供应模型，该模型明确考虑了中心无法观测且内生性的治疗质量选择，同时允许不同中心在生产力上存在差异。我们发现，如果一个中心降低其质量标准，导致其预期败血症感染率增加1个百分点，那么在保持生产力、资本和劳动力不变的情况下，该中心的患者数量可以增加1.6%；这一关系对应的质量与数量弹性为|$-$|0.2。值得注意的是，我们的方法能够估算出控制质量差异的生产力指标，而传统方法则会将较低质量的护理归因于较高的生产力。

abstract.text: We experimentally analyse distributional preferences when a decider chooses the provision of a good that benefits herself or a receiver, and creates costs for a group of payers. The treatment variation is the number of payers. We observe that subjects provide the good even if there are many payers so that the costs of provision exceed the benefits by far. This result holds regardless of whether the provision increases the decider’s payoff or not. Intriguingly, it is not only selfish or maximin types who provide the good. Rather, we show that a substantial fraction of subjects are “insensitive to group size”: they reveal to care about the payoff of all parties, but attach the same weight to small and large groups so that they ignore large provision costs that are dispersed among many payers. Our results have important consequences for the approval of policies with concentrated benefits and large, dispersed cost, as well as the analysis of ethical behaviour, medical decision-making, and charity donations.

10.1093/restud/rdw043.abstractZh: 我们通过实验分析当决策者选择提供对自己或接收者有利的商品时，如何分配偏好，同时给一组支付者带来成本的情况。实验的变量是支付者的数量。我们发现，即使有众多支付者，受试者仍然会提供商品，因为提供的成本远远超过了收益。这一结果无论提供商品是否增加了决策者的收益都是成立的。有趣的是，提供商品的不仅仅是自私或追求最大利益的类型。我们观察到，相当一部分受试者“对群体规模不敏感”：他们表现出关心所有方的收益，但对小规模和大规模群体给予相同的权重，从而忽略了分散在许多支付者之间的巨大提供成本。我们的研究结果对于评估具有集中收益和分散成本的政策的合理性，以及分析伦理行为、医疗决策和慈善捐赠具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We derive the incentive compatible and ex-ante welfare maximizing (⁠|$i.e.$| utilitarian) mechanism for settings with an arbitrary number of agents and alternatives where the privately informed agents have single-crossing and single-peaked preferences. The optimal outcome can be implemented by modifying a sequential voting scheme that is used in many legislatures and committees. The modification uses a flexible majority threshold for each of several alternatives, and allows us to replicate, via a single sequential procedure, the entire class of anonymous, unanimous, and dominant strategy incentive compatible mechanisms. Our analysis relies on elegant characterizations of this class of mechanisms for single-peaked and single-crossing preferences.

10.1093/restud/rdw044.abstractZh: 我们推导出了一种激励相容且能最大化事前福利的（即功利主义）机制，适用于任意数量的代理人和多重选择的情况，其中私人信息良好的代理人具有单一交叉偏好和单一峰偏好。最优结果可以通过修改一种常用于许多立法机构和委员会的序贯投票方案来实现。该修改方案为多个选择方案设置了灵活的多数决阈值，并允许我们通过单一的序贯程序来复制所有匿名、一致性和支配策略激励相容机制。我们的分析依赖于对这类机制在单一峰偏好和单一交叉偏好下的优雅描述。

abstract.text: This article estimates peer effects originating from the ability composition of tutorial groups for undergraduate students in economics. We manipulated the composition of groups to achieve a wide range of support, and assigned students—conditional on their prior ability—randomly to these groups. The data support a specification in which the impact of group composition on achievement is captured by the mean and standard deviation of peers’ prior ability, their interaction, and interactions with students’ own prior ability. When we assess the aggregate implications of these peer effects regressions for group assignment, we find that low- and medium-ability students gain on an average 0.19 SD units of achievement by switching from ability mixing to three-way tracking. Their dropout rate is reduced by 12 percentage points (relative to a mean of 0.6). High-ability students are unaffected. Analysis of survey data indicates that in tracked groups, low-ability students have more positive interactions with other students, and are more involved. We find no evidence that teachers adjust their teaching to the composition of groups.

10.1093/restud/rdw045.abstractZh: 本文估计了来自经济学本科学生辅导小组能力构成所带来的同伴效应。我们改变了小组的构成，以形成多样化的支持环境，并基于学生的先前能力，随机将学生分配到这些小组中。数据支持这样一种假设：小组构成对学业成绩的影响可以通过同伴先前能力的均值和标准差、同伴之间的互动以及同伴与自身先前能力的互动来体现。当我们评估这些同伴效应回归结果对小组分配的总体影响时，我们发现低能力和中等能力的学生通过从混合能力小组转变为三向跟踪小组，平均可以获得0.19个标准差单位的学业成绩提升。他们的辍学率也降低了12个百分点（相对于平均值的0.6）。而高能力学生则未受到显著影响。对调查数据的分析表明，在三向跟踪小组中，低能力学生与其他学生的互动更为积极，参与度也更高。我们没有发现教师会根据小组的构成调整教学方式的证据。

abstract.text: In this article we introduce a new computationally tractable framework for Ericson and Pakes-style dynamic oligopoly models that overcomes the computational complexity involved in computing Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE). First, we define a new equilibrium concept that we call moment-based Markov equilibrium (MME), in which firms keep track of their own state, the detailed state of dominant firms, and few moments of the distribution of fringe firms’ states. Second, we provide guidelines to use MME in applied work and illustrate with an application how it can endogenize the market structure in a dynamic industry model even with hundreds of firms. Third, we develop a series of results that provide support for using MME as an approximation. We present numerical experiments showing that MME approximates MPE for important classes of models. Then, we introduce novel unilateral deviation error bounds that can be used to test the accuracy of MME as an approximation in large-scale settings. Overall, our new framework opens the door to study new issues in industry dynamics.

10.1093/restud/rdw047.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个新的计算上可行的框架，用于解决Ericson和Pakes风格的动态寡头垄断模型，该框架克服了计算马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE）所涉及的复杂性问题。首先，我们定义了一个新的均衡概念，称为基于矩的马尔可夫均衡（MME），在这种均衡中，企业会跟踪自己的状态、主导企业的详细状态以及边缘企业状态的几个矩。其次，我们提供了在应用工作中使用MME的指南，并通过一个实例说明了如何在动态行业模型中，即使有数百家企业，也能内生化市场结构。第三，我们开发了一系列结果，以支持将MME作为近似方法的使用。我们通过数值实验表明，对于某些重要模型类别，MME能够近似MPE。此外，我们还提出了新的单边偏差误差界限，这些界限可用于测试MME在大规模环境中的近似精度。总体而言，我们的新框架为研究行业动态中的新问题打开了大门。

abstract.text: This article presents a framework for analysing global identification in log linearized Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) models that encompasses both determinacy and indeterminacy. First, it considers a frequency domain expression for the Kullback–Leibler distance between two DSGE models and shows that global identification fails if and only if the minimized distance equals 0. This result has three features: (1) it can be applied across DSGE models with different structures; (2) it permits checking whether a subset of frequencies can deliver identification; (3) it delivers parameter values that yield observational equivalence if there is identification failure. Next, the article proposes a measure for the empirical closeness between two DSGE models for a further understanding of the strength of identification. The measure gauges the feasibility of distinguishing one model from another based on a finite number of observations generated by the two models. It is shown to represent the highest possible power under Gaussianity when considering local alternatives. The above theory is illustrated using two small-scale and one medium-scale DSGE models. The results document that certain parameters can be identified under indeterminacy but not determinacy, that different monetary policy rules can be (nearly) observationally equivalent, and that identification properties can differ substantially between small and medium-scale models. For implementation, two procedures are developed and made available, both of which can be used to obtain and thus to cross validate the findings reported in the empirical applications. Although the article focuses on DSGE models, the results are also applicable to other vector linear processes with well-defined spectra, such as the (factor-augmented) vector autoregression.

10.1093/restud/rdw048.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于分析对数线性化动态随机一般均衡模型中的全球识别问题，该框架涵盖了确定性与非确定性两种情况。首先，文章提出了一种用于计算两个动态随机均衡模型之间Kullback–Leibler距离的频率域表达方式，并表明全球识别失败的条件仅在于最小化距离等于0。这一结果具有三个特点：(1) 该框架可以应用于结构不同的动态随机均衡模型；(2) 它允许检验某些频率子集是否能够实现识别；(3) 如果识别失败，该框架能够给出使观测值等价化的参数值。接下来，文章提出了一种衡量两个动态随机均衡模型之间实证接近程度的指标，以进一步了解识别的强弱程度。该指标基于两个模型生成的有限数量观测数据，来衡量区分一个模型与另一个模型的可行性。研究表明，在考虑局部替代方案时，该指标能够代表在高斯性假设下的最高可能精度。上述理论通过两个小规模和一個中等规模的动态随机均衡模型进行了验证。研究结果表明，某些参数在非确定性条件下可以被识别，而在确定性条件下则无法被识别；不同的货币政策规则可以（几乎）在观测上等价；小规模和中等规模模型之间的识别特性可能存在显著差异。为了实际应用，文章提出了两种程序，这些程序可用于获取并验证实证应用中的发现。尽管本文主要关注动态随机均衡模型，但这些结果同样适用于其他具有明确定义谱的向量线性过程，例如因子增强的向量自回归模型。

abstract.text: We consider learning and signalling in a dynamic Cournot oligopoly where firms have private information about their production costs and only observe the market price, which is subject to unobservable demand shocks. An equilibrium is Markov if play depends on the history only through the firms’ beliefs about costs and calendar time. We characterize symmetric linear Markov equilibria as solutions to a boundary value problem. In every such equilibrium, given a long enough horizon, play converges to the static complete information outcome for the realized costs, but each firm only learns its competitors’ average cost. The weights assigned to costs and beliefs under the equilibrium strategies are non-monotone over time. We explain this by decomposing incentives into signalling and learning, and discuss implications for prices, quantities, and welfare.

10.1093/restud/rdw049.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个动态的古诺寡头垄断环境中的学习和信号传递问题。在这种环境下，企业拥有关于自身生产成本的私人信息，但只能观察到市场价格，而市场价格则受到不可观测的需求冲击的影响。如果博弈仅通过企业对于成本和日历时间的信念来决定，那么均衡就是马尔可夫的。我们将对称线性马尔可夫均衡描述为边界值问题的解。在每一个这样的均衡中，只要时间足够长，博弈最终会收敛到给定成本下的静态完全信息结果，但每个企业只能了解竞争对手的平均成本。在均衡策略下，成本和信念的权重随时间呈现非单调变化。我们通过将激励分解为信号传递和学习来解释这一现象，并讨论了这对价格、数量和福利的影响。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic general equilibrium model in which the policy rate signals the central bank’s view about macroeconomic developments to price setters. The model is estimated with likelihood methods on a U.S. data set that includes the Survey of Professional Forecasters as a measure of price setters’ inflation expectations. This model improves upon existing perfect information models in explaining why, in the data, inflation expectations respond with delays to monetary impulses and remain disanchored for years. In the 1970s, U.S. monetary policy is found to signal-persistent inflationary shocks, explaining why inflation and inflation expectations were so persistently heightened. The signalling effects of monetary policy also explain why inflation expectations adjusted more sluggishly than inflation after the robust monetary tightening of the 1980s.

10.1093/restud/rdw050.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态一般均衡模型，在该模型中，政策利率反映了中央银行对宏观经济发展的看法，并传递给价格制定者。该模型采用似然方法对美国数据集进行了估计，其中包含了专业预测师调查作为价格制定者通胀预期的衡量指标。该模型改进了现有完全信息模型，解释了为什么在数据中，通胀预期对货币刺激的响应存在延迟，并且多年保持脱离实际的状态。在20世纪70年代，美国的货币政策被发现会持续传递通胀冲击，这解释了为什么通胀和通胀预期会如此持续地上升。货币政策的信号效应也解释了为什么在20世纪80年代强劲的货币紧缩之后，通胀预期的调整速度比通胀本身更为缓慢。

abstract.text: This paper explores the sale of an object to an ambiguity averse buyer. We show that the seller can increase his profit by using an ambiguous mechanism. That is, the seller can benefit from hiding certain features of the mechanism that he has committed to from the agent. We then characterize the profit maximizing mechanisms for the seller and characterize the conditions under which the seller can gain by employing an ambiguous mechanism.

10.1093/restud/rdw051.abstractZh: 本文探讨了将某物品出售给厌恶歧义性的买家的行为。我们指出，卖家可以通过使用一种模糊的机制来增加利润。也就是说，卖家可以从隐藏自己向代理人承诺的某些机制特征中获益。随后，我们描述了卖家利润最大化的机制，并指出了卖家通过运用模糊机制获得利益的必要条件。

abstract.text: We study symmetric information games where a number of senders choose what information to communicate. We show that the impact of competition on information revelation is ambiguous in general. We identify a condition on the information environment (i.e. the set of signals available to each sender) that is necessary and sufficient for equilibrium outcomes to be no less informative than the collusive outcome, regardless of preferences. The same condition also provides an easy way to characterize the equilibrium set and governs whether introducing additional senders or decreasing the alignment of senders' preferences necessarily increases the amount of information revealed.

10.1093/restud/rdw052.abstractZh: 我们研究对称信息博弈，其中一些发送者选择要传达的信息。我们指出，竞争对信息揭示的影响通常是模糊的。我们确定了信息环境的一个条件（即每个发送者可用的信号集合），这个条件对于均衡结果来说是必要的，也是充分的，使其信息量不低于共谋结果，无论偏好如何。同样的条件还提供了一种简单的方法来描述均衡集合，并决定了引入额外的发送者或降低发送者偏好的一致性是否必然会增加揭示的信息量。

abstract.text: We show that state non-separable preferences à la Epstein–Zin–Weil (EZW) provide a tractable and flexible framework to study the economics of health and longevity. This utility representation: (1) admits a preference for timing of resolution of uncertainty regarding mortality risks; (2) links the marginal valuation of survival to the level of survival; (3) can preserve homotheticity even for low degrees of intertemporal substitution without generating implausible predictions regarding the value of life; and (4) adds needed flexibility to account for the empirical evidence on the value of life. We illustrate the implications of EZW preferences for the economic value of observed differences in life expectancy across countries and over time, and for the value of life over the life cycle.

10.1093/restud/rdw053.abstractZh: 我们证明，基于Epstein–Zin–Weil理论的状态非分离偏好为研究健康与寿命经济学提供了一个可行且灵活的框架。这种效用表示方式具有以下特点：(1) 允许对死亡风险不确定性的解决时机进行偏好选择；(2) 将生存的边际估值与生存水平联系起来；(3) 即使在不产生不切实际生命价值预测的情况下，也能保持同伦性；(4) 为解释生命价值的实证证据提供了必要的灵活性。我们通过实例说明了Epstein–Zin–Weil偏好对各国之间及随时间变化的预期寿命差异的经济价值，以及生命周期内生命价值的体现。

abstract.text: A growing literature suggests that high-income countries export high-quality goods. Two hypotheses may explain such specialization, with different implications for welfare, inequality, and trade policy. Fajgelbaum et al. formalize the Linder hypothesis that home demand determines the pattern of specialization and, therefore, predict that high-income locations export high-quality products. The factor-proportions model also predicts that skill-abundant, high-income locations export skill-intensive, high-quality products. Prior empirical evidence does not separate these explanations. I develop a model that nests both hypotheses and employ microdata on U.S. manufacturing plants’ shipments and factor inputs to quantify the two mechanisms’ roles in quality specialization across U.S. cities. Home-market demand explains as much of the relationship between income and quality as differences in factor usage.

10.1093/restud/rdw054.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究表明，高收入国家出口的是高质量商品。有两种假设可以解释这种专业化现象，它们对福利、不平等和贸易政策有不同的影响。Fajgelbaum等人将Linder假设形式化，即国内需求决定了专业化模式，因此他们预测高收入地区会出口高质量产品。要素比例模型也预测，技能丰富的高收入地区会出口技能密集型、高质量产品。然而，先前的实证证据并未区分这两种解释。我开发了一个模型，将这两种假设结合起来，并利用美国制造工厂的发货数据和要素投入数据来量化这两种机制在美国城市质量专业化中的作用。国内市场需求解释了收入与质量之间的关系，以及要素使用差异所起的作用。

abstract.text: We develop a theoretical model with labour market frictions, incomplete financial markets, and with households which have two members. Households face unemployment risks, but their members adjust their labour supplies to insure against unemployment. We use the model to explain the cyclical properties of aggregate employment and participation. As in the U.S. data, the model predicts that the participation rate (the fraction of individuals that want jobs) is not strongly correlated with aggregate economic activity. This property is in sharp contrast to the strongly procyclical participation predicted by both neoclassical models and models with search frictions, when we assume bachelor households or households with infinitely many members (complete markets). In the two-member household model and in the data, primary earners are always in the labour force, secondary earners have a mildly countercyclical participation rate, and a mildly procyclical employment rate. Their behaviour insures the household against unemployment risks.

10.1093/restud/rdw055.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个包含劳动力市场摩擦、金融市场不完善以及家庭由两名成员组成的理论模型。家庭面临失业风险，但其成员会调整劳动力供给以防范失业。我们利用该模型来解释总体就业和参与率的周期性特征。与美国数据类似，该模型预测，参与率（希望找到工作的个体比例）与总体经济活动之间并无强烈相关性。这一特性与新古典模型以及存在搜寻摩擦的模型所预测的强烈顺周期性参与率形成鲜明对比，后者假设家庭由单身成员或无限多成员组成（完全市场）。在两名成员的家庭模型中，主要收入者始终处于劳动力市场中，次要收入者的参与率具有轻微的逆周期特征，而就业率则具有轻微的顺周期特征。他们的行为有助于家庭防范失业风险。

abstract.text: Why do people vote? We design a field experiment to estimate a model of voting “because others will ask”. The expectation of being asked motivates turnout if individuals derive pride from telling others that they voted, or feel shame from admitting that they did not vote, provided that lying is costly.
