In a door-to-door survey about election turnout, we experimentally vary (1) the informational content and use of a flyer pre-announcing the survey, (2) the duration and payment for the survey, and (3) the incentives to lie about past voting. The experimental results indicate significant social image concerns. For the 2010 Congressional election, we estimate a value of voting “to tell others” of about $\$$15, contributing 2 percentage points to turnout. Finally, we evaluate a get-out-the-vote intervention in which we tell potential voters that we will ask if they voted.

10.1093/restud/rdw056.abstractZh: 人们为什么要投票？我们设计了一项实地实验，以估计“因为别人会问”这一投票动机。如果个体从告诉他人自己投票中获得自豪感，或者因承认未投票而感到羞耻，那么被问到的预期会促使他们参与投票，前提是撒谎的成本较高。在一项关于选举投票率的入户调查中，我们通过实验改变了以下因素：（1）在宣布调查前发布的传单的信息内容和使用方式；（2）调查的持续时间和费用；（3）关于过去投票行为的撒谎激励。实验结果表明，社会形象问题对投票行为有显著影响。在2010年国会选举中，我们估计“为了告诉他人”而投票的花费约为15美元，这一因素使投票率增加了2个百分点。最后，我们评估了一项“动员投票”的干预措施，即向潜在选民说明我们会询问他们是否投票。

abstract.text: This article provides direct empirical evidence on the relationship between technology and firms’ global sourcing strategies. Using new data on U.S. firms’ decisions to contract for manufacturing services from domestic or foreign suppliers, I show that a firm’s adoption of communication technology between 2002 and 2007 is associated with a 3.1 point increase in its probability of fragmentation. The effect of firm technology also differs significantly across industries; in 2007, it is 20% higher, relative to the mean, in industries with production specifications that are easier to codify in an electronic format. These patterns suggest that technology lowers coordination costs, though its effect is disproportionately higher for domestic rather than foreign sourcing. The larger impact on domestic fragmentation highlights its importance as an alternative to offshoring, and can be explained by complementarities between technology and worker skill. High technology firms and industries are more likely to source from high human capital countries, and the differential impact of technology across industries is strongly increasing in country human capital.

10.1093/restud/rdw057.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于技术与企业全球采购策略之间关系的直接实证证据。通过利用美国企业选择从国内或国外供应商处采购制造服务的决策数据，我发现，在2002年至2007年间，企业采用通信技术与其企业碎片化概率增加3.1点之间存在关联。企业技术的效应在不同行业间也存在显著差异；在2007年，对于那些生产规格更容易以电子形式编码的行业来说，企业技术的效应比平均水平高出20%。这些现象表明，技术降低了协调成本，但其效应对于国内采购而言更为显著，而非国外采购。对国内企业碎片化影响较大的事实凸显了技术作为替代离岸外包方式的重要性，这一效应可以通过技术与工人技能之间的互补性来解释。高技术的企业和行业更有可能从人力资本较高的国家采购，而技术在不同行业间的差异性与国家人力资本水平密切相关。

abstract.text: We study effort and risk-taking behaviour in an economy with a continuum of principal–agent pairs where each agent exerts costly hidden effort. Principals write contracts based on both absolute and relative performance evaluations (APE and RPE, respectively) to make individually optimal risk–return trade-offs but do not take into account their impact on endogenously determined aggregate variables. This results in contractual externalities when these aggregate variables are used as benchmarks in contracts. Contractual externalities have welfare changing effects when principals put too much weight on APE or RPE due to information frictions. Relative to the second best, if the expected productivity is high, risk-averse principals over-incentivize their own agents, triggering a rat race in effort exertion, resulting in over-investment in effort and excessive exposure to industry risks. The opposite occurs when the expected productivity is low, inducing pro-cyclical investment and risk-taking behaviours.

10.1093/restud/rdw058.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有连续主体-代理对的经济体中的努力和风险承担行为，每个代理都付出昂贵的隐性努力。主体根据绝对和相对绩效评估（分别称为APE和RPE）来制定合同，以实现个体最优的风险回报权衡，但他们并未考虑这些评估对内生决定的总体变量的影响。当这些总体变量被用作合同的基准时，就会产生合同外部性。由于信息障碍，如果主体过于重视APE或RPE，这种外部性会对福利产生变化影响。相对于第二优选择而言，如果预期生产率较高，风险规避的主体会过度激励自己的代理，从而引发努力上的竞争，导致过度投资努力和过度暴露于行业风险中。而当预期生产率较低时，则会导致周期性投资和风险承担行为。

abstract.text: This article analyses the existence and the effects of bubbles in an endogenous growth model with financial frictions and heterogeneous investments. Bubbles are likely to emerge when the degree of pledgeability is in the middle range, implying that improving the financial market might increase the potential for asset bubbles. Moreover, when the degree of pledgeability is relatively low, bubbles boost long-run growth; when it is relatively high, bubbles lower growth. Furthermore, we examine the effects of a bubble burst, and show that the effects depend on the degree of pledgeability, that is, the quality of the financial system. Finally, we conduct a full welfare analysis of asset bubbles.

10.1093/restud/rdw059.abstractZh: 本文分析了一个包含金融摩擦和异质投资的内生增长模型中泡沫的存在及其影响。当抵押程度处于中等范围时，泡沫更有可能出现，这意味着改善金融市场可能会增加资产泡沫的潜力。此外，当抵押程度相对较低时，泡沫会促进长期增长；而当抵押程度相对较高时，泡沫则会降低增长。我们还研究了泡沫破裂的影响，并发现这些影响取决于抵押程度，即金融系统的质量。最后，我们对资产泡沫进行了全面的福利分析。

abstract.text: We study the optimal use of disclosure and fiscal backstops during financial crises.Providing information can reduce adverse selection in credit markets, but negative disclosures can also trigger inefficient bank runs.In our model governments are thus forced to choose between runs and lemons.A fiscal backstop mitigates the risk of runs and allows a government to pursue a high disclosure strategy.Our model explains why governments with strong fiscal positions are more likely to run informative stress tests, and, paradoxically, how they can end up spending less than governments that are more fiscally constrained.

10.1093/restud/rdw060.abstractZh: 我们研究了在金融危机期间信息披露与财政支持的最优使用方式。提供信息可以减少信贷市场中的逆向选择问题，但负面的信息披露也可能引发无效的银行挤兑。因此，在我们的模型中，政府被迫在银行挤兑和“柠檬问题”之间做出选择。财政支持可以减轻挤兑的风险，并使政府能够采取高强度的信息披露策略。我们的模型解释了为什么拥有强大财政实力的政府更有可能进行信息性压力测试，并且，矛盾的是，它们最终可能比财政状况更困难的政府花费更少。

abstract.text: Previous research has established that the predictions of game theory are quite sensitive to the assumptions made about the players’ beliefs. We evaluate the severity of this robustness problem by characterizing conditions on the primitives of the model—the players’ beliefs and higher-order beliefs about the payoff-relevant parameters—for the behaviour of a given Harsanyi type to be approximated by the behaviour of (a sequence of) perturbed types. This amounts to providing belief-based characterizations of the strategic topologies of Dekel et al. (2006). We apply our characterizations to a variety of questions concerning robustness to perturbations of higher-order beliefs, including genericity of types that are consistent with a common prior, and we investigate the connections between our notions of robustness and the notion of common |$p$|-belief of Monderer and Samet (1989).

10.1093/restud/rdw061.abstractZh: 先前的研究已经表明，博弈论的预测对关于玩家信念的假设非常敏感。我们通过描述模型的基本要素——玩家的信念以及关于收益相关参数的高阶信念——的条件来评估这种鲁棒性问题的重要性。这些条件决定了给定Harsanyi类型的行为能否通过一系列扰动类型的近似来体现。这相当于为Dekel等人（2006年）提出的战略拓扑提供了基于信念的表征。我们将这些表征应用于一系列关于高阶信念对扰动鲁棒性的问题，包括与共同先验一致的类型的通用性，并研究了我们的鲁棒性概念与Monderer和Samet（1989年）提出的共同$|p|$信念概念之间的联系。

abstract.text: This article studies multidimensional matching between workers and jobs. Workers differ in manual and cognitive skills and sort into jobs that demand different combinations of these two skills. To study this multidimensional sorting problem, I develop a theoretical framework that generalizes the unidimensional notion of assortative matching and sufficient conditions on the technology under which sorting obtains. I derive the equilibrium in closed form and use this explicit solution to study biased technological change. The main finding is that an increase in worker-job complementarities in cognitive relative to manual inputs leads to more pronounced sorting and wage inequality across cognitive relative to manual skills. This can trigger wage polarization and boost aggregate wage inequality. I then estimate the model for the U.S. and identify sizable technology shifts: during the last two decades, worker-job complementarities in cognitive inputs strongly increased, whereas complementarities in manual inputs decreased. In addition to this bias in complementarities, there has been a cognitive skill-bias in production. Counterfactual exercises suggest that these technology shifts (as opposed to changes in skill supply and demand) can account for observed changes in worker-job sorting, wage polarization and a significant part of the increase in U.S. wage dispersion.

10.1093/restud/rdw063.abstractZh: 本文研究了工人与职位之间的多维匹配问题。工人在手工技能和认知技能上存在差异，因此他们会被分配到需要不同组合这两种技能的职位上。为了研究这一多维匹配问题，我构建了一个理论框架，将单维的匹配概念推广到多维情况，并提出了技术条件对匹配过程的影响。我推导出了封闭形式的均衡解，并利用这一明确解来研究有偏的技术变革。主要发现是，如果工人认知技能相对于手工技能的互补性增加，会导致更明显的匹配差异和工资不平等，这种不平等会加剧工资两极分化，并提升整体工资不平等程度。随后，我对该模型进行了美国层面的实证分析，发现技术变革带来了显著的变化：在过去二十年里，工人的认知技能互补性显著增强，而手工技能的互补性则有所下降。除了这种互补性的偏差外，生产领域还存在认知技能方面的偏向。反事实分析表明，这些技术变革（而非技能供需的变化）可以解释工人匹配、工资两极分化以及美国工资差异扩大的部分原因。

abstract.text: Media outlets are increasingly owned by conglomerates, inducing a conflict of interest: a media outlet can bias its coverage to benefit companies in the same group. We test for bias by examining movie reviews in media outlets owned by News Corp, such as the Wall Street Journal, and Time Warner, such as Time. We find higher ratings for 20th Century Fox movies in News Corp. outlets compared to movies by other studios. To disentangle bias from correlation of taste, we introduce and validate a novel matching procedure using individual movie ratings from online platforms. Using this procedure, we find no evidence of bias in News Corp. nor Time Warner outlets. We reject even small effects, such as bias of one extra star (out of four) every thirteen movies. We test for differential bias when the return to bias is plausibly higher, examine bias by media outlet and by journalist, as well as editorial bias. We also consider bias by omission—whether media outlets are more likely to review highly-rated movies by affiliated studios—and conflict of interest within a movie aggregator. In none of these dimensions do we find evidence of bias. We relate to previous work and discuss three explanations for the lack of bias in our setting: high values of media reputation, organizational features in a conglomerate, and low returns to bias.

10.1093/restud/rdx002.abstractZh: 媒体机构越来越多地由企业集团所拥有，这导致了利益冲突：媒体机构可能会偏袒同一集团内的公司，以使其报道对集团有利。我们通过分析由新闻集团拥有的媒体机构（如《华尔街日报》）和时代华纳拥有的媒体机构（如《时代》杂志）发布的电影评论，来检验这种偏见。结果发现，在新闻集团拥有的媒体机构中，20世纪福克斯公司的电影获得的评分比其他电影要高。为了区分偏见与口味上的相关性，我们引入并验证了一种新的匹配方法，该方法使用在线平台上的个人电影评分。使用这种方法后，我们没有发现新闻集团或时代华纳媒体机构存在偏见。我们甚至排除了一些微小的效应，比如每十三部电影多一个星级的偏见。我们还测试了当偏见的回报较高时是否存在差异性偏见，以及媒体机构和记者之间的偏见，以及编辑偏见。此外，我们还考虑了因遗漏而产生的偏见——即媒体机构是否更倾向于评论附属公司的高评分电影——以及电影聚合器内部的利益冲突。在这些方面，我们都没有发现偏见的证据。我们将我们的结果与之前的研究进行比较，并提出了三种解释，说明为什么在我们的研究环境中不存在偏见：媒体声誉的高价值、企业集团的组织特性，以及偏见的低回报。

abstract.text: This study incorporates a recent preference specification of expectations-based loss aversion, which has been applied broadly in microeconomics, into a classic macro model to offer a unified explanation for three empirical observations about life-cycle consumption. First, loss aversion explains excess smoothness and sensitivity—that is, the empirical observation that consumption responds to income shocks with a lag. Intuitively, such lagged responses allow the agent to delay painful losses in consumption until his expectations have adjusted. Secondly, the preferences generate a hump-shaped consumption profile. Early in life, consumption is low due to a first-order precautionary-savings motive. However, as uncertainty resolves over time, this motive is dominated by time-inconsistent overconsumption that eventually leads to declining consumption towards the end of life. Thirdly, consumption drops at retirement. Prior to retirement, the agent wants to overconsume his uncertain income before his expectations catch up. Post-retirement, however, income is no longer uncertain, and overconsumption is associated with a sure loss in future consumption. As an empirical contribution, I structurally estimate the preference parameters using life-cycle consumption data. My estimates match those obtained in experiments and other micro studies, and generate the degree of excess smoothness observed in macro consumption data.

10.1093/restud/rdx003.abstractZh: 本研究将一种基于期望的损失厌恶偏好模型引入经典宏观模型中，该模型在微观经济学中已得到广泛应用，旨在为关于生命周期消费的三个实证观察结果提供统一解释。首先，损失厌恶解释了消费对收入冲击的过度平滑性和敏感性——即消费对收入冲击的反应存在滞后现象。直观上，这种滞后反应使得消费者能够推迟因消费损失而产生的痛苦，直到其预期调整完毕。其次，这种偏好模式导致消费曲线呈现驼峰状。在生命早期，由于一阶预防性储蓄动机，消费水平较低。然而，随着不确定性的消除，这种动机逐渐被时间不一致的过度消费所取代，最终导致生命末期消费下降。第三，退休时消费水平下降。在退休前，消费者希望在预期调整之前过度消费不确定的收入。然而，退休后，收入不再不确定，过度消费则与未来消费的确定性损失相关联。作为实证贡献，我使用生命周期消费数据来估计偏好参数。我的估计结果与实验和其他微观研究的结果一致，并解释了宏观消费数据中观察到的过度平滑现象。

abstract.text: I present a behavioural model of a “data analyst” who extrapolates a fully specified probability distribution over observable variables from a collection of statistical data sets that cover partially overlapping sets of variables. The analyst employs an iterative extrapolation procedure, whose individual rounds are akin to the stochastic regression method of imputing missing data. Users of the procedure’s output fail to distinguish between raw and imputed data, and it functions as their practical belief. I characterize the ways in which this belief distorts the correlation structure of the underlying data generating process—focusing on cases in which the distortion can be described as the imposition of a causal model (represented by a directed acyclic graph over observable variables) on the true distribution.

10.1093/restud/rdx004.abstractZh: 我提出了一个“数据分析师”的行为模型，该模型从一系列统计数据集中推断出可观测变量的完整概率分布，这些数据集涵盖了部分重叠的变量集。数据分析师采用一种迭代的外推方法，其各个轮次类似于用于填补缺失数据的随机回归方法。使用该方法的用户无法区分原始数据和推断数据，而该方法实际上成为了他们的实际认知。我描述了这种认知如何扭曲基础数据生成过程的相关结构——重点关注那种可以将扭曲描述为将因果模型（由可观测变量的有向无环图表示）施加到真实分布上的情况。

abstract.text: When designing data collection, crucial questions arise regarding how much data to collect and how much effort to expend to enhance the quality of the collected data. To make choice of sample design a coherent subject of study, it is desirable to specify an explicit decision problem. We use the Wald framework of statistical decision theory to study allocation of a budget between two or more sampling processes. These processes all draw random samples from a population of interest and aim to collect data that are informative about the sample realizations of an outcome. They differ in the cost of data collection and the quality of the data obtained. One may incur lower cost per sample member but yield lower data quality than another. Increasing the allocation of budget to a low-cost process yields more data, while increasing the allocation to a high-cost process yields better data. We initially view the concept of “better data” abstractly and then fix attention on two important cases. In both cases, a high-cost sampling process accurately measures the outcome of each sample member. The cases differ in the data yielded by a low-cost process. In one, the low-cost process has non-response and in the other it provides a low-resolution interval measure of each sample member’s outcome. In these settings, we study minimax-regret sample design for prediction of a real-valued outcome under square loss; that is, design which minimizes maximum mean square error. The analysis imposes no assumptions that restrict the unobserved outcomes. Hence, the decision maker must cope with both the statistical imprecision of finite samples and the partial identification of the true state of nature.

10.1093/restud/rdx005.abstractZh: 在设计数据收集方案时，关于收集多少数据以及为提升数据质量需要付出多少努力，这些问题至关重要。为了使样本设计的选择成为一个连贯的研究主题，有必要明确一个决策问题。我们采用统计决策理论的Wald框架来研究在两种或更多抽样过程之间分配预算的方式。这些过程都是从感兴趣的总体中抽取随机样本，并旨在收集能够反映样本结果的信息。它们在不同于数据收集成本和数据质量方面存在差异。一种方法可能每样本成员的成本较低，但数据质量较差；另一种方法则可能成本较高，但数据质量较好。增加预算分配给低成本的过程可以获得更多数据，而增加预算分配给高成本的过程则可以获得更好的数据。我们首先抽象地探讨“更好数据”的概念，然后重点关注两种重要情况。在这两种情况下，高成本的抽样过程都能准确测量每个样本成员的结果。这两种情况的区别在于低成本过程所提供的数据内容。在一种情况下，低成本过程存在无响应问题；在另一种情况下，它提供了对样本成员结果的低分辨率区间测量。在这些情况下，我们研究了在平方损失下预测实值结果的极小极大遗憾样本设计，即最小化最大均方误差的设计。该分析不假设任何限制未观测结果的限制条件。因此，决策者必须应对有限样本的统计不精确性以及自然状态的局部识别问题。

abstract.text: Public regulation is increasingly facing competition from “private politics” in the form of activism and corporate self-regulation. However, its effectiveness, welfare consequences, and interaction with public regulation are poorly understood. This article presents a unified dynamic framework for studying the interaction between public regulation, self-regulation, and boycotts. We show that the possibility of self-regulation saves on administrative costs, but also leads to delays. Without an active regulator, firms self-regulate to preempt or end a boycott and private politics is beneficial for activists but harmful for firms. With an active regulator, in contrast, firms self-regulate to preempt public regulation and private politics is harmful for activists but beneficial for firms. Our analysis generates a rich set of testable predictions that are consistent with the rise of private politics over time and the fact that there is more self-regulation and activism in the U.S., while public regulation continues to be more common in Europe.

10.1093/restud/rdx009.abstractZh: 公共监管正日益面临来自“私人政治”的竞争，后者以行动主义和企业自我监管的形式出现。然而，公共监管的有效性、对社会的福利影响以及其与私人政治之间的互动关系仍缺乏深入的理解。本文提出了一个统一的动态框架，用于研究公共监管、企业自我监管和抵制行为之间的相互作用。我们指出，企业自我监管可以节省行政成本，但也会导致延误。在没有积极监管者的情况下，企业会自我监管以预防或结束抵制行为，而私人政治对活动人士有利，但对企业有害。相反，在有积极监管者的情况下，企业会自我监管以规避公共监管，而私人政治对活动人士有害，但对企业有利。我们的分析提出了一系列可验证的预测，这些预测与私人政治随时间的增长以及美国自我监管和行动主义的增加相一致，而欧洲则仍然普遍采用公共监管。

abstract.text: A hyperbolic discounting model of labour supply and welfare participation with heterogeneous time preference parameters is estimated. Exclusion restrictions are constructed from variations in behaviour induced by time limits in a welfare reform experiment. We find that most individuals are time-inconsistent, and they exhibit varying degrees of present bias and perception of the commitment problem. Introducing a welfare component to the tax system can make individuals worse off by aggravating the commitment problem. Certain dynamic policy interventions carry sizeable commitment-related work incentives; for instance, a dynamic sanction triggered by past employment can be preferred by some individuals as a commitment device.

10.1093/restud/rdx011.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个具有异质时间偏好参数的劳动力供给与福利参与的双曲贴现模型。通过福利改革实验中的时间限制变化，我们推导出排除限制的条件。研究发现，大多数个体存在时间不一致性，并且表现出不同程度的当前偏差和对承诺问题的认知。在税收体系中引入福利成分可能会因加剧承诺问题而让个体处境更糟。某些动态政策干预措施能够带来显著的与承诺相关的工作激励；例如，过去就业引发的动态制裁可能被某些个体视为一种承诺机制。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how legal cannabis access affects student performance. Identification comes from an exceptional policy introduced in the city of Maastricht in the Netherlands that discriminated access via licensed cannabis shops based on an individual’s nationality. We apply a difference-in-difference approach using administrative panel data on course grades of local students enrolled at Maastricht University before and during the partial cannabis prohibition. We find that the academic performance of students who are no longer legally permitted to buy cannabis substantially increases. Grade improvements are driven by younger students and the effects are stronger for women and low performers. In line with how cannabis consumption affects cognitive functioning, we find that performance gains are larger for courses that require more numerical/mathematical skills. Our investigation of underlying channels using course evaluations suggests that performance gains are driven by an improved understanding of the material rather than changes in students’ study effort.

10.1093/restud/rdx020.abstractZh: 本文研究了合法购买大麻对学生学业表现的影响。研究基于荷兰马斯特里赫特市一项特殊的政策，该政策根据个人国籍来区分通过许可经营的大麻店购买大麻的权限。我们采用了差异分解方法，利用马斯特里赫特大学当地学生在大麻禁令实施前后课程成绩的相关行政面板数据进行分析。研究发现，那些不再被允许合法购买大麻的学生学业表现显著提升。成绩改善主要体现在年轻学生身上，且对女性和低成绩学生的影响更为显著。考虑到大麻消费对认知功能的影响，我们发现，对于需要更多数字/数学技能的课程来说，成绩提升更为明显。通过对课程评估的深入分析，我们认为成绩提升是由于学生对课程内容的理解加深，而非学习努力的变化所致。

abstract.text: Do tax cuts and spending increases stimulate output? Studies that identify fiscal shocks using structural vector autoregressions (SVAR) have reached different conclusions. In this article, we show analytically that this lack of consensus reflects different assumptions on the fiscal rules that—by relating tax and spending policies to macroeconomic conditions—determine the identification of fiscal shocks and the associated fiscal multipliers. We then propose a new identification strategy based on a proxy SVAR that uses non-fiscal instruments to directly estimate the parameters of the fiscal rules. We find that spending increases stimulate output more than tax cuts..

10.1093/restud/rdx030.abstractZh: 减税和支出增加是否会刺激产出？利用结构向量自回归模型来识别财政冲击的研究得出了不同的结论。在本文中，我们通过分析表明这种不一致性反映了对财政规则的不同假设——这些假设通过将税收和支出政策与宏观经济状况联系起来，决定了财政冲击的识别及其相关的财政乘数效应。随后，我们提出了一种基于代理SVAR的新识别策略，该策略利用非财政工具直接估计财政规则的参数。我们发现，支出增加对产出的刺激作用比减税更为显著。

abstract.text: We study how the management practices bureaucrats operate under correlate with the quantity of public services delivered, using data from the Nigerian Civil Service. We have hand‐coded independent engineering assessments of 4,700 project completion rates. We supplement this with a management survey in the bureaucracies responsible for these projects, building on Bloom and Van Reenen (2013). Management practices matter: increasing bureaucrats’ autonomy is positively associated with completion rates, yet practices related to incentives/monitoring of bureaucrats are negatively associated with completion rates. Our evidence provides new insights on the importance of management in public bureaucracies in a developing country setting.

10.1111/ecoj.12418.abstractZh: 我们研究了尼日利亚公务员制度的数据，探讨官僚管理实践与所提供的公共服务数量之间的关联。我们手动编码了4700个项目完成率的独立工程评估数据。此外，我们还基于Bloom和Van Reenen（2013）的研究，对负责这些项目的官僚机构进行了管理调查。管理实践至关重要：增加官僚的自主权与项目完成率呈正相关，而与官僚激励/监督相关的实践则与项目完成率呈负相关。我们的研究结果为发展中国家公共官僚机构中管理的重要性提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: This address considers the epidemiology of narratives relevant to economic fluctuations. The human brain has always been highly tuned toward narratives, whether factual or not, to justify ongoing actions, even such basic actions as spending and investing. Stories motivate and connect activities to deeply felt values and needs. Narratives “go viral” and spread far, even worldwide, with economic impact. The 1920–1921 Depression, the Great Depression of the 1930s, the so-called Great Recession of 2007–2009, and the contentious political-economic situation of today are considered as the results of the popular narratives of their respective times. Though these narratives are deeply human phenomena that are difficult to study in a scientific manner, quantitative analysis may help us gain a better understanding of these epidemics in the future. (JEL D72, E32, G01, N10)

10.1257/aer.107.4.967.abstractZh: 本文探讨了与经济波动相关的叙事的流行病学现象。人类大脑天生就倾向于接受各种叙事，无论这些叙事是真实的还是虚假的，它们都能为人们的持续行为提供理由，甚至包括诸如消费和投资这样的基本行为。故事能够激发人们的积极性，并将各种活动与深刻的价值观和需求联系起来。叙事往往能够“病毒式传播”，并在经济领域产生广泛影响。1920-1921年的经济大萧条、1930年代的大萧条、2007-2009年的所谓大衰退，以及当今充满争议的政治经济局势，都是各自时代流行叙事的结果。尽管这些叙事属于人类特有的现象，难以用科学方法进行研究，但定量分析或许能帮助我们未来更好地理解这些“流行病”。(JEL D72, E32, G01, N10)

abstract.text: Oliver Hart delivered his Prize Lecture on 8 December 2016 at the Aula Magna, Stockholm University.

10.1257/aer.107.7.1731.abstractZh: 奥利弗·哈特于2016年12月8日在斯德哥尔摩大学的大礼堂发表了他的获奖演讲。

abstract.text: Incentives are often associated with narrow financial rewards such as bonuses or executive stock options. But in general such rewards are just a small part of the design of incentives. Properly designed incentive systems have to take into account the full portfolio of activities that the agent can engage in, the array of instruments, many nonfinancial, that are available to influence individuals and consider the factors that motivate them in different settings. Thinking about incentives as a system of interacting instruments and influences has been a major advance in the economics of incentives in recent years. In this lecture I will describe the path from pay for performance to the broader view of incentive systems. (JEL D21, D82, D86, J33, J41, M12, M52)

10.1257/aer.107.7.1753.abstractZh: 激励措施通常与诸如奖金或高管股票期权这样的狭义财务奖励相关联。但总体而言，这些奖励只是激励设计的一部分。设计良好的激励系统必须考虑到代理人可以参与的全部活动范围，以及可用于影响个人的多种非财务手段，并考虑在不同情境下激励他们的因素。将激励措施视为一系列相互作用的工具和影响的体系，是近年来激励经济学领域的重要进展。在这场讲座中，我将描述从基于绩效的薪酬到更广泛的激励系统视角的演变过程。（JEL D21, D82, D86, J33, J41, M12, M52）

abstract.text: We show that the stock market may fail to aggregate information even if it appears to be efficient, and that the resulting decrease in the information content of prices may drastically reduce welfare. We solve a macroeconomic model in which information about fundamentals is dispersed and households make small, correlated errors when forming expectations about future productivity. As information aggregates in the market, these errors amplify and crowd out the information content of stock prices. When prices reflect less information, the conditional variance of stock returns rises, causing an increase in uncertainty and costly distortions in consumption, capital accumulation, and labor supply. (JEL D14, D83, D84, E21, E22, E24, G14)

10.1257/aer.20110433.abstractZh: 我们指出，即使股市看似高效，它也可能无法有效聚合信息，而由此导致的价格信息含量的减少可能会大幅降低福利水平。我们研究了一个宏观经济模型，在该模型中，关于基本面的信息分散，家庭在形成对未来生产力的预期时会产生小的、相关的错误。这些信息在市场中聚合后，这些错误会放大并挤占股票价格的信息含量。当价格反映的信息减少时，股票回报的条件方差会上升，从而增加不确定性，并导致消费、资本积累和劳动力供应方面的成本较高的扭曲现象。（JEL D14, D83, D84, E21, E22, E24, G14）

abstract.text: We quantify government spending multipliers in US data using Bayesian prior and posterior analysis of a monetary model with fiscal details and two distinct monetary-fiscal policy regimes. The combination of model specification, observable data, and relatively diffuse priors for some parameters lands posterior estimates in regions of the parameter space that yield fresh perspectives on the transmission mechanisms that underlie government spending multipliers. Short-run output multipliers are comparable across regimes—posterior means around 1.3 on impact—but much larger after 10 years under passive money/active fiscal than under active money/passive fiscal—90 percent credible sets of [1.5, 1.9] versus [0.1, 0.4] in present value, when estimated from 1955 to 2016. (JEL E52, E62, E63, H50)

10.1257/aer.20111196.abstractZh: 我们通过贝叶斯先验和后验分析，利用美国数据来量化政府支出的乘数效应。该分析涉及一个包含财政细节的货币模型，以及两种不同的货币-财政政策体制。模型设定、可观测数据以及一些参数的相对模糊先验，使得后验估计落在参数空间的特定区域，这为理解政府支出乘数效应的传导机制提供了新的视角。短期产出乘数在不同体制下具有可比性——后验均值约为1.3——但在10年后，被动货币/主动财政体制下的乘数效应远大于主动货币/被动财政体制——从1955年到2016年估算的现值下，可信区间分别为[1.5, 1.9]和[0.1, 0.4]。（JEL E52, E62, E63, H50）

abstract.text: We establish new facts about the way consumers allocate debt among their credit cards using data for a representative sample of cardholders in Mexico. We find that relative prices are weak predictors of the allocation of debt, purchases, and payments. Consumers allocate a large fraction of their debt to high-interest cards, incurring a cost of 31 percent above the minimum. Using an experiment, we find that consumers do not substitute in the price margin, although they respond to salient temporary low-interest offers. We conclude that limited attention and mental accounting best rationalize our results and discuss implications for the market. (JEL D14, G21, O12, O16)

10.1257/aer.20120273.abstractZh: 我们利用墨西哥代表性持卡人的数据，发现了关于消费者如何分配债务到信用卡之间的新事实。我们发现，相对价格并不是债务、购买和支付分配的强预测因素。消费者将很大一部分债务分配到高利率的信用卡上，这导致他们承担的成本比最低利率高出31%。通过实验发现，尽管消费者会对临时性的低利率优惠做出反应，但他们并不会改变价格边际。我们得出结论，有限的关注力和心理账户行为最能解释我们的研究结果，并讨论了这些结果对市场的影响。（JEL D14, G21, O12, O16）

abstract.text: We present evidence that cultural proximity (shared codes, beliefs, ethnicity) between lenders and borrowers increases the quantity of credit and reduces default. We identify in-group lending using dyadic data on religion and caste for officers and borrowers from an Indian bank, and a rotation policy that induces exogenous matching between them. Having an in-group officer increases credit access and loan size dispersion, reduces collateral requirements, and induces better repayment even after the in-group officer leaves. We consider a range of explanations and suggest that the findings are most easily explained by cultural proximity serving to mitigate information frictions in lending. (JEL D82, D83, G21, G28, O16, Z12, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20120942.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明借贷双方之间的文化接近性（共同的规范、信仰、种族归属）会增加信贷数量并减少违约行为。我们通过印度一家银行的官员和借款人的宗教与种姓数据，识别出群体内的借贷行为，并采用一种促使他们之间实现外部匹配的旋转策略。拥有群体内的官员能够增加信贷获取机会和贷款规模的分散性，降低抵押要求，并在群体内的官员离开后仍能促进更好的还款行为。我们考虑了多种解释方式，并认为这些发现最有可能由文化接近性所起到的作用来解释，即这种接近性有助于缓解借贷过程中的信息摩擦问题。（JEL D82, D83, G21, G28, O16, Z12, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper establishes a new fact about the compositional changes in the pool of unemployed over the US business cycle. Using microdata from the Current Population Survey for the years 1962–2012, it documents that in recessions the pool of unemployed shifts toward workers with high wages in their previous job and that these shifts are driven by the high cyclicality of separations for high-wage workers. The paper finds that standard theories of wage setting and unemployment have difficulty in explaining these patterns and evaluates a number of alternative theories that do better in accounting for the new fact. (JEL E24, E32, J31, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.20121186.abstractZh: 本文提出了关于美国经济周期中失业人口构成变化的新事实。通过利用1962年至2012年《当前人口调查》的微观数据，本文发现在经济衰退期间，失业人口会转向那些在之前工作中拥有高工资的劳动者。这种转变是由高工资劳动者较高的离职周期性所驱动的。本文指出，传统的工资设定和失业理论难以解释这些现象，并评估了若干能够更好解释这一新事实的替代理论。（JEL E24, E32, J31, J63, J64）

abstract.text: We examine the effects of trade liberalization in China on the evolution of markups and productivity of manufacturing firms. Although these dimensions of performance cannot be separately identified when firm output is measured by revenue, detailed price deflators make it possible to estimate the average effect of tariff reductions on both. Several novel findings emerge. First, cuts in output tariffs reduce markups, but raise productivity. Second, pro-competitive effects are most important among incumbents, while efficiency gains dominate for new entrants. Third, cuts in input tariffs raise both markups and productivity. We highlight mechanisms that explain these findings in the Chinese context. (JEL D24, F13, L25, L60, O14, P31, P33)

10.1257/aer.20121266.abstractZh: 我们研究了中国贸易自由化对制造业企业价格加成和生产率演变的影响。尽管当企业产出以收入衡量时，这些绩效维度无法单独识别，但详细的物价平减指数使得我们可以估算关税降低对两者平均的影响。研究发现了几个新的发现。首先，产出关税的降低会降低价格加成，但会提高生产率。其次，对现有企业而言，促进竞争的效果最为重要，而对于新进入者来说，效率提升更为显著。第三，投入关税的降低会同时提高价格加成和生产率。我们重点探讨了在中文背景下解释这些发现的机制。（JEL D24, F13, L25, L60, O14, P31, P33）

abstract.text: Using Bayesian methods, we estimate a nonlinear DSGE model in which the interest-rate lower bound is occasionally binding. We quantify the size and nature of disturbances that pushed the US economy to the lower bound in late 2008 as well as the contribution of the lower bound constraint to the resulting economic slump. We find that the interest-rate lower bound was a significant constraint on monetary policy that exacerbated the recession and inhibited the recovery, as our mean estimates imply that the zero lower bound (ZLB) accounted for about 30 percent of the sharp contraction in US GDP that occurred in 2009 and an even larger fraction of the slow recovery that followed. (JEL C11, C32, E12, E23, E32, E43, E52, G01)

10.1257/aer.20121437.abstractZh: 我们采用贝叶斯方法，对非线性DSGE模型进行了估计，该模型中利率下限具有偶尔的约束性。我们量化了在2008年末将美国经济推至利率下限的扰动因素的大小和性质，以及利率下限约束对随后经济衰退的影响。研究发现，利率下限对货币政策构成了重大限制，加剧了经济衰退并阻碍了复苏。我们的平均估计表明，零利率下限在2009年导致美国GDP出现约30%的急剧收缩，并在随后的缓慢复苏过程中占据了更大的比例。（JEL C11, C32, E12, E23, E32, E43, E52, G01）

abstract.text: We introduce liquidity frictions into an otherwise standard DSGE model with nominal and real rigidities and ask: can a shock to the liquidity of private paper lead to a collapse in short-term nominal interest rates and a recession like the one associated with the 2008 US financial crisis? Once the nominal interest rate reaches the zero bound, what are the effects of interventions in which the government provides liquidity in exchange for illiquid private paper? We find that the effects of the liquidity shock can be large, and show some numerical examples in which the liquidity facilities of the Federal Reserve prevented a repeat of the Great Depression in the period 2008–2009. (JEL E13, E31, E43, E44, E52, E58, G01)

10.1257/aer.20121660.abstractZh: 我们将流动性摩擦引入一个标准的DSGE模型中，该模型包含名义和实际的刚性因素，并探讨以下问题：私人票据的流动性冲击是否会导致短期名义利率的崩溃，以及是否会引发类似于2008年美国金融危机的衰退？一旦名义利率达到零下限，政府以提供流动性作为交换条件来置换流动性不足的私人票据的干预措施会产生什么影响？我们发现，流动性冲击的影响可能非常显著，并通过一些数值示例表明，美联储的流动性措施成功防止了2008-2009年期间大萧条的重演。（JEL E13, E31, E43, E44, E52, E58, G01）

abstract.text: We build a hybrid model of the aggregate labor market that features both standard labor supply forces and frictions in order to study the cyclical properties of gross worker flows across the three labor market states: employment, unemployment, and nonparticipation. Our parsimonious model is able to capture the key features of the cyclical movements in gross worker flows. Despite the fact that the wage per efficiency unit is constant over time, intertemporal substitution plays an important role in shaping fluctuations in the participation rate. (JEL E24, E32, J22, J31, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20121662.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个混合模型，该模型同时考虑了标准的劳动力供给力量和摩擦因素，以研究三种劳动力市场状态——就业、失业和非参与——下总体劳动力流动的周期性特征。我们的简约模型能够捕捉到总体劳动力流动周期性变动的关键特征。尽管每个效率单位的工资在时间上是恒定的，但跨期替代在塑造参与率的波动中起着重要作用。（JEL E24, E32, J22, J31, J64, J65）

abstract.text: I model the equilibrium risk sharing between countries with varying financial development. The most financially developed country takes greater risks because its financial intermediaries deal with funding problems better. In good times, the more financially developed country consumes more and runs a trade deficit financed by the higher financial income that it earns as compensation for taking greater risk. During global crises, it suffers heavier losses. Its currency emerges as the reserve currency because it appreciates during crises, thus providing a good hedge. I provide evidence that financial net worth plays a crucial role in understanding this asymmetric risk sharing. (JEL E44, F14, F32, G01, G15, G21)

10.1257/aer.20130479.abstractZh: 我模拟了不同金融发展水平国家之间的均衡风险分担情况。金融发展程度较高的国家承担更大的风险，因为其金融中介机构在融资问题上表现更优。在良好时期，金融发展程度较高的国家会进行更多的消费，并因更高的金融收入而产生贸易逆差，以此作为承担更大风险的补偿。而在全球危机期间，该国的损失更为严重。其货币会成为储备货币，因为在危机期间该货币会升值，从而提供良好的对冲手段。我有证据表明，金融净资产在理解这种不对称风险分担中起着至关重要的作用。（JEL E44, F14, F32, G01, G15, G21）

abstract.text: We study cross-country risk sharing as a second-best problem for members of a currency union using an open economy model with nominal rigidities and provide two key results. First, we show that if financial markets are incomplete, the value of gaining access to any given level of aggregate risk sharing is greater for countries that are members of a currency union. Second, we show that even if financial markets are complete, privately optimal risk sharing is constrained inefficient. A role emerges for government intervention in risk sharing both to guarantee its existence and to influence its operation. The constrained efficient risk-sharing arrangement can be implemented by contingent transfers within a fiscal union. We find that the benefits of such a fiscal union are larger, the more asymmetric the shocks affecting the members of the currency union, the more persistent these shocks, and the less open the member economies. Finally, we compare the performance of fiscal unions and of other macroeconomic stabilization instruments available in currency unions such as capital controls, government spending, fiscal deficits, and redistribution. (JEL E62, F31, F32, F41, F45)

10.1257/aer.20130817.abstractZh: 我们研究了货币联盟成员之间的跨国风险共享问题，采用了一个具有名义刚性特征的开放经济模型，并得出了两个关键结论。首先，我们表明如果金融市场不完善，那么对于货币联盟成员来说，获得任何给定水平的风险共享所带来的收益更大。其次，我们指出即使金融市场是完善的，私人最优风险共享仍然会存在效率低下的问题。在这种情况下，政府干预在风险共享中起着重要作用，既可以确保风险共享的顺利进行，又可以影响其运作方式。这种受限但有效的风险共享安排可以通过财政联盟内的转移支付来实现。我们发现，这种财政联盟的好处随着以下因素的增加而增加：影响货币联盟成员的冲击的不对称性、这些冲击的持续性以及成员国经济的开放程度。最后，我们比较了财政联盟与其他宏观经济稳定工具在货币联盟中的表现，如资本管制、政府支出、财政赤字和再分配政策。（JEL E62, F31, F32, F41, F45）

abstract.text: The demand for air quality depends on health impacts and defensive investments, but little research assesses the empirical importance of defenses. A rich quasi-experiment suggests that the Nitrogen Oxides (NO x ) Budget Program (NBP), a cap-and-trade market, decreased NO x emissions, ambient ozone concentrations, pharmaceutical expenditures, and mortality rates. The annual reductions in pharmaceutical purchases, a key defensive investment, and mortality are valued at about $800 million and $1.3 billion, respectively, suggesting that defenses are over one-third of willingness-to-pay for reductions in NO x emissions. Further, estimates indicate that the NBP's benefits easily exceed its costs and that NO x reductions have substantial benefits. (JEL I12, Q51, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20131002.abstractZh: 对空气质量的需求取决于健康影响以及防御性投资，但很少有研究评估防御措施的实际重要性。一项丰富的准实验表明，氮氧化物预算计划（NBP），一种总量控制与交易机制，减少了氮氧化物的排放、环境臭氧浓度、药品支出以及死亡率。药品购买的年度减少，作为一项关键的防御性投资，其带来的价值分别约为8亿美元和13亿美元，这表明防御措施的成本远低于人们愿意为减少氮氧化物排放所支付的费用。此外，估计表明，NBP的效益远远超过其成本，而减少氮氧化物排放具有显著的好处。（JEL I12, Q51, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: This paper models the optimal search strategies of the unemployed across space to characterize local labor markets. Our methodology allows for linkages between numerous areas, while preserving tractability. We estimate that labor markets are quite local, as the attractiveness of jobs to applicants sharply decays with distance. Also, workers are discouraged from searching in areas with strong competition from other job-seekers. However, as labor markets overlap, a local stimulus or transport improvements have modest effects on local outcomes, because ripple effects in job applications dilute their impact across a series of overlapping markets. (JEL J61, J64, R23, R58)

10.1257/aer.20131026.abstractZh: 本文模拟了失业者在空间中的最优搜索策略，以描述本地劳动力市场的情况。我们的研究方法能够连接多个区域，同时保持模型的易处理性。我们估计劳动力市场具有相当强的本地性，因为工作对求职者的吸引力随着距离的增加而显著下降。此外，来自其他求职者的激烈竞争也会使工人不愿在竞争激烈的地区进行搜索。然而，由于劳动力市场之间存在重叠，本地刺激措施或交通改善对本地结果的影响较为有限，因为求职申请中的连锁效应会削弱这些措施在整个重叠市场中的影响。（JEL J61, J64, R23, R58）

abstract.text: We investigate the role of information technology (IT) in the collection of delinquent consumer debt. We argue that the widespread adoption of IT by the debt collection industry in the 1990s contributed to the observed expansion of unsecured risky lending such as credit cards. Our model stresses the importance of delinquency and private information about borrower solvency. The prevalence of delinquency implies that the costs of debt collection must be borne by lenders to sustain incentives to repay debt. IT mitigates informational asymmetries, allowing lenders to concentrate collection efforts on delinquent borrowers who are more likely to repay. (JEL D14, D82, G21, L84, M15, O33)

10.1257/aer.20131029.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息技术在催收消费者欠款中的作用。我们认为，20世纪90年代催收行业广泛采用信息技术，促进了无担保高风险贷款（如信用卡贷款）的扩张。我们的模型强调了欠款情况以及关于借款人偿债能力的私人信息的重要性。欠款现象的普遍存在意味着，催收成本必须由贷款方承担，才能维持他们偿还债务的动机。信息技术缓解了信息不对称问题，使贷款方能够将催收精力集中在更有可能还款的欠款借款人身上。（JEL D14, D82, G21, L84, M15, O33）

abstract.text: We study a common value, first-price auction in which the number of bidders is endogenous: the seller (auctioneer) knows the value and solicits bidders at a cost. The number of bidders, which is unobservable, may thus depend on the true value. Therefore, being solicited conveys information. This solicitation effect may soften competition and impede information aggregation. Under certain conditions, there is an equilibrium in which the seller solicits many bidders, yet the resulting price is not competitive and fails to aggregate any information. More broadly, these ideas are relevant for markets with adverse selection in which informed traders initiate contacts. (JEL D44, D82)

10.1257/aer.20131057.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种常见的价值评估方式——第一价格拍卖，其中竞买者的数量是由拍卖师决定的：拍卖师知道价值，并以一定的成本吸引竞买者。由于竞买者的数量是不可观测的，因此可能会依赖于真实价值。因此，通过吸引竞买者可以传递信息。这种吸引效应可能会削弱竞争，并阻碍信息的整合。在某些条件下，会出现一种均衡状态：拍卖师吸引了许多竞买者，但 resulting price并不具有竞争力，也无法整合任何信息。更广泛地说，这些概念适用于存在逆向选择问题的市场，即信息丰富的交易者会主动联系其他参与者。（JEL D44, D82）

abstract.text: We develop an equilibrium model of on-the-job search with ex ante heterogeneous workers and firms, aggregate uncertainty, and vacancy creation. The model produces rich dynamics in which the distributions of unemployed workers, vacancies, and worker-firm matches evolve stochastically over time. We prove that the surplus function, which fully characterizes the match value and the mobility decision of workers, does not depend on these distributions. This result means the model is tractable and can be estimated. We illustrate the quantitative implications of the model by fitting to US aggregate labor market data from 1951–2012. The model has rich implications for the cyclical dynamics of the distribution of skills of the unemployed, the distribution of types of vacancies posted, and sorting between heterogeneous workers and firms. (JEL E24, E32, J24, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.20131118.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于在职搜索的均衡模型，该模型考虑了事前异质性的工人和企业、总体不确定性以及职位空缺的产生。该模型呈现出丰富的动态变化，其中失业工人的分布、职位空缺以及工人与企业的匹配关系会随时间随机演化。我们证明了，能够全面描述匹配价值以及工人流动决策的余值函数，并不依赖于这些分布。这一结果意味着该模型是可解的，并且可以进行估计。我们通过将模型拟合到1951年至2012年的美国总体劳动力市场数据来说明该模型的定量意义。该模型对于失业者技能分布的周期性变化、发布的职位空缺类型分布，以及异质工人与企业的排序等方面都有重要的启示作用。（JEL E24, E32, J24, J63, J64）

abstract.text: Many organizations have budgets that expire at the end of the fiscal year and may face incentives to rush to spend resources on low-quality projects at year's end. We test these predictions using data on procurement spending by the US federal government. Spending in the last week of the year is 4.9 times higher than the rest-of-the-year weekly average, and year-end information technology projects have substantially lower quality ratings. We also analyze the gains from allowing agencies to roll over unused funds into the next fiscal year. (JEL H57, H61)

10.1257/aer.20131296.abstractZh: 许多组织的预算在财政年度结束时到期，这些组织可能会受到激励，在年底匆忙将资源投入到质量较低的项目上。我们使用美国联邦政府的采购支出数据来验证这些预测。年度最后一周的支出是全年平均水平的4.9倍，而年底的信息技术项目的质量评分明显较低。我们还分析了允许机构将未使用的资金结转至下一个财政年度的好处。（JEL H57, H61）

abstract.text: We document in the Survey of Income and Program Participation covering the period 1990–2013 that a surprisingly large share of workers return to their previous employer after a jobless spell, and experience very different unemployment and employment outcomes than job switchers. The probability of recall is much less procyclical and volatile than the probability of finding a new employer. We add to a quantitative, and otherwise canonical, search-and-matching model of the labor market a recall option, which can be activated freely following aggregate and job-specific productivity shocks. Recall and search effort significantly amplify the cyclical volatility of new job-finding and separation probabilities. (JEL E24, E32, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.20131496.abstractZh: 我们在《收入与计划参与调查》中记录了1990至2013年期间的数据，发现令人惊讶的是，有很大比例的劳动者在失业一段时间后会回到之前的雇主处工作，并且他们的失业和就业状况与那些频繁更换雇主的人截然不同。劳动者重新回到原雇主的可能性，其顺周期性与波动性都远低于寻找新雇主的可能性。我们在传统的劳动力市场搜索与匹配模型中增加了一个“重新就业”选项，该选项可以在整体和特定岗位的生产力冲击后自由激活。重新就业和搜索努力显著增加了寻找新工作和离职概率的周期性波动。（JEL E24, E32, J63, J64）

abstract.text: Investors' subjective capital gains expectations are a key element explaining stock price fluctuations. Survey measures of these expectations display excessive optimism (pessimism) at market peaks (troughs). We formally reject the hypothesis that this is compatible with rational expectations. We then incorporate subjective price beliefs with such properties into a standard asset-pricing model with rational agents (internal rationality). The model gives rise to boom-bust cycles that temporarily delink stock prices from fundamentals and quantitatively replicates many asset-pricing moments. In particular, it matches the observed strong positive correlation between the price dividend ratio and survey return expectations, which cannot be matched by rational expectations. (JEL D83, D84, G12, G14)

10.1257/aer.20140205.abstractZh: 投资者对资本收益的主观预期是解释股票价格波动的关键因素。对这类预期的调查结果显示，在市场高峰（低谷）时期，投资者表现出过度的乐观（悲观）情绪。我们正式否定了这种预期与理性预期相一致的假设。随后，我们将具有此类特性的主观价格信念纳入一个标准资产定价模型中，该模型中的理性代理人具有内部理性特征。该模型产生了繁荣与萧条的周期，这些周期暂时将股票价格与基本面因素分离，并定量复制了许多资产定价特征。特别是，该模型与观察到的价格与股息比率之间的强正相关性以及调查得出的回报预期之间的相关性相匹配，而这些关系无法通过理性预期来解释。（JEL D83, D84, G12, G14）

abstract.text: Although economists have made substantial progress toward formulating theories of collusion in industrial cartels that account for a variety of fact patterns, important puzzles remain. Standard models of repeated interaction formalize the observation that cartels keep participants in line through the threat of punishment, but they fail to explain two important factual observations: first, apparently deliberate cheating actually occurs; second, it frequently goes unpunished even when it is detected. We propose a theory of equilibrium price cutting and business stealing in cartels to bridge this gap between theory and observation. (JEL D43, L12, L13)

10.1257/aer.20140359.abstractZh: 尽管经济学家在构建关于工业卡特尔中勾结行为的理论方面取得了显著进展，能够解释多种事实现象，但仍有重要的谜题尚未解决。标准的重复互动模型虽然能够解释卡特尔通过威胁惩罚来维持参与者遵守规则的行为，但它们无法解释两个重要的事实现象：首先，看似故意的欺诈行为确实会发生；其次，即使被发现，这种欺诈行为也常常得不到惩罚。我们提出了一种关于卡特尔中均衡价格削减和商业窃取行为的理论，以弥合理论与观察之间的差距。（JEL D43, L12, L13）

abstract.text: Several agents with privately known social values compete for a prize. The prize is allocated based on the claims of the agents, and the winner is subject to a limited penalty if he makes a false claim. If the number of agents is large, the optimal mechanism places all agents above a threshold onto a shortlist along with a fraction of agents below the threshold, and then allocates the prize to a random agent on the shortlist. When the number of agents is small, the optimal mechanism allocates the prize to the agent who makes the highest claim, but restricts the range of claims above and below. (JEL D63, D82)

10.1257/aer.20140494.abstractZh: 多个具有私人知晓的社会价值观的代理人竞争一个奖项。奖项的分配基于代理人的主张，如果获胜者提出虚假主张，则会受到一定的惩罚。如果代理人的数量较多，最优机制会将所有超过阈值的代理人列入短名单，并分配一部分低于阈值的代理人，然后随机将奖项分配给短名单上的代理人。当代理人的数量较少时，最优机制会将奖项分配给主张最高的代理人，但会限制其主张范围的上限和下限。（JEL D63, D82）

abstract.text: I propose a framework in which asymmetric multiproduct retailers compete for one-stop shoppers who have biased beliefs about their future purchase probabilities (and so make unplanned purchases). One firm carries a full portfolio of products while the other carries an incomplete but endogenous one. Using this framework, I examine the phenomenon of loss leading, the optimal product portfolio of the smaller firm, and the effects of banning loss leading. Among other results, I show that there is a nonpredatory (and possibly procompetitive) justification for the observation that such larger firms may charge below cost on the core product lines of their smaller rivals. (JEL D11, D21, D83, L13, L25, L71, L81)

10.1257/aer.20140605.abstractZh: 我提出了一个框架，其中不对称的多产品零售商竞争那些对未来购买概率持有偏见的一站式购物者（从而进行非计划性购买）。一家企业提供完整的产品组合，而另一家则提供不完整但具有内生性的产品组合。利用这一框架，我研究了“损失导向”现象、较小企业的最优产品组合，以及禁止“损失导向”行为的影响。其他结果表明，存在一种非掠夺性（且可能有利于竞争）的合理性，即较大的企业可能在较小竞争对手的核心产品线上以低于成本的价格销售产品。（JEL D11, D21, D83, L13, L25, L71, L81）

abstract.text: Most assets are traded in multiple interconnected trading venues. This paper develops an equilibrium model of decentralized markets that accommodates general market structures with coexisting exchanges. Decentralized markets can allocate risk among traders with different risk preferences more efficiently, thus realizing gains from trade that cannot be reproduced in centralized markets. Market decentralization always increases price impact. Yet, markets in which assets are traded in multiple exchanges, whether they are disjoint or intermediated, can give higher welfare than the centralized market with the same traders and assets. In decentralized markets, demand substitutability across assets is endogenous and heterogeneous among traders. (JEL D43, D44, D85, G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.20140759.abstractZh: 大多数资产在多个相互连接的交易场所进行交易。本文提出了一个去中心化市场的均衡模型，该模型能够适应具有多个交易所共存的一般市场结构。去中心化市场能够更有效地在具有不同风险偏好的交易者之间分配风险，从而实现在集中式市场中无法实现的交易收益。市场去中心化总是会增加价格的影响。然而，在多个交易所进行交易的市场中，无论这些交易所是否独立或中介，都能为相同交易者和资产带来更高的福利。在去中心化市场中，不同资产之间的需求替代性是内生且异质的。（JEL D43, D44, D85, G11, G12）

abstract.text: We study the impact of providing school report cards with test scores on subsequent test scores, prices, and enrollment in markets with multiple public and private providers. A randomly selected half of our sample villages (markets) received report cards. This increased test scores by 0.11 standard deviations, decreased private school fees by 17 percent, and increased primary enrollment by 4.5 percent. Heterogeneity in the treatment impact by initial school test scores is consistent with canonical models of asymmetric information. Information provision facilitates better comparisons across providers, and improves market efficiency and child welfare through higher test scores, higher enrollment, and lower fees. (JEL D83, H75, I21, I28, O15, O18)

10.1257/aer.20140774.abstractZh: 我们研究了在多个公立和私立教育机构提供的市场中，将学校成绩单中的测试成绩信息提供给学生对后续测试成绩、价格以及入学率的影响。我们随机选取了部分村庄（市场）发放了成绩单。这一举措使测试成绩提高了0.11个标准差，私立学校费用降低了17%，小学入学率上升了4.5%。不同初始学校测试成绩对处理效果的影响与不对称信息的典型模型相符。信息提供有助于更好地比较不同教育机构，并通过提高测试成绩、增加入学率和降低费用来提高市场效率和儿童福利。（JEL D83, H75, I21, I28, O15, O18）

abstract.text: Banks produce short-term debt for transactions and storing value. The value of this debt must not vary over time so agents can easily trade it at par like money. To produce money-like safe liquidity, banks keep detailed information about their loans secret, reducing liquidity if needed to prevent agents from producing costly private information about the banks' loans. Capital markets involve information revelation, so they produce risky liquidity. The trade-off between less safe liquidity and more risky liquidity determines which firms choose to fund projects through banks and which ones through capital markets. (JEL D92, E51, G21, G31, G32)

10.1257/aer.20140782.abstractZh: 银行通过产生短期债务来进行交易和存储价值。这种债务的价值必须保持稳定，以便交易双方能够像货币一样以面值进行交易。为了产生类似货币的稳定流动性，银行会对其贷款信息保密，必要时会减少流动性以防止交易方产生关于银行贷款的昂贵私人信息。资本市场涉及信息的披露，因此会产生风险较高的流动性。在较低稳定性的流动性和较高风险性的流动性之间的权衡，决定了哪些企业选择通过银行融资，哪些企业则选择通过资本市场融资。（JEL D92, E51, G21, G31, G32）

abstract.text: The 1870–1913 period marked the birth of the first era of trade globalization. How did this tremendous increase in trade affect economic development? This work isolates a causality channel by exploiting the fact that the introduction of the steamship in the shipping industry produced an asymmetric change in trade distances among countries. Before this invention, trade routes depended on wind patterns. The steamship reduced shipping costs and time in a disproportionate manner across countries and trade routes. Using this source of variation and novel data on shipping, trade, and development, I find that (i) the adoption of the steamship had a major impact on patterns of trade worldwide; (ii) only a small number of countries, characterized by more inclusive institutions, benefited from trade integration; and (iii) globalization was the major driver of the economic divergence between the rich and the poor portions of the world in the years 1850–1900. (JEL F14, F43, F63, L92, N70, O33)

10.1257/aer.20140832.abstractZh: 1870至1913年期间，标志着贸易全球化的第一个时代的诞生。这种贸易的巨大增长如何影响了经济发展？本研究通过利用蒸汽船在航运业中的引入导致国家间贸易距离出现不对称变化这一事实，来分离出因果关系。在这一发明之前，贸易路线依赖于风向。蒸汽船以不成比例的方式降低了各国和贸易路线的运输成本和时间。利用这一变量来源以及关于航运、贸易和发展的新数据，我发现：(i) 蒸汽船的采用对全球贸易模式产生了重大影响；(ii) 只有少数国家，这些国家具有更包容的体制，从贸易一体化中受益；(iii) 在1850至1900年间，全球化是世界经济贫富差距扩大的主要驱动力。(JEL F14, F43, F63, L92, N70, O33)

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of temporary tax incentives on equipment investment using shifts in accelerated depreciation. Analyzing data for over 120,000 firms, we present three findings. First, bonus depreciation raised investment in eligible capital relative to ineligible capital by 10.4 percent between 2001 and 2004 and 16.9 percent between 2008 and 2010. Second, small firms respond 95 percent more than big firms. Third, firms respond strongly when the policy generates immediate cash flows, but not when cash flows only come in the future. This heterogeneity materially affects investment-weighted estimates and supports models in which financial frictions or fixed costs amplify investment responses. (JEL D21, D22, D92, G31, H25, H32)

10.1257/aer.20140855.abstractZh: 我们通过分析加速折旧的变化来估算临时税收激励对设备投资的影响。对超过120,000家企业的数据进行分析后，我们得到了三个发现。首先，在2001年至2004年间，奖励性折旧使符合条件的资本投资相对于不符合条件的资本增加了10.4%，而在2008年至2010年间则增加了16.9%。其次，小型企业的反应比大型企业强烈95%。第三，当政策产生即时现金流时，企业会有强烈的反应，但当现金流只在未来出现时，企业反应并不强烈。这种差异性对以投资为权重的估计结果产生了实质性影响，并支持了这样一种模型：金融摩擦或固定成本会放大投资反应。（JEL D21, D22, D92, G31, H25, H32）

abstract.text: In business and politics, gifts are often aimed at influencing the recipient at the expense of third parties. In an experimental study, which removes informational and incentive confounds, subjects strongly respond to small gifts even though they understand the gift giver's intention. Our findings question existing models of social preferences. They point to anthropological and sociological theories about gifts creating an obligation to reciprocate. We capture these effects in a simple extension of existing models. We show that common policy responses (disclosure, size limits) may be ineffective, consistent with our model. Financial incentives are effective but can backfire. (JEL C92, D62, D64, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20140890.abstractZh: 在商业和政治领域，礼物往往旨在以牺牲第三方利益为代价来影响接受者。在一项实验研究中，通过消除信息性和激励性混淆因素后，受试者即使了解送礼者的意图，仍然会对小额礼物产生强烈的反应。我们的研究结果对现有的社会偏好模型提出了质疑。这些发现指向了关于礼物会产生回报义务的人类学和社会学理论。我们在现有模型的简单扩展中捕捉到了这些效应。我们发现，常见的政策应对措施（如披露、限制礼物大小等）可能无效，这与我们的模型相符。财务激励措施虽然有效，但可能会适得其反。（JEL C92, D62, D64, Z13）

abstract.text: Two identical firms who start exporting in different months, one each in January and December, will report dramatically different exports for the first calendar year. This partial-year effect biases down first-year export levels and biases up first-year export growth rates. For Peruvian exporters, the partial-year bias is large: first-year export levels are understated by 54 percent and the first-year growth rate is overstated by 112 percentage points. Correcting the partial-year effect dramatically reduces first-year export growth rates, raises initial export levels, and almost doubles the contribution of net firm entry and exit to overall export growth. (JEL D22, F14)

10.1257/aer.20141070.abstractZh: 两家在不同月份开始出口的相同公司，分别在一月和十二月，其第一年的出口数据会呈现出显著的差异。这种部分年度效应会导致第一年的出口水平下降，同时第一年的出口增长率上升。对于秘鲁的出口商来说，这种部分年度偏差尤为明显：第一年的出口水平被低估了54%，而第一年的增长率则被高估了112个百分点。纠正这种部分年度效应可以显著降低第一年的出口增长率，提高初始出口水平，并使净企业进入和退出对整体出口增长的贡献几乎翻倍。（JEL D22, F14）

abstract.text: We document basic facts about prices in online markets in the United States and Canada, which is a rapidly growing segment of the retail sector. Relative to prices in regular stores, prices in online markets are more flexible and exhibit stronger pass-through (60–75 percent) and faster convergence (half-life less than two months) in response to movements of the nominal exchange rate. Multiple margins of adjustment are active in the process of responding to nominal exchange rate shocks. Properties of goods, sellers, and markets are systematically related to pass-through and the speed of price adjustment for international price differentials. (JEL F31, F41, L11, L81)

10.1257/aer.20141127.abstractZh: 我们记录了美国与加拿大在线市场中价格的基本情况，这一领域是零售行业中增长迅速的一部分。与实体店铺的价格相比，在线市场的价格更为灵活，对名义汇率变动的传递性更强（60-75%），且价格调整的速度更快（半衰期不到两个月）。在应对名义汇率冲击的过程中，存在多种调整机制在发挥作用。商品、卖家以及市场的特性与国际价格差异的传递性及价格调整速度之间存在系统性关联。（JEL F31, F41, L11, L81）

abstract.text: Researchers measure crowd-out around one level of charity output to identify whether giving is motivated by altruism and/or warm-glow. However, crowd-out depends on output, implying first that the power to reject pure altruism varies, and second that a single measurement of incomplete crowd-out can be rationalized by many different preferences. By instead measuring crowd-out at different output levels, we allow both for identification and for a novel and direct test of impure altruism. Using a new experimental design, we present the first empirical evidence that, consistent with impure altruism, crowd-out decreases with output. (JEL D64, L31)

10.1257/aer.20141222.abstractZh: 研究人员通过测量不同慈善产出水平下的排斥效应，来识别捐赠行为是否由利他主义或温暖感驱动。然而，这种排斥效应取决于产出水平，这意味着首先，拒绝纯粹利他主义的能力会有所不同；其次，对不完全排斥效应的单一测量可以通过多种不同的偏好来解释。通过在不同产出水平下测量排斥效应，我们可以同时实现识别目的，并对不纯的利他主义进行新颖且直接的测试。通过新的实验设计，我们首次获得了实证证据，表明与不纯利他主义一致，排斥效应会随着产出的增加而减少。（JEL D64, L31）

abstract.text: This paper shows that employment in cohorts of US firms is strongly influenced by aggregate conditions at the time of their entry. Employment fluctuations of startups are procyclical, they persist into later years, and cohort-level employment variations are largely driven by differences in firm size, rather than the number of firms. An estimated general equilibrium firm dynamics model reveals that aggregate conditions at birth, rather than post-entry choices, drive the majority of cohort-level employment variation by affecting the share of startups with high growth potential. In the aggregate, changes in startup conditions result in large, slow-moving fluctuations in employment. (JEL D25, E24, E32, J23, L25, M13)

10.1257/aer.20141280.abstractZh: 本文指出，美国企业的员工就业状况在其进入市场时受到整体经济条件的强烈影响。初创企业的就业波动具有顺周期性，这些波动会持续多年，而群体层面的就业变化主要由企业规模的差异所驱动，而非企业数量的变化。通过估计的一般均衡企业动态模型可以发现，出生时的整体经济条件，而非进入市场后的选择，才是驱动群体层面就业变化的主要因素，因为这些条件影响了具有高成长潜力的初创企业的比例。总体而言，初创企业状况的变化会导致就业出现较大且缓慢的波动。（JEL D25, E24, E32, J23, L25, M13）

abstract.text: We introduce a notion of coarse competitive equilibrium, to study agents’ inability to tailor their consumption to prices. Our goal is to incorporate limited cognitive ability (in particular limited attention, memory, and complexity) into the analysis of competitive equilibrium. Compared to standard competitive equilibrium, our concept yields more extreme prices and, when all agents have the same endowment, riskier allocations. We provide a tractable model suitable for general equilibrium analysis as well as asset pricing. (JEL D11, D51, D91, G10)

10.1257/aer.20141287.abstractZh: 我们引入了一种“粗糙竞争均衡”的概念，用于研究代理人无法根据价格调整其消费行为的情况。我们的目标是将有限的认知能力（特别是有限的注意力、记忆力和复杂性）纳入竞争均衡的分析中。与标准竞争均衡相比，我们的概念会产生更极端的价格，并且当所有代理人拥有相同的初始资源时，会导致更冒险的资源配置。我们提供了一个适用于一般均衡分析以及资产定价的可行模型。（JEL D11, D51, D91, G10）

abstract.text: Unemployment is high when financial discounts are high. In recessions, the stock market falls and all types of investment fall, including employers' investment in job creation. The discount rate implicit in the stock market rises, and discounts for other claims on business income also rise. A higher discount implies a lower present value of the benefit of a new hire to an employer. According to the leading view of unemployment—the Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides model—when the incentive for job creation falls, the labor market slackens and unemployment rises. Thus high discount rates imply high unemployment. (JEL E24, E32, E44, J23, J31, J63)

10.1257/aer.20141297.abstractZh: 当金融贴现率较高时，失业率会升高。在经济衰退期间，股市下跌，各种投资也都会下降，包括雇主在创造就业机会上的投资。股市中隐含的贴现率上升，其他对商业收入的索取权所对应的贴现率也会随之上升。较高的贴现率意味着雇主从新雇用员工中获得的收益现值较低。根据失业问题的主流理论——Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides模型，当创造就业机会的激励下降时，劳动力市场会趋于疲软，失业率也会上升。因此，较高的贴现率意味着较高的失业率。（JEL E24, E32, E44, J23, J31, J63）

abstract.text: Existing evidence on peer effects in the productivity of coworkers stems from either laboratory experiments or real-world studies referring to a specific firm or occupation. In this paper, we aim at providing more generalizable results by investigating a large local labor market, with a focus on peer effects in wages rather than productivity. Our estimation strategy—which links the average permanent productivity of workers' peers to their wages—circumvents the reflection problem and accounts for endogenous sorting of workers into peer groups and firms. On average over all occupations, and in the type of high-skilled occupations investigated in studies on knowledge spillover, we find only small peer effects in wages. In the type of low-skilled occupations analyzed in extant studies on social pressure, in contrast, we find larger peer effects, about one-half the size of those identified in similar studies on productivity. (JEL J24, J31, J41, M12, M54)

10.1257/aer.20141300.abstractZh: 关于同事对生产力影响的现有研究主要来源于实验室实验或针对特定企业或职业的真实世界研究。本文旨在通过一个大型本地劳动力市场的研究，提供更具有普遍性的结果，重点关注工资而非生产力的同伴效应。我们的估计方法将工人同伴的平均永久生产力与他们工资之间的关系联系起来，从而避免了反射问题，并考虑了工人被分配到不同同伴群体和企业过程中的内生性排序现象。在各类职业中，以及在知识溢出研究中所关注的高技能职业中，我们发现工资上的同伴效应非常微弱。而在社会压力研究中所分析的低技能职业中，我们发现同伴效应较大，约为类似生产力研究中所识别出的效应的一半大小。（JEL J24, J31, J41, M12, M54）

abstract.text: Exploiting variation in the timing of resets of adjustable-rate mortgages (ARMs), we find that a sizable decline in mortgage payments (up to 50 percent) induces a significant increase in car purchases (up to 35 percent). This effect is attenuated by voluntary deleveraging. Borrowers with lower incomes and housing wealth have significantly higher marginal propensity to consume. Areas with a larger share of ARMs were more responsive to lower interest rates and saw a relative decline in defaults and an increase in house prices, car purchases, and employment. Household balance sheets and mortgage contract rigidity are important for monetary policy pass-through. (JEL D12, D14, E43, E52, G21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20141313.abstractZh: 通过利用可调利率抵押贷款（ARMs）重置时机的差异，我们发现，抵押贷款支付大幅减少（最高可达50%）会显著促进汽车购买量的增加（最高可达35%）。这种效应会因自愿减少债务而减弱。收入较低和住房财富较少的借款人，其消费边际倾向明显更高。拥有较多可调利率抵押贷款的地区对较低利率的反应更为敏感，违约率相对下降，房价、汽车购买量和就业人数也有所增加。家庭资产负债表和抵押贷款合同的刚性对货币政策的传导具有重要影响。（JEL D12, D14, E43, E52, G21, R31）

abstract.text: An ongoing debate in employment policy is whether promoting small and medium enterprises creates jobs. We use the elimination of small-scale industry (SSI) promotion in India to address this question. For 60 years, SSI promotion in India focused on reserving certain products for manufacture by small and medium enterprises. We identify the consequences for employment growth, investment, output, productivity, and wages of dismantling India's SSI reservations. We exploit variation in the timing of de-reservation across products and also measure the long-run impact of national SSI policy changes using variation in pretreatment exposure at the district level. Districts more exposed to de-reservation experienced higher employment and output growth. Entrants into the de-reserved product spaces and incumbents that were previously constrained by the size restrictions drove the increase in growth. The results suggest that dismantling India's SSI policies encouraged overall employment growth. (JEL E24, L25, L53, L60, O14, O25)

10.1257/aer.20141335.abstractZh: 在就业政策领域，一个持续存在的争论是：促进中小企业的发展是否真的能创造就业机会。我们通过印度对小型工业发展的限制措施来探讨这个问题。在过去60年里，印度对小型工业发展的限制措施主要集中在为小型和中型企业保留某些生产领域。我们研究了取消这些限制对就业增长、投资、产出、生产效率和工资的影响。我们分析了不同产品取消限制的时间差异，并通过地区层面的预处理条件变化来衡量国家政策变化的长期影响。那些更容易被取消限制的地区，其就业和产出增长更为显著。进入这些被取消限制领域的企业以及那些之前因规模限制而受限的企业，推动了经济增长。研究结果表明，取消印度对小型工业发展的限制措施确实促进了整体就业增长。（JEL E24, L25, L53, L60, O14, O25）

abstract.text: We examine the impact of policy uncertainty on trade, prices, and real income through firm entry investments in general equilibrium. We estimate and quantify the impact of trade policy on China's export boom to the United States following its 2001 WTO accession. We find the accession reduced the US threat of a trade war, which can account for over one-third of that export growth in the period 2000– 2005. Reduced policy uncertainty lowered US prices and increased its consumers' income by the equivalent of a 13-percentage-point permanent tariff decrease. These findings provide evidence of large effects of policy uncertainty on economic activity and the importance of agreements for reducing it. (JEL D72, F13, F14, O19, P33)

10.1257/aer.20141419.abstractZh: 我们研究了政策不确定性对贸易、价格和实际收入的影响，通过企业进入投资在一般均衡中进行分析。我们估算并量化了2001年中国加入世界贸易组织后，贸易政策对中国对美出口增长的影响。我们发现，加入世界贸易组织减少了美国发动贸易战争的威胁，这一因素在2000至2005年期间对出口增长的贡献超过了三分之一。减少政策不确定性降低了美国的价格，并增加了消费者的收入，其效果相当于降低13个百分点的永久性关税。这些发现证明了政策不确定性对经济活动具有巨大影响，以及达成减少政策不确定性的协议的重要性。（JEL D72, F13, F14, O19, P33）

abstract.text: This paper introduces a new IV strategy based on IVF (in vitro fertilization) induced fertility variation among childless women to estimate the causal effect of having children on their career. For this purpose, we use administrative data on IVF treated women in Denmark. Because observed chances of IVF success do not depend on labor market histories, IVF treatment success provides a plausible instrument for childbearing. Our IV estimates indicate that fertility effects on earnings are: (i) negative, large, and long-lasting; (ii) driven by fertility effects on hourly earnings and not so much on labor supply; and (iii) much stronger at the extensive margin than at the intensive margin.

10.1257/aer.20141467.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种基于体外受精（IVF）的新的工具变量（IV）策略，用于估计生育子女对女性职业生涯的因果效应。为此，我们使用了丹麦接受体外受精治疗的女性的行政数据。由于体外受精成功的几率并不依赖于劳动力市场历史，因此体外受精治疗成功可以作为一个合理的工具变量来衡量生育行为。我们的工具变量估计表明，生育对收入的影响具有以下特点：(i) 负面、显著且持久；(ii) 主要由生育对小时收入的影响驱动，而非劳动力供应；(iii) 在广泛层面上的影响比在密集层面上的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: We demonstrate that eponymy—firms being named after their owners—is linked to superior firm performance, but is relatively uncommon (about 19 percent of firms in our data). We propose an explanation based on eponymy creating an association between the entrepreneur and her firm that increases the reputational benefits/costs of successful/unsuccessful outcomes. We develop a corresponding signaling model, which further predicts that these effects will be stronger for entrepreneurs with rarer names. We find support for the model's predictions using a unique panel dataset consisting of over 1.8 million firms. (JEL D82, L25, L26, M13)

10.1257/aer.20141524.abstractZh: 我们证明，以企业主的名字命名的企业与更优的企业绩效相关，但这种现象相对罕见（在我们的数据中约19%的企业如此）。我们提出了一种基于企业主名字的解释，认为这种命名方式会建立企业家与其企业之间的关联，从而增强成功或失败结果所带来的声誉收益/成本。我们进一步提出了一个信号传递模型，该模型预测，对于名字较为罕见的企业家来说，这种效应会更为显著。我们使用一个包含超过180万家企业数据的独特面板数据集来验证该模型的预测结果。（JEL D82, L25, L26, M13）

abstract.text: We develop a quantifiable multi-country sourcing model in which firms self-select into importing based on their productivity and country-specific variables. In contrast to canonical export models where firm profits are additively separable across destination markets, global sourcing decisions naturally interact through the firm's cost function. We show that, under an empirically relevant condition, selection into importing exhibits complementarities across source markets. We exploit these complementarities to solve the firm's problem and estimate the model. Comparing counterfactual predictions to reduced-form evidence highlights the importance of interdependencies in firms' sourcing decisions across markets, which generate heterogeneous domestic sourcing responses to trade shocks. (JEL D24, F14, F23, L14, L21)

10.1257/aer.20141685.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个可量化的多国采购模型，在该模型中，企业根据自身的生产效率和各国特定变量自行选择进口行为。与传统的出口模型不同，在传统出口模型中，企业利润在不同目标市场之间是可加分的，而全球采购决策则通过企业的成本函数自然产生相互作用。我们证明，在某一具有实证相关性的条件下，选择进口行为会在不同来源市场之间产生互补性。我们利用这种互补性来解决企业的决策问题，并对模型进行估计。通过将反事实预测与简化形式的结果进行比较，我们强调了市场间相互依赖性在企業采购决策中的重要性，这种依赖性会导致国内采购对贸易冲击的异质反应。（JEL D24, F14, F23, L14, L21）

abstract.text: Urban growth requires the replacement of outdated buildings, yet growth may be restricted when landowners do not internalize positive spillover effects from their own reconstruction. The Boston Fire of 1872 created an opportunity for widespread simultaneous reconstruction, initiating a virtuous circle in which building upgrades encouraged further upgrades of nearby buildings. Land values increased substantially among burned plots and nearby unburned plots, capitalizing economic gains comparable to the prior value of burned buildings. Boston had grown rapidly prior to the Fire, but negative spillovers from outdated durable buildings had substantially constrained its growth by dampening reconstruction incentives. (JEL H76, N91, R11, R52, R58)

10.1257/aer.20141707.abstractZh: 城市的发展需要更换过时的建筑，然而，当土地所有者未能将自身重建带来的积极溢出效应内部化时，城市的发展可能会受到限制。1872年的波士顿大火为大规模的同时重建提供了机会，形成了一个良性循环：建筑升级促进了附近建筑的进一步升级。火灾发生区域及附近未受火灾影响的区域的土地价值显著上升，其经济收益相当于被烧毁建筑原有的价值。在火灾发生之前，波士顿已经迅速发展，但过时的耐用建筑带来的负面溢出效应严重限制了其发展，削弱了重建的激励。 (JEL H76, N91, R11, R52, R58)

abstract.text: Gender differences in task allocations may sustain vertical gender segregation in labor markets. We examine the allocation of a task that everyone prefers be completed by someone else (writing a report, serving on a committee, etc.) and find evidence that women, more than men, volunteer, are asked to volunteer, and accept requests to volunteer for such tasks. Beliefs that women, more than men, say yes to tasks with low promotability appear as an important driver of these differences. If women hold tasks that are less promotable than those held by men, then women will progress more slowly in organizations. (JEL I23, J16, J44, J71, M12, M51)

10.1257/aer.20141734.abstractZh: 性别差异在任务分配上可能维持着劳动力市场的纵向性别隔离。我们研究了那些大家都希望由他人完成的任务（如撰写报告、担任委员会成员等）的分配情况，发现女性比男性更愿意自愿参与这些任务，也更容易被邀请或接受这样的任务。认为女性更倾向于接受那些晋升机会较低的任务的观念，是造成这种差异的一个重要因素。如果女性从事的任务是男性所从事的那些任务晋升机会较低，那么女性在组织中的发展速度就会较慢。（JEL I23, J16, J44, J71, M12, M51）

abstract.text: We study the effect of financial relationships on firms' investment decisions and access to external finance. In the early twentieth century, securities underwriters commonly held directorships with American corporations. Section 10 of the Clayton Antitrust Act prohibited bankers from serving on the boards of railroads for which they underwrote securities. We find that following the implementation of Section 10, railroads with strong preexisting relationships with underwriters saw declines in their investment rates, valuations, and leverage, and increases in their costs of external funds. Reassuringly, we do not observe similar effects among industrials and utilities, which were not subject to Section 10. Our results are consistent with underwriters on corporate boards acting as delegated monitors, and highlight the potential for regulations intended to address conflicts of interest to disrupt valuable information flows. (JEL G24, G31, G32, G34, K22, N21, N22)

10.1257/aer.20150143.abstractZh: 我们研究了金融关系对企业投资决策和外部融资获取的影响。在二十世纪初，证券承销商通常在美国企业中担任董事职务。克莱顿反托拉斯法案第10条禁止银行家担任为他们承销证券的铁路公司的董事会成员。我们发现，在第10条实施之后，与承销商有深厚关系的铁路公司的投资率、估值和杠杆率均有所下降，而外部融资的成本则有所上升。令人欣慰的是，我们没有观察到工业企业和公用事业企业出现类似的效应，因为这些企业并未受到第10条的约束。我们的研究结果与承销商在企业董事会中充当监督者角色的观点一致，并揭示了旨在解决利益冲突的法规可能会破坏有价值的信息流动。 (JEL G24, G31, G32, G34, K22, N21, N22)

abstract.text: We construct a model of household decision-making in which agents consume a private and a public good, interpreted as children's welfare. Children's utility depends on their human capital, which depends on the time their parents spend with them and on the parents' human capital. We first show that as returns to human capital increase, couples at the top of the income distribution should spend more time with their children. This in turn should reinforce assortative matching, in a sense that we precisely define. We then embed the model into a transferable utility matching framework with random preferences, à la Choo and Siow (2006), which we estimate using US marriage data for individuals born between 1943 and 1972. We find that the preference for partners of the same education has significantly increased for white individuals, particularly for the highly educated. We find no evidence of such an increase for black individuals. Moreover, in line with theoretical predictions, we find that the “marital college-plus premium” has increased for women but not for men. (JEL D12, J12, J13, J15, J24)

10.1257/aer.20150154.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个家庭决策模型，其中个体消费一种私人物品和一种公共物品，这两种物品都被视为儿童福利。儿童的效用取决于他们的人力资本，而人力资本又取决于父母与他们相处的时间以及父母自身的人力资本。我们首先证明了，随着人力资本回报的增加，收入分布顶端的夫妇应该花更多时间与子女相处。这反过来会加强选择性匹配，我们对此有具体的定义。然后，我们将该模型嵌入到一个具有随机偏好的可转移效用匹配框架中，这一框架类似于Choo和Siow（2006年）的研究，我们使用1943年至1972年间出生的美国婚姻数据进行了估计。我们发现，对于白人个体来说，尤其是受过高等教育的白人个体，对相同教育背景伴侣的偏好显著增加。而对于黑人个体，则没有发现这种增加的证据。此外，与理论预测一致，我们发现“婚姻中的大学及以上学历溢价”在女性中有所上升，但在男性中并未出现这种情况。（JEL D12, J12, J13, J15, J24）

abstract.text: I introduce and study dynamic persuasion mechanisms. A principal privately observes the evolution of a stochastic process and sends messages over time to an agent. The agent takes actions in each period based on her beliefs about the state of the process and the principal wishes to influence the agent’s action. I characterize the optimal persuasion mechanism and show how to derive it in applications. I then consider the extension to multiple agents where higher-order beliefs matter. (JEL D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20150218.abstractZh: 我介绍了动态说服机制的研究。一个主体私下观察一个随机过程的演变，并随时间向一个代理人发送信息。代理人在每个时期根据她对过程状态的信念以及主体希望影响代理人行为的意愿来采取行动。我描述了最优说服机制，并展示了如何在实际应用中推导该机制。随后，我考虑了涉及多个代理人的情况，其中更高阶的信念也起着重要作用。（JEL D82, D83）

abstract.text: To generate big responses of unemployment to productivity changes, researchers have reconfigured matching models in various ways: by elevating the utility of leisure, by making wages sticky, by assuming alternating-offer wage bargaining, by introducing costly acquisition of credit, by assuming fixed matching costs, or by positing government-mandated unemployment compensation and layoff costs. All of these redesigned matching models increase responses of unemployment to movements in productivity by diminishing the fundamental surplus fraction, an upper bound on the fraction of a job's output that the invisible hand can allocate to vacancy creation. Business cycles and welfare state dynamics of an entire class of reconfigured matching models all operate through this common channel. (JEL E23, E24, E32, J24, J31, J41, J63)

10.1257/aer.20150233.abstractZh: 为了产生较大的失业对生产率变化的反应，研究人员以各种方式重新设计了匹配模型：通过提升休闲的效用、使工资具有粘性、假设交替报价下的工资谈判、引入昂贵的信贷获取成本、假设固定的匹配成本，或者假设政府规定的失业补偿和裁员成本。所有这些重新设计的匹配模型都通过减少基本剩余份额来增加失业对生产率变化的反应，而基本剩余份额是指无形之手能够分配给空缺创造的岗位产出的一部分。商业周期以及整个类别重新设计的匹配模型的福利状态动态都是通过这一共同渠道来运作的。（JEL E23, E24, E32, J24, J31, J41, J63）

abstract.text: We investigate the empirical relationship between ethnicity and culture, defined as a vector of traits reflecting norms, values, and attitudes. Using survey data for 76 countries, we find that ethnic identity is a significant predictor of cultural values, yet that within-group variation in culture trumps between-group variation. Thus, in contrast to a commonly held view, ethnic and cultural diversity are unrelated. Although only a small portion of a country's overall cultural heterogeneity occurs between groups, we find that various political economy outcomes (such as civil conflict and public goods provision) worsen when there is greater overlap between ethnicity and culture. (JEL D74, H41, J15, O15, O17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20150243.abstractZh: 我们研究了种族与文化之间的实证关系，文化被定义为一系列反映规范、价值观和态度的特征。通过对76个国家的调查数据进行分析，我们发现种族身份是文化价值观的重要预测因素，但群体内部的文化差异比群体间的差异更为显著。因此，与普遍观点相反，种族与文化多样性并不相关。尽管一个国家整体文化异质性中，群体间的差异只占一小部分，但我们发现，当种族与文化之间的重叠程度增加时，各种政治经济结果（如内战和公共物品供给）会恶化。（JEL D74, H41, J15, O15, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: Using a novel dataset, which merges good-level prices underlying the PPI with the respondents' balance sheets, we show that liquidity constrained firms increased prices in 2008, while their unconstrained counterparts cut prices. We develop a model in which firms face financial frictions while setting prices in customer markets. Financial distortions create an incentive for firms to raise prices in response to adverse financial or demand shocks. This reaction reflects the firms' decisions to preserve internal liquidity and avoid accessing external finance, factors that strengthen the countercyclical behavior of markups and attenuate the response of inflation to fluctuations in output. (JEL E31, E32, E44, G01, G32, L11)

10.1257/aer.20150248.abstractZh: 通过结合PPI中的商品价格与企业的资产负债表，我们使用一个新的数据集进行研究。研究发现，在2008年，受到流动性约束的企业提高了价格，而那些不受流动性限制的企业则降低了价格。我们建立了一个模型，该模型描述了企业在设定价格时面临的财务障碍。财务扭曲使得企业有动机在面临财务或需求冲击时提高价格。这种反应反映了企业为了保持内部流动性并避免外部融资而做出的决策，这些因素增强了价格的上调能力，并减弱了通货膨胀对产出波动的响应。（JEL E31, E32, E44, G01, G32, L11）

abstract.text: Decreasing returns at the macro level are an outcome of efficiency at the micro level. When inputs are scarce, an efficient economy carries out only the most productive projects; when inputs are abundant, the economy implements less productive projects as well. This link between decreasing returns and efficiency suggests that misallocation can reduce the extent of aggregate decreasing returns. I formalize this connection and establish two main results: (i) misallocation amplifies the volatility of output with respect to fluctuations in inputs; and (ii) financial integration amplifies shocks in relatively distorted economies, but mitigates them in less distorted economies. (JEL D24, D82, E23, E32, E44, F41)

10.1257/aer.20150314.abstractZh: 宏观层面的递减收益是微观层面效率的结果。当投入资源稀缺时，高效的经济体只会实施最具生产力的项目；而当投入资源充裕时，经济体也会选择实施效率较低的项目。这种递减收益与效率之间的关联表明，资源错配可能会减少整体递减收益的幅度。我对此进行了形式化分析，并得出了两个主要结论：(i) 资源错配会加剧产出对投入波动的敏感性；(ii) 金融整合会在相对扭曲的经济体中加剧冲击，但在不那么扭曲的经济体中则能够缓解这些冲击。(JEL D24, D82, E23, E32, E44, F41)

abstract.text: This paper examines the aftermath of postwar financial crises in advanced countries. We construct a new semiannual series on financial distress in 24 OECD countries for the period 1967–2012. The series is based on assessments of the health of countries' financial systems from a consistent, real-time narrative source, and classifies financial distress on a relatively fine scale. We find that the average decline in output following a financial crisis is statistically significant and persistent, but only moderate in size. More important, we find that the average decline is sensitive to the specification and sample, and that the aftermath of crises is highly variable across major episodes. A simple forecasting exercise suggests that one important driver of the variation is the severity and persistence of financial distress itself. At the same time, we find little evidence of nonlinearities in the relationship between financial distress and the aftermaths of crises. (JEL E32, E44, G01, N10, N20)

10.1257/aer.20150320.abstractZh: 本文探讨了战后发达国家金融危机的影响。我们构建了1967年至2012年间24个经合组织国家金融困境的半年度系列数据。该系列数据基于对各国金融系统健康状况的评估，并采用相对精细的类别对金融困境进行划分。研究发现，金融危机后平均产出下降具有统计学意义且持续时间较长，但降幅较为温和。更重要的是，我们发现平均产出下降的幅度会受到样本选择和统计方法的影响，且不同金融危机后的状况存在很大差异。简单的预测结果表明，导致这种差异的一个重要因素就是金融困境本身的严重程度和持续时间。同时，我们并未发现金融困境与危机后果之间存在非线性关系。（JEL E32, E44, G01, N10, N20）

abstract.text: We develop a structural empirical model of the US banking sector. Insured depositors and run-prone uninsured depositors choose between differentiated banks. Banks compete for deposits and endogenously default. The estimated demand for uninsured deposits declines with banks' financial distress, which is not the case for insured deposits. We calibrate the supply side of the model. The calibrated model possesses multiple equilibria with bank-run features, suggesting that banks can be very fragile. We use our model to analyze proposed bank regulations. For example, our results suggest that a capital requirement below 18 percent can lead to significant instability in the banking system. (JEL E44, G01, G21, G28, G32)

10.1257/aer.20150342.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个关于美国银行业的结构性实证模型。有保险的储户和容易倒闭的无保险储户会在不同的银行之间做出选择。银行为了争夺存款而竞争，并会内生性地出现违约现象。无保险存款的需求随着银行的财务困境而下降，而有保险的存款则不会如此。我们对模型的供给端进行了校准。经过校准的模型存在多个具有银行挤兑特征的均衡状态，这表明银行可能非常脆弱。我们利用该模型来分析拟议中的银行监管措施。例如，我们的研究结果表明，资本要求低于18%可能会导致银行系统出现严重的不稳定现象。（JEL E44, G01, G21, G28, G32）

abstract.text: We demonstrate the importance of politician social networks for electoral outcomes. Using large-scale data on family networks from over 20 million individuals in 15,000 villages in the Philippines, we show that candidates for public office are disproportionately drawn from more central families and family network centrality contributes to higher vote shares during the elections. Consistent with our theory of political intermediation, we present evidence that family network centrality facilitates relationships of political exchange. Moreover, we show that family networks exercise an effect independent of wealth, historical elite status, or previous electoral success. (JEL D72, D85, O17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20150343.abstractZh: 我们证明了政治家社交网络对选举结果的重要性。利用来自菲律宾15,000个村庄、超过2000万人的大规模家庭网络数据，我们发现担任公职的候选人大多来自较为核心的家庭，而家庭网络的中心性在选举期间有助于他们获得更高的选票份额。与我们的政治中介理论一致，我们有证据表明家庭网络的中心性促进了政治交流关系的发展。此外，我们还发现家庭网络的影响与财富、历史精英地位或以往选举成功无关。（JEL D72, D85, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of immigrant legalization on the crime rate of immigrants in Italy by exploiting an ideal regression discontinuity design: fixed quotas of residence permits are available each year, applications must be submitted electronically on specific “click days,” and are processed on a first come, first served basis until the available quotas are exhausted.
