Matching data on applications with individual-level criminal records, we show that legalization reduces the crime rate of legalized immigrants by 0.6 percentage points on average, on a baseline crime rate of 1.1 percent. (JEL J15, J61, K37, K42)

10.1257/aer.20150355.abstractZh: 我们通过采用理想回归不连续设计来估计移民合法化对意大利移民犯罪率的影响：每年都有固定的居留许可配额，申请必须在特定的“点击日”通过电子方式提交，并按先到先得的原则处理，直到配额用尽为止。通过匹配申请数据与个人犯罪记录数据，我们发现合法化使合法移民的犯罪率平均降低0.6个百分点，基准犯罪率为1.1%。（JEL J15, J61, K37, K42）

abstract.text: Rising home values also raise the cost of living, offsetting their impact on consumption. However, additional home equity collateral can loosen borrowing constraints, increasing spending for households that value their current endowment of housing highly. I use geographically linked microdata to exploit regional heterogeneity in housing markets and identify the causal effect of house price fluctuations on consumer spending. A $1 increase in home values leads to a $0.047 increase in spending for homeowners, but a negligible response for renters. Results reflect large responses among credit constrained households, suggesting looser borrowing constraints are a primary driver of the MPC out of housing wealth. (JEL D12, D14, E21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20150491.abstractZh: 房价上涨也会提高生活成本，从而抵消其对消费的影响。然而，额外的房屋净值抵押可以放宽借款限制，从而增加那些高度重视现有住房财富的家庭的支出。我利用地理相关的微观数据来利用不同地区的住房市场差异，并确定房价波动对消费者支出的因果效应。房价每上涨1美元，房主的消费支出就会增加0.047美元，而租户的反应则微不足道。结果显示，在借款受限的家庭中，这种反应较大，这表明放宽借款限制是住房财富对MPC产生积极影响的主要驱动力。（JEL D12, D14, E21, R31）

abstract.text: How have house prices evolved over the long run? This paper presents annual house prices for 14 advanced economies since 1870. We show that real house prices stayed constant from the nineteenth to the mid-twentieth century, but rose strongly and with substantial cross-country variation in the second half of the twentieth century. Land prices, not replacement costs, are the key to understanding the trajectory of house prices. Rising land prices explain about 80 percent of the global house price boom that has taken place since World War II. Our findings have implications for the evolution of wealth-to-income ratios, the growth effects of agglomeration, and the price elasticity of housing supply. (JEL C43, N10, N90, R31)

10.1257/aer.20150501.abstractZh: 房价在长期内是如何演变的？本文提供了自1870年以来14个发达经济体的年度房价数据。我们发现，从19世纪到20世纪中期，实际房价基本保持不变，但在20世纪下半叶出现了显著上升，且各国家之间的变化幅度较大。理解房价走势的关键在于土地价格而非重置成本。自第二次世界大战以来，约80%的全球房价上涨现象可以归因于土地价格的上升。我们的研究结果对财富与收入比率的演变、集聚效应的增长效应以及住房供应的价格弹性都有重要意义。（JEL C43, N10, N90, R31）

abstract.text: We show that a number of noncognitive skills and preferences, including patience and identity, are malleable in adults, and that investments in them reduce crime and violence. We recruited criminally engaged men and randomized one-half to eight weeks of cognitive behavioral therapy designed to foster self-regulation, patience, and a noncriminal identity and lifestyle. We also randomized $200 grants. Cash alone and therapy alone initially reduced crime and violence, but effects dissipated over time. When cash followed therapy, crime and violence decreased dramatically for at least a year. We hypothesize that cash reinforced therapy's impacts by prolonging learning-by-doing, lifestyle changes, and self-investment.

10.1257/aer.20150503.abstractZh: 我们表明，许多非认知技能与偏好，包括耐心和身份认同，在成年人中是可以改变的，对这些技能的投资能够减少犯罪和暴力行为。我们招募了从事犯罪活动的男性，并将其中一半人随机分配接受为期八周的认知行为疗法，该疗法旨在培养自我调节能力、耐心以及非犯罪性的身份认同和生活方式。我们还向他们发放了200美元的补助。单独使用现金和单独进行疗法最初都能减少犯罪和暴力行为，但这些效果随着时间的推移而减弱。当现金与疗法结合使用时，犯罪和暴力行为在至少一年内显著减少。我们认为，现金通过延长实践学习、生活方式改变以及自我投资的过程，从而增强了疗法的效果。

abstract.text: We quantify how sensitive is migration by star scientists to changes in personal and business tax differentials across states. We uncover large, stable, and precisely estimated effects of personal and corporate taxes on star scientists' migration patterns. The long-run elasticity of mobility relative to taxes is 1.8 for personal income taxes, 1.9 for state corporate income tax, and −1.7 for the investment tax credit. While there are many other factors that drive when innovative individuals and innovative companies decide to locate, there are enough firms and workers on the margin that state taxes matter. (JEL H24, H25, H71, H73, J44, J61, R32)

10.1257/aer.20150508.abstractZh: 我们通过顶尖科学家对各州个人税和企业税差异变化的敏感度来量化迁移的敏感性。我们发现，个人税和企业税对顶尖科学家迁移模式有着显著、稳定且精确估算的影响。相对于税收而言，长期迁移的弹性分别为：个人所得税为1.8，州企业所得税为1.9，投资税收抵免为-1.7。尽管还有许多其他因素影响着创新个体和企业的选址决策，但仍有足够多的企业和工人受到州税的影响。（JEL H24, H25, H71, H73, J44, J61, R32）

abstract.text: Contrary to standard search models predictions, past studies have not found a positive effect of unemployment insurance (UI) on reemployment wages. We estimate a positive UI wage effect exploiting an age-based regression discontinuity design in Austria. A search model incorporating duration dependence predicts two countervailing forces: UI induces workers to seek higher-wage jobs, but reduces wages by lengthening unemployment. Matching-function heterogeneity plausibly generates a negative relationship between the UI unemployment-duration and wage effects, which holds empirically in our sample and across studies, reconciling disparate wage-effect estimates. Empirically, UI raises wages by improving reemployment firm quality and attenuating wage drops. (JEL J31, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20150528.abstractZh: 与标准搜索模型的预测相反，过去的研究并未发现失业保险对再就业工资有正面影响。我们在奥地利采用基于年龄的回归断点设计，估计了失业保险对工资的正面影响。一个包含持续时间依赖性的搜索模型预测了两种相反的力量：失业保险促使工人寻求更高工资的职位，但同时由于延长失业时间而降低工资。匹配函数的异质性合理地解释了失业保险失业时长与工资效应之间的负相关关系，这一关系在我们的样本和不同研究中都得到了实证支持，从而调和了不同的工资效应估计结果。从经验上看，失业保险通过提高再就业企业的质量并减少工资下降来提升工资水平。（JEL J31, J64, J65）

abstract.text: We estimate a model of illicit drugs markets using data on purchases of crack cocaine. Buyers are searching for high-quality drugs, but they determine drugs' quality (i.e., their purity) only after consuming them. Hence, sellers can rip off first-time buyers or can offer higher-quality drugs to induce buyers to purchase from them again. In equilibrium, a distribution of qualities persists. The estimated model implies that if drugs were legalized, in which case purity could be regulated and hence observable, the average purity of drugs would increase by approximately 20 percent and the dispersion would decrease by approximately 80 percent. Moreover, increasing penalties may raise the purity and affordability of the drugs traded by increasing sellers’ relative profitability of targeting loyal buyers versus first-time buyers.

10.1257/aer.20150540.abstractZh: 我们基于可卡因购买数据，建立了一个非法毒品市场的模型。购买者寻求的是高质量毒品，但只有在消费之后才能判断毒品的纯度。因此，卖家可以欺骗首次购买者，或者提供更高品质的毒品以促使购买者再次购买。在均衡状态下，毒品的纯度分布会持续存在。模型预测，如果毒品合法化，并且纯度可以被监管，那么毒品的平均纯度将增加约20%，而纯度分布的离散度将减少约80%。此外，加强惩罚措施可能会提高毒品的纯度和可负担性，因为这将增加卖家针对忠实购买者而非首次购买者的相对盈利能力。

abstract.text: This paper shows how to identify and estimate, using standard semi-parametric techniques, a class of dynamic games with perfect monitoring, that have been at the frontier of recent research in political economy. The empirical analysis provides novel quantitative insights into the trade-off that voters face between ideology and ability, the differences in ability and ideology among parties and states, and the differences in preferences between political candidates and voters. We analyze the consequences of term limits and quantify their relative importance. Specifically, we characterize conditions under which term limits improve voters' welfare. (JEL C57, C73, D72)

10.1257/aer.20150566.abstractZh: 本文展示了如何利用标准的半参数技术，识别和估计一类具有完美监控机制的动态博弈，这类博弈是政治经济学领域近期研究的前沿课题。实证分析为选民在意识形态与能力之间的权衡、不同政党与国家的能力和意识形态差异，以及政治候选人与选民之间的偏好差异提供了新的定量见解。我们还分析了任期限制的影响，并量化了它们的相对重要性。具体而言，我们描述了在何种条件下，任期限制能够提升选民的福利。（JEL C57, C73, D72）

abstract.text: Hayek (1945) argues that local information is key to understanding the efficiency of alternative economic systems and whether production should be centralized or decentralized. The Chinese experience of decentralizing SOEs confirms this insight: when the distance to the government is farther, the SOE is more likely to be decentralized, and this distance-decentralization link is more pronounced with higher communication costs and greater firm-performance heterogeneity. However, when the Chinese central government oversees SOEs in strategic industries, the distance-decentralization link is muted. We also consider alternative agency-cost-based explanations, and do not find much support. (JEL D22, D83, L25, L32, L33, O14, P31)

10.1257/aer.20150592.abstractZh: 哈耶克（1945）认为，本地信息对于理解不同经济体系的效率以及生产是否应该集中化或分散化至关重要。中国对国有企业进行分散化的实践证实了这一观点：与政府的距离越远，国有企业越有可能实现分散化，而这一距离与分散化的关系在通信成本较高且企业绩效存在较大异质性时更为明显。然而，当中国政府对战略产业中的国有企业进行监管时，这一关系则被削弱。我们还考虑了基于代理成本的替代解释，但并未发现足够的支持。（JEL D22, D83, L25, L32, L33, O14, P31）

abstract.text: We provide a comprehensive account of the dynamics of eurozone countries from 2000 to 2012. We analyze private leverage, fiscal policy, labor costs, and spreads, and we propose a model and an identification strategy to separate the impact of credit cycles, excessive government spending, and sudden stops. We then ask how periphery countries would have fared with different policies. We find that countries could have stabilized their employment if they had followed more conservative fiscal policies during the boom. Macroprudential policies and an early intervention by the central bank to prevent market segmentation and reduce fiscal austerity would also have significantly reduced the recession. (JEL E24, E32, E58, E62, F33, F42, H61)

10.1257/aer.20150630.abstractZh: 我们全面分析了2000至2012年间欧元区国家的经济动态。我们研究了私人杠杆率、财政政策、劳动力成本以及利差问题，并提出了一种模型及识别策略，以区分信贷周期、过度政府支出以及突然停止等因素的影响。接着，我们探讨了如果外围国家采取不同的政策，其经济状况会如何。研究发现，如果这些国家在经济繁荣时期采取更为保守的财政政策，这些国家的就业状况本可以保持稳定。此外，宏观审慎政策以及中央银行及早的干预措施，能够防止市场分割并减少财政紧缩，从而显著减轻经济衰退的影响。（JEL E24, E32, E58, E62, F33, F42, H61）

abstract.text: The interaction between community and markets remains a central theme in the social sciences. The empirical evidence is rich: in some instances, markets strengthen social ties, while in others they undermine them. The impact of markets on inequality and welfare also varies widely. This paper develops a model where individuals in a social network choose whether to participate in their network and whether to participate in the market. We show that individual behavior is defined by the q-core of the network and the key to understanding the conflicting evidence is whether the market and the network are complements or substitutes. (JEL D63, D85, J15, L82, O15, Z13, Z31)

10.1257/aer.20150635.abstractZh: 社区与市场之间的互动一直是社会科学中的核心主题。相关的实证证据非常丰富：在某些情况下，市场能够强化社会联系；而在另一些情况下，则可能会破坏这些联系。市场对不平等和福利的影响也各不相同。本文提出了一个模型，其中社交网络中的个体可以选择是否参与网络活动以及是否参与市场活动。我们指出，个体的行为是由网络的q-核心决定的，而理解这些相互矛盾的证据的关键在于市场与网络是互补还是替代关系。（JEL D63, D85, J15, L82, O15, Z13, Z31）

abstract.text: We consider a class of dynamic collective action problems in which either a single principal or two competing principals vie for the support of members of a group. We focus on the dynamic problem that emerges when agents negotiate and commit their support to principals sequentially. We show that competition reduces agents' welfare with public goods, or if and only if there are positive externalities on uncommitted agents, and increases agents' welfare with public bads. We apply the model to the study of corporate takeovers, vote buying, and exclusive deals. (JEL D42, D62, D72, D82, G34, H41)

10.1257/aer.20150755.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一类动态集体行动问题，其中要么是一个单一的主体，要么是两个竞争的主体争夺群体的成员支持。我们关注的是当代理人依次协商并承诺支持某个主体时出现的动态问题。我们表明，竞争会降低代理人的福利，尤其是在涉及公共物品的情况下，或者当且仅当未承诺的代理人能够从中获得正外部性时；而竞争则会提高代理人的福利，尤其是在涉及公共坏情况时。我们将这一模型应用于企业收购、投票操纵和独家交易的研究中。（JEL D42, D62, D72, D82, G34, H41）

abstract.text: We combine georeferenced data on mining extraction of 14 minerals with information on conflict events at spatial resolution of 0.5 o × 0.5 o for all of Africa between 1997 and 2010. Exploiting exogenous variations in world prices, we find a positive impact of mining on conflict at the local level. Quantitatively, our estimates suggest that the historical rise in mineral prices (commodity super-cycle) might explain up to one-fourth of the average level of violence across African countries over the period. We then document how a fighting group's control of a mining area contributes to escalation from local to global violence. Finally, we analyze the impact of corporate practices and transparency initiatives in the mining industry. (JEL C23, D74, L70, O13, Q34)

10.1257/aer.20150774.abstractZh: 我们结合了1997年至2010年间非洲各地14种矿物的地理参考数据，以及冲突事件的信息，这些数据的空间分辨率达到0.5英里×0.5英里。通过利用世界价格的外生变化，我们发现采矿活动对当地冲突产生了积极影响。从数量上看，我们的估计表明，历史上矿物价格的上涨（商品超级周期）可能解释了非洲各国在此期间暴力行为平均水平中高达四分之一的原因。我们还研究了某个武装组织对采矿区的控制如何导致从局部暴力升级为全球性的暴力事件。最后，我们分析了矿业企业行为及透明度举措的影响。（JEL C23, D74, L70, O13, Q34）

abstract.text: This paper develops a method for forecasting the marginal abatement cost (MAC) of climate policy using three features of the failed Waxman-Markey bill. First, the MAC is revealed by the price of traded permits. Second, the permit price is estimated using a regression discontinuity design (RDD) comparing stock returns of firms on either side of the policy's free permit cutoff rule. Third, because Waxman-Markey was never implemented, I extend the RDD approach to incorporate prediction market prices which normalize estimates by policy realization probabilities. A final bounding analysis recovers a MAC range of $5 to $19 per ton CO 2 e. (JEL G12, G14, Q52, Q54, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20150781.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种预测气候政策边际减排成本（MAC）的方法，该方法基于失败的Waxman-Markey法案的三个特征。首先，边际减排成本可以通过交易许可的价格来推断。其次，许可价格是通过回归离散设计（RDD）来估算的，该设计通过比较政策下自由许可截止规则两侧企业的股票回报来进行。第三，由于Waxman-Markey法案从未实施，我扩展了RDD方法，将预测市场价格纳入其中，这些价格通过政策实现概率来规范化估算结果。最终的边界分析表明，边际减排成本的范围在每吨二氧化碳当量5到19美元之间。（JEL G12, G14, Q52, Q54, Q58）

abstract.text: Governments regularly subsidize new ventures to spur innovation. This paper conducts the first large-sample, quasi-experimental evaluation of R&D subsidies. I use data on ranked applicants to the US Department of Energy's SBIR grant program. An early-stage award approximately doubles the probability that a firm receives subsequent venture capital and has large, positive impacts on patenting and revenue. These effects are stronger for more financially constrained firms. Certification, where the award contains information about firm quality, likely does not explain the grant effect. Instead, the grants are useful because they fund technology prototyping.(JEL D22, G24, G32, L53, O31, O34, O38)

10.1257/aer.20150808.abstractZh: 政府经常对新兴企业提供补贴以促进创新。本文首次对研发补贴进行了大规模、准实验性的评估。本文使用了美国能源部SBIR资助计划申请者的数据。早期获得的资助大约使企业获得后续风险投资的概率翻倍，并对专利申请和收入产生显著积极影响。对于资金较为有限的企業来说，这些效应更为明显。如果资助信息中包含企业质量的相关信息，可能并不能完全解释资助的效果。相反，资助之所以有用，是因为它们为技术原型开发提供了资金支持。(JEL D22, G24, G32, L53, O31, O34, O38)

abstract.text: An evidence game is a strategic disclosure game in which an informed agent who has some pieces of verifiable evidence decides which ones to disclose to an uninformed principal who chooses a reward. The agent, regardless of his information, prefers the reward to be as high as possible. We compare the setup in which the principal chooses the reward after the evidence is disclosed to the mechanism-design setup where he can commit in advance to a reward policy, and show that under natural conditions related to the evidence structure and the inherent prominence of truth, the two setups yield the same outcome. (JEL C72, D82, D83, K41)

10.1257/aer.20150913.abstractZh: 证据博弈是一种战略性披露博弈，其中拥有部分可验证证据的知情代理人决定向不知情的委托人披露哪些证据，而委托人则选择奖励。无论代理人掌握何种信息，他都会希望获得的奖励尽可能高。我们比较了委托人披露证据后选择奖励的设定方式，以及他可以提前确定奖励政策的机制设计方式。结果表明，在与证据结构及真理的固有重要性相关的自然条件下，这两种设定方式会产生相同的结果。（JEL C72, D82, D83, K41）

abstract.text: We develop a version of Afriat's theorem that is applicable in a variety of choice environments beyond the setting of classical consumer theory. This allows us to devise tests for rationalizability in environments where the set of alternatives is not the positive orthant of a Euclidean space and where the rationalizing utility function is required to satisfy properties appropriate to that environment. We show that our results are applicable, amongst others, to choice data on lotteries, contingent consumption, and intertemporal consumption. (JEL D11, D81)

10.1257/aer.20150947.abstractZh: 我们发展了一个适用于多种选择环境的Afriat定理版本，超越了经典消费者理论的环境。这使我们能够在替代方案集合不是欧几里得空间正象限的环境中，设计出合理的测试方法，并且要求合理化效用函数满足该环境所需的特性。我们证明，我们的结果适用于彩票选择数据、偶然消费以及跨时期消费等场景。（JEL D11, D81）

abstract.text: We develop a methodology to construct nonparametric counterfactual predictions, free of functional form restrictions on preferences and technology, in neoclassical models of international trade. First, we establish the equivalence between such models and reduced exchange models in which countries directly exchange factor services. This equivalence implies that, for an arbitrary change in trade costs, counterfactual changes in the factor content of trade, factor prices, and welfare only depend on the shape of a reduced factor demand system. Second, we provide sufficient conditions under which estimates of this system can be recovered nonparametrically. Together, these results offer a strict generalization of the parametric approach used in so-called gravity models. Finally, we use China's recent integration into the world economy to illustrate the feasibility and potential benefits of our approach. (JEL C51, D51, F11, F14, O19, P33)

10.1257/aer.20150956.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种方法论，用于构建非参数性反事实预测，这些预测不受偏好和技术功能形式的限制，适用于新古典国际贸易模型。首先，我们建立了这些模型与简化交换模型之间的等价性，在简化交换模型中，各国直接交换要素服务。这种等价性意味着，对于贸易成本的任意变化，贸易要素含量、要素价格以及福利的反事实变化仅取决于简化要素需求系统的形态。其次，我们提供了充分条件，通过这些条件可以非参数性地恢复该系统的估计值。总的来说，这些结果是对所谓重力模型中使用的参数化方法的严格推广。最后，我们以中国最近融入世界经济为例，说明了我们方法的可行性和潜在优势。（JEL C51, D51, F11, F14, O19, P33）

abstract.text: Common views hold that the efficient way to limit warming to a chosen level is to price carbon emissions at a rate that increases exponentially. We show that this Hotelling tax on carbon emissions is actually inefficient. The least-cost policy path takes advantage of the climate system's inertia to delay reducing emissions and allow greater cumulative emissions. The efficient carbon tax follows an inverse-U-shaped path and grows more slowly than the Hotelling tax. Economic models that assume exponentially increasing carbon taxes are overestimating the cost of limiting warming, overestimating the efficient near-term carbon tax, and overvaluing technologies that mature sooner. (JEL H23, Q54, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20150986.abstractZh: 普遍的观点认为，将升温控制在特定水平的有效方法是以呈指数增长的税率对碳排放征税。我们证明，这种霍特林式碳排放税实际上效率低下。最低成本的政策路径利用了气候系统的惯性，推迟减排措施的实施，从而允许更大的累积排放。有效的碳税遵循逆U形路径，其增长速度比霍特林式税收要慢。假设碳排放税呈指数增长的经济模型高估了限制升温的成本，高估了短期内有效的碳税，并高估了那些发展更快的技术的价值。（JEL H23, Q54, Q58）

abstract.text: Using a multisector general equilibrium model, we show that the interplay of idiosyncratic microeconomic shocks and sectoral heterogeneity results in systematic departures in the likelihood of large economic downturns relative to what is implied by the normal distribution. Such departures can emerge even though GDP fluctuations are approximately normally distributed away from the tails, highlighting the different nature of large economic downturns from regular business-cycle fluctuations. We further demonstrate the special role of input-output linkages in generating tail comovements, whereby large recessions involve not only significant GDP contractions, but also large simultaneous declines across a wide range of industries. (JEL D57, E16, E23, E32)

10.1257/aer.20151086.abstractZh: 通过采用多部门一般均衡模型，我们展示了特异性微观经济冲击与部门异质性之间的相互作用，导致大规模经济衰退的可能性与正态分布所暗示的情况存在系统性差异。这种差异即使在经济产出波动大致呈正态分布且远离尾部的情况下仍会出现，这凸显了大规模经济衰退与常规商业周期波动的不同本质。我们进一步证明了投入产出联系在产生尾部协同效应中的特殊作用，即大规模经济衰退不仅涉及显著的GDP收缩，还伴随着广泛行业范围内的同步大幅下滑。（JEL D57, E16, E23, E32）

abstract.text: Online college courses are a rapidly expanding feature of higher education, yet little research identifies their effects relative to traditional in-person classes. Using an instrumental variables approach, we find that taking a course online, instead of in-person, reduces student success and progress in college. Grades are lower both for the course taken online and in future courses. Students are less likely to remain enrolled at the university. These estimates are local average treatment effects for students with access to both online and in-person options; for other students, online classes may be the only option for accessing college-level courses. (JEL I23, I26)

10.1257/aer.20151193.abstractZh: 在线大学课程是高等教育中迅速扩展的一个特点，然而关于其与传统面对面课程相比的影响的研究却很少。通过工具变量方法分析发现，选择在线课程而非面对面课程会降低学生的大学学业成功率和进步速度。无论是在线课程还是后续课程，学生的成绩都较低。学生留在大学就读的可能性也较低。这些估计值是针对那些同时拥有在线和面对面课程选择的学生而言的；对于其他学生来说，在线课程可能是他们获取大学水平课程的唯一选择。（JEL I23, I26）

abstract.text: We analyze how a larger presence of female evaluators affects committee decision-making using information on 100,000 applications to associate and full professorships in Italy and Spain. These applications were assessed by 8,000 randomly selected evaluators. A larger number of women in evaluation committees does not increase either the quantity or the quality of female candidates who qualify. Information from individual voting reports suggests that female evaluators are not significantly more favorable toward female candidates. At the same time, male evaluators become less favorable toward female candidates as soon as a female evaluator joins the committee. (JEL I23, J16, J71)

10.1257/aer.20151211.abstractZh: 我们分析了女性评估者数量的增加如何影响委员会的决策过程，研究数据来自意大利和西班牙的10万份副教授和正教授职位申请。这些申请由8000名随机选择的评估者进行评审。评估委员会中女性数量的增加并未提高符合条件的女性候选人的数量或质量。从个人投票报告中可以看出，女性评估者对女性候选人的态度并没有显著改善。同时，一旦有女性评估者加入委员会，男性评估者对女性候选人的态度就会变得不那么友好。（JEL I23, J16, J71）

abstract.text: Child stunting in India exceeds that in poorer regions like sub-Saharan Africa. Data on over 168,000 children show that, relative to Africa, India's height disadvantage increases sharply with birth order. We posit that India’s steep birth order gradient is due to favoritism toward eldest sons, which affects parents' fertility decisions and resource allocation across children. We show that, within India, the gradient is steeper for high-son-preference regions and religions. The gradient also varies with sibling gender as predicted. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that India's steeper birth order gradient can explain over one-half of the India-Africa gap in average child height.

10.1257/aer.20151282.abstractZh: 印度儿童发育迟缓的情况比撒哈拉以南非洲等较贫穷地区的更为严重。关于超过168,000名儿童的数据表明，与非洲相比，印度的身高劣势随着出生顺序的增加而急剧上升。我们认为，印度这种明显的出生顺序梯度是由于对长子的偏爱，这种偏好影响了父母的生育决策以及资源在子女之间的分配。研究表明，在印度内部，高子偏好地区和宗教中这种梯度更为明显。此外，这种梯度也随兄弟姐妹的性别而变化，这与预期一致。粗略计算表明，印度更为明显的出生顺序梯度可以解释印度与非洲在儿童平均身高上的超过一半差距。

abstract.text: We track the geographic and temporal propagation of local economic shocks from new oil and gas production generated by hydrofracturing. Each million dollars of new production produces $80,000 in wage income and $132,000 in royalty and business income within a county. Within 100 miles, one million dollars of new production generates $257,000 in wages and $286,000 in royalty and business income. Roughly two-thirds of the wage income increase persists for two years. Assuming no general equilibrium effects, new extraction increased aggregate US employment by as many as 640,000, and decreased the unemployment rate by 0.43 during the Great Recession. (JEL D86, L14, L81, L82)

10.1257/aer.20151326.abstractZh: 我们追踪了由水力压裂产生的新的石油和天然气生产对当地经济冲击的地理和时间传播情况。每新增一百万美元的产量，在一个县内会产生80,000美元的工资收入以及132,000美元的特许权使用费和商业收入。在100英里的范围内，每新增一百万美元的产量，会产生257,000美元的工资收入以及286,000美元的特许权使用费和商业收入。大约三分之二的工资收入增长能够持续两年。假设没有一般均衡效应，新的开采活动在大衰退期间使美国的总就业人数增加了多达640,000人，并将失业率降低了0.43。（JEL D86, L14, L81, L82）

abstract.text: Almost all firms in developing countries have fewer than ten workers, with a modal size of one. Are there potential high-growth entrepreneurs, and can public policy help identify them and facilitate their growth? A large-scale national business plan competition in Nigeria provides evidence on these questions. Random assignment of US$34 million in grants provided each winner with approximately US$50,000. Surveys tracking applicants over five years show that winning leads to greater firm entry, more survival, higher profits and sales, and higher employment, including increases of over 20 percentage points in the likelihood of a firm having ten or more workers. (JEL D22, L11, L26, L53, M13, O14)

10.1257/aer.20151404.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，几乎所有企业的员工数量都少于十人，其中大多数企业的规模仅为一家。是否存在潜在的高增长企业家？公共政策能否帮助他们被识别并促进其发展？尼日利亚的一项大规模全国商业计划竞赛为这些问题提供了证据。随机分配的3400万美元资助使每位获胜者获得了约5万美元的资金。对申请者进行的五年跟踪调查显示，获胜者能够带来更多的企业参与、更高的存活率、更高的利润和销售额，以及更高的就业率，包括企业拥有十名或更多员工的可能性增加了20个百分点以上。（JEL D22, L11, L26, L53, M13, O14）

abstract.text: We develop a novel framework to analyze the structural implications of the marriage market for household consumption. We define a revealed preference characterization of efficient household consumption when the marriage is stable. We characterize stable marriage with intrahousehold (consumption) transfers but without assuming transferable utility. Our revealed preference characterization generates testable conditions even with a single observation per household and heterogeneous individual preferences across households. The characterization also allows for identifying the intrahousehold decision structure (including the sharing rule) under the same minimalistic assumptions. An application to Dutch household data illustrates the usefulness of our theoretical results. (JEL D60, D63, H21, H23, I38)

10.1257/aer.20151413.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个新颖的框架，用于分析婚姻市场对家庭消费的结构性影响。我们定义了在婚姻稳定时有效家庭消费的一种显示偏好特征。我们描述了包含家庭内部消费转移的稳定婚姻模式，但并未假设转移效用。我们的显示偏好特征即使在每个家庭仅有一次观察数据以及家庭间偏好存在异质性的情况下，也能生成可检验的条件。该特征还允许在相同的简约假设下识别家庭内部的决策结构（包括分配规则）。将这一理论结果应用于荷兰家庭数据，证明了其实用性。（JEL D60, D63, H21, H23, I38）

abstract.text: Coordinated single-offer school assignment systems are a popular education reform. We show that uncoordinated offers in NYC's school assignment mechanism generated mismatches. One-third of applicants were unassigned after the main round and later administratively placed at less desirable schools. We evaluate the effects of the new coordinated mechanism based on deferred acceptance using estimated student preferences. The new mechanism achieves 80 percent of the possible gains from a no-choice neighborhood extreme to a utilitarian benchmark. Coordinating offers dominates the effects of further algorithm modifications. Students most likely to be previously administratively assigned experienced the largest gains in welfare and subsequent achievement. (JEL C78, D82, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.20151425.abstractZh: 协调的单一申请学校分配系统是一项受欢迎的教育改革措施。我们发现，纽约市学校分配机制中缺乏协调的申请导致了不匹配的情况。三分之一的申请者在第一轮分配后未被分配，随后被安排到不太理想的学校。我们基于估计的学生偏好，评估了新协调机制的效果。新机制实现了从无选择邻域极端情况到功利主义基准的80%潜在收益。协调的申请方式在进一步算法改进中占据了主导地位。那些之前可能被行政分配的学生在福利和学业成绩方面获得了最大的提升。（JEL C78, D82, I21, I28）

abstract.text: Multiplicity of equilibria and the dependence on strong common knowledge assumptions are well-known problems in mechanism design. We address them by studying full implementation via transfer schemes, under general restrictions on agents' beliefs. We show that incentive-compatible transfers ensure uniqueness—and hence full implementation—if they induce sufficiently weak strategic externalities. We then design transfers for full implementation by using information on beliefs in order to weaken the strategic externalities of the baseline canonical transfers. Our results rely on minimal restrictions on agents' beliefs, specifically on moments of the distribution of types, that arise naturally in applications. (JEL D62, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20151462.abstractZh: 均衡的多重性以及对强共同知识假设的依赖是机制设计中的众所周知的问题。我们通过研究在代理人信念的一般限制下的完全实施方案来解决这些问题。我们表明，如果激励相容的转移方案能够引发足够弱的策略性外部性，那么这些方案就能确保唯一性——从而实现完全实施。然后，我们设计了一种转移方案，利用关于信念的信息来削弱基线典型转移方案中的策略性外部性，从而实现完全实施。我们的结果依赖于对代理人信念的最小限制，特别是类型分布的概率矩，这些限制在应用中是自然而然出现的。（JEL D62, D82, D83）

abstract.text: Did the financial crisis in 2007–2008 spread from distressed banks to households through a contraction of the credit supply? We study this question with a dataset that contains observations on all accounts in Danish banks as well as comprehensive information about individual account holders and banks. We document that banks exposed to the financial crisis reduced their lending relative to nonexposed banks, which in turn caused a significant decrease in the borrowing and spending of their customers. The effects were persistent: borrowing remained lower through the postcrisis years and spending foregone during the crisis was not recovered. (JEL D12, D14, E21, E32, G01, G21)

10.1257/aer.20151497.abstractZh: 2007-2008年的金融危机是通过信贷供应收缩，从困境中的银行扩散到家庭吗？我们使用了一个包含丹麦银行所有账户数据以及关于个人账户持有者和银行的全面信息的数据集来研究这个问题。我们发现，面临金融危机的银行相对于未受影响的银行减少了贷款，这反过来导致了客户借款和支出的显著下降。这些影响是持久的：在危机后的几年里，借款水平仍然较低，而危机期间被抑制的支出并未恢复。（JEL D12, D14, E21, E32, G01, G21）

abstract.text: We study the impact of large exchange rate devaluations on the cost of living at different points on the income distribution. Poor households spend relatively more on tradeable product categories and consume lower-priced varieties within categories. Changes in the relative price of tradeables and of lower-priced varieties affect the cost of living of low-income relative to high-income households. We quantify these effects following the 1994 Mexican devaluation and show that they can have large distributional consequences. Two years post-devaluation, the cost of living for the bottom income decile rose 1.48 to 1.62 times more than for the top income decile. (JEL D12, D31, E31, F31, O12, O19, O24)

10.1257/aer.20151551.abstractZh: 我们研究了大幅汇率贬值对不同收入分布层次的生活成本的影响。贫困家庭在可交易产品类别上的支出相对较多，并且倾向于消费这些类别中价格较低的品种。可交易产品以及价格较低品种的相对价格变化，会影晌低收入家庭与高收入家庭的生活成本。我们通过1994年墨西哥货币贬值事件来量化这些影响，并发现其可能带来重大的分配后果。贬值两年后，最低收入群体的生活成本是最高收入群体的1.48至1.62倍。（JEL D12, D31, E31, F31, O12, O19, O24）

abstract.text: We extend search theory to multiple indivisible units and perfectly divisible assets, solving them respectively with induction and recursion. Buyer demands and prices are random, and the seller can partially exercise orders. With divisible assets, the Bellman value function is increasing and strictly concave, and the optimal reservation price falls in the position, reflecting increasing holding costs (opportunity cost of delaying optionality for inframarginal units). The marginal value exists, and is strictly convex with a falling purchase cap density. Our model is amenable to price-quantity bargaining; e.g., greater buyer bargaining power is tantamount to greater search frictions. (JEL C61, C78, D25, D83, G31)

10.1257/aer.20151579.abstractZh: 我们将搜索理论扩展到多个不可分割的单元和完全可分割的资产，分别通过归纳法和递归法来解决这些问题。买方需求和价格是随机的，卖方可以部分行使订单。在可分割的资产情况下，贝尔曼价值函数是递增且严格凹的，最优保留价格位于该位置，反映出持有成本的增加（对于次边缘单元而言，延迟选择性的机会成本增加）。边际价值存在，并且是严格凸的，购买上限的密度则呈下降趋势。我们的模型适用于价格-数量谈判；例如，买方议价能力越强，搜索摩擦就越大。（JEL C61, C78, D25, D83, G31）

abstract.text: We study the effect of wealth on labor supply using the randomized assignment of monetary prizes in a large sample of Swedish lottery players. Winning a lottery prize modestly reduces earnings, with the reduction being immediate, persistent, and quite similar by age, education, and sex. A calibrated dynamic model implies lifetime marginal propensities to earn out of unearned income from −0.17 at age 20 to −0.04 at age 60, and labor supply elasticities in the lower range of previously reported estimates. The earnings response is stronger for winners than their spouses, which is inconsistent with unitary household labor supply models. (JEL D14, J22, J31)

10.1257/aer.20151589.abstractZh: 我们研究了财富对劳动力供给的影响，通过随机分配货币奖金的方式，对大量瑞典彩票玩家进行了研究。赢得彩票奖金会适度降低收入，这种影响是立即生效的，并且在不同年龄、教育水平和性别上表现出相似的趋势。经过校准的动态模型表明，从20岁的−0.17到60岁的−0.04，人们从非劳动收入中获得的边际收益倾向呈下降趋势，同时劳动力供给的弹性也处于先前报告估计值中的较低范围。与配偶相比，中奖者对收入的反应更为强烈，这与单位家庭劳动力供给模型的观点不一致。（JEL D14, J22, J31）

abstract.text: This paper studies the implications of individuals’ knowledge of future job loss for the existence of an unemployment insurance (UI) market. Learning about job loss leads to consumption decreases and spousal labor supply increases. This suggests existing willingness to pay estimates for UI understate its value. But it yields new estimation methodologies that account for and exploit responses to learning about future job loss. Although the new willingness to pay estimates exceed previous estimates, I estimate much larger frictions imposed by private information. This suggests privately traded UI policies would be too adversely selected to be profitable, at any price. (JEL D82, D83, G22, J22, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20151655.abstractZh: 本文研究了个人对未来失业信息的了解对失业保险市场存在性的影响。了解失业信息会导致消费减少和配偶劳动力供给增加。这表明现有的失业保险支付意愿估计值低估了其价值。但新的估计方法能够考虑并利用对未来失业信息的反应。尽管新的支付意愿估计值高于之前的估计值，但我估计了由私人信息带来的更大摩擦。这表明私人交易的失业保险政策在任何价格下都过于不利，无法盈利。（JEL D82, D83, G22, J22, J64, J65）

abstract.text: We estimate the causal effect of sovereign default on the equity returns of Argentine firms. We identify this effect by exploiting changes in the probability of Argentine sovereign default induced by legal rulings in the case of NML Capital, Ltd. v. Republic of Argentina. We find that a 10 percent increase in the probability of default causes a 6 percent decline in the value of Argentine equities and a 1 percent depreciation of a measure of the exchange rate. We examine the channels through which a sovereign default may affect the economy. (JEL D22, F31, F34, G32, O14, O16, O19)

10.1257/aer.20151667.abstractZh: 我们估计了主权违约对阿根廷企业股票回报的因果效应。我们通过利用NML Capital, Ltd.诉阿根廷共和国案中法律裁决导致的阿根廷主权违约概率变化来识别这一效应。我们发现，违约概率增加10%，会导致阿根廷股票价值下降6%，以及汇率指标贬值1%。我们进一步探讨了主权违约可能影响经济的途径。（JEL D22, F31, F34, G32, O14, O16, O19）

abstract.text: Crowdfunding provides innovation in enabling entrepreneurs to contract with consumers before investment. Under aggregate demand uncertainty, this improves screening for valuable projects. Entrepreneurial moral hazard and private cost information threatens this benefit. Crowdfunding's after-markets enable consumers to actively implement deferred payments and thereby manage moral hazard. Popular crowdfunding platforms offer schemes that allow consumers to do so through conditional pledging behavior. Efficiency is sustainable only if expected returns exceed an agency cost associated with the entrepreneurial incentive problems. By reducing demand uncertainty, crowdfunding promotes welfare and complements traditional entrepreneurial financing, which focuses on controlling moral hazard. (JEL D21, D81, D82, D86, G32, L26)

10.1257/aer.20151700.abstractZh: 众筹为企业家提供了在投资之前与消费者进行合作的机会，从而推动了创新。在总需求不确定的情况下，这有助于筛选出有价值的项目。然而，企业家道德风险以及私人成本信息可能会威胁到这一优势。众筹的“后市场”功能使消费者能够主动实施延期付款，从而管理道德风险。受欢迎的众筹平台提供了通过有条件承诺行为来实现这一功能的方案。只有当预期回报超过与企业家激励问题相关的代理成本时，效率才能持续。通过降低需求不确定性，众筹促进了福利，并补充了传统创业融资方式，后者主要关注控制道德风险。（JEL D21, D81, D82, D86, G32, L26）

abstract.text: Considering markets with nonpivotal buyers, we analyze the anticompetitive effects of breakup fees used by an incumbent facing a more efficient entrant in the future. Buyers differ in their intrinsic switching costs. Breakup fees are profitably used to foreclose entry, regardless of the entrant's efficiency advantage or level of switching costs. Banning breakup fees is beneficial to consumers. The ban enhances the total welfare unless the entrant's efficiency is close to the incumbent's. Inefficient foreclosure arises not because of rent shifting from the entrant, but because the incumbent uses a long-term contract to manipulate consumers' expected surplus from not signing it. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D86, L13, L51)

10.1257/aer.20151710.abstractZh: 在考虑非核心买家的市场情况下，我们分析了现有企业面对未来更高效的新进入者时，使用分手费所带来的反竞争效应。不同买家的内在转换成本各不相同。无论新进入者的效率优势如何，或者转换成本水平如何，使用分手费都是有利可图的，因为这样可以阻止新进入者进入市场。禁止使用分手费对消费者是有益的。除非新进入者的效率与现有企业相近，否则禁令会提升整体福利。无效的进入限制并非因为租金从新进入者转移，而是因为现有企业利用长期合同来操纵消费者不签署合同的预期收益。（JEL D11, D21, D43, D86, L13, L51）

abstract.text: We study information spillovers in a dynamic setting with correlated assets owned by privately informed sellers. In the model, a trade of one asset can provide information about the value of other assets. Importantly, the information content of trading behavior is endogenously determined. We show that this endogeneity leads to multiple equilibria when assets are sufficiently correlated. The equilibria are ranked in terms of both trade volume and efficiency. The model has implications for policies targeting post-trade transparency. We show that introducing post-trade transparency can increase or decrease welfare and trading volume depending on the asset correlation, equilibrium being played, and the composition of market participants. (JEL D82, D83, G14, G18)

10.1257/aer.20151714.abstractZh: 我们研究了在动态环境中，由私人知情卖家持有的相关资产所带来的信息溢出效应。在模型中，一种资产的交易可以提供其他资产价值的信息。重要的是，交易行为的信息含量是由内生因素决定的。我们表明，这种内生性会导致当资产相关性足够强时出现多个均衡状态。这些均衡状态根据交易量和效率进行排名。该模型对旨在提高交易后透明度的政策具有启示意义。我们指出，引入交易后透明度可以依据资产相关性、所参与的均衡状态以及市场参与者的构成，增加或减少福利和交易量。（JEL D82, D83, G14, G18）

abstract.text: The evidence for the United States points to balanced growth despite falling investment-good prices and a less-than-unitary elasticity of substitution between capital and labor. This is inconsistent with the Uzawa Growth Theorem. We extend Uzawa's theorem to show that the introduction of human capital accumulation in the standard way does not resolve the puzzle. However, balanced growth is possible if education is endogenous and capital is more complementary with schooling than with raw labor. We present a class of aggregate production functions for which a neoclassical growth model with capital-augmenting technological progress and endogenous schooling converges to a balanced growth path. (JEL E22, E24, I26, J24, O33, O41, O47)

10.1257/aer.20151739.abstractZh: 针对美国的证据表明，尽管投资商品价格下降以及资本与劳动力之间的替代弹性小于1，经济增长仍然保持平衡。这与Uzawa增长定理不符。我们扩展了Uzawa的定理，发现以传统方式引入人力资本积累并不能解决这一难题。然而，如果教育被认为是内生变量，并且资本与教育的互补性高于与原始劳动力的互补性，那么平衡增长是可能的。我们提出了一类综合生产函数，其中具有资本增强技术进步和内生教育的新古典增长模型能够收敛到平衡增长路径。（JEL E22, E24, I26, J24, O33, O41, O47）

abstract.text: A seller designs a mechanism to sell a single object to a potential buyer whose private type is his incomplete information about his valuation. The seller can disclose additional information to the buyer about his valuation without observing its realization. In both discrete-type and continuous-type settings, we show that discriminatory disclosure—releasing different amounts of additional information to different buyer types—dominates full disclosure in terms of seller revenue. An implication is that the orthogonal decomposition technique, while an important tool in dynamic mechanism design, is generally invalid when information disclosure is part of the design. (JEL D11, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20151743.abstractZh: 一位卖家设计了一种机制，用于向潜在买家出售一个单一物品，而买家对其价值的了解是不完全的。卖家可以在不观察买家行为的情况下，向买家透露关于其价值的额外信息。在离散型与连续型两种情况下，我们表明，在卖家收益方面，针对不同买家类型进行差异化的信息披露更为有效。这意味着，尽管正交分解技术在动态机制设计中是一个重要工具，但当信息披露是设计的一部分时，这种技术通常是不有效的。（JEL D11, D82, D83）

abstract.text: In many competitive settings, consumers buy multiple product categories, and some prefer to use a single firm, generating complementary cross-category price effects. To study pricing in supermarkets, an organizational form where these effects are internalized, we develop a multi-category, multi-seller demand model and estimate it using UK consumer data. This class of model is used widely in theoretical analysis of retail pricing. We quantify cross-category pricing effects and find that internalizing them substantially reduces market power. We find that consumers inclined to one-stop (rather than multi-stop) shopping have a greater pro-competitive impact because they generate relatively large cross-category effects. (JEL D12, L11, L13, L81)

10.1257/aer.20160055.abstractZh: 在许多竞争环境中，消费者会购买多个产品类别的商品，有些人更倾向于使用单一企业，从而产生互补的跨类别价格效应。为了研究超市中的定价问题，我们开发了一个能够内部化这些效应的组织形式，并基于英国消费者数据对该模型进行了估计。这类模型在零售定价的理论分析中被广泛使用。我们量化了跨类别价格效应，并发现内部化这些效应可以显著减少市场力量。我们发现，倾向于一站式购物（而非多步购物）的消费者具有更强的促进竞争的作用，因为他们产生的跨类别效应相对较大。（JEL D12, L11, L13, L81）

abstract.text: We develop a model where party leaders choose the competence of politicians on the ballot to trade off electoral success against their own survival. The predicted correlation between the competence of party leaders and followers is strongly supported in Swedish data. We use a novel approach, based on register data for the earnings of the whole population, to measure the competence of all politicians in 7 parties, 290 municipalities, and 10 elections (for the period 1982–2014). We ask how competence was affected by a zipper quota, requiring local parties to alternate men and women on the ballot, implemented by the Social Democratic Party in 1993. Far from being at odds with meritocracy, this quota raised the competence of male politicians where it raised female representation the most. We argue that resignation of mediocre male leaders was a key driver of this effect. (JEL D72, J16)

10.1257/aer.20160080.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，其中政党领袖通过投票选择政治人物的能力，以在选举成功与自身生存之间取得平衡。在瑞典的数据中，政党领袖与追随者之间的能力相关性得到了有力支持。我们采用了一种新颖的方法，基于整个人口的收入登记数据，来衡量7个政党、290个市镇以及10次选举中所有政治人物的能力（时间范围为1982年至2014年）。我们探讨了“拉链配额”如何影响政治人物的能力，该配额要求地方政党在候选人名单中交替安排男性和女性候选人，这一措施由社会民主党于1993年实施。这一配额与精英制度并无冲突，反而提升了男性政治人物的能力，同时女性代表的比例也得到了提升。我们认为，平庸的男性领袖的辞职是这种效果的关键驱动因素。（JEL D72, J16）

abstract.text: We present a decision-theoretic analysis of an agent's understanding of the interdependencies in her choices. We provide the foundations for a simple and flexible model that allows the misperception of correlated risks. We introduce a framework in which the decision maker chooses a portfolio of assets among which she may misperceive the joint returns, and present simple axioms equivalent to a representation in which she attaches a probability to each possible joint distribution over returns and then maximizes subjective expected utility using her ( possibly misspecified) beliefs. (JEL D11, D81, D83, G11)

10.1257/aer.20160093.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种决策理论分析，用于研究一个代理人对其选择中相互依赖关系的理解。我们为这样一个简单而灵活的模型奠定了基础，该模型允许代理人对相关风险产生误解。我们引入了一个框架，在这个框架中，决策者可以在一系列资产中选择一个投资组合，并可能误解这些资产的联合回报。我们提出了一些简单的公理，这些公理相当于一个表示方式，即决策者为每个可能的回报联合分布赋予一个概率，然后利用她的（可能错误的）信念来最大化主观期望效用。（JEL D11, D81, D83, G11）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes a bilateral trade model where the buyer's valuation for the object is uncertain and she observes only a signal about her valuation. The seller gives a take-it-or-leave-it offer to the buyer. Our goal is to characterize those signal structures which maximize the buyer's expected payoff. We identify a buyer-optimal signal structure which generates (i) efficient trade and (ii) a unit-elastic demand. Furthermore, we show that every other buyer-optimal signal structure yields the same outcome as the one we identify: in particular, the same price. (JEL D11, D42, D82, D83, L12)

10.1257/aer.20160145.abstractZh: 本文分析了一个双边贸易模型，其中买方的物品估值是不确定的，她只能观察到关于自己估值的信号。卖方向买方提供一个接受或放弃的报价。我们的目标是确定那些能够最大化买方预期收益的信号结构。我们找到了一种买方最优信号结构，这种结构能够产生（i）有效的交易和（ii）单位弹性需求。此外，我们表明其他所有买方最优信号结构都会产生与我们确定的那种结构相同的结果：特别是，价格也会相同。（JEL D11, D42, D82, D83, L12）

abstract.text: We show that any well-behaved demand function can be represented by its “demand manifold,” a smooth curve that relates the elasticity and convexity of demand. This manifold is a sufficient statistic for many comparative statics questions; leads naturally to characterizations of new families of demand functions that nest most of those used in applied economics; and connects assumptions about demand structure with firm behavior and economic performance. In particular, the demand manifold leads to new insights about industry adjustment with heterogeneous firms, and can be empirically estimated to provide a quantitative framework for measuring the effects of globalization. (JEL F12, L11)

10.1257/aer.20160175.abstractZh: 我们证明，任何行为良好的需求函数都可以用“需求流形”来表示，这是一种平滑曲线，能够关联需求的弹性和凸性。这种流形是许多比较静态问题的充分统计量；它自然引出了对新的需求函数族的表征，这些函数族涵盖了应用经济学中大多数使用的需求函数；并且将关于需求结构的假设与企业的行为和经济绩效联系起来。特别是，需求流形为异质企业下的行业调整提供了新的见解，并且可以通过实证估计来提供一个定量框架，以衡量全球化的影响。（JEL F12, L11）

abstract.text: We show that policy uncertainty about how the rising public debt will be stabilized accounts for the lack of deflation in the US economy at the zero lower bound. We first estimate a Markov-switching VAR to highlight that a zero-lower-bound regime captures most of the comovements during the Great Recession: a deep recession, no deflation, and large fiscal imbalances. We then show that a microfounded model that features policy uncertainty accounts for these stylized facts. Finally, we highlight that policy uncertainty arises at the zero lower bound because of a trade-off between mitigating the recession and preserving long-run macroeconomic stability. (JEL E31, E32, E52, E62, G01, H63)

10.1257/aer.20160186.abstractZh: 我们指出，关于如何稳定不断增长的公共债务的政策不确定性，是美国经济在零下限条件下缺乏通缩的原因。我们首先使用马尔可夫切换向量自回归模型进行估计，以表明零下限制度能够解释大衰退期间的大部分共同趋势：深度衰退、无通缩以及严重的财政失衡。随后，我们展示了一个基于微观基础的模型，该模型考虑了政策不确定性，能够解释这些典型现象。最后，我们指出，在零下限条件下，政策不确定性的产生是由于在缓解经济衰退与保持长期宏观经济稳定之间做出权衡的结果。（JEL E31, E32, E52, E62, G01, H63）

abstract.text: We study how relational contracts mitigate Becker's classic problem of providing general human capital when training contracts are incomplete. The firm's profit-maximizing agreement is a multiperiod apprenticeship in which the novice is trained gradually over time and eventually receives all knowledge. The firm adopts a 1/e rule, whereby at the beginning of the relationship the novice is trained, for free, just enough to produce a fraction 1/e of the efficient output. After that, the novice earns all additional knowledge with labor. This rule causes inefficiently lengthy relationships that grow longer the more patient the players. A minimum wage is welfare enhancing. (JEL D82, D86, J24, M53)

10.1257/aer.20160194.abstractZh: 我们研究了关系契约如何缓解贝克尔提出的经典问题——在培训合同不完整的情况下如何提供通用人力资本。企业的利润最大化协议是一种多期学徒制，在这个过程中，新手会逐步接受培训，最终获得所有知识。企业采用1/e规则：在关系开始时，新手会免费接受足够的培训，以产生有效产出的一部分1/e。之后，新手通过劳动获得所有额外的知识。这一规则导致关系变得效率低下且持续时间延长，尤其是当参与者更加耐心时。设定最低工资能够提升福利水平。（JEL D82, D86, J24, M53）

abstract.text: We analyze sequential, binary voting schemes in settings where several privately informed agents have single-peaked preferences over a finite set of alternatives, and we focus on robust equilibria that do not depend on assumptions about the players' beliefs about each other. Our main results identify two intuitive conditions on binary voting trees, ensuring that sincere voting at each stage forms an ex post perfect equilibrium. In particular, we uncover a strong rationale for content-based agendas: if the outcome should not be sensitive to beliefs about others, nor to the deployment of strategic skills, the agenda needs to be built “from the extremes to the middle” so that more extreme alternatives are both more difficult to adopt, and are put to vote before other, more moderate options. An important corollary is that, under simple majority, the equilibrium outcome of the incomplete information game is always the Condorcet winner. Finally, we aim to guide the practical design of schemes that are widely used by legislatures and committees and we illustrate our findings with several case studies. (JEL D71, D72, I10, J16, J32, K10)

10.1257/aer.20160277.abstractZh: 我们分析了在多个私人信息代理人对有限备选方案具有单峰偏好情况下的顺序二元投票机制，重点关注那些不依赖于代理人相互认知假设的稳健均衡。我们的主要研究结果指出了二元投票树的两个直观条件，确保每个阶段的真诚投票能够形成事后完美的均衡。特别地，我们发现了基于内容的议程安排的合理依据：如果结果不应受到对他人的认知或战略技能运用的影响，那么议程安排需要从极端到中间逐步构建，这样更极端的备选方案不仅更难采纳，也会在其他较为温和的选项之前被纳入投票。一个重要推论是，在简单多数原则下，信息不完全的博弈的均衡结果总是符合康德赛特原则的胜利者。最后，我们旨在为立法机构和委员会广泛使用的投票机制的实际设计提供指导，并通过几个案例研究来说明我们的发现。（JEL D71, D72, I10, J16, J32, K10）

abstract.text: We propose a novel and easy-to-implement approach to detect potential overbilling based on the hours worked implied by the service codes which physicians submit to Medicare. Using the Medicare Part B Fee- for-Service (FFS) Physician Utilization and Payment Data in 2012 and 2013 released by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, we construct estimates for physicians' hours spent on Medicare beneficiaries. We find that about 2,300 physicians, representing about 3 percent of those with 20 or more hours of Medicare Part B FFS services, have billed Medicare over 100 hours per week. We consider these implausibly long hours.

10.1257/aer.20160349.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖且易于实施的方法，用于检测基于医生向医疗保险机构提交的服务代码所暗示的工作时间而可能出现的过度计费问题。利用美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心在2012年和2013年发布的医疗保险B部分按服务收费（FFS）医生使用情况和支付数据，我们估算了医生为医疗保险受益人服务所花费的时间。我们发现，约有2300名医生，占提供20小时或更多医疗保险B部分按服务收费服务的医生总数的约3%，每周向医疗保险机构计费的时间超过了100小时。我们认为这些异常长的工作时间是不合理的。

abstract.text: A strategy is obviously dominant if, for any deviation, at any information set where both strategies first diverge, the best outcome under the deviation is no better than the worst outcome under the dominant strategy. A mechanism is obviously strategy-proof (OSP) if it has an equilibrium in obviously dominant strategies. This has a behavioral interpretation: a strategy is obviously dominant if and only if a cognitively limited agent can recognize it as weakly dominant. It also has a classical interpretation: a choice rule is OSP-implementable if and only if it can be carried out by a social planner under a particular regime of partial commitment. (JEL D11, D44, D82)

10.1257/aer.20160425.abstractZh: 如果对于任何偏差，在任何两个策略首次出现分歧的信息集上，偏离情况下的最佳结果都不优于占优策略下的最坏结果，那么这种策略显然具有优势。如果一个机制在明显占优的策略下存在均衡，那么它显然具有策略防御性（OSP）。从行为学的角度来看，一个策略显然具有优势当且仅当认知有限的代理人能够将其识别为弱优势策略。从经典经济学理论的角度来看，一个选择规则是OSP可实施的当且仅当在社会规划者在特定的部分承诺制度下能够执行该规则。（JEL D11, D44, D82）

abstract.text: Online prices are increasingly used for measurement and research applications, yet little is known about their relation to prices collected offline, where most retail transactions take place. I conduct the first large-scale comparison of prices simultaneously collected from the websites and physical stores of 56 large multi-channel retailers in 10 countries. I find that price levels are identical about 72 percent of the time. Price changes are not synchronized but have similar frequencies and average sizes. These results have implications for national statistical offices, researchers using online data, and anyone interested in the effect of the Internet on retail prices. (JEL D22, L11, L81, O14)

10.1257/aer.20160542.abstractZh: 在线价格越来越多地被用于测量和研究应用，但关于其与线下收集的价格之间的关系，我们知之甚少。线下是大多数零售交易发生的场所。我首次对来自10个国家56家大型多渠道零售商的网站和实体店同时收集的价格进行了大规模比较。我发现，大约72%的情况下，价格水平是相同的。价格变化并不同步，但频率和平均幅度相似。这些结果对国家统计机构、使用在线数据的研究人员以及任何对互联网对零售价格影响感兴趣的人都具有意义。（JEL D22, L11, L81, O14）

abstract.text: A decision maker doubts the stationarity of his environment. In response, he uses two models, one with time-varying parameters, and another with constant parameters. Forecasts are then based on a Bayesian model averaging strategy, which mixes forecasts from the two models. In reality, structural parameters are constant, but the (unknown) true model features expectational feedback, which the reduced-form models neglect. This feedback permits fears of parameter instability to become self-confirming. Within the context of a standard asset-pricing model, we use the tools of large deviations theory to show that even though the constant parameter model would converge to the rational expectations equilibrium if considered in isolation, the mere presence of an unstable alternative drives it out of consideration. (JEL C63, D83, D84)

10.1257/aer.20160665.abstractZh: 决策者对其所处环境的稳定性持怀疑态度。为此，他使用了两种模型：一种具有时变参数，另一种具有常数参数。预测结果基于贝叶斯模型平均策略，该策略结合了两种模型的预测结果。实际上，结构参数是恒定的，但（未知的）真实模型特征包含了预期反馈，而简化形式模型忽略了这一点。这种反馈使得对参数不稳定性的担忧得以自我确认。在标准资产定价模型的背景下，我们利用大偏差理论的工具表明，尽管常数参数模型如果单独考虑会收敛到理性预期均衡，但仅仅存在一个不稳定的替代方案就会使其失去考虑价值。（JEL C63, D83, D84）

abstract.text: In a field experiment with a retail chain (1,300 employees, 193 shops), randomly selected sales teams received a bonus. The bonus increases both sales and number of customers dealt with by 3 percent. Each dollar spent on the bonus generates $3.80 in sales, and $2.10 in profit. Wages increase by 2.2 percent while inequality rises only moderately. The analysis suggests effort complementarities to be important, and the effectiveness of peer pressure in overcoming free-riding to be limited. After rolling out the bonus scheme, the performance of the treatment and control shops converges, suggesting long-term stability of the treatment effect. (JEL D22, J31, J33, L25, L81, M53, M54)

10.1257/aer.20160788.abstractZh: 在一项针对零售连锁店（拥有1,300名员工，193家门店）的实地实验中，随机选取的销售团队获得了奖金。该奖金使销售额和接待客户数量分别增加了3%。每花费1美元用于奖金，可带来3.80美元的销售额和2.10美元的利润。工资水平增加了2.2%，而不平等程度仅略有上升。分析表明，努力的互补性非常重要，而同伴压力在克服搭便车行为方面的效果有限。在实施奖金计划后，实验组和对照组的业绩趋于一致，这表明该计划的效果具有长期稳定性。（JEL D22, J31, J33, L25, L81, M53, M54）

abstract.text: We measure the persuasive effects of slanted news and tastes for like-minded news, exploiting cable channel positions as exogenous shifters of cable news viewership. Channel positions do not correlate with demographics that predict viewership and voting, nor with local satellite viewership. We estimate that Fox News increases Republican vote shares by 0.3 points among viewers induced into watching 2.5 additional minutes per week by variation in position. We then estimate a model of voters who select into watching slanted news, and whose ideologies evolve as a result. We use the model to assess the growth over time of Fox News influence, to quantitatively assess media-driven polarization, and to simulate alternative ideological slanting of news channels. (JEL D72, L82)

10.1257/aer.20160812.abstractZh: 我们研究了倾斜新闻和迎合相同观点的新闻在说服效果上的差异，并将有线电视频道的立场作为影响观众观看习惯的外生因素。研究发现，电视频道的立场与预测观众和投票行为的人口统计特征无关，也与当地卫星电视的收视率无关。我们估计，由于频道立场的变化，福克斯新闻使观众每周额外观看2.5分钟新闻的时间增加，从而使共和党的得票率增加了0.3个百分点。接着，我们建立了一个模型，用于分析选择观看倾斜新闻的选民，以及他们的意识形态因此而产生的变化。我们利用该模型来评估福克斯新闻影响力随时间的变化，定量分析媒体驱动的极化现象，并模拟新闻频道不同的意识形态倾向。（JEL D72, L82）

abstract.text: A new basis for an international poverty measurement is proposed based on linear programming for specifying the least cost diet and explicit budgeting for nonfood spending. This approach is superior to the World Bank's $1-a-day line because it is (i) clearly related to survival and well being; (ii) comparable across time and space since the same nutritional requirements are used everywhere while nonfood spending is tailored to climate; (iii) adjusts consumption patterns to local prices; (iv) presents no index number problems since solutions are always in local prices; and (v) requires only readily available information. The new approach implies much more poverty than the World Bank's, especially in Asia. (JEL C61, I14, I31, I32, O15)

10.1257/aer.20161080.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于线性规划的国际贫困测量新方法，该方法旨在确定最低成本的饮食方案，并对非食品支出进行明确预算。这种方法优于世界银行提出的“每天1美元”标准，因为它具有以下优点：(i) 与生存和福祉密切相关；(ii) 由于各地使用相同的营养需求标准，且非食品支出会根据气候情况进行调整，因此具有跨时间和空间的可比性；(iii) 能够根据当地价格调整消费模式；(iv) 由于解决方案始终以当地价格表示，因此不存在指数数值问题；(v) 只需要易于获取的信息即可实施。这种新方法所反映的贫困程度远高于世界银行的指标，尤其是在亚洲地区。(JEL C61, I14, I31, I32, O15)

abstract.text: We study the evolution of trade liberalization's effects on Brazilian local labor markets. Regions facing larger tariff cuts experienced prolonged declines in formal sector employment and earnings relative to other regions. The impact of tariff changes on regional earnings 20 years after liberalization was three times the effect after 10 years. These increasing effects on regional earnings are inconsistent with conventional spatial equilibrium models, which predict declining effects due to spatial arbitrage. We investigate potential mechanisms, finding empirical support for a mechanism involving imperfect interregional labor mobility and dynamics in labor demand, driven by slow capital adjustment and agglomeration economies. This mechanism gradually amplifies the effects of liberalization, explaining the slow adjustment path of regional earnings and quantitatively accounting for the magnitude of the long-run effects. (JEL F16, J23, J31, J61, O15, O19, R23)

10.1257/aer.20161214.abstractZh: 我们研究了贸易自由化对巴西本地劳动力市场影响的演变。面临更大关税削减的地区，正式部门就业和收入下降的时间比其他地区要长。关税变化对地区收入的影响在自由化20年后是10年后的三倍。这些对地区收入的影响增加与传统的空间均衡模型不符，后者预测由于空间套利效应而会出现下降。我们调查了潜在的机制，发现实证支持了一种机制，即由于区域间劳动力流动的不完全性和劳动力需求的动态性，加上资本调整的缓慢和集聚经济效应，这种机制逐渐放大了自由化的影响，解释了地区收入调整的缓慢过程，并定量地解释了长期影响的幅度。（JEL F16, J23, J31, J61, O15, O19, R23）

abstract.text: We employ a discrete choice experiment in the employment process for a national call center to estimate the willingness to pay distribution for alternative work arrangements relative to traditional office positions. Most workers are not willing to pay for scheduling flexibility, though a tail of workers with high valuations allows for sizable compensating differentials. The average worker is willing to give up 20 percent of wages to avoid a schedule set by an employer on short notice, and 8 percent for the option to work from home. We also document that many job-seekers are inattentive, and we account for this in estimation. (JEL J22, J31, J80, L84)

10.1257/aer.20161500.abstractZh: 我们在国家呼叫中心的就业过程中采用了离散选择实验，以估算相对于传统办公职位的不同工作安排的支付意愿分布。大多数工人不愿意为时间安排的灵活性支付费用，不过有一部分工人对这类服务有较高的价值，因此能够带来显著的补偿差异。平均而言，工人愿意放弃20%的工资来避免雇主在短时间内设定的工作时间安排，而选择在家工作则愿意放弃8%的工资。我们还发现许多求职者缺乏注意力，我们在估计过程中考虑了这一因素。（JEL J22, J31, J80, L84）

abstract.text: Do single women avoid career-enhancing actions because these actions signal undesirable traits, like ambition, to the marriage market? While married and unmarried female MBA students perform similarly when their performance is unobserved by classmates (on exams and problem sets), unmarried women have lower participation grades. In a field experiment, single female students reported lower desired salaries and willingness to travel and work long hours on a real-stakes placement questionnaire when they expected their classmates to see their preferences. Other groups' responses were unaffected by peer observability. A second experiment indicates the effects are driven by observability by single male peers. (JEL C93, D82, J12, J16, J31)

10.1257/aer.20170029.abstractZh: 单身女性是否避免那些能够提升职业能力的行动，因为这些行为可能会向婚恋市场展示她们不理想的特质，比如雄心壮志？当已婚和未婚的女性MBA学生在同学无法观察到她们的表现时（比如在考试和习题集中的表现），她们的表现差异并不明显。不过，未婚女性在参与评估时的成绩较低。在一项实地实验中，单身女性学生在填写真实情境的招聘问卷时，报告称她们期望的薪资较低，也不愿意长途旅行或长时间工作，尤其是在预期同学能够看到她们偏好的情况下。其他群体的反应并未受到同伴观察的影响。第二项实验表明，这种影响是由单身男性同伴的观察所驱动的。（JEL C93, D82, J12, J16, J31）

abstract.text: Selection (adverse or advantageous) is the central problem that inhibits the smooth, efficient functioning of competitive health insurance markets. Even—and perhaps especially—when consumers are well-informed decision makers and insurance markets are highly competitive and offer choice, such markets may function inefficiently due to risk selection. Selection can cause markets to unravel with skyrocketing premiums and can cause consumers to be under- or overinsured. In its simplest form, adverse selection arises due to the tendency of those who expect to incur high health care costs in the future to be the most motivated purchasers. The costlier enrollees are more likely to become insured rather than to remain uninsured, and conditional on having health insurance, the costlier enrollees sort themselves to the more generous plans in the choice set. These dual problems represent the primary concerns for policymakers designing regulations for health insurance markets. In this essay, we review the theory and evidence concerning selection in competitive health insurance markets and discuss the common policy tools used to address the problems it creates. We emphasize the two markets that seem especially likely to be targets of reform in the short and medium term: Medicare Advantage (the private plan option available under Medicare) and the state-level individual insurance markets.

10.1257/jep.31.4.23.abstractZh: 选择问题（无论是负面选择还是正面选择）是阻碍竞争性健康保险市场平稳高效运行的核心问题。即便消费者是信息充分的决策者，且保险市场竞争激烈且提供多种选择，但由于风险选择问题，这些市场仍可能运行效率低下。选择问题可能导致保费飙升，使消费者面临保险不足或过度保险的情况。最简单的情况下，负面选择是由于那些预计未来将承担高昂医疗费用的消费者成为最积极的购买者。费用较高的参保者更有可能获得保险，而不是保持无保险状态；在拥有健康保险的前提下，费用较高的参保者更倾向于选择更优厚的保险计划。这两个问题代表了政策制定者在设计健康保险市场法规时的主要关注点。在本文中，我们回顾了关于竞争性健康保险市场中选择问题的理论和证据，并讨论了用于解决这些问题的一般政策工具。我们特别强调了两个在短期和中期可能成为改革目标的市场：Medicare Advantage（Medicare下的私人保险计划选项）以及州级个人保险市场。

abstract.text: State laws that limit how much hospitals are paid by uninsured patients provide a unique opportunity to study how financial incentives of health care providers affect the care they deliver. We estimate the laws reduce payments from uninsured patients by 25-30 percent. Even though the uninsured represent a small portion of their business, hospitals respond by decreasing the amount of care delivered to these patients, without measurable effects on a broad set of quality metrics. The results show that hospitals can, and do, target care based on financial considerations, and suggest that altering provider financial incentives can generate more efficient care. (JEL G22, H75, I11, I13, I18)

10.1257/pol.20160060.abstractZh: 限制医院从无保险患者处获得支付的国家法律，为研究医疗保健提供者的经济激励如何影响所提供的医疗服务提供了独特的机会。我们估计，这些法律使无保险患者的支付金额减少了25-30%。尽管无保险患者占医院业务的比例很小，但医院会相应减少对这些患者的医疗服务，而这对一系列质量指标的影响并不明显。研究结果表明，医院确实会根据经济因素来决定提供何种医疗服务，并表明改变提供者的经济激励措施可以带来更高效的医疗服务。（JEL G22, H75, I11, I13, I18）

abstract.text: Anecdotal reports and systematic research highlight the prevalence of narrow-network plans on the Affordable Care Act's health insurance Marketplaces. At the same time, Marketplace premiums in the period 2014-16 were much lower than projected by the Congressional Budget Office in 2009. Using detailed data on the breadth of both hospital and physician networks, we studied the prevalence of narrow networks and quantified the association between network breadth and premiums. Controlling for many potentially confounding factors, we found that a plan with narrow physician and hospital networks was 16 percent cheaper than a plan with broad networks for both, and that narrowing the breadth of just one type of network was associated with a 6-9 percent decrease in premiums. Narrow-network plans also have a sizable impact on federal outlays, as they depress the premium of the second-lowest-price silver plan, to which subsidy amounts are linked. Holding all else constant, we estimate that federal subsidies would have been 10.8 percent higher in 2014 had Marketplaces required all plans to offer broad provider networks. Narrow networks are a promising source of potential savings for other segments of the commercial insurance market.

10.1377/hlthaff.2016.1669.abstractZh: 传闻报道和系统的研究都表明，在《平价医疗法案》的医疗保险市场平台上，窄网络计划非常普遍。与此同时，2014至2016年期间，市场平台的保费远低于国会预算办公室在2009年预测的水平。通过详细的数据分析医院和医生网络的覆盖范围，我们研究了窄网络计划的普遍性，并量化了网络覆盖范围与保费之间的关系。在控制了众多可能干扰因素后，我们发现，拥有窄医生网络和医院网络的计划比拥有广泛网络计划的计划便宜16%；而仅缩小某一类型网络的覆盖范围，也能使保费降低6-9%。窄网络计划对联邦支出也有显著影响，因为它们会降低第二低价格银色计划的保费，而补贴金额与这些计划相关。在所有其他因素保持不变的情况下，我们估计，如果市场平台要求所有计划都提供广泛的医疗服务网络，那么2014年的联邦补贴将增加10.8%。窄网络计划是商业保险市场其他领域的潜在节省来源。

abstract.text: We study the causal effect of maternal education on childhood immunization rates. We use the Compulsory Education Law of 1997, and the differentiation in its implementation across regions, as instruments for schooling of young mothers in Turkey. The Compulsory Education Law increased the compulsory years of schooling of those born after 1986 from 5 to 8 years. We find that education of mothers increases the probability of completing the full course of diphtheria, pertussis, and tetanus and Hepatitis B vaccinations for their children. The results are robust to variations in regression specification and including various individual and community variables.

10.2139/ssrn.2976278.abstractZh: 我们研究了母亲教育水平对儿童免疫率的影响。我们利用1997年颁布的《义务教育法》以及该法律在不同地区的实施差异，作为土耳其年轻母亲接受教育的工具。根据《义务教育法》，1986年后出生的儿童义务教育年限从5年增加到8年。我们发现，母亲接受教育会增加她们子女完成白喉、百日咳、破伤风和乙型肝炎疫苗接种全程接种的概率。这些结果在回归模型参数变化以及纳入各种个体和社区变量的情况下仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: That prenatal events can have life-long consequences is now well established. Nevertheless, research on the Fetal Origins Hypothesis is flourishing and has expanded to include the early childhood (postnatal) environment. Why does this literature have a “second act?” We summarize the major themes and contributions driving the empirical literature since our 2011 reviews, and try to interpret the literature in light of an overarching conceptual framework about how human capital is produced early in life. One major finding is that relatively mild shocks in early life can have substantial negative impacts, but that the effects are often heterogeneous reflecting differences in child endowments, budget constraints, and production technologies. Moreover, shocks, investments, and interventions can interact in complex ways that are only beginning to be understood. Many advances in our knowledge are due to increasing accessibility of comprehensive administrative data that allow events in early life to be linked to long-term outcomes. Yet, we still know relatively little about the interval between, and thus about whether it would be feasible to identify and intervene with affected individuals at some point between early life and adulthood. We do know enough, however, to be able to identify some interventions that hold promise for improving child outcomes in early life and throughout the life course.

10.3386/w23017.abstractZh: 现在已经明确，产前事件可能会带来终生的影响。尽管如此，关于“胎儿起源假说”的研究仍然十分活跃，并且已经扩展到包括幼儿期（出生后）环境。为什么这些研究会有“第二幕”？我们总结了自2011年综述以来推动实证研究的主要主题和贡献，并试图从一个关于人类资本在生命早期如何产生的总体概念框架来解读这些研究。一个主要的发现是，生命早期相对轻微的冲击可能会产生显著的负面影响，但这些影响往往具有异质性，这反映了儿童禀赋、预算限制和生产技术的差异。此外，冲击、投资和干预措施可以以复杂的方式相互作用，而这些机制才刚刚开始被理解。我们知识的许多进步都得益于综合性行政数据的日益普及，这些数据使得生命早期的事件能够与长期结果联系起来。然而，我们对生命早期到成年之间的间隔期仍然知之甚少，因此也无法确定是否可以在这一期间对受影响个体进行干预。不过，我们已经有足够的信息来识别一些有望改善儿童生命早期及整个生命历程的干预措施。

abstract.text: Overdose deaths from prescription opioid pain relievers nearly quadrupled between 1999 and 2010, making this the worst drug overdose epidemic in U.S. history. In response, numerous supply-side interventions have aimed to limit access to opioids. However, these supply disruptions may have the unintended consequence of increasing the use of substitute drugs, including heroin. We study the consequences of one of the largest supply disruptions to date to abusable opioids – the introduction of an abuse-deterrent version of OxyContin in 2010. Our analysis exploits across state variation in exposure to the OxyContin reformulation. Using data from the National Survey on Drug Use and Health (NSDUH), we show that states with higher pre-2010 rates of OxyContin misuse experienced larger reductions in OxyContin misuse, permitting us to isolate consumer substitution responses. We estimate large differential increases in heroin deaths immediately after reformulation in states with the highest initial rates of OxyContin misuse. We find less evidence of differential reductions in overall opioid-related deaths, potentially due to substitution towards other opioids, including more harmful synthetic opioids such as fentanyl. Our results imply that a substantial share of the dramatic increase in heroin deaths since 2010 can be attributed to the reformulation of OxyContin.

10.3386/w23031.abstractZh: 从1999年到2010年，因处方阿片类止痛药导致的过量死亡人数几乎增加了四倍，这成为美国历史上最严重的药物过量流行病。为了应对这一情况，政府采取了许多供应方面的干预措施来限制阿片类药物的获取。然而，这些供应中断措施可能无意中增加了替代药物的使用，包括海洛因。我们研究了迄今为止最大规模的阿片类药物供应中断之一——2010年引入的具有滥用抑制功能的奥施康定改革版本所带来的后果。我们的分析利用了各州在奥施康定改革版本暴露程度上的差异。通过美国国家药物使用与健康调查的数据，我们发现2010年之前奥施康定滥用率较高的州，奥施康定滥用率下降幅度更大，这使我们能够分离出消费者的替代行为。我们估计，在最初奥施康定滥用率较高的州，改革版本推出后，海洛因死亡人数立即出现了大幅上升。我们发现，整体阿片类药物相关死亡人数的减少幅度较小，这可能是由于消费者转向了其他阿片类药物，包括更有害的合成阿片类药物如芬太尼。我们的结果表明，自2010年以来海洛因死亡人数的大幅增加，在很大程度上可以归因于奥施康定的改革版本。

abstract.text: This study provides a national analysis of how the 2014 Affordable Care Act (ACA) Medicaid expansions have affected aggregate prescription drug utilization. Given the prominent role of prescription medications in the management of chronic conditions, as well as the high prevalence of unmet health care needs in the population newly eligible for Medicaid, the use of prescription drugs represents an important measure of the ACA’s policy impact. Prescription drug utilization also provides insights into whether insurance expansions have increased access to physicians, since obtaining these medications requires interaction with a health care provider. We use 2013-2015 data from a large, nationally representative, all-payer pharmacy transactions database to examine effects on overall prescription medication utilization as well as effects within specific drug classes. Using a differences-in-differences (DD) regression framework, we find that within the first 15 months of expansion, Medicaid-paid prescription utilization increased by 19 percent in expansion states relative to states that did not expand; this works out to approximately seven additional prescriptions per year per newly enrolled beneficiary. The greatest increases in Medicaid prescriptions occurred among diabetes medications, which increased by 24 percent. Other classes of medication that experienced relatively large increases include contraceptives (22 percent) and cardiovascular drugs (21 percent), while several classes more consistent with acute conditions such as allergies and infections experienced significantly smaller increases. As a placebo test, we examine Medicare-paid prescriptions and find no evidence of a post-ACA effect. Both expansion and non-expansion states followed statistically similar trends in Medicaid prescription utilization in the pre-policy era, offering support for our DD approach. We did not observe reductions in uninsured or privately insured prescriptions, suggesting that increased utilization under Medicaid did not substitute for other forms of payment. Within expansion states, increases in prescription drug utilization were larger in geographical areas with higher uninsured rates prior to the ACA. Finally, we find some suggestive evidence that increases in prescription drug utilization were greater in areas with larger Hispanic and black populations.

10.3386/w23044.abstractZh: 本研究对2014年《平价医疗法案》推动的Medicaid扩展政策如何影响处方药总体使用情况进行了全国性分析。鉴于处方药在管理慢性疾病中的重要作用，以及新纳入Medicaid的人群中仍存在大量未满足的医疗保健需求，处方药的使用是衡量该政策影响的重要指标。处方药的使用情况还能反映保险扩展是否增加了患者与医生的接触机会，因为获取这些药物需要与医疗服务提供者进行互动。我们利用了2013至2015年间来自一个具有全国代表性、涵盖所有医疗服务提供者的药房交易数据库的数据，来研究这些政策对整体处方药使用的影响，以及特定药物类别的使用情况。通过差异-差异回归框架分析发现，在扩展政策实施的最初15个月内，Medicaid支付的处方药使用量在扩展州比未扩展州增加了19%，相当于每个新参保受益人每年额外使用大约7种处方药。其中，糖尿病药物的处方使用量增加了24%，其他使用量显著增加的类别包括避孕药（22%）和心血管药物（21%），而一些与急性疾病相关的药物类别，如抗过敏药和抗感染药，使用量的增加幅度则相对较小。作为对照测试，我们还研究了Medicare支付的处方药情况，发现没有证据表明《平价医疗法案》实施后存在相关影响。在政策实施前的时期，无论是扩张型还是非扩张型州，Medicaid处方使用的趋势都相当相似，这支持了我们的数据分析方法。我们没有观察到无保险或私人保险患者的处方数量减少，这表明在Medicaid下增加的处方使用并没有替代其他形式的支付方式。在扩张型州内，处方药物使用量的增加在ACA实施前无保险率较高的地区更为明显。最后，我们发现一些有启发性的证据表明，在西班牙裔和黑人人口较多的地区，处方药物使用的增加更为显著。

abstract.text: This study exploits differences in the implementation of welfare reform across states and over time to identify causal effects of maternal work incentives, and by inference employment, on youth arrests between 1990 and 2005, the period during which welfare reform unfolded. We consider both serious and minor crimes as classified by the FBI, investigate the extent to which effects were stronger in states with more stringent work incentive policies and larger welfare caseload declines, and use a number of different model specifications to assess robustness and patterns. We find that welfare reform led to reduced youth arrests for minor crimes, by 7-9 %, with similar estimates for males and females, but that it did not affect youth arrests for serious crimes. The results from this study add to the scant literature on the effects of maternal employment on adolescent behavior by exploiting a large-scale social experiment that is still in effect to this day, and provide some support for the widely-embraced argument that welfare reform would discourage undesirable social behavior, not only of mothers, but also of the next generation.

10.3386/w23054.abstractZh: 本研究利用各州及不同时期福利改革实施情况的差异，来识别母亲工作激励措施以及由此引发的就业变化对1990至2005年间青少年被捕情况的因果效应。我们涵盖了联邦调查局分类的严重犯罪和轻微犯罪，并探讨了在实施更严格工作激励政策的州，福利案件数量下降幅度更大的情况下，这些效应是否更为显著。我们通过多种模型参数设置来评估结果的稳健性和模式。研究发现，福利改革使青少年因轻微犯罪被捕的比例减少了7-9%，男性和女性的估计值相似，但并未影响青少年因严重犯罪被捕的情况。本研究的结果为关于母亲就业对青少年行为影响的少量文献提供了补充，通过利用至今仍生效的大规模社会实验，为广泛接受的论点提供了支持，即福利改革能够抑制不良社会行为，不仅针对母亲，也针对下一代。

abstract.text: Alan Garber and Jonathan Skinner (2008) famously conjectured that the US health care system was “uniquely inefficient” relative to other countries. We test this idea using cross-country data on prescription drug sales newly linked with an arguably objective measure of relative therapeutic benefits, or drug quality. Specifically, we investigate how higher and lower quality drugs diffuse in the US relative to Australia, Canada, Switzerland, and the UK. Our tabulations suggest that lower quality drugs diffuse more in the US relative to high quality drugs, compared to each of our four comparison countries – consistent with Garber and Skinner’s conjecture.

10.3386/w23068.abstractZh: Alan Garber和Jonathan Skinner在2008年提出，美国的医疗保健系统相对于其他国家来说“效率极低”。我们采用跨国数据对这一观点进行了验证，这些数据涉及处方药销售情况，并辅以一个客观衡量相对治疗效益或药物质量的指标。具体来说，我们研究了在美国家与澳大利亚、加拿大、瑞士和英国相比，质量高低不同的药物是如何传播的。我们的统计结果显示，与四个对比国家相比，美国中质量较低的药物传播更为频繁，这与Garber和Skinner的推测一致。

abstract.text: Maternity and family leave policies enable mothers to take time off work to prepare for and recover from childbirth and to care for their new children. While there is substantial variation in the details of these policies around the world, the existing research yields the following general conclusions. First, despite important barriers to the take-up of leave, both the implementation of new programs and extensions of existing ones increase leave-taking rates among new parents. Second, leave entitlements less than one year in length can improve job continuity for women and increase their employment rates several years after childbirth; longer leaves can negatively influence women’s earnings, employment, and career advancement. Third, extensions in existing paid leave policies have no impact on measures of child well-being, but the introduction of short paid and unpaid leave programs can improve children’s short- and long-term outcomes. Fourth, while more research is needed, the current evidence shows minimal impacts of existing U.S. state-level programs on employer-level outcomes such as employee productivity, morale, profitability, turnover rates, or the total wage bill.

10.3386/w23069.abstractZh: 产假和家庭休假政策使母亲能够休假，以准备和从分娩中恢复，并照顾她们的新婴儿。尽管世界各地这些政策的细节存在很大差异，现有研究得出了以下总体结论。首先，尽管存在许多阻碍休假实施的障碍，但新项目的实施和现有政策的延长都能提高新父母的休假率。其次，为期不到一年的休假可以提升女性的工作连续性，并在分娩后几年内提高她们的就业率；而更长的休假则可能对女性的收入、就业和职业发展产生负面影响。第三，现有带薪休假政策的延长对儿童福祉指标没有影响，但引入短期带薪和无薪休假计划可以改善儿童的短期和长期状况。第四，虽然还需要更多的研究，但目前的证据表明，美国各州现有的休假政策对雇主层面的结果，如员工生产力、士气、盈利能力、员工流动率或总工资水平，几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: Policies aiming to improve healthcare productivity often focus on reducing care fragmentation. Care fragmentation occurs when services are spread across many providers, potentially making coordination difficult. Using Medicare claims data, we analyze the effect of moving to a region with more fragmented care delivery. We find that 60% of regional variation in care fragmentation is independent of patients' individual demand for care and moving to a region with 1 SD higher fragmentation increases care utilization by 10%. When patients move to more fragmented regions, they increase their use of specialists and have fewer encounters with primary care physicians. More fragmented regions have more intensive care provision on many margins, including services sometimes associated with overutilization (hospitalizations, emergency department visits, repeat imaging studies) as well as services associated with high value care (vaccines, guideline concordant for diabetics).

10.3386/w23078.abstractZh: 旨在提高医疗效率的政策通常侧重于减少医疗服务的分散性。医疗服务的分散性是指服务分布在多个提供者手中，这可能会使得协调变得困难。我们利用医疗保险索赔数据，分析了迁移到医疗服务分散程度更高的地区所带来的影响。研究发现，60%的医疗服务分散性差异与患者的个人医疗需求无关，而迁移到分散程度高1个标准差的地区会使医疗利用率增加10%。当患者迁移到医疗服务分散程度更高的地区时，他们会更多地使用专科医生，而与初级保健医生的接触次数则会减少。在医疗服务分散程度更高的地区，许多方面的医疗服务更为密集，包括有时与过度使用相关的服务（如住院、急诊就诊、重复影像学检查），以及与高价值护理相关的服务（如疫苗接种、符合糖尿病治疗指南的护理）。

abstract.text: A common objection to “sin taxes”—corrective taxes on goods like cigarettes, alcohol, and sugary drinks, which are believed to be over-consumed—is that they fall disproportionately on low-income consumers. This paper studies the interaction between corrective and redistributive motives in a general optimal taxation framework. On the one hand, redistributive concerns amplify the corrective benefits of a sin tax when sin good consumption is concentrated on the poor, even when bias and demand elasticities are constant across incomes. On the other hand, a sin tax can generate regressivity costs, raising more revenue from the poor than from the rich. Sin tax regressivity can be offset by targeted transfers or income tax reforms if differences in sin good consumption are driven by income effects, but not if they are driven by preference heterogeneity, and not if the indirect incentives the sin tax generates for labor supply decisions are not salient. The price elasticity of demand determines the extent to which corrective benefits versus regressivity costs determine the size of the optimal tax. We implement our optimal tax formulas in a calibrated model of sugar-sweetened beverage consumption for a range of parameter values suggested by empirical work.

10.3386/w23085.abstractZh: 对“罪恶税”的常见反对意见是，这类针对香烟、酒精和含糖饮料等过度消费商品的税收，会不成比例地影响低收入消费者。本文研究了在一般最优税收框架下，纠正性动机与再分配动机之间的相互作用。一方面，当罪恶税针对的消费品消费集中在穷人身上时，再分配动机会增强罪恶税的纠正效果，即使偏差和需求弹性在不同收入层次上保持不变。另一方面，罪恶税可能会产生逆向累进成本，导致从穷人那里获得的税收收入高于富人。如果罪恶税导致的逆向累进成本可以通过有针对性的转移支付或所得税改革来抵消，那么这种影响在因收入效应导致罪恶税消费差异的情况下是可行的；但如果这种差异是由偏好异质性引起的，或者罪恶税对劳动力供给决策的间接激励并不显著，那么逆向累进成本就无法得到抵消。需求的价格弹性决定了纠正效果与逆向累进成本在多大程度上决定了最优税收的规模。我们在一个经过校准的含糖饮料消费模型中，根据实证研究结果，实现了最优税收公式。

abstract.text: We compare healthcare spending in public and private Medicare using newly available claims data from Medicare Advantage (MA) insurers. MA insurer revenues are 30 percent higher than their healthcare spending. Healthcare spending is 25 percent lower for MA enrollees than for enrollees in traditional Medicare (TM) in the same county with the same risk score. Spending differences between MA and TM are similar across sub-populations of enrollees and sub-categories of care, with similar reductions for "high value" and "low value" care. Spending differences primarily reflect differences in healthcare utilization; spending per encounter and hospital payments per admission are very similar in MA and TM. Geographic variation in MA spending is about 20 percent higher than in TM, but geographic variation in hospital prices is about 20 percent lower. We present evidence consistent with MA plans encouraging substitution to less expensive care, such as primary rather than specialist care, and outpatient rather than inpatient surgery, and with employing various types of utilization management. Some of the overall spending differences between MA and TM may be driven by selection on unobservables, and we report a range of estimates of this selection effect using mortality outcomes to proxy for selection.

10.3386/w23090.abstractZh: 我们利用Medicare Advantage（MA）保险公司新获得的索赔数据，对比了公共和私人Medicare的医疗保健支出。MA保险公司的收入比其医疗保健支出高出30%。在相同风险评分的同一县内，MA参保人的医疗保健支出比传统Medicare（TM）参保人低25%。MA和TM之间的支出差异在参保人的不同亚群体和护理子类别中相似，无论是“高价值”还是“低价值”护理，支出都呈现类似的减少趋势。支出差异主要反映了医疗保健利用上的差异；MA和TM中每次就诊的支出以及每次住院的医疗费用非常相似。MA支出的地理差异约为TM的20%，但医院价格的地理差异则约为TM的20%低。我们的研究结果表明，MA计划鼓励患者选择成本较低的护理方式，例如选择初级医生而非专科医生，选择门诊手术而非住院手术，并采用各种利用管理手段。MA和TM之间整体支出的差异可能部分是由不可观测因素导致的选择效应驱动的，我们报告了使用死亡率作为选择效应的代理变量的一系列估计值。

abstract.text: We use panel U.S. tax data spanning 2008-2013 to study the impact of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) young adult provision on two important demographic outcomes—childbearing and marriage. The impact on childbearing is theoretically ambiguous, as gaining insurance may increase access to contraceptive services, while also reducing the out-of-pocket costs of childbirth. The impact on marriage is also ambiguous, as marriage rates may decrease when young adults have less need for dependent health insurance through a spouse, but may increase when they are now allowed to stay on their parent’s plans even if they are married. Changes in childbearing and marriage can, in turn, lead to changes in the likelihood of filing a tax return. Since W-2 forms record access to employer-provided fringe benefits, we were able to examine the impact of the coverage expansion by focusing on young adults whose parents have access to benefits. We compare those who are slightly younger than the age threshold to those who are slightly older. Our results suggest that the ACA young adult provision led to a modest decrease in childbearing and marriage rates, though the propensity to file a tax return did not change significantly.
