In a discrete choice framework subsuming logit, probit and random coefficients models, we prove that utility and consideration set probabilities can be separately identified without these data intensive methods. In full-consideration models, choice probabilities satisfy a symmetry property analogous to Slutsky symmetry in continuous choice models. This symmetry breaks down in consideration set models when changes in characteristics perturb consideration, and we show that consideration probabilities are constructively identified from the resulting asymmetries. In a lab experiment, we recover preferences and consideration probabilities using only data on which items were ultimately chosen, and we apply the model to study hotel choices on Expedia.com and insurance choices in Medicare Part D.

10.3386/w23566.abstractZh: 考虑集模型放宽了消费者知晓所有可用选项的假设。迄今为止，对这些模型的识别论证依赖于关于哪些选项被考虑的辅助数据，或者依赖于被排除在考虑范围之外的工具变量或效用变量。在包含逻辑模型、概率模型以及随机系数模型的离散选择框架中，我们证明了无需这些数据密集型方法即可分别识别效用和考虑集概率。在完全考虑模型中，选择概率满足一种类似于连续选择模型中Slutsky对称性的性质。然而，在考虑集模型中，当特征的变化影响考虑集时，这种对称性就会失效。我们展示了可以从由此产生的不对称性中构建性地识别考虑概率。在实验室实验中，我们仅使用最终选择哪些项目的数据就能恢复偏好和考虑概率，并将该模型应用于研究Expedia.com上的酒店选择和Medicare Part D中的保险选择。

abstract.text: We conducted a randomized controlled trial testing the effect of modest incentives to attend the gym among new members of a fitness facility, a population that is already engaged in trying to change a health behavior. Our experiment randomized 836 new members of a private gym into a control group, receiving a $30 payment unconditionally, or one of 3 incentive groups, receiving a payment if they attended the gym at least 9 times over their first 6 weeks as members. The incentives were a $30 payment, a $60 payment, and an item costing $30 that leveraged the endowment effect. These incentives had only moderate impacts on attendance during members’ first 6 weeks and no effect on their subsequent visit trajectories. We document substantial overconfidence among new members about their likely visit rates and discuss how overconfidence may undermine the effectiveness of a modest incentive program.

10.3386/w23567.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项随机对照试验，旨在测试对健身设施的新会员给予适度激励以促使他们前往健身房的效果。这些新会员本身就已经有改变健康行为的意愿。实验中，我们将836名新会员随机分配到三个激励组：一组获得30美元的支付；另一组在成为会员的前6周内至少去健身房9次才能获得支付；还有一组则获得了价值30美元的物品，该物品利用了禀赋效应。这些激励措施在会员的前6周对出勤率仅有中等程度的提升，而对后续访问行为则没有显著影响。我们发现新会员对自己可能的访问频率存在显著的过度自信，并探讨了这种过度自信如何可能削弱适度激励计划的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper contributes to the debate on the impact of juvenile punishment on adult criminal recidivism and high school completion. We link the universe of case files of those who were convicted of a crime as a juvenile between 1996 and 2012 in a southern U.S. state to the public school administrative records and to adult criminal records. The detail of the data allows us to utilize information on the exact types of crimes committed, as well as the type and duration of punishment imposed, both as a juvenile and as an adult. We exploit random assignment of cases to judges and use idiosyncratic judge stringency in imprisonment to estimate the causal effect of incarceration on adult crime and on high school completion. Incarceration has a detrimental impact on high school completion for earlier cohorts, but it has no impact on later cohorts, arguably because of the school reform implemented in the state in the late 1990s. We find that incarceration as a juvenile has no impact on future violent crime, but it lowers the propensity to commit property crime. Juvenile incarceration increases the propensity of being convicted for a drug offense in adulthood, but this effect is largely driven by time spent in prison as a juvenile. Specifically, juvenile incarceration has no statistically significant impact on adult drug offenses if time spent in prison is less than the median, but longer incarceration increases adult drug conviction, arguably because longer prison stays intensify emotional stress, leading to drug use.

10.3386/w23573.abstractZh: 本文对青少年犯罪惩罚对成年犯罪再犯率及高中毕业率的影响进行了探讨。我们将美国南部某州1996至2012年间青少年时期被定罪者的案件档案与公立学校行政记录以及成年犯罪记录进行了关联。通过详细的数据分析，我们能够获取关于犯罪类型、刑罚类型及持续时间的信息。通过随机分配案件给法官，并利用法官对监禁时间的特殊要求，我们估算了监禁对成年犯罪和高中毕业率的因果效应。研究发现，对于较早的群体而言，青少年时期的监禁对高中毕业率有负面影响，但对于较晚的群体则没有这种影响，这可能是因为该州在1990年代末实施了学校改革。我们发现，青少年时期的监禁对未来暴力犯罪的犯罪率没有影响，但会降低财产犯罪的犯罪倾向。青少年时期的监禁会增加成年后因毒品犯罪被定罪的可能性，但这种影响主要源于青少年时期在监狱中的时间。具体来说，如果青少年时期的监禁时间少于中位数，那么其对成年后毒品犯罪的统计显著影响并不明显；但如果监禁时间较长，则会增加成年后的毒品犯罪定罪率，这可能是因为较长的监禁时间会加剧情绪压力，从而导致毒品使用行为。

abstract.text: The retail clinic is an innovation that has the potential to improve competition in health care markets. Given concern about inefficient use of the emergency room (ER) increasing health care costs, we use all ER visits in New Jersey from 2006-2014 to examine the impact of retail clinics on ER usage. We find that people residing close to an open clinic are 4.1-12.3 percent less likely to use an ER for preventable conditions and for minor acute conditions. Our estimates suggest annual cost savings of over $70 million from reduced ER usage if retail clinics were readily available across New Jersey.

10.3386/w23585.abstractZh: 零售诊所是一种具有改善医疗市场竞争潜力的创新模式。鉴于对急诊室利用效率低下导致医疗成本增加的担忧，我们选取了2006至2014年间新泽西州的所有急诊就诊数据，来研究零售诊所对急诊使用率的影响。研究发现，居住在开放诊所附近的人，因可预防疾病和轻微急性病症而使用急诊的机会减少了4.1%至12.3%。我们的估计表明，如果零售诊所在新泽西州广泛普及，每年可节省超过7000万美元的急诊费用。

abstract.text: A major provision of the Affordable Care Act was the creation of Health Insurance Marketplaces, which began operating for the 2014 plan year. Although enrollment initially grew in these markets, enrollment has fallen recently amid insurer exits and rising premiums. To better understand these markets, we estimate premium elasticity of demand for Marketplace plans, using within-plan premium changes from 2014 to 2015, accounting for state-specific trends and simultaneous changes in generosity. Our preferred estimate implies that a one percent premium increase reduces plan-specific enrollment by 1.7 percent. We argue that this high elasticity reflects the rapid growth and high churn in this market, as well as the high degree of standardization and the availability of many close substitutes.

10.3386/w23597.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》的一项重要规定是创建了健康保险市场，这些市场自2014年计划年度开始运营。尽管这些市场的注册人数最初有所增长，但近年来由于保险公司退出和保费上升，注册人数有所下降。为了更好地理解这些市场，我们利用2014年至2015年的计划内保费变化数据，同时考虑各州的特定趋势和保费优惠政策的变动，估算了市场计划需求的保费弹性。我们的估算结果显示，保费每上升1%，计划特定注册人数将减少1.7%。我们认为，这种高弹性反映了该市场的快速增长和高流动性，以及高度的标准化程度和众多近似替代品的可用性。

abstract.text: We propose a novel framework to analyse the macroeconomic impact of noncommunicable diseases. We incorporate measures of disease prevalence into a human capital augmented production function, which enables us to determine the economic costs of chronic health conditions in terms of foregone gross domestic product (GDP). Unlike previously adopted frameworks, this approach allows us to account for i) variations in human capital for workers in different age groups, ii) mortality and morbidity effects of non-communicable diseases, and iii) the treatment costs of diseases. We apply our methodology to China, Japan, and South Korea, and estimate the economic burden of chronic conditions in five domains (cardiovascular diseases, cancer, respiratory diseases, diabetes, and mental health conditions). Overall, total losses associated with these non-communicable diseases over the period 2010-2030 are $16 trillion for China (measured in real USD with the base year 2010), $5.7 trillion for Japan, and $1.5 trillion for South Korea. Our results also highlight the limits of cost-effectiveness analysis by identifying some intervention strategies to reduce disease prevalence in China that are cost beneficial and therefore a rational use of resources, though they are not cost-effective as judged by conventional thresholds.

10.3386/w23601.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架，用于分析非传染性疾病对宏观经济的影响。我们将疾病流行率的指标纳入到人力资本增强的生产函数中，从而能够确定慢性健康状况所导致的国内生产总值损失的经济成本。与以往采用的框架不同，这种方法能够考虑以下因素：i) 不同年龄组工人的人力资本差异；ii) 非传染性疾病对死亡率和发病率的影响；iii) 疾病的治疗成本。我们将该方法应用于中国、日本和韩国，估算了五个领域（心血管疾病、癌症、呼吸系统疾病、糖尿病和心理健康问题）的慢性状况的经济负担。总体而言，2010年至2030年间，这些非传染性疾病造成的总损失分别为：中国的16万亿美元（以2010年为基准年的实际美元计算）、日本的5.7万亿美元，韩国的1.5万亿美元。我们的研究结果还揭示了成本效益分析的局限性，指出了一些在中国具有成本效益的干预策略，这些策略是资源的合理运用，尽管按照传统标准来看并不具有成本效益。

abstract.text: While many results from the treatment-effect and related literatures are familiar and have been applied productively in health economics evaluations, other potentially useful results from those literatures have had little influence on health economics practice. With the intent of demonstrating the value and use of some such results in health economics applications, this paper focuses on one particular class of parameters that describe probabilities that one outcome is larger or smaller than other outcomes, namely inequality probabilities. While the properties of such parameters have been explored in the technical literature, they have scarcely been considered in informing practical questions in health evaluations. This paper discusses how such probabilities can be used informatively, and describes how they might be identified or bounded given standard sampling assumptions and information only on marginal distributions of outcomes. Graphical and algebraic exposition reveals the logic supporting these results, as well as their empirical implementation, to be quite straightforward. Applications to health outcome evaluations are presented and discussed throughout.

10.3386/w23603.abstractZh: 虽然许多关于处理效应及相关文献的结果已经为人所熟知，并已在健康经济学评估中得到有效应用，但其他一些潜在有用的结果对健康经济学实践的影响却相对较小。本文旨在展示这些结果在健康经济学应用中的价值与用途，重点探讨一类描述某一结果比其他结果更可能或更不可能发生的概率的参数，即不平等概率。尽管这类参数的性质已在技术文献中有所探讨，但在为健康评估的实际问题提供信息方面，这些参数却很少被考虑。本文讨论了如何利用这些概率来提供信息，并描述了在给定标准抽样假设以及仅知道结果的边际分布的情况下，如何识别或限定这些概率。通过图形和代数方法，本文揭示了支持这些结果的逻辑，以及它们的实际实现方式，这些方式都非常简单明了。全文还介绍了应用于健康结果评估的案例，并进行了讨论。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) includes several provisions designed to expand insurance coverage that also alter the tie between employment and health insurance. In this paper, we exploit variation across geographic areas in the potential impact of the ACA to estimate its effect on health insurance coverage and labor market outcomes in the first two years after the implementation of its main features. Our measures of potential ACA impact come from pre-existing population shares of uninsured individuals within income groups that were targeted by Medicaid expansions and federal subsidies for private health insurance, interacted with each state’s Medicaid expansion status. Our findings indicate that the majority of the increase in health insurance coverage since 2013 is due to the ACA and that areas in which the potential Medicaid and exchange enrollments were higher saw substantially larger increases in coverage. While labor market outcomes in the aggregate were not significantly affected, our results indicate that labor force participation reductions in areas with higher potential exchange enrollment were offset by increases in labor force participation in areas with higher potential Medicaid enrollment

10.3386/w23607.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》包含多项旨在扩大保险覆盖范围的条款，这些条款也改变了就业与医疗保险之间的联系。在本文中，我们利用不同地理区域在《平价医疗法案》潜在影响上的差异，来估算该法案在实施其主要条款后的头两年对医疗保险覆盖率和劳动力市场结果的影响。我们对《平价医疗法案》潜在影响的衡量，基于被医疗补助计划和联邦私人健康保险补贴覆盖的收入群体中的无保险人群比例，并结合各州的医疗补助计划扩展状况。我们的研究发现表明，自2013年以来，医疗保险覆盖率的大部分增长是由《平价医疗法案》带来的，而在医疗补助计划和交易所潜在注册人数较高的地区，覆盖率的增长幅度更大。虽然整体劳动力市场结果并未受到显著影响，但我们的研究结果表明，在潜在交易所注册人数较高的地区，劳动力参与率的下降被潜在医疗补助注册人数较高的地区的劳动力参与率增长所抵消。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates a randomized controlled trial of the Nurse-Family Partnership (NFP) program conducted in Memphis, TN in 1990. NFP offers home visits conducted by nurses for disadvantaged first-time mothers during pregnancy and early childhood. We test NFP treatment effects using permutation-based inference that accounts for the NFP randomization protocol. Our methodology is valid for small samples and corrects for multiple-hypothesis testing. We also analyze the underlying mechanisms generating these treatment effects. We decompose NFP treatment effects into components associated with the intervention-enhanced parenting and early childhood skills. The NFP improves home investments, parenting attitudes and mental health for mothers of infants at age 2. At age 6, the NFP boosts cognitive skills for both genders and socio-emotional skills for females. These treatment effects are explained by program-induced improvements in maternal traits and early-life family investments. At age 12, the treatment effects for males (but not for females) persist in the form of enhanced achievement test scores. Treatment effects are largely explained by enhanced cognitive skills at age 6. Our evidence of pronounced gender differences in response to early childhood interventions contributes to a growing literature on this topic.

10.3386/w23610.abstractZh: 本文评估了1990年在田纳西州孟菲斯市进行的护士-家庭伙伴关系项目的随机对照试验。该计划由护士为处于弱势地位的新手母亲在孕期和幼儿期提供家访服务。我们采用基于排列的推断方法，以考虑护士-家庭伙伴关系项目的随机化方案，来检验该计划的治疗效果。我们的方法适用于小样本数据，并纠正了多假设检验的问题。我们还分析了产生这些治疗效果的潜在机制。我们将护士-家庭伙伴关系计划的治疗效果分解为与干预措施相关的育儿行为和幼儿期技能提升两部分。该计划提升了2岁婴儿母亲的家庭投资、育儿态度以及心理健康状况。在6岁时，该计划提升了男女的认知技能以及女性的社会情感技能。这些治疗效果可以通过项目带来的母亲特质改善和家庭早期投资的影响来解释。在12岁时，男性的治疗效果（但女性并非如此）以成绩提升的形式持续存在。这些治疗效果主要可以通过6岁时认知技能的提升来解释。我们关于早期儿童干预措施对性别差异影响的证据，为这一领域的研究提供了支持。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of provider choice policies on workers’ compensation medical and indemnity costs. We find no difference in average medical costs between states where policies give employers control over the choice of provider and states where policies instead give workers the most control. But a richer distributional analysis indicates that developed medical costs for the costliest cases are higher in states where policies give workers more control over provider choice. We find similar evidence for indemnity costs, although the point estimates also indicate (statistically insignificantly) higher average costs where policy gives workers the most control over provider choice. Overall, the evidence suggests little relationship between provider choice policies and average medical or indemnity costs, but a higher incidence of high-cost cases when policies give workers more control of the choice of provider.

10.3386/w23611.abstractZh: 我们研究了供应商选择政策对工人赔偿医疗费用及赔偿成本的影响。研究发现，在那些政策赋予雇主对供应商选择的掌控权的州与那些政策赋予工人更多自主权的州之间，平均医疗费用并无差异。但更深入的分配性分析表明，在那些政策赋予工人更多供应商选择权的州，最昂贵案件的医疗费用更高。对于赔偿成本，我们也发现了类似的证据，尽管点估计也显示，在政策赋予工人更多供应商选择权的州，平均赔偿成本略高（但差异在统计上并不显著）。总体而言，这些证据表明，供应商选择政策与平均医疗或赔偿成本之间几乎没有关联，但在政策赋予工人更多供应商选择权的州，高成本案件的发生率更高。

abstract.text: Higher asthma rates are one of the more obvious ways that health inequalities between African American and other children are manifested beginning in early childhood. In 2010, black asthma rates were double non-black rates. Some but not all of this difference can be explained by factors such as a higher incidence of low birth weight (LBW) among blacks; however, even conditional on LBW, blacks have a higher incidence of asthma than others. Using a unique data set based on the health records of all children born in New Jersey between 2006 and 2010, we show that when we split the data by whether or not children live in a “black” zip code, this racial difference in the incidence of asthma among LBW children entirely disappears. All LBW children in these zip codes, regardless of race, have a higher incidence of asthma. Our results point to the importance of residential segregation and neighborhoods in explaining persistent racial health disparities.

10.3386/w23622.abstractZh: 较高的哮喘发病率是非洲裔美国儿童与其他儿童之间健康不平等在幼儿时期就开始显现的明显表现之一。2010年时，黑人儿童的哮喘发病率是非黑人的两倍。这种差异部分但并非全部可以由一些因素解释，比如黑人儿童中低出生体重的发病率较高；然而，即使考虑到低出生体重的因素，黑人的哮喘发病率仍然高于其他人。我们利用2006至2010年间新泽西州所有儿童的健康记录数据，发现当按照儿童是否居住在“黑人聚居区”来划分数据时，黑人儿童中低出生体重儿童哮喘发病率的种族差异完全消失了。在这些聚居区中，所有低出生体重儿童，无论种族如何，其哮喘发病率都较高。我们的研究结果强调了住宅隔离和社区环境在解释持续存在的种族健康差异方面的重要性。

abstract.text: Hospitals and physicians independently negotiate contracts with insurers. As a result, a privately insured individual can attend an in-network hospital emergency department, but receive care and potentially a large, unexpected bill from an out-of-network emergency physician working at that hospital. Because patients do not choose their emergency physician, emergency physicians can remain out-of-network and charge high prices without losing patient volume. As we illustrate, this strong outside option improves emergency physicians’ bargaining power with insurers. We then analyze a New York State law that introduced binding arbitration between emergency physicians and insurers and therefore weakened physicians’ outside option in negotiations. We observe that the New York law reduced out-of-network billing by 34 percent and lowered in-network emergency physician payments by 9 percent.

10.3386/w23623.abstractZh: 医院和医生与保险公司独立协商合同。因此，私人保险的客户可以在网络内的医院急诊部门就诊，但可能会遇到来自该医院的非网络内急诊医生的昂贵治疗费用。由于患者无法自行选择急诊医生，非网络内的急诊医生可以收取高价，而不会失去患者数量。正如我们所展示的，这种强大的外部选择增强了急诊医生与保险公司之间的谈判能力。然后，我们分析了纽约州的一项法律，该法律引入了急诊医生与保险公司之间的强制仲裁机制，从而削弱了医生在谈判中的外部选择。我们发现，纽约州的法律使非网络内计费减少了34%，而网络内急诊医生的支付金额则降低了9%。

abstract.text: Reclassification risk is a major concern in health insurance. We use a rich dataset with individual-level information on health risk to empirically study one possible solution: dynamic contracts. Empirically, dynamic contracts with one-sided commitment substantially reduce the reclassification risk present with spot contracting, achieving close to the first-best for consumers with flat net income paths. Gains are smaller for consumers with net income growth, and these consumers prefer ACA-like community rating over dynamic contracts. However, lower risk aversion, sufficient switching costs, or government insurance of pre-age-25 health risks can raise welfare with dynamic contracts above the level in ACA-like markets.

10.3386/w23624.abstractZh: 重新分类风险是健康保险中的一个主要问题。我们利用包含个人健康风险信息的丰富数据集，实证研究了一种可能的解决方案：动态合同。实证结果表明，具有单方面承诺的动态合同能够显著降低即时合同存在的重新分类风险，使消费者的净收入路径接近最优状态。对于净收入增长的消费者来说，收益较小，这些消费者更倾向于选择类似ACA的社区评级制度，而不是动态合同。然而，如果风险厌恶程度较低、转换成本足够高，或者政府为25岁之前的健康风险提供保险，那么动态合同的福利水平可以超过类似ACA市场的水平。

abstract.text: Behavioral economics lacks empirical evidence on some foundational empirical questions. We adapt standard elicitation methods to measure multiple behavioral factors per person in a representative U.S. sample, along with financial condition, cognitive skills, financial literacy, classical preferences and demographics. Individually, B-factors are prevalent, distinct from other decision inputs, and correlate negatively with financial outcomes in richly-conditioned regressions. Conditioning further on other B-factors does not change the results, validating common practice of modeling B-factors separately. Corrections for low task/survey effort modestly strengthen the results. Our findings provide bedrock empirical foundations for behavioral economics, and offer methodological guidance for research designs.

10.3386/w23625.abstractZh: 行为经济学在一些基础性的实证问题上缺乏实证证据。我们采用标准的方法对代表性美国样本中的个人行为进行多因素测量，包括财务状况、认知能力、金融素养、传统偏好以及人口统计信息。单独来看，行为因素与其他决策输入因素不同，并且在条件复杂的回归分析中与财务结果呈负相关。进一步考虑其他行为因素并不会改变这些结果，这验证了将行为因素单独建模的常见做法。对低任务/调查努力的校正在一定程度上增强了研究结果的可靠性。我们的发现为行为经济学提供了坚实的实证基础，并为研究设计提供了方法论指导。

abstract.text: We provide the ﬁrst general empirical test of tax invariance (TIV). When a 25 per-cent tax remitted by manufacturers was eliminated in Washington state and the retail cannabis excise tax was simultaneously increased from 25 to 37 percent—a shift in-tended to be revenue-neutral—TIV did not hold. Manufacturers kept two-thirds of their tax savings instead of passing all their savings through to retail ﬁrms via lower prices as predicted by TIV. One-third of the retail tax increase was passed on to consumers via higher retail prices – TIV would have predicted constant or even declining tax-inclusive retail prices.

10.3386/w23632.abstractZh: 我们首次进行了关于税收不变性的一般性实证测试。在华盛顿州，制造商需缴纳的25%税收被取消，同时零售大麻的消费税从25%增加到37%——这一变化原本旨在保持税收平衡。然而，税收不变性并未得到验证。制造商保留了三分之二的税收节省，而不是如税收不变性理论所预测的那样通过降低价格将节省下来的税收全部转嫁给零售企业。三分之一的消费税增加通过提高零售价格转嫁给了消费者——而税收不变性理论本应预测零售价格会保持或甚至下降。

abstract.text: The appropriate size and scope of government nutrition assistance programs is a regular source of debate among policy-makers, and with calls to reduce government benefits, a clear understanding of household responses to any proposed benefit reduction is critical. Exploiting the design of U.S. nutrition assistance programs, we examine how low-income households reallocate their budgets following an exogenous reduction in nutrition assistance benefits. The magnitude of our results suggests that the budget for an average low-income household with children is severely inflexible and likely unable to absorb more than a $2 to $3 reduction in nutrition benefits per child per week.

10.3386/w23633.abstractZh: 政府营养援助计划的适当规模和范围一直是政策制定者经常讨论的话题，而随着要求减少政府福利的呼声，明确了解家庭对任何拟议的福利削减的反应至关重要。通过研究美国营养援助计划的设计，我们探讨了低收入家庭在营养援助福利外生减少后如何重新分配预算。我们的研究结果表明，有孩子的平均低收入家庭的预算非常僵化，每孩子每周的福利削减幅度最多只能达到2到3美元。

abstract.text: Between 2011 and 2014, Texas enacted three pieces of legislation that significantly reduced funding for family planning services and increased restrictions on abortion clinic operations. Together this legislation creates cross-county variation in access to abortion and family planning services, which we leverage to understand the impact of family planning and abortion clinic access on abortions, births, and contraceptive purchases. In response to these policies, abortions to Texas residents fell 20.5% and births rose 2.6% in counties that no longer had an abortion provider within 50 miles. Changes in the family planning market induced a 1.5% increase in births for counties that no longer had a publicly funded family planning clinic within 25 miles. Meanwhile, responses of retail purchases of condoms and emergency contraceptives to both abortion and family planning service changes were minimal.

10.3386/w23634.abstractZh: 在2011年至2014年间，德克萨斯州通过了三项立法，大幅削减了计划生育服务的资金，并增加了对堕胎诊所运营的限制。这些立法导致各县的堕胎和计划生育服务获取情况出现差异，我们利用这一差异来研究计划生育和堕胎诊所的获取情况对堕胎、出生人数以及避孕用品购买行为的影响。作为对这些政策的回应，在50英里范围内没有堕胎服务提供点的县，堕胎数量减少了20.5%，而出生人数则上升了2.6%。在25英里范围内没有公共资金支持的计划生育诊所的县，计划生育市场的变化导致出生人数增加了1.5%。与此同时，避孕套和紧急避孕药的零售购买量对堕胎和计划生育服务的变化反应很小。

abstract.text: Since the 1984 passage of the Waxman-Hatch Act, generic prescription drugs have become central to disease treatment and generic drug entry and price competition has been vigorous in the U.S. Nonetheless, recent policy concern has focused on potential supply inadequacy and price increases among selected generic drugs. Details regarding the supply of generic drugs throughout the product life cycle are surprisingly unstudied. Here, we examine manufacturer entry, exit, the extent of competition and the relationship between supply structure and inflation adjusted prices among generic drugs. Our empirical approach is descriptive and reduced form, following recent innovations on the older structure-conduct-performance tradition. We employ quarterly national data on quantities, wholesale dollar sales and manufacturers from QuintilesIMS National Sales Perspective data, 2004Q4–2016Q3. Defining a market as the molecule-dosage-form, we observe that median sizes of drug markets are predominantly small, with annual inflation adjusted sales revenues of less than $10 million but increasing over time. The median number of manufacturers in each market is about two, the mean about four. We find evidence to suggest decreasing numbers of suppliers over our study period, particularly following implementation of the Affordable Care Act in 2010 and the Generic Drug User Fee Amendments of 2012, attributable both to more exit and less entry. Approximately 40 percent of markets are supplied by one manufacturer; the share of markets supplied by one or two manufacturers is observed to increase over time and is more likely among non-oral drugs and those belonging to selected therapeutic classes. We find evidence to suggest prices of generic drugs are statistically significantly increasing over time, particularly following the implementation of the 2010 Affordable Care Act and the 2012 Generic Drug User Fee Amendments. Price increases are positively correlated with reduced manufacturer counts and alternative measures of increased supplier concentration, holding all else constant. Our results suggest the market for generic drugs is largely comprised of small revenue products the supply of which has tended towards duopoly or monopoly in recent years. Therefore, it is surprising generic drug prices have not been observed to be higher and potentially risen more over our study period. This issue merits further study; we suggest several testable hypotheses based in economic theory.

10.3386/w23640.abstractZh: 自1984年《瓦克斯曼-哈奇法案》通过以来，仿制药已成为疾病治疗的核心，而美国境内的仿制药进入市场及价格竞争一直十分激烈。然而，近期政策关注点集中在部分仿制药可能出现的供应不足和价格上涨问题上。关于仿制药在整个产品生命周期中的供应情况，目前的研究却相对较少。本文研究制造商的进入与退出、竞争程度，以及供应结构与通胀调整后的价格之间的关系。我们的研究方法采用描述性分析，并借鉴了关于结构-行为-绩效的传统研究思路。我们采用了QuintilesIMS National Sales Perspective数据，涵盖了2004年第四季度至2016年第三季度的季度数据，包括药品数量、批发销售额以及制造商信息。将市场定义为分子-剂型，我们发现药品市场的规模大多较小，年通胀调整后的销售收入不足1000万美元，但随着时间的推移这一数字有所上升。每个市场中平均有大约两家制造商，总体数量约为四家。研究发现，在研究期间，供应商的数量有所减少，尤其是在2010年《平价医疗法案》和2012年《仿制药用户费修正案》实施后，制造商的退出现象更为明显，而进入市场的情况则有所减少。大约40%的市场由一家制造商供应；随着时间的推移，由一家或两家制造商供应的市场比例有所上升，这种情况在非口服药品以及某些治疗类别的药品中更为常见。我们发现有证据表明，仿制药的价格随着时间的推移而显著上升，尤其是在2010年《平价医疗法案》和2012年《仿制药用户费修正案》实施之后。在其他因素保持不变的情况下，价格上升与制造商数量的减少以及供应商集中度的增加呈正相关。我们的研究结果表明，仿制药市场主要由小型收入产品构成，近年来其供应趋向于双头垄断或垄断状态。因此，令人惊讶的是，在研究的整个期间，仿制药的价格并没有出现更高的水平，也没有进一步上升的趋势。这个问题值得进一步研究；我们提出了几个基于经济理论的、可检验的假设。

abstract.text: Regulation can influence the structure, conduct and performance of consumer product markets and the structure of product markets can influence regulation. Since the vast majority of prescription drugs consumed by Americans are generic, the structure of the U.S. generic prescription drug market is of wide interest. The supply of prescription drugs in the U.S. is also heavily regulated by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). We describe events leading up to the passage and implementation of the Generic Drug User Fee Amendments in 2012 (GDUFA I), and compare its FDA commitments, provisions, goals and fee structure to that of the 1992 Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) for branded drugs. Although GDUFA I expires September 30, 2017, reauthorization for GDUFA II is currently underway and is likely to shift the user fee structure away from annual facility fees to annual program fees. We explain how the fee structure of GDUFA I, and that being considered for GDUFA II, erects barriers to entry and creates scale and scope economies for incumbent manufacturers of generic drugs. Furthermore, in order to implement fees under GDUFA I, FDA required the submission of self-reported data on generic manufacturing practices including domestic and foreign active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and finished dosage form (FDF) facilities. These data provide an unprecedented window into the recent evolution of generic drug manufacturing markets. Our analyses of these data suggest that generic drug manufacturing in 2017 is quite concentrated: a very large portion of ANDA holders have small portfolios consisting of less than five ANDAs, while a small number of very large ANDA holders have portfolios consisting of hundreds or even thousands of ANDAs. The number of API and FDF facilities have each declined by approximately 10-11% between 2013 and 2017. Furthermore, in 2017, generic manufacturing is largely foreign and has become increasingly so since 2013. We discuss the implications of the current structure of the U.S. generic prescription drug market for GDUFA II ratification and implementation.

10.3386/w23642.abstractZh: 监管可以影响消费品市场的结构、行为和绩效，而产品市场的结构也可以影响监管政策。由于美国人消费的大部分处方药都是仿制药，因此美国仿制药市场的结构引起了广泛的关注。美国食品药品监督管理局对处方药的供应也进行了严格的监管。本文描述了2012年《仿制药用户费用修正案》的通过和实施过程，并将其FDA的承诺、条款、目标和费用结构与1992年《处方药用户费用法》对品牌药物的费用结构进行了比较。虽然《仿制药用户费用修正案》的有效期至2017年9月30日，但《仿制药用户费用修正案II》的重新授权正在进行中，预计费用结构将从年度设施费用转变为年度项目费用。我们解释了《仿制药用户费用修正案I》的费用结构以及正在考虑中的《仿制药用户费用修正案II》如何为现有仿制药制造商创造进入壁垒，并带来规模经济和范围经济。此外，为了实施《仿制药用户费用修正案I》中的费用制度，FDA要求提交关于仿制药制造实践的自我报告数据，包括国内外的活性药物成分和成品制剂设施。这些数据为我们提供了了解仿制药制造市场最新发展情况的独特窗口。我们对这些数据的分析表明，2017年仿制药制造市场相当集中：许多ANDA持有者拥有数量较少的药品申请，而少数大型ANDA持有者则拥有数百甚至数千份药品申请。在2013年至2017年间，API和FDF设施的数量均减少了大约10-11%。此外，2017年，通用制造领域主要由外国企业主导，且自2013年以来这一情况愈发明显。我们讨论了美国通用处方药市场当前结构对GDUFA II的批准和实施的影响。

abstract.text: Using national data on opioid prescriptions written by physicians from 2006 to 2014, we uncover a striking relationship between opioid prescribing and medical school rank. Even within the same specialty and practice location, physicians who completed their initial training at top medical schools write significantly fewer opioid prescriptions annually than physicians from lower ranked schools. Additional evidence suggests that some of this gradient represents a causal effect of education rather than patient selection across physicians or physician selection across medical schools. Altering physician education may therefore be a useful policy tool in fighting the current epidemic.

10.3386/w23645.abstractZh: 通过利用2006至2014年间医生开具阿片类药物处方的全国数据，我们发现阿片类药物处方量与医学院校的排名之间存在显著关系。即使在相同的专业领域和执业地点，在顶尖医学院校完成初始培训的医生，其每年开具的阿片类药物处方数量明显少于来自排名较低的医学院校的医生。进一步的证据表明，这种差异部分是由于教育的影响，而非患者选择或医生选择医学院校所带来的影响。因此，改变医生的教育水平可能成为应对当前流行病的一个有效政策工具。

abstract.text: Chronic pain clearly lowers utility, but it is empirically challenging to estimate the monetary compensation needed to offset this utility reduction. We use the subjective well-being method to estimate the value of pain relief among individuals age 50 and older. We use a sample of 64,205 observations from 4 waves (2008-2014) of the Health and Retirement Study, a nationally representative individual-level survey data, permitting us to control for individual heterogeneity. Our models, which allow for nonlinear effects in income, show the value of avoiding pain ranging between 56 to 145 USD per day. These results are lower than previously reported, suggesting that the value of pain relief varies by income levels. Thus, previous estimates of the value of pain relief assuming constant monetary compensation for pain across income levels are heavily affected by the highest income level. Furthermore, we find that the value of pain relief increases with pain severity.

10.3386/w23649.abstractZh: 慢性疼痛显然会降低效用，但实证上难以估算出抵消这种效用减少所需的货币补偿。我们采用主观幸福感方法，估算了50岁及以上人群从疼痛缓解中获得的价值。我们使用了来自“健康与退休研究”的64,205个观测数据，该研究是一项具有全国代表性的个体级调查数据，使我们能够控制个体间的异质性。我们的模型允许收入存在非线性效应，结果显示避免疼痛的价值每天在56至145美元之间。这些结果低于先前报告的数值，表明疼痛缓解的价值因收入水平而异。因此，先前假设不同收入水平下疼痛缓解的价值具有恒定货币补偿的估计结果，很大程度上受到最高收入水平的显著影响。此外，我们发现疼痛缓解的价值随着疼痛严重程度的增加而增加。

abstract.text: Generic pharmaceuticals provide low-cost access to treatment. Despite their chemical equivalence to branded products, many mechanisms may hinder generic substitution. Consumers may be unaware of their equivalence. Firms may influence consumers through advertising or product line extensions. We estimate a structural model of pharmaceutical demand where consumers learn about stochastic match qualities with specific drugs. Naïve models, without consumer heterogeneity and learning, grossly underestimate demand elasticities. Consumer bias against generics critically depends on experience. Advertising and line extensions yield modest increases in branded market shares. These effects are dominated by consumers’ initial perception bias against generics.

10.3386/w23662.abstractZh: 仿制药为治疗提供了低成本的选择。尽管它们在化学成分上与品牌药品相同，但许多因素可能会阻碍仿制药的替代。消费者可能并不了解这两种药品之间的等效性。企业可以通过广告或产品线的扩展来影响消费者。我们建立了一个药品需求的结构模型，其中消费者会了解特定药物的随机匹配质量。没有消费者异质性和学习过程的简单模型会严重低估需求弹性。消费者对仿制药的偏见在很大程度上取决于个人经验。广告和产品线的扩展能够适度提高品牌药品的市场份额。这些效应主要受到消费者最初对仿制药的负面认知的影响。

abstract.text: How much are low-income individuals willing to pay for health insurance, and what are the implications for insurance markets? Using administrative data from Massachusetts’ subsidized insurance exchange, we exploit discontinuities in the subsidy schedule to estimate willingness to pay and costs of insurance among low-income adults. As subsidies decline, insurance take-up falls rapidly, dropping about 25% for each $40 increase in monthly enrollee premiums. Marginal enrollees tend to be lower-cost, consistent with adverse selection into insurance. But across the entire distribution we can observe – approximately the bottom 70% of the willingness to pay distribution – enrollee willingness to pay is always less than half of own expected costs. As a result, we estimate that take-up will be highly incomplete even with generous subsidies: if enrollee premiums were 25% of insurers’ average costs, at most half of potential enrollees would buy insurance; even premiums subsidized to 10% of average costs would still leave at least 20% uninsured. We suggest an important role for uncompensated care for the uninsured in explaining these findings and explore normative implications.

10.3386/w23668.abstractZh: 低收入人群愿意为健康保险支付多少费用，这对保险市场有何影响？我们利用马萨诸塞州补贴保险交易所的行政数据，通过补贴计划中的不连续性来估算低收入成年人的支付意愿和保险成本。随着补贴的减少，保险覆盖率迅速下降，每月参保人保费每增加40美元，保险覆盖率就会下降约25%。边际参保人往往属于成本较低的群体，这与保险中的逆向选择现象一致。但在整个分布中，我们可以观察到——大约处于支付意愿分布的最底层70%——参保人的支付意愿始终低于其预期成本的一半。因此，我们估计即使有慷慨的补贴，保险覆盖率也会非常低：如果参保人保费仅为保险公司平均成本的25%，那么最多只有一半的潜在参保人会购买保险；即使保费补贴到平均成本的10%，仍有至少20%的人无法获得保险。我们认为，为无保险者提供无偿护理在解释这些发现方面起着重要作用，并探讨了相关的规范意义。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to use the method of instrumental variables to estimate the causal impact of youth obesity on U.S. medical care costs. We examine data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey for 2001-2013 and instrument for child BMI using the BMI of the child’s biological mother. IV estimates indicate that obesity raises annual medical care costs by $1,354 (in 2013 dollars) or 159%, which is considerably higher than previous estimates of the association of youth obesity with medical costs; thus, the cost-effectiveness of anti-obesity interventions have likely been underestimated. The costs of youth obesity are borne almost entirely by third party-payers, which is consistent with substantial externalities of youth obesity, which in turn represents an economic rationale for government intervention.

10.3386/w23682.abstractZh: 本文首次采用工具变量方法，估算青少年肥胖对美国医疗费用的因果影响。我们基于2001-2013年的医疗支出面板调查数据，以儿童生母的体质指数作为工具变量来估计儿童肥胖对医疗费用的影响。工具变量估计结果显示，肥胖每年导致医疗费用增加1,354美元（按2013年美元价值计算），增幅达159%，这一数值远高于以往关于青少年肥胖与医疗费用关系的估计；因此，反肥胖干预措施的成本效益可能被低估了。青少年肥胖带来的成本几乎完全由第三方支付方承担，这与青少年肥胖带来的显著外部性相一致，这也为政府干预提供了经济上的依据。

abstract.text: We test whether the ACA dependent care provision is associated with young adults’ propensity to live with/near parents and to receive food assistance. Data come from the 2008 Survey of Income and Program Participation. Findings indicate that the provision is associated with a 3.0 percentage point increase in young adults’ living with parents during the period in which the ACA had been passed but the provision was not effective, and a 6.0 percentage point increase during the time between the provision becoming effective and the end of 2013. In some specifications, the provision is associated with reduced use of food assistance.

10.3386/w23700.abstractZh: 我们测试了《平价医疗法案》中的 Dependent Care 条款是否与年轻成年人倾向于与父母同住/居住在父母附近以及接受食品援助的倾向有关。数据来自2008年的收入与计划参与调查。研究结果表明，在《平价医疗法案》通过但相关条款尚未生效的时期，这一条款与年轻成年人与父母同住的比例增加了3.0个百分点；而在相关条款生效至2013年底这段时间内，这一比例增加了6.0个百分点。在某些假设条件下，这一条款还与食品援助的使用减少有关。

abstract.text: In Chinese culture those who are born in the year of the Dragon under the zodiac calendar are believed to be destined for good fortune and greatness, and parents prefer their kids to be born in a Dragon year. Using provincial level panel data, we first show that the number of marriages goes up during the two years preceding a Dragon year and that births jump up in a Dragon year. Using three recently collected micro data sets from China we show that those born in a Dragon year are more likely to have a college education, and that they obtain higher scores at the university entrance exam. Similarly, Chinese middle school students have higher test scores if they are born in a Dragon year. We show that these results are not because of family background, student self-esteem or students’ expectations about their future. We find, however, that the “Dragon” effect on test scores is eliminated when we account for parents’ expectations about their children’s educational and professional success. We find that parents of Dragon children have higher expectations for their children in comparison to other parents, and that they invest more heavily in their children in terms of time and money. We also show that girls are about six cm shorter than boys, but that this height disadvantage is cut by about half if a girl is born in the year of the Dragon and that effect is twice as strong in rural areas. Given that childhood nutrition is related to adolescent height, this suggests that parents may also be investing in Dragon girls in terms of nutrition. The results are insensitive to model specification and estimation strategy, including using an RD design. These results show that even though neither the Dragon children nor their families are inherently different from other children and families, the belief in the prophecy of success and the ensuing investment become self-fulfilling.

10.3386/w23709.abstractZh: 在中国文化中，生肖中属龙年出生的人被认为注定会拥有好运和成就，因此父母更倾向于让孩子在龙年出生。我们利用省级面板数据发现，龙年之前的两年，婚姻数量会增加，而龙年出生的新生儿数量也会上升。通过三个最近收集的中国微观数据集，我们发现属龙年出生的人更有可能接受高等教育，并且在大学入学考试中取得更高的分数。同样，中国中学生如果在龙年出生，他们的考试成绩也会更高。我们发现，这些结果并非由于家庭背景、学生的自尊心或对未来的期望。然而，当我们考虑父母对孩子教育和职业成功的期望时，龙年对考试成绩的影响就被消除了。我们发现，龙年出生孩子的父母对子女的期望比其他父母更高，并且在时间和金钱上的投入也更多。我们还发现，女孩的身高比男孩低约6厘米，但如果女孩在龙年出生，这种身高劣势会减半，而且这一效应在农村地区更为明显。考虑到儿童营养与青少年身高有关，这表明父母可能在营养方面也投入更多资源在龙年出生女孩身上。这些结果不受模型设定和估计策略的影响，包括使用RD设计。这些结果表明，尽管龙族的孩子及其家庭本身与其他孩子和家庭并无本质区别，但人们对成功预言的信仰以及随之而来的投资行为却会自我实现。

abstract.text: Electronic cigarettes are a less harmful alternative to combustible cigarettes. We analyze data on e-cigarette choices in an online experimental market. Our data and mixed logit model capture two sources of consumer optimization errors: over-estimates of the relative risks of e-cigarettes; and present bias. Our novel data and policy analysis make three contributions. First, our predictions about e-cigarette use under counter-factual policy scenarios provide new information about current regulatory tradeoffs. Second, we provide empirical evidence about the role consumer optimization errors play in tobacco product choices. Third, we contribute to behavioral welfare analysis of policies that address individual optimization errors.

10.3386/w23710.abstractZh: 电子香烟是燃烧型香烟的一种危害较小的替代品。我们分析了在线实验市场中关于电子香烟选择的数据。我们的数据和混合逻辑模型揭示了两种消费者优化误差：对电子香烟相对风险的过高估计；以及现状偏差。我们的新颖数据和政策分析做出了三项贡献。首先，我们对反事实政策情景下电子香烟使用的预测，为当前的监管权衡提供了新的信息。其次，我们提供了关于消费者优化误差在烟草产品选择中作用的实证证据。第三，我们对解决个体优化误差的政策的行为福利分析做出了贡献。

abstract.text: The purpose of this paper is to investigate the effects of state-level Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) laws in the U.S. on maternal health behaviors and infant health outcomes. Using multi-state, multi-year difference-in-differences analyses, we estimated effects of state EITC generosity on maternal health behaviors, birth weight and gestation weeks. We find little difference in maternal health behaviors associated with state-level EITC. In contrast, results for key infant health outcomes of birth weight and gestation weeks show small improvements in states with EITCs, with larger effects seen among states with more generous EITCs. Our results provide evidence for important health benefits of state-level EITC policies.

10.3386/w23714.abstractZh: 本文旨在研究美国各州实施的劳动收入税收抵免政策对孕产妇健康行为和婴儿健康结果的影响。通过多州、多年的差异分析，我们评估了各州劳动收入税收抵免政策的慷慨程度对孕产妇健康行为、出生体重及妊娠周数的影响。研究发现，各州劳动收入税收抵免政策对孕产妇健康行为的影响差异不大。相比之下，对于婴儿健康的关键指标——出生体重和妊娠周数，有劳动收入税收抵免政策的州显示出较小的改善效果，而在税收抵免政策更为慷慨的州中，这种改善效果更为显著。我们的研究结果证明了各州劳动收入税收抵免政策在促进健康方面具有重要作用。

abstract.text: Health insurance confers benefits to the previously uninsured, including improvements in health, reductions in out-of-pocket spending, and reduced medical debt. But because the nominally uninsured pay only a small share of their medical expenses, health insurance also provides substantial transfers to non-recipient parties who would otherwise bear the costs of providing uncompensated care to the uninsured. The prevalence of uncompensated care helps explain the limited take-up of heavily-subsidized public health insurance and the evidence that many recipients value formal health insurance at substantially less than the cost to insurers of providing that coverage. The distributional implications of public subsidies for health insurance depend critically on the ultimate economic incidence of the transfers they deliver to providers of uncompensated care.

10.3386/w23718.abstractZh: 健康保险为之前未投保的人群带来诸多好处，包括健康状况的改善、个人支出的减少以及医疗债务的降低。但由于名义上未投保的人仅承担一小部分医疗费用，健康保险还向那些原本需要承担未投保人群医疗费用的非受益方提供了大量资金转移。未补偿护理的普遍存在现象有助于解释为何公共健康保险受到的限制性接受，以及为何许多受益者认为正式健康保险的价值远低于保险公司提供该保险所付出的成本。公共补贴对健康保险的影响，关键在于这些补贴最终对未补偿护理提供者的经济影响。

abstract.text: Estimating peer effects is notoriously difficult because of the reflection problem and the endogeneity of peer group formation. This paper tests for peer effects in obesity in a novel way that addresses these challenges. It addresses the reflection problem by using the alter’s genetic risk score for obesity, which is a significant predictor of obesity, is determined prior to birth, and cannot be affected by the behavior of others. It addresses the endogeneity of peer group formation by examining peers who are not self-selected: full siblings. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Adolescent Health, we find evidence of positive peer effects in weight and obesity; having a sibling with a high genetic predisposition raises one’s risk of obesity, even controlling for one’s own genetic predisposition to obesity. Implications of the findings include that peer effects may be an explanation for continued worldwide increases in weight, and that, because of social multipliers, the cost-effectiveness of obesity treatment and prevention programs may have been underestimated.

10.3386/w23719.abstractZh: 估计同伴效应非常困难，这主要是由于反射问题和同伴群体形成的内生性问题。本文采用一种新颖的方法来测试肥胖中的同伴效应，以克服这些挑战。通过使用同伴的肥胖遗传风险评分来解决这个问题，该评分是肥胖的一个重要预测因子，在出生前就已确定，且不会受到他人行为的影响。同时，通过研究非自我选择的同伴——全同胞，本文还解决了同伴群体形成的内生性问题。利用《全国青少年健康纵向调查》的数据，我们发现同伴效应在体重和肥胖方面存在积极影响；即使控制了个体自身的肥胖遗传倾向，拥有遗传倾向较高的同胞也会增加肥胖的风险。这些发现的意义在于，同伴效应可能是全球体重持续增加的一个解释因素，而且由于社会乘数效应，肥胖治疗和预防项目的成本效益可能被低估了。

abstract.text: We analyze long-term impacts of the 1967-1970 Nigerian Civil War, providing the first evidence of intergenerational impacts. Women exposed to the war in their growing years exhibit reduced adult stature, increased likelihood of being overweight, earlier age at first birth, and lower educational attainment. Exposure to a primary education program mitigates impacts of war exposure on education. War exposed men marry later and have fewer children. War exposure of mothers (but not fathers) has adverse impacts on child growth, survival, and education. Impacts vary with age of exposure. For mother and child health, the largest impacts stem from adolescent exposure.

10.3386/w23721.abstractZh: 我们分析了1967-1970年尼日利亚内战的长期影响，首次发现了代际影响的现象。在成长过程中暴露于战争中的女性，其成年身高较低，超重的可能性增加，首次生育的年龄较早，教育水平也较低。接受初等教育计划能够减轻战争对教育的负面影响。暴露于战争中的男性结婚年龄较晚，子女数量较少。战争对母亲的影响（而非父亲）会对儿童的成长、生存和教育产生不利影响。影响程度随暴露年龄的不同而有所差异。对于母亲和儿童的健康而言，最大的影响来自青少年时期的暴露。

abstract.text: This study contributes to the literature on supply-side adjustments to insurance expansions by examining the effect of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) on ambulance response times. Exploiting temporal and geographic variation in the implementation of the ACA as well as pre-treatment differences in uninsured rates, we estimate that the expansions of private and Medicaid coverage under the ACA combined to slow ambulance response times by an average of 19%. We conclude that, through extending coverage to individuals who, in its absence, would not have availed themselves of emergency medical services, the ACA added strain to emergency response systems.

10.3386/w23722.abstractZh: 本研究通过考察《平价医疗法案》对救护车响应时间的影响，为关于保险扩展的供给侧调整的文献做出了贡献。我们利用《平价医疗法案》实施过程中的时间和地理差异，以及治疗前的无保险率差异，估计在《平价医疗法案》下，私人和医疗补助覆盖范围的扩大使救护车响应时间平均减缓了19%。我们得出结论，通过为那些在没有《平价医疗法案》的情况下不会寻求紧急医疗服务的个体提供覆盖，该法案给紧急响应系统带来了额外的负担。

abstract.text: Self-control problems constitute a potential explanation for the under-investment in preventive health care observed in low-income countries. A commonly proposed policy tool to solve such problems is offering consumers commitment devices. We conduct a field experiment to evaluate the effectiveness of different types of theoretically-motivated commitment contracts in increasing preventive doctor visits by hypertensive patients in rural India. We document varying levels of takeup of the different commitment contracts, but find no effects on actual doctor visits or individual health outcomes. Thus, a substantial number of individuals pay for commitments, but then fail to follow through on the specified task, losing money without experiencing any health benefit. We develop and structurally estimate a pre-specified model of consumer behavior under present bias with varying levels of naivete. The results are consistent with a large share of individuals being partially naive about their own self-control problems: in other words, they are sophisticated enough to demand some commitment, but overly optimistic about whether a given commitment is sufficiently strong to be effective. The results suggest that commitment devices may in practice be welfare diminishing, at least in some contexts, and serve as a cautionary tale about the role of these contracts in the health care sector.

10.3386/w23727.abstractZh: 自我控制问题可能是解释低收入国家预防性医疗保健投资不足的一个潜在原因。一种常见的政策工具是提供承诺机制，以帮助消费者履行承诺。我们开展了一项实地实验，评估不同类型理论驱动的承诺合同在增加印度农村高血压患者就医次数方面的效果。我们发现不同承诺合同的采用程度有所不同，但并未发现其对实际就医次数或个人健康结果产生任何影响。因此，尽管有相当一部分人愿意支付承诺费用，但他们往往未能履行承诺，最终损失金钱而没有任何健康收益。我们构建并结构性地估计了一个基于当前偏见的消费者行为模型，该模型考虑了不同水平的天真程度。研究结果表明，大部分人对自己的自我控制问题存在部分认知偏差：也就是说，他们足够聪明，能够要求一些承诺，但过于乐观地认为某个承诺足够有力以产生效果。结果表明，承诺机制在某些情况下可能会降低福利，并提醒人们注意这类合同在医疗保健领域的应用风险。

abstract.text: We explore the rise and fall of pellagra, a disease caused by inadequate niacin consumption, in the American South, focusing on the first half of the twentieth century. We first consider the hypothesis that the South’s monoculture in cotton undermined nutrition by displacing local food production. Consistent with this hypothesis, a difference-in-differences estimation shows that after the arrival of the boll weevil, food production in affected counties rose while cotton production and pellagra rates fell. The results also suggest that after 1937 improved medical understanding and state fortification laws helped eliminate pellagra.

10.3386/w23730.abstractZh: 我们探讨了由烟酸摄入不足引起的一种疾病——糙皮病的兴衰情况，研究范围集中在20世纪上半叶的美国南部地区。我们首先考虑了这样一个假设：南部地区对棉花的单一种植方式通过取代当地食物生产，从而影响了当地的营养状况。与这一假设一致的是，差异-差异估计结果显示，在棉铃虫出现之后，受影响地区的食物产量有所上升，而棉花产量和糙皮病的发病率则有所下降。研究结果还表明，自1937年后，医学知识的进步以及各州的强化食品法规有助于消除糙皮病。

abstract.text: We evaluate the consequences of narrow hospital networks in commercial health care markets. We develop a bargaining solution, Nash-in-Nash with Threat of Replacement, that captures insurers' incentives to exclude, and combine it with California data and estimates from Ho and Lee (2017) to simulate equilibrium outcomes under social, consumer, and insurer-optimal networks. Private incentives to exclude generally exceed social incentives, as the insurer benefits from substantially lower negotiated hospital rates. Regulation prohibiting exclusion increases prices and premiums and lowers consumer welfare without significantly affecting social surplus. However, regulation may prevent harm to consumers living close to excluded hospitals.

10.3386/w23742.abstractZh: 我们评估了医院网络狭窄在商业医疗市场中的后果。我们提出了一种讨价还价解决方案，即“Nash-in-Nash与替代威胁模型”，该模型能够捕捉保险公司排除其他医院的动机。结合加利福尼亚州的数据以及Ho和Lee（2017年）的估计结果，我们模拟了在社交、消费者和保险公司均寻求最优网络情况下的均衡结果。私人排除其他医院的动机通常大于社会层面的动机，因为保险公司可以从谈判达成更低的医院费用中获益。禁止排除行为的法规会提高价格和保费，降低消费者福利，但并不会显著影响社会剩余。不过，此类法规或许能够避免对居住在被排除医院附近的消费者造成不利影响。

abstract.text: We uncover political dynamics that reward and reinforce increases in US health spending by studying the passage of the 2003 Medicare Modernization (MMA). We focus on a provision added to the MMA, which allowed hospitals to apply for temporary Medicare payment increases. Hospitals represented by members of Congress who voted ‘Yea’ to the MMA were more likely to receive payment increases. The payment increases raised local health spending and led to suggestive increases in health sector employment. Members of Congress representing hospitals that got a payment increase received large increases in campaign contributions before and after the program was extended.

10.3386/w23748.abstractZh: 我们通过研究2003年医疗保险现代化法案的通过，揭示了那些奖励并强化美国健康支出增加的政治动态。我们重点关注该法案中添加的一项条款，该条款允许医院申请临时性的医疗保险支付增加。那些在投票支持该法案的国会议员所代表的医院，更有可能获得支付增加。这些支付增加提升了当地的健康支出，并导致健康行业就业人数有所上升。而在该法案延长之前和之后，那些获得支付增加的医院所代表的国会议员，其竞选资金也大幅增加。

abstract.text: We used a randomized management consulting intervention with 80 public-sector healthcare facilities in Nigeria to study the role of information, training, and supervision on the adoption of improved organizational practices. Facilities that received detailed improvement plans and nine months of implementation support—including regular visits to monitor progress and set intermediate goals related to the plans—showed large, significant short-term effects on the adoption of practices that were under the responsibility of facility staff. Facilities that received general improvement advice but no implementation support showed no change in practices. Implementation support appears crucial for improvements, especially in contexts without market incentives for the adoption of effective managerial practices.

10.3386/w23749.abstractZh: 我们采用随机化的管理咨询干预措施，对尼日利亚的80家公共部门医疗机构进行了研究，探讨信息、培训和监督在促进改进组织实践方面的作用。那些获得了详细改进计划以及为期九个月的实施支持（包括定期访问以监测进展并设定与计划相关的中期目标）的医疗机构，在短期内对由机构工作人员负责的实践改进取得了显著成效。而仅获得一般改进建议但未获得实施支持的医疗机构，其实践并未发生任何变化。实施支持对于改进工作至关重要，尤其是在缺乏市场激励措施推动有效管理实践采纳的情况下。

abstract.text: Hospital payment regulation has historically been introduced to meet multiple policy objectives. The primary objective of "all-payer" rate setting regimes was to control costs through consistent, centrally regulated payments. These regimes were often linked, however, to an ancillary goal of financing care for the uninsured. We show that this secondary objective made states' all-payer regimes economically and legally unstable. Their economic instability reflected a feedback loop from surcharge rates to insurance coverage rates and back to the quantities of uncompensated care in need of being financed. The erosion of all-payer regimes' surcharge bases was particularly pronounced when health maintenance organizations were exempted from surcharge collections, creating a regulatory arbitrage opportunity. The economic and legal instability we highlight could largely have been avoided by financing the cost of uncompensated care provision through taxation of income or other standard revenue bases. These developments thus illustrate the wisdom of the Tinbergen Rule, which recommends that independent policy objectives be met with independent policy instruments.

10.3386/w23758.abstractZh: 医院支付监管的历史上是为了实现多种政策目标而引入的。所谓“全支付者”费率设定制度的主要目的，是通过统一、中央集权的支付方式来控制成本。然而，这些制度往往与另一个次要目标——为无保险人群提供医疗服务——相关联。研究表明，这一次要目标使得各州的全支付者制度在经济和法律上都不稳定。其经济上的不稳定反映了从附加费费率到保险覆盖率的反馈循环，以及需要融资的无补偿医疗服务的数量。当健康维护组织被免除附加费征收时，全支付者制度中的附加费基础遭到严重侵蚀，从而创造了监管套利的机会。我们强调的这种经济和法律上的不稳定，其实可以通过对收入或其他标准收入来源征税来避免。这些发展充分说明了 Tinbergen 规则的智慧，该规则建议用独立的政策工具来实现独立的政策目标。

abstract.text: Mental illnesses are prevalent in the United States and globally. Cost is a critical barrier to treatment receipt. We study the effects of recent and major eligibility expansions within Medicaid, a public insurance system for the poor in the U.S., on psychotropic prescription medications for mental illness. We estimate differences-in-differences models using administrative data on medications for which Medicaid was a third-party payer over the period 2011 to 2017. Our findings suggest that these expansions increased psychotropic prescriptions by 22.3%. We show that Medicaid, and not patients, financed these prescriptions. For states expanding Medicaid, the total cost of these prescriptions was $30.8M. Expansion effects were experienced across most major mental illness categories and across states with different levels of patient need, system capacity, and expansion scope. We find no evidence that Medicaid expansion reduced a proxy for serious mental illness: suicide.

10.3386/w23760.abstractZh: 精神疾病在美国及全球范围内普遍存在。费用是治疗接受的重要障碍。本研究探讨了美国针对贫困人口的公共保险体系——医疗补助计划中，最近进行的重大资格扩展对精神疾病用药的影响。我们利用2011至2017年间医疗补助作为第三方支付方的药物管理数据，建立了差异-差异模型进行估算。研究结果表明，这些扩展措施使精神疾病用药量增加了22.3%。我们发现，这些用药费用是由医疗补助计划承担的，而非患者个人负担。对于扩大医疗补助计划的州来说，这些用药的总费用达到了3080万美元。这种扩展效应在大多数主要精神疾病类别中均有所体现，且在不同患者需求水平、系统能力和扩展范围不同的州中也有显现。我们没有发现医疗补助扩展会降低严重精神疾病的指标——自杀率。

abstract.text: This paper surveys evidence documenting positive linkages among social capital, prosocial behaviour, and subjective well-being. Whether in the workplace, at home, in the community, or among nations, better and deeper social connections, and especially higher levels of trust are linked to higher subjective well-being, even beyond the effects flowing through higher incomes and better health. Prosocial behaviour is also shown to be a robust predictor of well-being in both correlational and experimental contexts. These two lines of research are connected, as prosocial acts are most likely to increase well-being when they are delivered in ways that improve social capital, and reflect intentional generosity free of either compulsion or personal gain. We infer that these deep links between prosocial acts and well-being have an evolutionary benefit in maintaining the quality of social capital and thereby delivering cooperative human responses in times of crisis.

10.3386/w23761.abstractZh: 本文综述了多项研究证据，这些证据表明社会资本、亲社会行为与主观幸福感之间存在积极关联。无论是在工作场所、家庭、社区还是国家之间，更紧密的社会联系，尤其是更高的信任水平，都与更高的主观幸福感相关，这种关联甚至超越了通过更高收入和改善健康所带来的影响。亲社会行为也被证明是预测幸福感的有效因素，无论是在相关性研究还是实验研究中。这两项研究相互关联，因为当亲社会行为以能够提升社会资本的方式实施，并且体现出无强制感且出于自愿的慷慨行为时，它们最有可能增加幸福感。我们认为，亲社会行为与幸福感之间的这种深层联系在进化上具有积极意义，有助于维持社会资本的质量，从而在危机时期激发人类的合作行为。

abstract.text: Marijuana is partially prohibited: though banned federally, it is available to 1 in 4 U.S. adults under state statutes. We measure the size of the interstate trade generated by state-level differences in legal status with a natural experiment: Oregon allowed stores to sell marijuana for recreational use on October 1, 2015, next to Washington where stores had been selling recreational marijuana since July 2014. Using administrative data covering the universe of Washington's sales and a differences-in-discontinuities approach, we find retailers along the Oregon border experienced a 36 percent decline in sales immediately after Oregon's market opened. We investigate the home location of recent online reviewers of marijuana retailers and find similar cross-border patterns. By the end of Washington's 2018 fiscal year, our results imply that Washington had earned between $44 million and $75 million in tax revenue from cross-border shoppers. These cross-border incentives may create a “race to legalize.”

10.3386/w23762.abstractZh: 大麻部分被禁止：虽然联邦层面已将其列为非法物品，但根据各州法律，仍有四分之一的美国成年人可以购买大麻。我们通过一项自然实验来测量因各州法律差异而产生的跨州贸易规模：2015年10月1日，俄勒冈州允许商店销售用于娱乐用途的大麻，而华盛顿州自2014年7月以来就一直允许商店销售娱乐用大麻。利用涵盖华盛顿州所有销售数据的行政数据，并采用差异不连续性方法分析后，我们发现俄勒冈州市场开放后，俄勒冈州边界附近的零售商销售额立即下降了36%。我们还调查了最近在线评论大麻零售商的居住地，发现类似的跨境模式。到华盛顿州2018财年末，我们的研究结果表明，华盛顿州从跨境购物者那里获得了4400万至7500万美元的税收收入。这些跨境激励措施可能会引发“合法化竞赛”。

abstract.text: A growing literature argues that early environments affecting childhood health may influence significantly later-life health and socioeconomic status. In this article, we present new evidence on the relationship between infant mortality and later-life outcomes using variation in infant mortality in England and Wales at the onset of World War II. We exploit the variation in infant mortality across birth cohorts and regions to estimate associations between infant mortality and adult outcomes, such as health, disability, and employment. Our findings suggest that exposure to a higher infant mortality environment is significantly associated with higher likelihood of reporting poor health, a higher likelihood of reporting a disability, a lower probability of employment, and a higher probability of reporting no earned income. We also find that the effects of the infant health environment do not become manifest until after age 55.

10.3386/w23763.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究指出，影响儿童健康的早期环境可能会对其后的健康和社会经济地位产生显著影响。在本文中，我们利用第二次世界大战前夕英格兰和威尔士的婴儿死亡率变化，提出了关于婴儿死亡率与后期结果之间关系的新证据。我们通过分析不同出生队列和地区之间的婴儿死亡率差异，来估算婴儿死亡率与成人结果（如健康、残疾和就业状况）之间的关联。我们的研究发现，处于较高婴儿死亡率的环境中，报告健康状况不佳的可能性显著增加，报告残疾的可能性也更高，就业的概率更低，且没有赚取收入的可能性也更高。此外，婴儿健康环境的影响直到55岁以后才会显现出来。

abstract.text: Accurate risk adjustment facilitates healthcare market competition. Risk adjustment typically aims to predict annual costs of individuals enrolled in an insurance plan for a full year. However, partial-year enrollment is common and poses a challenge to risk adjustment, since diagnoses are observed with lower probability when individual is observed for a shorter time. Due to missed diagnoses, risk adjustment systems will underpay for partial-year enrollees, as compared to full-year enrollees with similar underlying health status and usage patterns. We derive a new adjustment for partial-year enrollment in which payments are scaled up for partial-year enrollees’ observed diagnoses, which improves upon existing methods. We simulate the role of missed diagnoses using a sample of commercially insured individuals and the 2014 Marketplace risk adjustment algorithm, and find the expected spending of six-month enrollees is underpredicted by 19%. We then examine whether there are systematically different care usage patterns for partial-year enrollees in this data, which can offset or amplify underprediction due to missed diagnoses. Accounting for differential spending patterns of partial-year enrollees does not substantially change the underprediction for six-month enrollees. However, one-month enrollees use systematically less than one-twelfth the care of full-year enrollees, partially offsetting the missed diagnosis effect.

10.3386/w23765.abstractZh: 准确的风险调整有助于促进医疗市场的竞争。风险调整通常旨在预测参加保险计划的个人全年的年度成本。然而，部分年度参保情况较为常见，这给风险调整带来了挑战，因为当个体被观察的时间较短时，诊断被观察到的概率也会降低。由于漏诊的存在，与具有相似基础健康状况和使用模式的全年参保者相比，风险调整系统会对部分年度参保者进行较低的支付。我们提出了一种新的调整方法，对部分年度参保者的诊断情况进行相应的调整，从而改善现有方法。我们通过使用商业保险个体的样本和2014年市场风险调整算法，模拟了漏诊的影响，发现六个月参保者的预期支出被低估了19%。然后，我们检查了在这组数据中，部分年度参保者的护理使用模式是否存在系统性差异，这种差异可能会抵消或放大因漏诊导致的低估。考虑到部分年度参保者的不同支出模式，对六个月参保者的低估并没有显著变化。然而，一个月参保者的护理使用量系统地少于全年参保者的十二分之一，部分抵消了漏诊的影响。

abstract.text: Mergers that affiliate a hospital with a Catholic owner, network, or system reduce the set of possible reproductive medical procedures since Catholic hospitals have strict prohibitions on contraception. Using changes in ownership of hospitals, we find that Catholic hospitals reduce the per bed rates of tubal ligations by 31%, whereas there is no significant change in related permitted procedures such as Caesarian sections. However, across a variety of measures, we find minimal overall welfare reductions. Still, fewer tubal ligations increase the risk of unintended pregnancies across the United States, imposing a potentially substantial cost for less reliable contraception on women and their partners.

10.3386/w23768.abstractZh: 将医院与天主教所有者、网络或系统合并后，由于天主教医院对避孕有严格限制，可进行的生殖医疗程序数量会减少。通过研究医院所有权的变化，我们发现天主教医院使每床位的输卵管结扎手术费用减少了31%，而诸如剖腹产等相关手术则没有显著变化。不过，从各种指标来看，整体福利的减少幅度很小。尽管如此，较少的输卵管结扎手术会增加美国范围内意外怀孕的风险，从而给女性及其伴侣带来潜在的高昂代价，因为他们需要依赖不太可靠的避孕措施。

abstract.text: By the end of 2016, 28 states had liberalized their marijuana laws: by decriminalizing possession, by legalizing for medical purposes, or by legalizing more broadly. More states are considering such policy changes even while supporters and opponents continue to debate their impacts. Yet evidence on these liberalizations remains scarce, in part due to data limitations. We use data from Monitoring the Future’s annual surveys of high school seniors to evaluate the impact of marijuana liberalizations on marijuana use, other substance use, alcohol consumption, attitudes surrounding substance use, youth health outcomes, crime rates, and traffic accidents. These data have several advantages over those used in prior analyses. We find that marijuana liberalizations have had minimal impact on the examined outcomes. Notably, many of the outcomes predicted by critics of liberalizations, such as increases in youth drug use and youth criminal behavior, have failed to materialize in the wake of marijuana liberalizations.

10.3386/w23779.abstractZh: 截至2016年底，已有28个州放宽了大麻法律：通过非刑事化持有大麻、将大麻合法化用于医疗目的，或更广泛地将其合法化。越来越多的州正在考虑此类政策调整，尽管支持者和反对者仍在继续讨论这些政策的影响。然而，关于这些法律调整的证据仍然很少，部分原因是数据限制。我们利用“监测未来”组织每年对高中毕业生进行的调查数据，来评估大麻法律放宽对大麻使用、其他物质使用、酒精消费、对物质使用的态度、青少年健康状况、犯罪率和交通事故的影响。这些数据比以往分析中使用的数据具有多个优势。我们发现，大麻法律放宽对所考察的结果影响甚微。值得注意的是，许多批评者所预测的后果，如青少年药物使用率和青少年犯罪行为的增加，在大麻法律放宽后并未出现。

abstract.text: Home equity is the primary self-funding mechanism for long term services and supports (LTSS). Using data from the relevant waves of the Health and Retirement Study (1996-2010), we exploit the exogenous variation in the form of wealth shocks resulting from the value of housing assets, to examine the effect of wealth on use of home health, unpaid help and nursing home care by older adults. We find a significant increase in the use of paid home health care and unpaid informal care but no effect on nursing home care access. We conduct a placebo test on individuals who do not own property; their use of LTSS was not affected by the housing wealth changes. The findings suggest that a wealth shock exerts a positive and significant effect on the uptake of home health and some effect on unpaid care but no significant effect on nursing home care.

10.3386/w23781.abstractZh: 家庭资产是长期服务和支持的主要自我融资机制。利用《健康与退休研究》相关阶段的数据（1996-2010年），我们利用因住房资产价值变化而产生的财富冲击这一外生变量，来研究财富对老年人使用家庭健康护理、无偿帮助以及养老院护理的影响。我们发现，老年人使用付费家庭健康护理和无偿非正式护理的情况显著增加，但并未对养老院护理的获取产生影响。我们对没有房产的个人进行了安慰剂测试，结果显示他们使用长期服务和支持的情况并未受到住房财富变化的影响。研究结果表明，财富冲击对家庭健康护理的使用有积极且显著的影响，对无偿护理也有一定影响，但对养老院护理的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: Previous studies have shown that years of formal schooling attained affects health behaviors, but little is known about how the stringency of academic programs affects such behaviors, especially among youth. Using national survey data from the Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBS), we study the effects of mathematics and science high-school graduation requirements (HSGR) on high school students’ risky health behaviors--specifically on drinking, smoking, and marijuana use. We find that an increase in mathematics and science HSGR has significant negative impacts on alcohol consumption among high-school students, especially males and non-white students. The effects of math and science HSGR on smoking and marijuana use are also negative but generally less precisely estimated. Our results suggest that curriculum design may have potential as a policy tool to curb youth drinking.

10.3386/w23803.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，接受多年的正规教育会影响健康行为，但关于学术课程的严格程度如何影响这些行为，尤其是青少年的行为，目前知之甚少。我们利用青少年风险行为监测系统的全国调查数据，研究了数学和科学高中毕业要求对高中生危险健康行为的影响——具体包括对饮酒、吸烟和大麻使用的影響。研究发现，数学和科学的高中毕业要求增加对高中生的酒精消费有显著的负面影响，尤其是男性和非白人学生。数学和科学的高中毕业要求对吸烟和大麻使用的负面影响同样显著，但估计的精确度相对较低。我们的研究结果表明，课程设计可能具有作为政策工具来遏制青少年饮酒的潜力。

abstract.text: Providing clean water requires maintenance, as well as the initial connections that are typically measured. Frequently, the water supply fails in the developing world, especially when users don’t pay the marginal cost of water. This paper uses the timing of frequent, unexpected water service outages in Lusaka, Zambia to identify the short-term impacts of piped water access on contagious disease, economic activity and time use. We use microdata from the primary water utility in the city on the timing and location of supply complaints to identify outages, matched to extensive administrative data across the city. Conditional on fixed effects for time and water service district within Lusaka, we find that increases in outages are associated with increased incidence of diarrheal disease, upper respiratory infections, typhoid fever and measles. We match outages to geolocated microdata on financial transactions from the largest mobile money provider in Zambia, and find that outages cause a reduction in financial transactions. Outages also increase the time that young girls spend at their chores, possibly at the expense of time they spend doing schoolwork. Imperfect infrastructure appears to burden the poor in ways that go far beyond obvious health consequences.

10.3386/w23807.abstractZh: 提供清洁的水需要维护，以及通常所测量的初始连接。在发展中国家，供水经常出现问题，尤其是在用户不支付水资源的边际成本时。本文以赞比亚卢萨卡频繁出现的意外供水中断时间为例，研究管道供水对传染病、经济活动和时间使用的短期影响。我们利用该市主要供水公司的微观数据，了解供水中断的时间和地点，并将其与城市范围内的广泛行政数据进行匹配。在考虑卢萨卡时间和供水区固定效应的基础上，我们发现供水中断次数的增加与腹泻病、上呼吸道感染、伤寒和麻疹的发病率上升有关。我们将供水中断与赞比亚最大的移动货币提供商的地理定位财务交易数据进行匹配，发现供水中断会导致财务交易减少。此外，供水中断还增加了年轻女孩做家务的时间，可能以牺牲她们学习的时间为代价。不完善的基础设施似乎以超出健康后果的方式给穷人带来负担。

abstract.text: We examine multi-generational impacts of positive in utero health interventions using a new research design that exploits sharp increases in prenatal Medicaid eligibility that occurred in some states. Our analyses are based on U.S. Vital Statistics Natality files, which enables linkages between individuals' early life Medicaid exposure and the next generation's health at birth. We find evidence that the health benefits associated with treated generations' early life program exposure extend to later offspring. Our results suggest that the returns on early life health investments may be substantively underestimated.

10.3386/w23810.abstractZh: 我们采用一种新的研究设计，通过考察某些州在产前医疗补助资格方面发生的急剧增加，来探讨积极产前健康干预措施对多代人的影响。我们的分析基于美国生命统计出生数据，这使得能够将个体早期生活中的医疗补助接触情况与下一代出生时的健康状况联系起来。我们发现，与接受治疗的代际在早期生活中的医疗补助接触相关的健康益处会延续到后代。我们的研究结果表明，早期生活健康投资的回报可能被实质性地低估了。

abstract.text: Cigarette smoking leads to large healthcare and morbidity costs, and mortality losses, and smoking cessation plays a key role in reducing health risk and economic costs. While medical evidence suggests that some smokers are more likely to respond to medication treatment than others depending on genetic markers, it remains unexplored whether pharmacogenetic testing is cost-effective in treating potential quitters of smoking. We address this knowledge gap by developing a lifecycle model in which individuals make smoking, health investment and consumption-savings decisions. Depending on an individual's genotype, smoking may bring enjoyment but deteriorates one's health, and the dynamic evolution of health capital determines life expectancy. In addition to heterogeneous genotypes, individuals also differ in demographics. We calibrate this model to fit key economic and medical observations in the U.S. We then propose three smoking cessation policies, two with standard treatments and one personalized depending on genetic markers, all under the same program costs. We construct two unified measures of effectiveness and subsequently compute the cost-effectiveness ratio. We find that personalized treatment is the most cost-effective: for each dollar of program cost, it generates $8.94 value in effectiveness, which is 22-45% higher than those under standard treatments.

10.3386/w23820.abstractZh: 吸烟会导致巨大的医疗保健成本和健康风险，而戒烟在降低健康风险和经济成本方面起着关键作用。虽然医学证据表明，某些吸烟者在接受药物治疗方面可能比其他人更有反应，这取决于基因标记，但关于药物遗传学检测在帮助潜在戒烟者方面是否具有成本效益，目前尚未有研究。我们通过开发一个生命周期模型来解决这一知识空白，该模型让个体在吸烟、健康投资和消费-储蓄决策方面做出选择。根据个体的基因型，吸烟可能会带来愉悦感，但也会损害健康，而健康资本的动态演变决定了预期寿命。除了基因型差异外，个体在人口统计学方面也存在差异。我们调整该模型以符合美国的关键经济和医学观察结果。随后，我们提出了三种戒烟政策：两种采用标准治疗方法，一种根据基因标记进行个性化治疗，所有这些政策都遵循相同的项目成本。我们构建了两种统一的有效性衡量标准，并随后计算了成本效益比。研究发现，个性化治疗最具成本效益：每投入一美元的项目成本，它能带来8.94美元的有效性价值，这比标准治疗方法的效益高出22-45%。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of the NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament on college students’ drinking behavior using a nationally representative sample of American institutions. While success in intercollegiate athletics may augment the visibility of a university to prospective students and thereby benefit the school, it may also have a negative effect on the current student body by influencing risky behavior, especially the consumption of alcohol commonly associated with game day festivities. Using the Harvard School of Public Health College Alcohol Study (CAS), we find that a school’s participation in the NCAA Tournament is associated with a 30% increase in binge drinking and a 9% increase in self-reported drunk driving by male students at that school. The results suggest that this increase is not offset by less alcohol use before or after the tournament (intertemporal substitution) but instead seems to represent a net increase in the amount of alcohol consumed by students at participating schools.

10.3386/w23821.abstractZh: 我们研究了NCAA男子篮球锦标赛对大学生饮酒行为的影响，样本来自美国具有全国代表性的高校。虽然大学体育赛事的成功可能会提升学校的知名度，从而有利于学校的发展，但它也可能对在校学生产生负面影响，尤其是通过影响风险行为，特别是与比赛日庆典相关的酒精消费。利用哈佛公共卫生学院的大学酒精研究数据，我们发现，一所学校参与NCAA锦标赛后，该校男性学生的酗酒率增加了30%，自我报告的酒驾行为增加了9%。研究结果表明，这种增加并未因锦标赛前后酒精使用量的减少而得到抵消，反而似乎代表了参与学校学生酒精消费总量的净增加。

abstract.text: We develop a simple approximation that relates the total external validity bias in randomized trials to (i) bias from selection on observables and (ii) a measure for the role of treatment effect heterogeneity in driving selection into the experimental sample.

10.3386/w23826.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种简单的近似方法，将随机试验中的总外部有效性偏差与以下因素联系起来：(i) 对可观测变量的选择偏差；(ii) 治疗效果异质性在驱动实验样本选择中的作用。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of optimal financing for R&D-intensive firms that uses their unique features—large capital outlays, long gestation periods, high upside, and low probabilities of R&D success—that explains three prominent stylized facts about these firms: their relatively low use of debt, large cash balances, and underinvestment in R&D. The model relies on the interaction of the unique features of R&D-intensive firms with three key frictions: adverse selection about R&D viability, asymmetric information about the upside potential of R&D, and moral hazard from risk shifting. We establish the optimal pecking order of securities with direct market financing. Using a tradeoff between tax benefits and the costs of risk shifting for debt, we establish conditions under which the firm uses an all-equity capital structure and firms raise enough financing to carry excess cash. A firm may use a limited amount of debt if it has pledgeable assets in place. However, market financing still leaves potentially valuable R&D investments unfunded. We then use a mechanism design approach to explore the potential of intermediated financing, with a binding precommitment by firm insiders to make costly ex post payouts. A mechanism consisting of put options can be used in combination with equity to eliminate underinvestment in R&D relative to the direct market financing outcome. This optimal intermediary-assisted mechanism consists of bilateral “insurance” contracts, with investors offering firms insurance against R&D failure and firms offering investors insurance against very high R&D payoffs not being realized.

10.3386/w23831.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种针对研发密集型企业的最优融资理论，该理论利用了这些企业的独特特征——巨额资本投入、较长的研发周期、较高的收益潜力以及较低的研发成功概率——来解释关于这些企业的三个显著现象：相对较低的债务使用率、较大的现金余额以及研发投资不足。该模型基于研发密集型企业的独特特征与三个关键摩擦因素的相互作用：关于研发可行性的逆向选择、关于研发潜在收益的不对称信息，以及风险转移带来的道德风险。我们确定了直接市场融资下证券的最优优先级。通过权衡债务带来的税收优惠与风险转移的成本，我们确定了企业采用全权益资本结构的条件，以及企业筹集足够资金以持有超额现金的条件。如果企业拥有可抵押资产，则可以使用有限的债务。然而，市场融资仍然可能导致有价值的研发投资资金不足。随后，我们采用机制设计方法探讨中介融资的潜力，通过企业内部人士的约束性承诺来避免昂贵的事后支付。结合股权和看跌期权，可以形成一种机制，以克服直接市场融资下研发投资不足的问题。这种最优的中介辅助机制包括双边“保险”合同，投资者为企业的研发失败提供保险，而企业则为投资者提供保险，以防研发收益过高未能实现。

abstract.text: Inequality in wealth among elderly households, and in particular the prevalence of very low wealth holdings, can be an important consideration in the design of social insurance programs. This paper examines the incidence and determinants of low levels of financial and total wealth using repeated cross-sections of the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and a small longitudinal sample of HRS respondents observed both at age 65 and shortly before death. Most of those who report very low wealth holdings at the end of their life had little wealth at the traditional retirement age of 65. There is strong persistence over time in reports of very low wealth, and more generally relatively little evidence that wealth is drawn down in the first 15 years of retirement. The age-specific probability of reporting low wealth increases slowly after age 65. Low lifetime earnings are strongly predictive of low wealth at retirement and at the end of life. The post-retirement onset of a major medical condition, and, for married women, the loss of their spouse, are both associated with small increases in the probability of reporting very low wealth, but they account for a small fraction of low-wealth outcomes. Low levels of wealth accumulation before age 65, rather than gaps in the safety net after 65 or rapid spend-down of accumulated assets, appear to be the primary determinant of low levels of wealth just before death.

10.3386/w23839.abstractZh: 老年家庭之间的财富不平等，尤其是极低财富持有情况的普遍性，是设计社会保险计划时需要考虑的重要因素。本文通过健康与退休研究（HRS）的重复横截面数据，以及HRS受访者在65岁及临终前不久进行的纵向调查，探讨了低水平财务财富和总财富的发生情况及决定因素。大多数在生命结束时报告拥有极低财富的人，在传统的退休年龄65岁时几乎没有财富。极低财富的报告情况在时间上表现出强烈的持续性，总体上几乎没有证据表明在退休后的前15年里财富会减少。65岁以后，报告低财富的概率会缓慢增加。低 lifetime收入是退休时和生命结束时财富较低的强烈预测因素。退休后出现重大医疗状况，对于已婚女性来说，失去配偶，这些因素都与报告极低财富的概率略有增加有关，但它们对低财富结果的影响很小。在65岁之前积累的较低财富水平，而非65岁后的社会保障缺口或资产迅速消耗，似乎是死亡前财富水平较低的主要决定因素。

abstract.text: This study uses Monte Carlo simulations to examine the ability of the two-stage least-squares (2SLS) estimator and two-stage residual inclusion (2SRI) estimators with varying forms of residuals to estimate the local average and population average treatment effect parameters in models with binary outcome, endogenous binary treatment, and single binary instrument. The rarity of the outcome and the treatment are varied across simulation scenarios. Results show that 2SLS generated consistent estimates of the LATE and biased estimates of the ATE across all scenarios. 2SRI approaches, in general, produce biased estimates of both LATE and ATE under all scenarios. 2SRI using generalized residuals minimizes the bias in ATE estimates. Use of 2SLS and 2SRI is illustrated in an empirical application estimating the effects of long-term care insurance on a variety of binary healthcare utilization outcomes among the near-elderly using the Health and Retirement Study.

10.3386/w23840.abstractZh: 本研究采用蒙特卡洛模拟方法，考察了两阶段最小二乘法估计量以及采用不同形式残差的两阶段残差包含估计量在二元结果模型、内生二元处理模型和单一二元工具变量模型中对局部平均效应和总体平均处理效应参数的估计能力。模拟场景中，结果的稀有性和处理的随机性各不相同。结果表明，两阶段最小二乘法估计量在所有情景下都能得到一致的处理效应参数估计值，而两阶段残差包含估计量则普遍存在估计偏差。总体而言，两阶段残差包含估计量在所有情景下都会产生处理效应参数估计偏差，而使用广义残差的两阶段残差包含估计量能够最小化这种估计偏差。本研究还通过一项实证应用，利用健康与退休研究数据，探讨了长期护理保险对近老年人群体中的多种二元医疗利用结果的影响。

abstract.text: We estimated the average returns, in terms of patient survival, to the marginal innovations in oral chemotherapy market induced by Part D expansion of oral chemotherapy coverage for elderly individuals by mandating inclusion of “all or substantially all” oral anti-cancer medications on plans’ formularies. We exploited exogenous variation in the age of diagnosis for different cancer sites - and therefore the relative expansion in market size for different cancers under the Medicare’s prescription drug coverage – to isolate the effect of Part D on innovation and the health benefits that these innovative technologies provide. Using data from FDA and clinical studies from January 1994 to December 2016, we find that the approval rate for oral chemotherapies increased an additional 5.7% (95% CI: 1.7, 9.8) after implementation of Part D for every 1% increase in exposure to the Medicare market. In contrast, greater exposure to Medicare was associated with a smaller increase in the indication-specific survival gains reported in the drug’s label (3.2% [95% CI: 2.1, 4.3]) and 8.0% [95% CI: 6.1, 9.8] lower in absolute and relative gains, respectively). Similar trends were not observed for intravenously administered chemotherapy whose coverage was largely unaffected by Part D. These findings suggest that there could be diminishing returns to incentives for pharmaceutical innovation created by broad coverage mandates and that health policy tools, such as value–based pricing, may help maximize the health benefits provided by future pharmaceutical innovations.

10.3386/w23842.abstractZh: 我们估算了由于Part D对老年人群口服化疗覆盖范围的扩展，要求在保险计划处方清单上包含“全部或大部分”口服抗癌药物，这一变化在患者生存方面所带来的平均回报。我们利用不同癌症部位诊断年龄的外生变化——因此，在Medicare的处方药覆盖范围内，不同癌症的市场规模相对扩张程度不同——来分离Part D对创新的影响以及这些创新技术所提供的健康效益。根据1994年1月至2016年12月来自FDA和临床研究的数据，我们发现，在Part D实施后，每增加1%的Medicare市场参与度，口服化疗的批准率额外增加了5.7%（95%置信区间：1.7，9.8）。相比之下，更大的Medicare市场参与度与药物标签中报告的特定疾病生存增益的增加幅度较小相关（3.2% [95%置信区间：2.1，4.3]），并且绝对和相对增益分别降低了8.0% [95%置信区间：6.1，9.8]。对于主要通过静脉给药的化疗药物来说，这种趋势并未出现，因为其覆盖范围在Part D的影响下基本没有变化。这些发现表明，通过广泛覆盖要求为制药创新提供的激励可能具有递减回报效应，而诸如基于价值的定价等健康政策工具可能有助于最大化未来制药创新所提供的健康效益。

abstract.text: In health care systems with a competitive health insurance market, governments or other sponsors (e.g. employers) often subsidize premiums to encourage enrolment. These subsidies are typically independent of plan choice leaving the absolute premium differences in place so as not to distort consumer choice of plan. Such subsidies do, however, change the relative premium differences across plans, which, according to theories from behavioral economics, can affect choice. Consumers might be sensitive to differences relative to a reference premium (“relative thinking”). Furthermore, consumers might be particularly sensitive to a reference premium of zero (“zero-price effect”), a relevant range for some subsidized health insurance markets. This paper tests these ideas with two sources of evidence. We argue that observed equilibria in Germany and the U.S. Medicare Advantage markets are consistent with a powerful zero-price effect, resulting in an equilibrium focal pricing at zero. This contrasts with the Netherlands where equilibrium premiums are well above zero. In an empirical test using hypothetical questions in a web-based survey in these three countries, we also find evidence for both a relative thinking and a zero-price effect in the demand for health insurance. Our findings imply that well-designed subsidies can leverage relative thinking to increase demand elasticity for health plans. Creation of a powerful reference price (e.g., at zero), however, risks subverting price competition.

10.3386/w23846.abstractZh: 在竞争性的健康保险市场中，政府或其他赞助方（如雇主）通常会补贴保费以鼓励人们参保。这些补贴通常与选择计划无关，从而保持绝对保费差异，以避免扭曲消费者的计划选择。然而，这种补贴确实改变了不同计划之间的相对保费差异，根据行为经济学的理论，这可能会影响消费者的选择。消费者可能对相对于参考保费的差异非常敏感（“相对思维”）。此外，消费者可能对零参考保费特别敏感（“零价格效应”），这在一些有补贴的健康保险市场中是一个相关现象。本文通过两个证据来源来检验这些观点。我们认为，德国和美国Medicare Advantage市场的观察结果与强大的零价格效应一致，导致均衡定价处于零水平。这与荷兰的情况不同，荷兰的均衡保费远高于零。在这三个国家进行的一项基于网络调查的实证测试中，我们还发现了消费者在健康保险需求中表现出相对思维和零价格效应的证据。我们的研究结果表明，设计良好的补贴可以通过利用相对思维来增加对健康计划的需求弹性。然而，创建强大的参考价格（例如，零价格）可能会破坏价格竞争。

abstract.text: We study the effect of recent legalization of recreational marijuana use (RMLs) in the United States on Social Security Disability Insurance and Supplemental Security Income claiming, proxied by new applications and new benedficiaries, over the period 2001 to 2019. We combine administrative caseload data from the Social Security Administration with state policy changes using two-way fixed effects regression. We find that RML adoption increases new disability application rates. However, there is no change in new beneficiaries post-RML. We provide suggestive evidence that the observed changes in applications post-RML are potentially driven by increases in marijuana misuse and selective migration.

10.3386/w23862.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国近期娱乐性大麻使用合法化对社会保障残疾保险和补充安全收入申请的影响，通过新申请数量和新增受益人来反映这一影响，研究时间跨度为2001年至2019年。我们结合了社会保障管理局的行政案件数据以及各州的政策变化，采用双向固定效应回归模型进行分析。研究发现，娱乐性大麻使用的合法化增加了新的残疾申请数量。然而，娱乐性大麻使用合法化后，新增受益人数量并未发生变化。我们有理由认为，申请数量的变化可能由大麻滥用的增加和选择性迁移所驱动。

abstract.text: E-cigarettes are available in over 7,000 flavors, whereas all flavors but menthol are banned in combustible cigarettes. The FDA recently requested a ban on e-cigarette flavors, but was rejected. The FDA is again considering this ban and also a ban on menthol in combustible cigarettes, but there is little information on the impacts of alternative bans on the market for combustible and e-cigarettes. Our study provides these much-needed estimates. We conduct a discrete choice experiment on a nationally representative sample of 2,031 adult smokers and recent quitters that we collected.
