The root of the problem is that traditionally, standard errors rely on estimating a theoretically derived asymptotic variance, and often this asymptotic variance involves substantially more complex quantities than the original parameter to be estimated. Standard errors are important: they are used both to assess the precision of estimators in the form of confidence intervals, to create “feasible statistics” for testing, to build forecasting models based on, say, daily estimates, and also to optimize the tuning parameters. The contribution of this paper is to provide an alternative and general solution to this problem, which we call Observed Asymptotic Variance. It is a general nonparametric method for assessing asymptotic variance (AVAR). It provides consistent estimators of AVAR for a broad class of integrated parameters Θ =\int θ_t dt, where the spot parameter process θ can be a general semi-martingale, with continuous and jump components. The observed AVAR is implemented with the help of a two-scales method. Its construction works well in the presence of microstructure noise, and when the observation times are irregular or asynchronous in the multivariate case. The methodology is valid for a wide variety of estimators, including the standard ones for variance and covariance, and also for more complex estimators, such as, of leverage effects, high frequency betas, and semi-variance.

10.3982/ecta12501.abstractZh: 高频金融数据的可用性催生了一系列基于日内数据的估计方法，提升了金融计量经济学领域大范围数据分析的质量。然而，估计这些估计量的标准误差往往具有挑战性。问题的根源在于，传统上标准误差的估计依赖于理论推导出的渐近方差，而这一渐近方差往往涉及比原始待估计参数更为复杂的量。标准误差非常重要：它们被用来评估估计量的精确度，形成置信区间；为检验创建“可行的统计结果”；基于日度估计值构建预测模型；以及优化调整参数。本文的贡献在于提供了一种替代且通用的解决方案，我们称之为“观测渐近方差”。这是一种通用的非参数方法，用于评估渐近方差。它为广泛的一类积分参数Θ =\int θ_t dt提供了一致的渐近方差估计方法，其中现货参数过程θ可以是具有连续和跳跃成分的普通半鞅。观测渐近方差的构建借助双尺度方法实现。该方法在存在微观结构噪声、观测时间不规则或多变量情况下仍能有效。该方法适用于多种估计量，包括方差和协方差的标准估计量，以及更复杂的估计量，如杠杆效应、高频贝塔值以及半方差等。

abstract.text: We characterize optimal mechanisms for the multiple-good monopoly problem and provide a framework to find them. We show that a mechanism is optimal if and only if a measure $μ$ derived from the buyer's type distribution satisfies certain stochastic dominance conditions. This measure expresses the marginal change in the seller's revenue under marginal changes in the rent paid to subsets of buyer types. As a corollary, we characterize the optimality of grand-bundling mechanisms, strengthening several results in the literature, where only sufficient optimality conditions have been derived. As an application, we show that the optimal mechanism for $n$ independent uniform items each supported on $[c,c+1]$ is a grand-bundling mechanism, as long as $c$ is sufficiently large, extending Pavlov's result for $2$ items [Pavlov'11]. At the same time, our characterization also implies that, for all $c$ and for all sufficiently large $n$, the optimal mechanism for $n$ independent uniform items supported on $[c,c+1]$ is not a grand bundling mechanism.

10.3982/ecta12618.abstractZh: 我们描述了多商品垄断问题的最优机制，并提供了一个寻找这些机制的框架。我们证明，一个机制是最优的，当且仅当从买家类型分布导出的度量$μ$满足某些随机优势条件。这个度量表达了在支付给买家类型子集的租金发生边际变化时，卖家收入的边际变化。作为推论，我们描述了捆绑机制的最优性，从而加强了文献中仅推导出充分条件的最优性条件的几个结果。作为一个应用，我们证明了对于$n$个独立且分布在$[c,c+1]$上的商品，只要$c$足够大，最优机制就是捆绑机制，这扩展了Pavlov在$2$个商品情况下得出的结果[Pavlov'11]。同时，我们的描述还意味着，对于所有$c$和所有足够大的$n$，分布在$[c,c+1]$上的$n$个独立商品的最优机制不是捆绑机制。

abstract.text: The accepted manuscript version (last revised 5 Jan 2018 (v8)) has 118 pages, 3 tables, 11 figures, and includes supplementary appendix. This version corrects some typos in Example 2 of the published version. This supplement contains 11 appendices with additional results and some omitted proofs. Appendices F-J include additional results for Sections 2-7, respectively. Appendix K gathers auxiliary results on algebra of covering entropies. Appendices L and M contain the proofs of Sections 4 and 5 omitted from the main text. Appendix N contains the proofs of Sections 6 omitted from the main text, together with the proofs of the additional results for Section 6 in Appendix I. Appendix O reports the results of a simulation experiment.

10.3982/ecta12723.abstractZh: 已接受的稿件版本（最后一次修订于2018年1月5日，版本8）共有118页，包含3张表格、11幅图表，并附有补充附录。该版本修正了已发表版本中示例2中的一些拼写错误。补充附录包含11个附录，其中包含了额外的结果以及一些被省略的证明。附录F-J分别提供了第2至第7节的其他结果。附录K汇集了关于覆盖熵的代数方面的辅助结果。附录L和M包含了主文中省略的第4节和第5节的证明。附录N包含了主文中省略的第6节的证明，以及附录I中第6节额外结果的证明。附录O报告了一项模拟实验的结果。

abstract.text: We propose a novel methodology for evaluating the accuracy of numerical solutions to dynamic economic models. It consists in constructing a lower bound on the size of approximation errors. A small lower bound on errors is a necessary condition for accuracy: If a lower error bound is unacceptably large, then the actual approximation errors are even larger, and hence, the approximation is inaccurate. Our lower‐bound error analysis is complementary to the conventional upper‐error (worst‐case) bound analysis, which provides a sufficient condition for accuracy. As an illustration of our methodology, we assess approximation in the first‐ and second‐order perturbation solutions for two stylized models: a neoclassical growth model and a new Keynesian model. The errors are small for the former model but unacceptably large for the latter model under some empirically relevant parameterizations.

10.3982/ecta12791.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法论，用于评估动态经济模型数值解的准确性。该方法包括构建近似误差大小的下界。较小的误差下界是准确性的必要条件：如果误差下界过大，那么实际的近似误差会更大，因此近似结果是不准确的。我们的下界误差分析是对传统上用误差上界（最坏情况）进行分析的补充，后者为准确性提供了充分条件。作为我们方法论的示例，我们评估了两个典型模型的一阶和二阶摄动解的近似情况：一个新古典增长模型和一个新的凯恩斯模型。对于前者模型，误差较小，但对于后者模型，在某些具有实际意义的参数化条件下，误差会过大，无法接受。

abstract.text: We develop econometric tools for studying jump dependence of two processes from high-frequency observations on a fixed time interval. In this context, only segments of data around a few outlying observations are informative for the inference. We derive an asymptotically valid test for stability of a linear jump relation over regions of the jump size domain. The test has power against general forms of nonlinearity in the jump dependence as well as temporal instabilities. We further propose an efficient estimator for the linear jump regression model that is formed by optimally weighting the detected jumps with weights based on the diffusive volatility around the jump times. We derive the asymptotic limit of the estimator, a semiparametric lower efficiency bound for the linear jump regression, and show that our estimator attains the latter. The analysis covers both deterministic and random jump arrivals. In an empirical application, we use the developed inference techniques to test the temporal stability of market jump betas.

10.3982/ecta12962.abstractZh: 我们开发了经济计量学工具，用于从高频观测数据中研究两个过程的跳跃依赖性，这些观测数据来自固定的时间间隔。在这种情况下，只有围绕少数异常观测数据的数据段对推断才有意义。我们推导出一个渐近有效的测试方法，用于检验线性跳跃关系在跳跃大小域各区域中的稳定性。该测试能够应对跳跃依赖性中的一般非线性形式以及时间不稳定性。我们进一步提出了一种高效的线性跳跃回归模型估计方法，该方法通过基于跳跃时刻周围的扩散波动性对检测到的跳跃进行最优加权来构建模型。我们推导出了该估计量的渐近极限，即线性跳跃回归的半参数下界效率界限，并证明我们的估计量达到了这一下界。该分析涵盖了确定性和随机跳跃情况。在一项实证应用中，我们使用所开发的推断技术来测试市场跳跃贝塔值的时间稳定性。

abstract.text: This paper empirically investigates how sentences to be assigned at trial impact plea bargaining. The analysis is based on a variation of a bargaining model with asymmetric information due to Bebchuk (1984). I provide conditions for the non-parametric identification of the model, propose a consistent non-parametric estimator, and implement it using data on criminal cases from North Carolina. I find that the majority of cases settle for a sentence that is roughly 50 percent of the one that would be assigned in the event of a trial conviction. Employing the estimated model, I evaluate how different sentencing reforms affect the outcome of criminal cases. My results indicate that lowering mandatory minimum sentences has the potential to greatly reduce the total amount of jail time assigned by the justice system, but may increase conviction rates. In contrast, the broader use of non-jail sentences for less serious crimes reduces the number of jail convictions, but has a negligible effect over the total assigned jail time. 1.

10.3982/ecta12974.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究，探讨了在审判中确定的刑罚对认罪协商的影响。分析基于Bebchuk（1984）提出的具有信息不对称问题的协商模型的一种变体。我提出了非参数识别该模型的条件，并提出了一种一致的非参数估计方法，随后利用北卡罗来纳州的刑事案件数据进行了实证检验。研究发现，大多数案件的刑罚大约仅为审判定罪情况下所确定的刑罚的50%。通过运用该估计模型，我评估了不同的量刑改革对刑事案件结果的影响。我的研究结果表明，降低强制最低刑期有可能大幅减少司法系统所判处的监禁时间，但可能会增加定罪率。相反，对于较轻的犯罪采用非监禁刑罚，虽然可以减少监禁定罪的数量，但对总监禁时间的减少影响微乎其微。

abstract.text: In this paper we prove the existence of recursive equilibria in stochastic production economies with infinitely lived agents and incomplete financial markets. We consider a general dynamic model with several commodities, which encompasses heterogeneous agent versions of both the Lucas asset pricing model and the stochastic neo-classical growth model as special cases. Our main assumption is that there are atomless shocks to fundamentals that have a purely transitory component and a component that does not depend on last period's shocks directly.

10.3982/ecta13047.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们证明了在具有无限寿命的代理人和不完全金融市场下的随机生产经济中，递归均衡的存在性。我们考虑了一个包含多种商品的一般动态模型，该模型包含了卢卡斯资产定价模型和随机新古典增长模型的各种特例。我们的主要假设是，基本面的冲击是无原子的，这些冲击具有纯粹的过渡性成分，以及一个不依赖于上一期冲击的成分。

abstract.text: This paper develops a theory of randomization tests under an approximate symmetry as-sumption. Randomization tests provide a general means of constructing tests that control size in finite samples whenever the distribution of the observed data exhibits symmetry under the null hypothesis. Here, by exhibits symmetry we mean that the distribution remains invariant under a group of transformations. In this paper, we provide conditions under which the same construction can be used to construct tests that asymptotically control the probability of a false rejection whenever the distribution of the observed data exhibits approximate symmetry in the sense that the limiting distribution of a function of the data exhibits symmetry under the null hypothesis. An important application of this idea is in settings where the data may be grouped into a fixed number of “clusters ” with a large number of observations within each cluster. In such settings, we show that the distribution of the observed data satisfies our ap-proximate symmetry requirement under weak assumptions. In particular, our results allow for the clusters to be heterogeneous and also have dependence not only within each cluster, but also across clusters. This approach enjoys several advantages over other approaches in these settings. Among other things, it leads to a test that is asymptotically similar, which, as shown in a simulation study, translates into improved power at many alternatives. Finally, we use our results to revisit the analysis of Angrist and Lavy (2009), who examine the impact of a cash award on exam performance for low-achievement students in Israel.

10.3982/ecta13081.abstractZh: 本文在近似对称性的假设下，发展了一种随机化检验的理论。随机化检验提供了一种通用方法，可以在有限样本情况下构建能够控制检验功效的检验，前提是观测数据的分布在零假设下具有对称性。这里所说的对称性是指分布在一组变换下保持不变。在本文中，我们提出了一些条件，在这些条件下，同样的构造方法可以用来构建能够渐近控制错误拒绝概率的检验，前提是观测数据的分布具有近似对称性，即数据的函数在其极限分布下在零假设下具有对称性。这一思想的一个重要应用是在数据被划分为固定数量的“簇”的情况下，每个簇内包含大量观测值。在这种情况下，我们证明了在弱假设下，观测数据的分布满足我们的近似对称性要求。特别地，我们的结果允许簇内部存在异质性，并且簇之间也存在依赖性。与其它方法相比，这种方法具有多个优势。例如，它得出的检验在渐近意义上具有相似性，正如模拟研究所示，这可以提高许多替代假设的功效。最后，我们利用我们的结果重新审视了Angrist和Lavy（2009）的研究，他们研究了现金奖励对以色列低成就学生考试表现的影响。

abstract.text: We study the estimation of (joint) moments of microstructure noise based on high frequency data. The estimation is conducted under a nonparametric setting, which allows the underlying price process to have jumps, the observation times to be irregularly spaced, and the noise to be dependent on the price process and to have diurnal features. Estimators of arbitrary orders of (joint) moments are provided, for which we establish consistency as well as central limit theorems. In particular, we provide estimators of autocovariances and autocorrelations of the noise. Simulation studies demonstrate excellent performance of our estimators in the presence of jumps, irregular observation times, and even rounding. Empirical studies reveal (moderate) positive autocorrelations of microstructure noise for the stocks tested.

10.3982/ecta13085.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于高频数据对微观结构噪声的联合矩进行估计的方法。该估计在非参数框架下进行，允许价格过程出现跳跃，观测时间分布不规律，且噪声依赖于价格过程并具有昼夜特征。我们提供了任意阶联合矩的估计方法，并证明了其一致性以及中心极限定理。特别地，我们提供了噪声自协方差和自相关性的估计方法。仿真研究表明，我们的估计方法在存在跳跃、不规则观测时间甚至舍入误差的情况下仍能表现出优异的性能。实证研究表明，所测试的股票中微观结构噪声具有（中等程度的）正自相关性。

abstract.text: We develop a continuum player timing game that subsumes standard wars of attrition and pre-emption games, and introduces a new rushes phenomenon. Payoffs are continuous and single-peaked functions of the stopping time and stopping quantile. We show that if payoffs are hump-shaped in the quantile, then a sudden “rush” of players stops in any Nash or subgame perfect equilibrium. Fear relaxes the first mover advantage in pre-emption games, asking that the least quantile beat the average; greed relaxes the last mover advantage in wars of attrition, asking just that the last quantile payoff exceed the average. With greed, play is inefficiently late: an accelerating war of attrition starting at optimal time, followed by a rush. With fear, play is inefficiently early: a slowing pre-emption game, ending at the optimal time, preceded by a rush. The theory predicts the length, duration, and intensity of stopping, and the size and timing of rushes, and offers insights for many common timing games.

10.3982/ecta13089.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个连续时间玩家博弈模型，该模型包含了标准的消耗战和先占博弈，并引入了一种新的“突袭”现象。收益是停止时间和停止分位数的连续且单峰函数。我们证明，如果收益在分位数上呈驼峰状，那么任何纳什均衡或子博弈完美均衡中都会出现玩家的突然“突袭”。恐惧会削弱先占博弈中的先动者优势，要求最小分位数超过平均水平；贪婪则会削弱消耗战中的最后行动者优势，要求最后分位数的收益超过平均水平。在贪婪的情况下，博弈的起始时间会较晚：以最优时间开始的一场加速的消耗战，随后出现突袭。在恐惧的情况下，博弈的起始时间会较早：以最优时间结束的一场放缓的先占博弈，随后出现突袭。该理论能够预测停止的时间长度、持续时间和强度，以及突袭的规模和时机，并为许多常见的时间博弈提供了洞察力。

abstract.text: We study from both a theoretical and an empirical perspective how a network of military alliances and enmities affects the intensity of a conflict. The model combines elements from network theory and from the politico-economic theory of conflict. We obtain a closed-form characterization of the Nash equilibrium. Using the equilibrium conditions, we perform an empirical analysis using data on the Second Congo War, a conflict that involves many groups in a complex network of informal alliances and rivalries. The estimates of the fighting externalities are then used to infer the extent to which the conflict intensity can be reduced through (i) dismantling specific fighting groups involved in the conflict; (ii) weapon embargoes; (iii) interventions aimed at pacifying animosity among groups. Finally, with the aid of a random utility model, we study how policy shocks can induce a reshaping of the network structure.

10.3982/ecta13117.abstractZh: 我们从理论和实证两个角度研究军事联盟和敌对关系网络如何影响冲突的激烈程度。该模型结合了网络理论和政治经济冲突理论的元素。我们得出了纳什均衡的封闭形式描述。利用均衡条件，我们对第二次刚果战争的数据进行了实证分析，这场冲突涉及许多团体，并在复杂的非正式联盟和竞争网络中展开。通过估算战斗外部性，我们推断出可以通过以下方式降低冲突激烈程度：(i) 解散参与冲突的特定战斗团体；(ii) 实施武器禁运；(iii) 采取旨在平息团体间敌意的干预措施。最后，借助随机效用模型，我们研究了政策冲击如何促使网络结构发生重塑。

abstract.text: I study repeated competition among oligopolists. The only novelty is that firms may go bankrupt and permanently exit: the probability that a firm survives a price war depends on its financial strength, which varies stochastically over time. Under some conditions including no entry, an anti-folk theorem holds: when firms are patient, so that strength levels change relatively quickly, every Nash equilibrium involves an immediate price war that lasts until at most one firm remains. Surprisingly, the possibility of entry may facilitate collusion, as may impatience. The model can explain some observed patterns of collusion and predation.

10.3982/ecta13121.abstractZh: 我研究寡头竞争中的重复博弈现象。唯一的新颖之处在于，企业可能会破产并永久退出竞争：一家企业能否在价格战中立于不败之地，取决于其财务实力，而财务实力会随时间随机变化。在某些条件下，包括没有新进入者的情形，存在一个反民定理：当企业具有耐心，使得实力水平变化相对较快时，每个纳什均衡都会引发一次立即发生的价格战，直到最多只剩一家企业存活。令人惊讶的是，新进入者的存在可能会促进勾结行为，而不耐烦的态度也可能起到同样的作用。该模型能够解释一些观察到的勾结和掠夺行为模式。

abstract.text: Limited overlap between the covariate distributions of groups with different treatment assignments does not only make estimates of average treatment effects rather imprecise, but can also lead to substantially distorted confidence intervals. This paper argues that this is because the coverage error of traditional confidence intervals is driven by the number of observations in the areas of limited overlap. Some of these “local sample sizes” can be very small in applications, up to the point that distributional approximations derived from classical asymptotic theory become unreliable. Building on this observation, this paper constructs confidence intervals based on classical approaches to small sample inference. The approach is easy to implement, and has superior theoretical and practical properties relative to standard methods in empirically relevant settings.

10.3982/ecta13141.abstractZh: 不同处理组之间的协变量分布存在有限重叠，这不仅使得平均处理效应的估计变得相当不准确，还可能导致置信区间出现显著偏差。本文认为，这是因为传统置信区间的覆盖误差受到重叠区域中观测数量的影响。在某些应用中，这些“局部样本量”可能非常小，以至于从经典渐近理论推导出的分布近似变得不可靠。基于这一观察，本文提出了一种基于经典小样本推断方法构建置信区间的方法。该方法易于实施，并且在具有实证相关性的情境下，其理论性和实用性都优于标准方法。

abstract.text: We extend Ellsberg's two-urn paradox and propose three symmetric forms of partial ambiguity by limiting the possible compositions in a deck of 100 red and black cards in three ways. Interval ambiguity involves a symmetric range of 50 − n to 50 + n red cards. Complementarily, disjoint ambiguity arises from two nonintersecting intervals of 0 to n and 100 − n to 100 red cards. Two-point ambiguity involves n or 100 − n red cards. We investigate experimentally attitudes towards partial ambiguity and the corresponding compound lotteries in which the possible compositions are drawn with equal objective probabilities. This yields three key findings: distinct attitudes towards the three forms of partial ambiguity, significant association across attitudes towards partial ambiguity and compound risk, and source preference between two-point ambiguity and two-point compound risk. Our findings help discriminate among models of ambiguity in the literature.

10.3982/ecta13239.abstractZh: 我们扩展了Ellsberg的两 urn悖论，并通过三种方式限制100张红黑牌的组合可能性，提出了三种对称形式的部分模糊性。区间模糊性涉及一个对称的红牌范围，从50-n到50+n。互补性模糊性则源于两个不相交的区间，分别是0到n和100-n到100的红牌。两点模糊性涉及n或100-n的红牌。我们通过实验研究了人们对部分模糊性的态度，以及相应的复合彩票，其中可能的组合以相等的客观概率产生。研究得出了三个关键发现：对三种部分模糊性形式的态度各不相同，人们对部分模糊性与复合风险的态度存在显著关联，并且在两点模糊性与两点复合风险之间存在偏好差异。我们的发现有助于区分文献中不同的模糊性模型。

abstract.text: Kolotilin acknowledges financial support from the Australian Research Council. Zapechelnyuk acknowledges financial support from the Economic and Social Research Council (grant no. ES/N01829X/1)

10.3982/ecta13251.abstractZh: Kolotilin感谢澳大利亚研究委员会的财政支持。Zapechelnyuk感谢经济和社会研究委员会的财政支持（资助编号：ES/N01829X/1）。

abstract.text: We document abrupt increases in retail beer prices just after the consummation of the MillerCoors joint venture, both for MillerCoors and its major competitor, Anheuser‐Busch. Within the context of a differentiated‐products pricing model, we test and reject the hypothesis that the price increases can be explained by movement from one Nash–Bertrand equilibrium to another. Counterfactual simulations imply that prices after the joint venture are 6%–8% higher than they would have been with Nash–Bertrand competition, and that markups are 17%–18% higher. We relate the results to documentary evidence that the joint venture may have facilitated price coordination.

10.3982/ecta13333.abstractZh: 我们记录了MillerCoors合资企业成立之后，无论是MillerCoors还是其主要竞争对手Anheuser-Busch的零售啤酒价格均出现了急剧上涨。在差异化产品定价模型的背景下，我们测试并否定了价格上升可以通过从一个Nash-Bertrand均衡转移到另一个均衡来解释的假设。反事实模拟表明，合资企业成立后的价格比在Nash-Bertrand竞争情况下高出6%至8%，而价格加成则高出17%至18%。我们将这些结果与文献中的证据联系起来，这些证据表明合资企业可能促进了价格协调。

abstract.text: We consider forecasting with uncertainty about the choice of predictor variables. The researcher wants to select a model, estimate the parameters, and use this for forecasting. We investigate the dis-tributional properties of a number of different schemes for model choice and parameter estimation: in-sample model selection using the Akaike information criterion, out-of-sample model selection, and splitting the data into subsamples for model selection and parameter estimation. Using a weak-predictor local asymptotic scheme, we provide a representation result that facilitates comparison of the distributional properties of the procedures and their associated forecast risks. We develop a sim-ulation procedure that improves the accuracy of the out-of-sample and split-sample methods uni-formly over the local parameter space. We also examine how bootstrap aggregation (bagging) affects the local asymptotic risk of the estimators and their associated forecasts. Numerically, we find that for many values of the local parameter, the out-of-sample and split-sample schemes perform poorly if implemented in the conventional way. But they perform well, if implemented in conjunction with our risk-reduction method or bagging.

10.3982/ecta13372.abstractZh: 我们考虑了在预测变量选择存在不确定性的情况下进行预测的问题。研究者希望选择一个模型，估计参数，并运用这些参数进行预测。我们研究了多种模型选择和参数估计方法的分布特性：包括使用赤池信息量准则进行样本内模型选择、样本外模型选择，以及将数据分割成子样本以进行模型选择和参数估计。通过采用弱预测变量局部渐近方法，我们提供了一种表示结果，有助于比较这些方法的分布特性及其相关的预测风险。我们还开发了一种模拟程序，该程序能够统一提高样本外和分割样本方法的准确性。此外，我们还研究了自举聚合（bagging）对估计量及其相关预测风险的局部渐近影响。数值结果表明，对于许多局部参数值，如果以传统方式实施样本外和分割样本方法，其性能会较差。但如果与我们的风险降低方法或自举聚合结合使用，则性能会有所改善。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a perfectly competitive model of a market with adverse selection. Prices are determined by zero-profit conditions, and the set of traded contracts is determined by free entry. Crucially for applications, contract characteristics are endogenously determined, consumers may have multiple dimensions of private information, and an equilibrium always exists. Equilibrium corresponds to the limit of a differentiated products Bertrand game. We apply the model to establish theoretical results on the equilibrium effects of mandates. Mandates can increase efficiency but have unintended consequences. With adverse selection, an insurance mandate reduces the price of low-coverage policies, which necessarily has indirect effects such as increasing adverse selection on the intensive margin and causing some consumers to purchase less coverage.

10.3982/ecta13434.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个存在逆向选择的完全竞争市场模型。价格由零利润条件决定，而交易合约的数量则由自由进入机制决定。对于实际应用而言，合约特征是由内生因素决定的，消费者可能拥有多个维度的私人信息，且均衡始终存在。均衡对应于差异化产品伯特兰博弈的边界。我们应用该模型来探讨强制要求对均衡影响的理论结果。强制要求可以提高效率，但也可能产生意想不到的后果。在逆向选择的情况下，保险强制要求会降低低覆盖率保单的价格，这必然会产生间接影响，例如增加密集边际上的逆向选择，导致部分消费者减少保险覆盖。

abstract.text: This paper extends the long-term factorization of the stochastic discount factor introduced and studied by Alvarez and Jermann (2005) in discrete-time ergodic environments and by Hansen and Scheinkman (2009) and Hansen (2012) in Markovian environments to general semimartingale environments. The transitory component discounts at the stochastic rate of return on the long bond and is factorized into discounting at the long-term yield and a positive semimartingale that extends the principal eigenfunction of Hansen and Scheinkman (2009) to the semimartingale setting. The permanent component is a martingale that accomplishes a change of probabilities to the long forward measure, the limit of T-forward measures. The change of probabilities from the data-generating to the long forward measure absorbs the long-term risk-return trade-off and interprets the latter as the long-term risk-neutral measure.

10.3982/ecta13438.abstractZh: 本文扩展了Alvarez和Jermann（2005）在离散时间遍历环境中，以及Hansen和Scheinkman（2009）以及Hansen（2012）在马尔可夫环境中提出的随机贴现因子的长期分解方法，将其应用于一般的半鞅环境。过渡成分以长期债券的随机回报率进行贴现，并分解为以长期收益率进行的贴现和一個正半鞅，后者将Hansen和Scheinkman（2009）的主要特征函数扩展到半鞅环境中。永久成分是一个鞅，它实现了从数据生成测度到长期前向测度的概率变化，后者是T-前向测度的极限。从数据生成测度到长期前向测度的概率变化吸收了长期风险-回报权衡，并将后者解释为长期风险中性测度。

abstract.text: We provide the first analysis of altruism in networks. Agents are connected through a fixed, weighted network and care about the well-being of their network neigh-bors. Given some initial distribution of incomes, agents may provide financial support to their poorer friends. We characterize the Nash equilibria of this transfer game for general networks and utility functions. We show that equilibria solve a well-behaved maximization program, related to classical problems of optimal transportation on networks. We build on this reformulation and establish existence, uniqueness in consumptions and generic uniqueness in transfers. We show that transfers are affected by the geometry of the altru-istic network. They flow through shortest paths and chains of transfers emerge when the network is not transitive. We analyze the effects of changes in incomes and in the network. When an agent suffers a negative income shock, the equilibrium consumption of every agent decreases weakly. We characterize the impact of small redistributions and show that decreasing income inequality may increase consumption inequality. We also characterize the impact of a small increase in altruism. While altruistic networks reduce inequality, more altruism may lead to more inequality.

10.3982/ecta13533.abstractZh: 我们首次对网络中的利他行为进行了分析。个体通过固定的、带有权重的网络相互连接，并且关心网络邻居的福祉。在一定的初始收入分配下，个体可能会向较贫困的朋友提供经济支持。我们描述了这种转移游戏在一般网络和效用函数下的纳什均衡。我们发现这些均衡解决了与网络上的最优运输问题相关的良好行为最大化问题。在此基础上，我们证明了转移行为的存在性、消费行为的唯一性以及转移行为的通用唯一性。我们还发现，转移行为受到利他网络几何结构的影响，它们通过最短路径进行传递，而当网络不具备传递性时，就会出现转移链。我们分析了收入变化和网络结构变化的影响。当一个个体面临负收入冲击时，每个个体的均衡消费都会减少。我们描述了小规模再分配的影响，并发现减少收入不平等可能会加剧消费不平等。我们还描述了小规模利他行为增加的影响。虽然利他网络能够减少不平等，但更多的利他行为可能会导致更大的不平等。

abstract.text: The impact of insurer competition on welfare, negotiated provider prices, and premiums in the U.S. private health care industry is theoretically ambiguous.Reduced competition may increase the premiums charged by insurers and their payments made to hospitals.However, it may also strengthen insurers' bargaining leverage when negotiating with hospitals, thereby generating offsetting cost decreases.To understand and measure this trade-off, we estimate a model of employer-insurer and hospital-insurer bargaining over premiums and reimbursements, household demand for insurance, and individual demand for hospitals using detailed California admissions, claims, and enrollment data.We simulate the removal of both large and small insurers from consumers' choice sets.Although consumer welfare decreases and premiums typically increase, we find that premiums can fall upon the removal of a small insurer if an employer imposes effective premium constraints through negotiations with the remaining insurers.We also document substantial heterogeneity in hospital price adjustments upon the removal of an insurer, with renegotiated price increases and decreases of as much as 10% across markets.

10.3982/ecta13570.abstractZh: 保险公司竞争对美国私人医疗保健行业的福利、协商达成的医疗服务价格以及保费的影响在理论上存在不确定性。竞争减少可能会提高保险公司的收费以及向医院支付的费用。然而，这也可能增强保险公司在与医院谈判时的议价能力，从而带来成本降低的效果。为了理解和衡量这种权衡，我们基于详细的加利福尼亚州住院、理赔和注册数据，建立了一个模型，模拟了雇主与保险公司以及医院与保险公司在保费和报销费用方面的谈判过程，同时考虑了家庭对保险的需求以及个人对医院服务的需求。我们模拟了大型和小型保险公司从消费者选择范围中移除的情况。尽管消费者福利下降且保费通常上升，但我们发现，如果雇主通过与剩余保险公司谈判实施有效的保费限制，小型保险公司的移除反而可能导致保费下降。我们还发现，在保险公司被移除后，医院的价格调整存在显著的异质性，重新谈判后的价格涨幅或降幅可达10%。

abstract.text: We introduce a novel economic indicator, named excess idle time (EXIT), measuring the extent of sluggishness in observed financial prices. Using a complete limit theory, we provide econometric support for the fact that high-frequency transaction prices are, coherently with liquidity and asymmetric information theories of price determination, generally stickier than implied by the ubiquitous semimartingale assumption. EXIT provides, for every asset and each trading day, a proxy for the extent of frictions (liquidity and asymmetric information) which is conceptually different from traditional price-impact measures. We relate it to existing measures and show its favorable performance under realistic data generating processes. We conclude by showing that EXIT uncovers an economically-meaningful short-term and long-term liquidity premium in market returns.

10.3982/ecta13595.abstractZh: 我们引入了一个新的经济指标，名为“闲置时间过剩”（EXIT），用于衡量观察到的金融价格中存在的迟缓程度。通过完整的极限理论，我们为高频交易价格与流动性和信息不对称理论相一致的结论提供了计量经济学支持。高频交易价格通常比普遍存在的半鞅假设所暗示的更为稳定。EXIT为每一种资产和每一个交易日提供了一个衡量摩擦（流动性和信息不对称）程度的指标，这一概念上不同于传统的价格影响度量方法。我们将EXIT与现有的度量方法联系起来，并展示了其在现实数据生成过程中的良好表现。最后，我们得出结论，EXIT揭示了市场回报中具有经济意义的短期和长期流动性溢价。

abstract.text: We solve a general class of dynamic rational-inattention problems in which an agent repeatedly acquires costly information about an evolving state and selects actions. The solution resembles the choice rule in a dynamic logit model, but it is biased towards an optimal default rule that does not depend on the realized state. We apply the general solution to the study of (i) the sunk-cost fallacy; (ii) inertia in actions leading to lagged adjustments to shocks; and (iii) the tradeoff between accuracy and delay in decision-making.

10.3982/ecta13636.abstractZh: 我们解决了一类通用的动态理性忽略问题，在这个问题中，一个代理人不断获取关于不断变化状态的昂贵信息，并选择相应的行动。该解决方案类似于动态逻辑模型中的选择规则，但它倾向于一个最优的默认规则，该规则不依赖于实际状态。我们将这一通用解决方案应用于研究以下问题：(i)沉没成本谬误；(ii)导致对冲击的滞后调整的惯性行为；(iii)决策中准确性与延迟之间的权衡。

abstract.text: What does contract negotiation look like when some parties hold private information and negotiation frictions are negligible? This paper analyzes the above question and provides a foundation for renegotiation-proof contracts in a related environment. The model extends the framework of the Coase conjecture to situations in which the quantity or quality of the good is endogenously determined and to more general environments in which the traded goods are complements or substitutes. All equilibria converge to a unique outcome as frictions become negligible, which is separating, efficient, and straightforward to characterize.

10.3982/ecta13637.abstractZh: 当某些当事人持有私人信息且谈判摩擦可以忽略不计时，合同谈判会呈现怎样的形态？本文对上述问题进行了分析，并为相关环境下具有重新谈判防护性的合同提供了理论基础。该模型将Coase猜想的框架扩展到了商品数量或质量由内生因素决定的情况，以及交易商品为互补品或替代品的更一般环境下。随着摩擦的忽略，所有均衡都会收敛到唯一的结果，这种结果具有分离性、效率性，并且易于描述。

abstract.text: The ill-posedness of the inverse problem of recovering a regression function in a nonparametric instrumental variable model leads to estimators that may suffer from a very slow, logarithmic rate of convergence. In this paper, we show that restricting the problem to models with monotone regression functions and monotone instruments significantly weakens the ill-posedness of the problem. In stark contrast to the existing literature, the presence of a monotone instrument implies boundedness of our measure of ill-posedness when restricted to the space of monotone functions. Based on this result we derive a novel non-asymptotic error bound for the constrained estimator that imposes monotonicity of the regression function. For a given sample size, the bound is independent of the degree of ill-posedness as long as the regression function is not too steep. As an implication, the bound allows us to show that the constrained estimator converges at a fast, polynomial rate, independently of the degree of ill-posedness, in a large, but slowly shrinking neighborhood of constant functions. Our simulation study demonstrates significant finite-sample performance gains from imposing monotonicity even when the regression function is rather far from being a constant. We apply the constrained estimator to the problem of estimating gasoline demand functions from U.S. data.

10.3982/ecta13639.abstractZh: 在非参数工具变量模型中，逆问题的不适定性会导致估计量收敛速度非常缓慢，呈对数级增长。本文指出，将问题限制在具有单调回归函数和单调工具变量的模型中，可以显著减弱问题的不适定性。与现有文献不同，当限制在单调函数空间时，单调工具变量的存在意味着我们的不适定性度量具有有界性。基于这一结果，我们推导出了一种针对受限估计量的新颖非渐近误差界，该误差界要求回归函数具有单调性。对于给定的样本量，只要回归函数不是过于陡峭，该误差界就与不适定性的程度无关。由此可以推断，受限估计量在常数函数的较大但逐渐缩小的邻域内，以快速的多项式速率收敛，与不适定性的程度无关。我们的模拟研究表明，即使回归函数与常数相差甚远，施加单调性也能带来显著的有限样本性能提升。我们将受限估计量应用于从美国数据估计汽油需求函数的问题。

abstract.text: We study some seemingly anomalous results that arise in possibly misspeciﬁed, reduced-rank linear asset-pricing models estimated by the continuously updated generalized method of moments. When a spurious factor (that is, a factor that is uncorrelated with the returns on the test assets) is present, the test for correct model speciﬁcation has asymptotic power that is equal to the nominal size. In other words, applied researchers will erroneously conclude that the model is correctly speciﬁed even when the degree of misspeciﬁcation is arbitrarily large.The rejection probability of the test for overidentifying restrictions typically decreases further in underidentiﬁed models where the dimension of the null space is larger than 1.

10.3982/ecta13750.abstractZh: 我们研究了一些看似异常的结果，这些结果可能出现在通过连续更新的广义矩方法估计的、参数设定不准确的降秩线性资产定价模型中。当存在虚假因子（即与测试资产的回报不相关的因子）时，检验模型正确参数设定的渐近功效等于名义大小。换句话说，应用研究人员可能会错误地认为模型参数设定是正确的，即使参数设定的错误程度非常大。在欠定模型中，当零空间的维度大于1时，检验过度识别限制的拒绝概率通常会进一步降低。

abstract.text: We develop a new quantile-based panel data framework to study the nature of income persistence and the transmission of income shocks to consumption.Log-earnings are the sum of a general Markovian persistent component and a transitory innovation.The persistence of past shocks to earnings is allowed to vary according to the size and sign of the current shock.Consumption is modeled as an age-dependent nonlinear function of assets and the two earnings components.We establish the nonparametric identification of the nonlinear earnings process and the consumption policy rule.Exploiting the enhanced consumption and asset data in recent waves of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we find nonlinear persistence and conditional skewness to be key features of the earnings process.We show that the impact of earnings shocks varies substantially across earnings histories, and that this nonlinearity drives heterogeneous consumption responses.The transmission of shocks is found to vary systematically with assets.

10.3982/ecta13795.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个新的基于分位数的面板数据框架，用于研究收入持久性的本质以及收入冲击对消费的传递机制。收入是一般马尔可夫持久成分和过渡性创新的总和。过去冲击对收入的持久性可以根据当前冲击的规模和符号而变化。消费被建模为资产和两个收入成分的年龄依赖的非线性函数。我们建立了非线性收入过程和消费政策规则的非参数识别方法。利用最近几轮收入动态面板研究中增强的消费和资产数据，我们发现非线性持久性和条件偏度是收入过程的关键特征。我们表明，收入冲击的影响在不同收入历史中差异很大，这种非线性驱动了异质性的消费反应。我们发现，冲击的传递与资产有系统性的变化。

abstract.text: This paper develops a theory of socially determined aspirations, and the interaction of those aspirations with growth and inequality.The interaction is bidirectional: economy-wide outcomes determine individual aspirations, which in turn determine investment incentives and social outcomes.Thus aspirations, income and the distribution of income evolve jointly.When capital stocks lie in some compact set, steady states distributions must exhibit inequality and are typically clustered around local poles.When sustained growth is possible, initial histories matter.Either there is convergence to an equal distribution (with growth) or there is perennial relative divergence across clusters, with withincluster convergence.A central feature that drives these results is that aspirations that are moderately above an individual's current standard of living tend to encourage investment, while still higher aspirations may lead to frustration.

10.3982/ecta13865.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种关于社会决定的抱负理论，以及这些抱负与经济增长和不平等之间的相互作用。这种相互作用是双向的：整个经济领域的结果决定了个人的抱负，而个人的抱负又反过来影响投资激励和社会结果。因此，抱负、收入以及收入的分配是共同演变的。当资本存量处于某个紧凑的区域内时，稳态分布必然表现出不平等，并且通常会在局部极点附近聚集。当持续经济增长成为可能时，初始历史条件就变得重要。要么会趋向于一种平等的收入分配（伴随着经济增长），要么会在各个集群之间持续出现相对差异，同时各集群内部也会出现收敛。推动这些结果的一个核心特征是，适度高于个人当前生活水平的抱负往往能够鼓励投资，而更高的抱负则可能导致挫败感。

abstract.text: The demand for assets as prices and initial wealth vary identifies beliefs and attitudes towards risk.We derive conditions that guarantee identification with no knowledge either of the cardinal utility index (attitudes towards risk) or of the distribution of future endowments or payoffs of assets; the argument applies even if the asset market is incomplete and demand is observed only locally.

10.3982/ecta13880.abstractZh: 随着资产价格和初始财富的变化，人们对风险的认知和态度也会发生变化。我们推导出了一些条件，这些条件保证了在既不知道基数效用指数（对风险的态度），也不知道未来资产收益分布的情况下，也能实现这种识别；即使资产市场是不完整的，且需求仅从局部观察到，这一论点仍然适用。

abstract.text: A growing number of school districts use centralized assignment mechanisms to allocate school seats in a manner that reflects student preferences and school priorities.Many of these assignment schemes use lotteries to ration seats when schools are oversubscribed.The resulting random assignment opens the door to credible quasi-experimental research designs for the evaluation of school effectiveness.Yet the question of how best to separate the lottery-generated variation integral to such designs from non-random preferences and priorities remains open.This paper develops easily-implemented empirical strategies that fully exploit the random assignment embedded in a wide class of mechanisms, while also revealing why seats are randomized at one school but not another.We use these methods to evaluate charter schools in Denver, one of a growing number of districts that combine charter and traditional public schools in a unified assignment system.The resulting estimates show large achievement gains from charter school attendance.Our approach generates efficiency gains over ad hoc methods, such as those that focus on schools ranked first, while also identifying a more representative average causal effect.We also show how to use centralized assignment mechanisms to identify causal effects in models with multiple school sectors.

10.3982/ecta13925.abstractZh: 越来越多的学区采用集中分配机制来分配学校座位，以反映学生的偏好和学校的优先事项。许多这种分配方案在学校报名人数过多时使用抽签来分配座位。这种随机分配为评估学校效能的准实验研究设计提供了可能。然而，如何最好地将这种设计中不可或缺的抽签产生的变异与非随机的偏好和优先事项区分开来，这个问题仍然没有答案。本文提出了一些易于实施的实证策略，这些策略能够充分利用广泛机制中的随机分配，同时揭示为什么某个学校的座位是随机分配的，而另一个学校则不是。我们使用这些方法来评估丹佛的特许学校，丹佛是越来越多将特许学校和传统公立学校结合在一起的学区之一。研究结果显示，就读特许学校可以带来显著的学业成绩提升。我们的方法比那些仅关注排名靠前的学校的临时方法更能提高效率，同时还能识别出更具代表性的平均因果效应。我们还展示了如何利用集中分配机制在多所学校部门模型中识别因果效应。

abstract.text: Modeling intergenerational altruism is crucial to evaluate the long-term consequences of current decisions, and requires a set of principles guiding such altruism. We axiomatically develop a theory of pure, direct altruism: Altruism is pure if it concerns the total utility (rather than the mere consumption utility) of future generations, and direct if it directly incorporates the utility of all future generations. Our axioms deliver a new class of altruistic, forward-looking preferences, whose weight put on the consumption of a future generation generally depends on the consumption of other generations. The only preferences lacking this dependence correspond to the quasi-hyperbolic discounting model, which our theory characterizes. Our approach provides a framework to analyze welfare in the presence of altruistic preferences and addresses technical challenges stemming from the interdependent nature of such preferences.

10.3982/ecta13937.abstractZh: 对代际利他主义进行建模对于评估当前决策的长期后果至关重要，这需要一套指导这种利他主义的原则。我们公理性地发展了一种纯粹的直接利他主义理论：如果利他主义涉及未来世代的总效用（而不仅仅是单纯的消费效用），那么这种利他主义就是纯粹的；如果它直接包含了所有未来世代的效用，那么这种利他主义就是直接的。我们的公理提出了一类新的利他主义型、前瞻性偏好，这类偏好的权重通常取决于对其他世代的消费。唯一缺乏这种依赖性的偏好对应于我们的理论所描述的准超线性折扣模型。我们的方法为分析存在利他主义偏好的福利状况提供了一个框架，并解决了由于这些偏好相互依赖而产生的技术挑战。

abstract.text: We explore the impact of private information in sealed-bid first-price auctions. For a given symmetric and arbitrarily correlated prior distribution over values, we characterize the lowest winning-bid distribution that can arise across all information structures and equilibria. The information and equilibrium attaining this minimum leave bidders indifferent between their equilibrium bids and all higher bids. Our results provide lower bounds for bids and revenue with asymmetric distributions over values. We also report further characterizations of revenue and bidder surplus including upper bounds on revenue. Our work has implications for the identification of value distributions from data on winning bids and for the informationally robust comparison of alternative auction mechanisms.

10.3982/ecta13958.abstractZh: 我们探讨了私有信息在密封投标首价拍卖中的影响。对于给定对称且任意相关的价值先验分布，我们描述了在所有信息结构和均衡中可能出现的最低中标投标分布。达到这一最小值的投标信息和均衡使得投标者对其均衡投标和所有更高投标之间无差异。我们的研究结果为不对称价值分布的投标和收入提供了下限。我们还进一步描述了收入和投标者剩余的特征，包括收入的上限。我们的工作对于从中标投标数据识别价值分布以及对于不同拍卖机制的信息稳健比较具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper examines the role of uncertainty shocks in a one-sector, representative-agent dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model. When prices are flexible, uncertainty shocks are not capable of producing business cycle co-movements among key macro variables. With countercyclical markups through sticky prices, however, uncertainty shocks can generate fluctuations that are consistent with business cycles. Monetary policy usually plays a key role in offsetting the negative impact of uncertainty shocks. If the central bank is constrained by the zero lower bound, then monetary policy can no longer perform its usual stabilizing function and higher uncertainty has even more negative effects on the economy. Calibrating the size of uncertainty shocks using fluctuations in the VIX, the authors find that increased uncertainty about the future may indeed have played a significant role in worsening the Great Recession, which is consistent with statements by policymakers, economists, and the financial press.

10.3982/ecta13960.abstractZh: 本文探讨了不确定性冲击在一个部门代表性代理人动态随机一般均衡模型中的作用。当价格具有灵活性时，不确定性冲击无法导致关键宏观经济变量之间的商业周期联动。然而，通过粘性价格实施反周期加价机制，不确定性冲击可以产生与商业周期一致的波动。货币政策通常在抵消不确定性冲击的负面影响方面发挥着关键作用。如果中央银行受到零下限约束，那么货币政策就无法再发挥其通常的稳定作用，更高的不确定性会对经济产生更负面的影响。通过利用VIX的波动来校准不确定性冲击的大小，作者发现对未来不确定性的增加确实可能在加剧大衰退中发挥了重要作用，这与政策制定者、经济学家和金融媒体的说法一致。

abstract.text: Owing to the worldwide shortage of deceased-donor organs for transplantation, living donations have become a significant source of transplant organs.However, not all willing donors can donate to their intended recipients because of medical incompatibilities.These incompatibilities can be overcome by an exchange of donors between patients.For kidneys, such exchanges have become widespread in the last decade with the introduction of optimization and market design techniques to kidney exchange.A small but growing number of liver exchanges have also been conducted.Over the last two decades, a number of transplantation procedures emerged where organs from two living donors are transplanted to a single patient.Prominent examples include dual-graft liver transplantation, lobar lung transplantation, and simultaneous liver-kidney transplantation.Exchange, however, has been neither practiced nor introduced in this context.We introduce dual-donor organ exchange as a novel transplantation modality, and through simulations show that living-donor transplants can be significantly increased through such exchanges.We also provide a simple theoretical model for dual-donor organ exchange and introduce optimal exchange mechanisms under various logistical constraints.

10.3982/ecta13971.abstractZh: 由于全球范围内可供移植的死亡捐献者器官短缺，活体捐献已成为移植器官的重要来源。然而，并非所有愿意捐献的捐献者都能将器官捐献给预定的接受者，因为存在医学上的不相容性。这种不相容性可以通过患者之间的器官交换来克服。在肾脏移植方面，随着优化和市场设计技术的引入，这种交换在过去十年中变得普遍。肝脏移植的交换也时有发生，尽管数量较少，但正在逐渐增加。在过去的二十年里，出现了一些移植手术，其中两个活体捐献者的器官被移植给同一个患者。典型的例子包括双肝移植、肺叶移植以及同时进行的肝肾移植。然而，在这种背景下，交换技术尚未被实践或引入。我们提出了双捐献者器官交换这一新的移植方式，并通过模拟表明，通过这种交换可以显著增加活体捐献者的移植数量。我们还提供了一个简单的理论模型，用于双捐献者器官交换，并提出了在各种物流限制下的优化交换机制。

abstract.text: We propose a method to correct for sample selection in quantile regression models.Selection is modelled via the cumulative distribution function, or copula, of the percentile error in the outcome equation and the error in the participation decision.Copula parameters are estimated by minimizing a method-of-moments criterion.Given these parameter estimates, the percentile levels of the outcome are re-adjusted to correct for selection, and quantile parameters are estimated by minimizing a rotated "check" function.We apply the method to correct wage percentiles for selection into employment, using data for the UK for the period 1978-2000.We also extend the method to account for the presence of equilibrium effects when performing counterfactual exercises.

10.3982/ecta14030.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种方法来纠正分位数回归模型中的样本选择问题。样本选择通过结果的百分位数误差的累积分布函数或copula来建模，同时考虑参与决策中的误差。copula参数通过最小化矩估计准则来估计。在得到这些参数估计值后，结果的百分位数水平会被重新调整以纠正选择偏差，而分位数参数则通过最小化旋转后的“检查”函数来估计。我们应用该方法来纠正1978-2000年间英国就业选择中的工资百分位数偏差。此外，该方法还扩展到了在进行反事实分析时考虑均衡效应的情况。

abstract.text: We present a model of the relationship between real interest rates, credit spreads, and the structure and risk of the banking system. Banks intermediate between entrepreneurs and investors, and can monitor entrepreneurs projects. We characterize the equilibrium for a xed aggregate supply of savings, showing that safer entrepreneurs will be funded by nonmonitoring banks and riskier entrepreneurs by monitoring banks. We show that an increase in savings reduces interest rates and spreads, increases the relative size of the nonmonitoring banking system and the probability of failure of monitoring banks. We also show that the dynamic version of the model exhibits endogenous boom and bust cycles, and rationalizes the existence of countercyclical risk premia and the connection between low interest rates, credit spreads, and the buildup of risks during booms.

10.3982/ecta14057.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，用于研究实际利率、信用利差与银行系统结构和风险之间的关系。银行介于企业家和投资者之间，能够监督企业家项目。我们针对固定总储蓄供应条件下的均衡状态进行了分析，发现更安全的企业家会由不监督的银行提供资金，而风险更高的企业家则需要通过监督银行来获得资金。我们进一步表明，储蓄的增加会降低利率和信用利差，同时增加不监督银行系统的相对规模以及监督银行失败的概率。此外，我们还发现该模型的动态版本会表现出周期性繁荣与萧条，并解释了反周期风险溢价的存在，以及低利率、信用利差与繁荣时期风险累积之间的联系。

abstract.text: Democracies widely differ in the extent to which powerful elites and interest groups retain influence over politics.While a large literature argues that elite capture is rooted in a country's history, our understanding of the determinants of elite persistence is limited.In this paper, we show that allowing old-regime agents to remain in office during democratic transitions is a key determinant of the extent of elite capture.We exploit quasi-random from Indonesia: Soeharto-regime mayors were allowed to finish their terms before being replaced by new leaders.Since mayors' political cycles were not synchronized, this event generated exogenous variation in how long old-regime mayors remained in their position during the democratic transition.Districts with longer exposure to old-regime mayors experience worse governance outcomes, higher elite persistence, and lower political competition in the medium run.The results suggest that slower transitions towards democracy allow the old-regime elites to capture democracy.

10.3982/ecta14125.abstractZh: 不同民主国家的强大精英和利益集团对政治的影响程度存在很大差异。尽管大量研究认为精英掌控现象源于一个国家的历史背景，但我们对精英持续执政的决定因素的理解仍然有限。在本文中，我们指出，允许旧政权代理人继续在民主过渡期间任职是精英掌控程度的一个关键决定因素。我们以印度尼西亚为例：苏哈托政权中的市长在被新领导人取代之前可以继续任职。由于市长的政治周期并不同步，这一事件导致了旧政权市长在民主过渡期间任职时间的外部变化。那些长期由旧政权市长执政的地区，在中期会出现更差的治理结果、更高的精英持续执政现象以及更低的政治竞争程度。研究结果表明，向民主过渡的缓慢过程使得旧政权精英能够掌控民主制度。

abstract.text: We use variation in historical state centralization to examine the long-term impact of institutions on cultural norms. The Kuba Kingdom, established in Central Africa in the early 17th century by King Shyaam, had more developed state institutions than the other independent villages and chieftaincies in the region. It had an unwritten constitution, separation of political powers, a judicial system with courts and juries, a police force, a military, taxation, and significant public goods provision. Comparing individuals from the Kuba Kingdom to those from just outside the Kingdom, we find that centralized formal institutions are associated with weaker norms of rule following and a greater propensity to cheat for material gain. This finding is consistent with recent models where endogenous investments to inculcate values in children decline when there is an increase in the effectiveness of formal institutions that enforce socially desirable behavior. Consistent with such a mechanism, we find that Kuba parents believe it is less important to teach children values related to rule-following behaviors.

10.3982/ecta14139.abstractZh: 我们通过研究历史状态下中央集权的变化，来探讨制度对文化规范长期影响的研究。17世纪初，由沙亚姆国王在中非建立了古巴王国，其国家制度比该地区其他独立村庄和酋长国更为发达。该王国拥有不成文的宪法、政治权力分离、由法院和陪审团组成的司法体系、警察部队、军队、税收制度以及重要的公共物品供给。通过比较古巴王国居民与周边地区的居民，我们发现，中央集权的正式制度与较弱的服从规则的行为规范以及更大的为了物质利益而作弊的倾向有关。这一发现与近期模型的结果一致，即当正式制度在执行社会期望行为方面的有效性提高时，用于灌输价值观的内生性投资就会减少。与这种机制一致的是，我们发现古巴的家长认为，教导与服从规则行为相关的价值观并不那么重要。

abstract.text: Differences in preferences are important to explain variation in individuals' behavior. There is, however, no consensus on how to take these differences into account when evaluating policies. While prominent in the economic literature, the standard utilitarian criterion is controversial. According to some, interpersonal comparability of utilities involves value judgments with little objective basis. Others argue that social justice is primarily about the distribution of commodities assigned to individuals, rather than their subjective satisfaction or happiness. In this paper, we propose and axiomatically characterize a criterion, named opportunity-equivalent utilitarian, that addresses these claims. First, our criterion ranks social alternatives on the basis of individuals' ordinal preferences. Second, it compares individuals based on the fairness of their assignments. Opportunity-equivalent utilitarianism requires society to maximize the sum of specific indices of well-being that are cardinal, interpersonally comparable, and represent each individual's preferences.

10.3982/ecta14151.abstractZh: 偏好差异对于解释个体行为的变化至关重要。然而，在评估政策时如何考虑这些差异尚未形成共识。尽管在经济学文献中这一标准被广泛应用，但标准的功利主义标准仍存在争议。一些人认为，效用的人际可比性涉及缺乏客观依据的价值判断。另一些人则认为，社会正义主要关乎分配给个体的商品分配，而非个体的主观满足或幸福感。在本文中，我们提出并公理化了一种名为“机会等价功利主义”的标准，以回应这些观点。首先，我们的标准根据个体的序数偏好对社会选择进行排序。其次，它基于个体所分配到的商品的公平性来比较个体。机会等价功利主义要求社会最大化那些具有基数性、人际可比性且能反映每个个体偏好的具体福祉指标的总和。

abstract.text: A principal wishes to screen an agent along several dimensions simultaneously. The agent has quasilinear preferences that are additively separable across the various components. We consider a robust version of the principal’s problem, in which she knows the marginal distribution of each component of the agent’s type, but does not know the joint distribution. Any mechanism is evaluated by its worst-case expected profit, over all joint distributions consistent with the known marginals. We show that the optimum for the principal is simply to screen along each component separately. This result does not require any assumptions (such as single-crossing) on the structure of preferences within each component. Applications of the model include monopoly pricing and dynamic taxation. This paper has greatly benefited from conversations with Florian Scheuer, as well as helpful comments from (in random order) Richard Holden, Dawen Meng, Andy

10.3982/ecta14165.abstractZh: 一位委托人希望同时根据多个维度来筛选代理人。代理人的偏好具有准线性特征，并且这些偏好在不同维度之间是可加分的。我们考虑了委托人的问题的一个鲁棒版本，在这个版本中，委托人知道代理人类型中每个维度的边际分布，但不知道联合分布。任何机制的评价标准都是基于其在所有已知边际分布下的最坏情况预期利润。我们证明了委托人的最优选择是分别根据每个维度来筛选代理人。这一结果不需要对每个维度内偏好的结构做出任何假设（例如单一交叉假设）。该模型的应用包括垄断定价和动态税收问题。本文在撰写过程中得到了Florian Scheuer的许多帮助，同时也得到了Richard Holden、Dawen Meng和Andy等人的宝贵意见。

abstract.text: We propose a novel model of stochastic choice: the single-crossing random utility model (SCRUM). This is a random utility model in which the collection of preferences satisfies the single-crossing property. We o↵er a characterization of SCRUMs based on two easy-to-check properties: the classic Monotonicity property and a novel condition, Centrality. The identified collection of preferences and associated probabilities is unique. We show that SCRUMs nest both single-peaked and single-dipped random utility models and establish a stochastic monotone comparative result for the case of SCRUMs.

10.3982/ecta14230.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖的随机选择模型：单交叉随机效用模型（SCRUM）。这是一种随机效用模型，其中偏好集合满足单交叉性质。我们基于两个易于验证的性质对SCRUM进行了表征：经典的单调性性质以及一个新颖的条件——中心性。所确定的偏好集合及其相关概率是一致且唯一的。我们证明了SCRUM既包含单峰随机效用模型，也包含单凹随机效用模型，并为SCRUM的情况建立了一个随机单调比较结果。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a model of competitive bundling with an arbitrary number of firms. In the regime of pure bundling, we find that relative to separate sales pure bundling tends to raise market prices, benefit firms, and harm consumers when the number of firms is above a threshold. This is in contrast to the findings in the duopoly case on which the existing literature often focuses. Our analysis also sheds new light on how consumer valuation dispersion affects price competition more generally. In the regime of mixed bundling, having more than two firms raises new challenges in solving the model. We derive the equilibrium pricing conditions and show that when the number of firms is large, the equilibrium prices have simple approximations and mixed bundling is generally pro-competitive relative to separate sales. Firms' incentives to bundle are also investigated.

10.3982/ecta14251.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个包含任意数量企业的竞争捆绑模型。在纯捆绑机制下，我们发现与单独销售相比，当企业数量超过某个阈值时，捆绑销售往往会提高市场价格，使企业受益，而消费者则受损。这与现有文献通常关注的双寡头情况下的研究结果不同。我们的分析还揭示了消费者估值分散如何影响价格竞争的一般规律。在混合捆绑机制下，超过两个企业的情况会带来新的模型求解挑战。我们推导出了均衡定价条件，并表明当企业数量较大时，均衡价格具有简单的近似表达式，且混合捆绑通常比单独销售更有利于市场竞争。此外，我们还研究了企业进行捆绑销售的动机。

abstract.text: We consider the value of persistent information in strictly competitive situations, formalized as stochastic zero-sum games where only the maximizer ob-serves the state that evolves according to an ergodic Markov operator. We say that operator Q is better for the maximizer than operator P if the value of the game under Q is higher than under P regardless of the stage game. We show that this defines a partial order on the space of ergodic Markov operators, and provide a full characterization of this partial order. An i.i.d. state is the best case for the informed player; however, a perfectly persistent state is not necessarily the worst case. The analysis relies on a novel characterization of the value of a stochastic game with incomplete information. Our results can alternatively be interpreted as pertaining to the limit of the minmax value in repeated Bayesian games with Markov types. 1.

10.3982/ecta14330.abstractZh: 我们考虑在严格竞争情境下持久信息的价值，将其形式化为随机零和博弈，其中只有最大化者能够观察到根据遍历马尔可夫算子演变的状态。如果博弈在Q算子下的价值高于P算子下的价值，无论博弈处于何种阶段，我们称Q算子对最大化者来说优于P算子。我们证明了这定义了遍历马尔可夫算子空间上的一个偏序，并提供了该偏序的完整描述。独立同分布的状态是信息充分的玩家的最佳选择；然而，完全持久的状态并不一定是最坏的情况。该分析依赖于对不完全信息下随机博弈价值的一种新颖描述。我们的结果也可以被解释为与具有马尔可夫类型的重复贝叶斯博弈中最小最大值的极限相关。

abstract.text: The theory of continuous time games (Simon and Stinchcombe (1989), Bergin and MacLeod (1993)) shows that continuous time interactions can generate very different equilibrium behavior than conventional discrete time interactions. We introduce new laboratory methods that allow us to eliminate natural inertia in subjects' decisions in continuous time experiments, thereby satisfying critical premises of the theory and enabling a first-time direct test. Applying these new methods to a simple timing game, we find strikingly large gaps in behavior between discrete and continuous time as the theory suggests. Reintroducing natural inertia into these games causes continuous time behavior to collapse to discrete time-like levels in some settings as predicted by subgame perfect Nash equilibrium. However, contra this prediction, the strength of this effect is fundamentally shaped by the severity of inertia: behavior tends towards discrete time benchmarks as inertia grows large and perfectly continuous time benchmarks as it falls towards zero. We provide evidence that these results are due to changes in the nature of strategic uncertainty as inertia approaches the continuous limit.

10.3982/ecta14346.abstractZh: 连续时间博弈理论（Simon和Stinchcombe，1989年；Bergin和MacLeod，1993年）表明，连续时间的互动可能会产生与传统离散时间互动截然不同的均衡行为。我们引入了新的实验室方法，这些方法能够消除连续时间实验中主体决策中的自然惯性，从而满足该理论的关键前提条件，并允许进行首次直接测试。将这些新方法应用于一个简单的计时博弈，我们发现，正如理论所预测的那样，离散时间和连续时间之间的行为存在显著差异。在某些情况下，重新引入自然惯性会使连续时间行为降至类似离散时间的水平，这与子博弈完美纳什均衡的预测一致。然而，与这一预测相反，这种效应的强度从根本上取决于惯性的大小：当惯性增大时，行为趋向于离散时间的标准；而当惯性趋近于零时，行为则趋向于完全连续的基准。我们有证据表明，这些结果是由于惯性接近连续极限时，战略不确定性的性质发生了变化所导致的。

abstract.text: A mixed manna contains goods (that everyone likes) and bads (that everyone dislikes), as well as items that are goods to some agents, but bads or satiated to others. If all items are goods and utility functions are homogeneous of degree 1 and concave (and monotone), the competitive division maximizes the Nash product of utilities (Gale–Eisenberg): hence it is welfarist (determined by the set of feasible utility profiles), unique, continuous, and easy to compute. We show that the competitive division of a mixed manna is still welfarist. If the zero utility profile is Pareto dominated, the competitive profile is strictly positive and still uniquely maximizes the product of utilities. If the zero profile is unfeasible (for instance, if all items are bads), the competitive profiles are strictly negative and are the critical points of the product of disutilities on the efficiency frontier. The latter allows for multiple competitive utility profiles, from which no single-valued selection can be continuous or resource monotonic. Thus the implementation of competitive fairness under linear preferences in interactive platforms like SPLIDDIT will be more difficult when the manna contains bads that overwhelm the goods.

10.3982/ecta14564.abstractZh: 混合型“玛纳”包含两类物品：一类是大家都喜欢的“好物”，另一类是大家都不喜欢的“坏物”。此外，还有些物品对某些参与者来说是好物，但对其他参与者来说则是坏物或已经满足需求的物品。如果所有物品都是好物，且效用函数具有1阶齐次性、凹性（且单调），那么竞争分配方式能够最大化效用乘积（Gale–Eisenberg模型），因此这种分配方式是福利主义的，且是唯一的、连续的，同时易于计算。我们证明，混合型“玛纳”的竞争分配方式仍然是福利主义的。如果零效用配置是帕累托占优的，那么竞争配置将是严格正的，并且仍然能够最大化效用乘积。如果零效用配置不可行（例如，如果所有物品都是坏物），那么竞争配置将是严格负的，并且是效率边界上非效用乘积的临界点。后者允许存在多个竞争效用配置，从这些配置中无法得出单一值的选择，因为这样的选择既不连续也不单调。因此，在像SPLIDDIT这样的互动平台中，当“玛纳”中坏物过多而好物不足时，实施竞争公平性的难度将会增加。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of intergenerational transmission of preferences that rationalizes the choice between alternative parenting styles (as set out in Baumrind1967). ParentsmaximizeanobjectivefunctionthatcombinesBeckerian altruism and paternalism towards children. They can affect their children’s choices via two channels: either by influencing children’s preferences or by imposing direct restrictions on their choice sets. Different parenting styles (authoritarian, authoritative, and permissive) emerge as equilibrium outcomes, and are affected both by parental preferences and by the socioeconomic environment. Parenting style, in turn, feeds back into the children’s welfare and economic success. The theory is consistent with the decline of authoritarian parenting observed in industrialized countries, and with the greater prevalence of more permissive parenting in countries characterized by low inequality.

10.3982/ecta14634.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种关于代际偏好传递的理论，该理论解释了在 Baumrind（1967）提出的三种不同育儿方式之间的选择。父母会最大化一个结合了 Becker 式的利他主义和对孩子的家长式关怀的客观函数。他们可以通过两种途径影响孩子的选择：一是通过影响孩子的偏好，二是直接限制他们的选择范围。不同的育儿方式（专制型、权威型、放任型）作为均衡结果出现，并受到父母偏好以及社会经济环境的影响。反过来，育儿方式又会影响孩子的福利和经济成就。这一理论与工业化国家中观察到的专制型育儿方式的减少，以及不平等程度较低的国家中更为普遍的放任型育儿方式的存在是一致的。

abstract.text: We study a dynamic principal–agent relationship with adverse selection and limited commitment. We show that when the relationship is subject to productivity shocks, the principal may be able to improve her value over time by progressively learning the agent's private information. She may even achieve her first‐best payoff in the long run. The relationship may also exhibit path dependence, with early shocks determining the principal's long‐run value. These findings contrast sharply with the results of the ratchet effect literature, in which the principal persistently obtains low payoffs, giving up substantial informational rents to the agent.

10.3982/ecta14718.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个存在逆向选择和有限承诺的动态主-代理关系。我们发现，当这种关系受到生产力冲击的影响时，主方可以通过逐步了解代理人的私人信息，从而随着时间的推移提升自身的价值。从长远来看，主方甚至可以实现其最优收益。此外，这种关系还可能表现出路径依赖性，即早期的冲击会决定主方的长期价值。这些发现与“棘轮效应”文献的结果截然不同，在后者中，主方始终获得较低的收益，而放弃了大量的信息租金给代理人。

abstract.text: Procedural failures of physicians or teams in interventional healthcare may positively or negatively predict subsequent patient outcomes. We identify this “learning from failure”-effect by applying (non-)linear dynamic panel methods using data from the Belgian Transcatheter Aorta Valve Implantation (TAVI) registry containing information on the first 860 TAVI procedures in Belgium. Using bias-corrected fixed effects linear probability models and the split-panel jackknife estimator proposed by Dhaene and Jochmans (2015), we find that a previous death positively and significantly predicts subsequent survival of the succeeding patient. Moreover, our results also provide evidence for learning from failure for stroke. We find that these learning from failure effects are not long-living and that learning from failure is transmitted across adverse events, e.g., a stroke affects subsequent survival.

https://openalex.org/W2904327126.abstractZh: 在介入性医疗中，医生或团队的程序性失误可能会对患者的后续结果产生正面或负面的影响。我们通过应用（非）线性动态面板方法，利用比利时经导管主动脉瓣植入术登记数据来识别这种“从失败中学习”的效果。该登记数据包含了比利时前860例经导管主动脉瓣植入术的信息。利用Dhaene和Jochmans（2015年）提出的偏差校正固定效应线性概率模型以及分割面板杰克刀估计方法，我们发现先前发生的死亡会显著地预测后续患者的生存情况。此外，我们的研究结果还为中风后的“从失败中学习”提供了证据。我们发现，这种从失败中学习的效果并非长期有效，而且这种学习效果会跨越不良事件传递，例如，中风会影响后续患者的生存情况。
